title: Fulfillment Coordinator I
description:
Join Liberty and Help Deliver Exceptional Member Experiences

At Liberty Dental Plan, every member interaction matters. As a Fulfillment Coordinator I, you'll play a critical role behind the scenes by ensuring ID cards, member communications, and fulfillment requests are processed accurately, efficiently, and on time. This position is ideal for a highly organized professional who enjoys working in a fast-paced environment, takes pride in attention to detail, and thrives as part of a collaborative team.

About the Role

The Fulfillment Coordinator I is responsible for supporting daily fulfillment operations, including processing ticket requests, preparing mailings, coordinating shipments, maintaining inventory, and assisting with quality control activities. You will work closely with multiple departments and vendors to ensure materials and communications reach members accurately and efficiently.

What You'll Do

  • Respond to daily fulfillment ticket requests and complete assigned production tasks.
  • Print, collate, fold, stuff, meter, seal, count, package, and distribute fulfillment materials.
  • Process and support member ID card requests.
  • Operate fulfillment equipment, including printers, folder inserters, and postage meters.
  • Perform quality checks on outgoing mail and fulfillment materials.
  • Assist with shipping and receiving activities.
  • Coordinate vendor deliveries while following established procedures.
  • Track inventory levels and support supply replenishment efforts.
  • Proofread and edit documents to ensure accuracy and quality.
  • Maintain records, documentation, and fulfillment-related files.
  • Support approval processes and coordinate project requests as needed.
  • Collaborate with internal teams to ensure fulfillment deadlines and service expectations are met.
  • Perform additional duties as assigned.

What You'll Bring

Required Qualifications

  • High school diploma or GED equivalent.
  • Minimum of 2 years of experience in fulfillment, mailroom operations, or a related environment.
  • Experience working with office machinery such as printers, postage equipment, and folding/stuffing machines.
  • Intermediate proficiency with Microsoft Word and Microsoft Excel.
  • Strong proofreading, editing, and documentation skills.
  • Excellent attention to detail and organizational abilities.
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills.
  • Strong time management and prioritization skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple tasks and work effectively despite frequent interruptions.
  • Ability to work both independently and collaboratively as part of a team.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Previous mailroom experience.
  • Experience with inventory tracking, materials management, document archiving, and records maintenance.
  • Knowledge of postal and shipping guidelines.
  • Familiarity with mailroom operations and equipment.
  • Knowledge of inventory and warehousing principles.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and ability to exercise sound judgment.

Who You'll Work With

This role partners with a variety of cross-functional teams, including:

  • Fulfillment Operations
  • Operations
  • Marketing & Communications
  • Quality Assurance/Compliance
  • Member Services/Customer Support
  • Information Technology (IT)
  • Facilities
  • People Operations and Leadership
  • Finance (including Accounts Payable)

Why Join Liberty Dental Plan?

At Liberty Dental Plan, you'll be part of a mission-driven organization dedicated to providing quality dental benefits and exceptional service to the communities we serve. This role offers the opportunity to make a direct impact on the member experience while working alongside supportive teams in a collaborative environment. You'll gain exposure to multiple departments, develop operational expertise, and contribute to processes that help keep our organization running smoothly.

Ready to Apply?

If you're detail-oriented, dependable, and enjoy delivering high-quality work in a fast-paced operational environment, we'd love to hear from you. Apply today and become part of a team committed to excellence and service at Liberty Dental Plan.

title: Firmware Engineer, Manufacturing Test
description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE JOB

As a Firmware Engineer on the Manufacturing Test team you will develop new platforms to interact with our products at the lowest levels (I2C, SPI, CAN, UART, USB, etc). You will work within an interdisciplinary product development team, delivering a streamlined solution for test execution and automation. Your code will ensure that we are consistently shipping the highest quality products to our customers. You will build features targeted at embedded Linux, NIX, and several RTOS platforms. You will debug and solve complex data acquisition challenges in analog and digital realms. In this role you’ll need to think creatively and come up with solutions to solve difficult testing problems and push to continuously improve our methods of automation, throughput, user interfaces, and data analytics.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Build things that test things. Utilize your expertise in firmware/software development to anticipate failure modes and build code for host/client verification of form, fit, function.
  • Develop low-level firmware/software for microcontroller platforms interfacing to robots, or control algorithms for OTS Data acquisition tools.
  • Build capability for device side validation of system-level features, utilizing SSH, gRPC, while creating or leveraging existing debug tools.
  • Quickly debug and troubleshoot issues that span the electrical, firmware, and software boundaries, and transfer that process to automated test and failure analysis SOPs for production line staff.
  • Engage in DFT/DFM reviews with electrical engineering and product firmware teams.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • BS or MS in CS/CE/EE or equivalent industry experience
  • Strong C coding ability for embedded systems
  • Experience integrating microcontrollers with analog and digital sensors
  • Experience developing firmware in bare-metal, RTOS environments, and embedded Linux
  • Solid understanding and application of coding best practices, board bring up and debugging
  • Some familiarity with common bus protocols such as USB, SPI, I2C, CAN, RS232, RS485, Ethernet, etc.
  • Eligible to obtain and maintain an active U.S. Secret security clearance

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bring up and Debug expertise for new designs, comfortable with low and high-speed interfaces
  • Strong fundamentals for data acquisition and analysis (FFT, Bode, control loops)
  • Experience with one or more microcontroller cores (ARM, AVR, MSP430, PIC, etc.)
  • Experience with embedded Linux development and deployment process
  • Debugging skills with JTAG, SWD, Oscilloscopes, and Logic analyzers
  • Have a bias for action. If you see a problem, you want to solve and fix it
  • Be naturally curious about the technologies and tools you use
US Salary Range
$111,000—$147,000 USD

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

  • No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

  • Please always verify communications:
    • Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address.
    • Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.

  • Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

  • What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

Data Privacy

To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit .

By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third-party service provider provides risk-intelligence services that may include analysis of sanctions and watchlists, adverse media, public-record information, and other lawful open-source or commercial data sources. This third-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.

What Will Make You Stand Out

title: Senior Actuarial Associate
description:
American Equity Investment Life Insurance Company is a leading provider of annuity solutions designed to help clients protect and grow retirement income. Part of Brookfield Wealth Solutions, we partner with more than 40,000 financial professionals and help fund over half a million retirements nationwide. Recognized by Newsweek as one of America’s Most Trustworthy Companies and named a Top Workplace in Iowa, American Equity fosters a collaborative and purpose-driven culture where employees are empowered to ignite their passion and help shape the future of financial services.

Headquartered in Des Moines, Iowa, with satellite offices in New York, NY, American Equity provides opportunities for employees to support work across the enterprise, including our sister company, American National, headquartered in Houston, Texas.

GENERAL PURPOSE OF THE JOB:

The Senior Actuarial Associate supports the Company’s VM-22 valuation function through the execution of actuarial modeling, reserve calculations, validation activities, and analytical review. The role contributes to quarterly valuation processes, model implementation efforts, production controls, and reserve reporting while partnering with stakeholders across Actuarial, Finance, Investments, Product, and Technology. The Senior Actuarial Associate develops technical expertise in principle-based reserving and helps ensure valuation results are accurate, well-supported, and delivered on a timely basis.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

· Execute components of the quarterly VM-22 valuation process, including reserve production, reconciliation, documentation, and analytical review.

· Prepare reserve movement analysis and investigate drivers of changes in valuation results.

· Support quarterly and annual financial reporting processes through preparation and validation of actuarial exhibits and supporting materials.

· Support validation, testing, and implementation activities for VM-22 valuation models.

· Perform user acceptance testing, regression testing, and model result verification.

· Assist in the development and maintenance of model documentation and validation materials.

· Identify modeling issues, propose solutions, and support implementation of enhancements.

· Perform actuarial analyses related to annuity reserving, cash flow projections, and asset-liability modeling.

· Develop and maintain analytical tools used to monitor valuation results and key performance indicators.

· Conduct sensitivity testing and experience analysis to support valuation and assumption review activities.

· Research and explain reserve impacts resulting from changes in assumptions, models, products, or market conditions.

· Execute valuation controls and reconciliations to support a well-controlled reporting process.

· Prepare documentation supporting actuarial analyses, valuation processes, and model changes.

· Ensure work products are completed in accordance with applicable professional standards, Company policies, and internal controls.

· Partner with colleagues across Actuarial, Investments, Product, Finance, Risk, and Technology to support valuation initiatives.

· Support implementation of regulatory and business changes affecting VM-22 valuation processes.

· Assist in evaluating the impact of new products, model enhancements, and reporting requirements.

· Maintain and expand knowledge of principle-based reserving, actuarial valuation methodologies, and annuity products.

· Participate in special projects and continuous improvement initiatives related to valuation processes and systems.

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES:

None required for this position.

EDUCATION AND/OR EXPERIENCE:

· Bachelor’s degree in actuarial science, or related field of study; plus a minimum of two (2) years of progressively responsible related actuarial experience, or equivalent combination of education/and experience;

· At least three actuarial exams completed;

· Experience with annuity products, financial reporting, valuation, modeling, or related actuarial functions.

· Experience with principle-based reserving, stochastic modeling, asset-liability modeling, or financial projections is preferred.

· Experience with actuarial modeling platforms such as PathWise, AXIS, Prophet, MG-ALFA, or similar systems is preferred.

LANGUAGE SKILLS:

· Ability to read, analyze, and interpret technical journals, financial reports, and legal documents from regulatory agencies, and other members of the business community.

· Ability to effectively present information to the Actuarial management team.

MATHEMATICAL and TECHNICAL SKILLS:

· Programing experience is highly desirable using VBA, SQL, R or some other language and the desire to apply these programming principles.

· Modeling of annuity products within MG-ALFA (or similar actuarial software) and using tools in Excel, SQL and R to manage model input and output.

· Database inspection in MS SQL server for data collection and validation.

· Ability to comprehend and apply principles of advanced mathematical concepts and

theory.

· Intermediate level experience with MS Excel including pivot tables, VLookup, Indirect, charts, and macros.

· Exposure to MS Teams, Word, Outlook and other day-to-day business applications.

REASONING ABILITY:

· Ability to apply principles of logical thinking to a wide range of intellectual and practical problems.

· Ability to deal with nonverbal symbolism in its most difficult phases.

· Ability to deal with a variety of abstract and concrete variables.

CERTIFICATES, LICENSES, PROFESSIONAL DESIGNATIONS:

· Actively pursuing successful completion of actuarial examinations.

Wat bieden wij?

  • Een salaris in lijn met jouw kennis en ervaring.
  • Telefoon en laptop van de zaak.
  • Veel ruimte om jezelf te ontwikkelen.
  • Volop afwisseling en ruimte voor eigen initiatief.
  • Goede secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden (o.a. pensioenregeling en 26 vakantiedagen)

  • Informele cultuur met leuke collega’s, gezellige (vrijdagmiddag) borrels, uitjes en kantoor feestjes.

Wanneer ben je succesvol?

  • Minimaal 2-3 jaar relevante werkervaring

title: Data Engineer
description:
Ben jij de Data Engineer die ons dataplatform naar een hoger niveau tilt? Dan zoeken wij jou!

Wie zijn wij?

Bij Medicore groeit de hoeveelheid data razendsnel, en jij zorgt dat we daar slimmer gebruik van maken. Bij Medicore help je zorgorganisaties slimmer en toekomstbestendig te werken. Met ons innovatieve platform, AI-oplossingen en ecosysteem van partneroplossingen ondersteunen je klanten bij vraagstukken rondom zorgprocessen, digitalisering, efficiëntie en innovatie.

Uiteraard sta je er niet alleen voor. In Utrecht zetten ongeveer 100 medewerkers, waaronder consultants, accountmanagers, supportmedewerkers en developers, zich dagelijks in voor de zorg. Je werkt intensief samen binnen een scrumteam van developers, testers, UX-designers en een Product Owner, en werkt daarnaast nauw samen met data-analisten, DevOps en customer services.

Samen ontwikkelen we Medicore, ons complete en open ECD voor de klinische en poliklinische GGZ, jeugdzorg en zelfstandige klinieken. Vanzelfsprekend vind je hier modules voor dossierinformatie, registratie en facturatie. Maar Medicore gaat verder. Medicore is een toekomstgericht platform dat naadloos integreert met andere systemen, zoals speech-to-text, AI-assistenten, medicatiebeheer of klantspecifieke apps.

In de afgelopen jaren is er binnen het ECD een enorme hoeveelheid data opgebouwd: verslagen, afspraken, evaluaties en diagnoses. UP brengt deze data samen en maakt deze direct bruikbaar in het dagelijkse werk. UP is de virtuele collega binnen het Medicore ECD-platform die data omzet in overzicht en actiegerichte inzichten. Geen losse informatie, maar precies dat wat op dat moment aandacht vraagt. Zo hoeft de gebruiker niet meer te zoeken in dossiers of te schakelen tussen modules. UP laat zien wat belangrijk is, zodat de behandelaar zich kan focussen op de zorg voor de cliënt.

Wat bieden wij?

  • Bruto salaris tussen de € 5.012, – en € 6.200, – op basis van kennis en ervaring;
  • Mogelijkheden om vanuit huis te werken inclusief € 500,- budget voor de inrichting van een thuiswerkplek;
  • 25 vakantiedagen en de mogelijkheid om bij te kopen;
  • Flexibele werkomgeving en veel autonomie;
  • Reiskostenvergoeding en/of een NS Businesscard;
  • Pensioenregeling en collectiviteitskorting op je zorgverzekering;
  • Ruimte en budget om je te blijven verdiepen in Azure data engineering, Databricks, Microsoft Fabric en Snowflake, bijvoorbeeld via certificeringen, congressen of vakliteratuur;
  • Gezellige vrijdagmiddagborrels;
  • Leuke teamactiviteiten zoals wijn- of kaasproeverijen, skitrips en sportieve events.

Wat ga je doen als Data Engineer bij Medicore?

Als Data Engineer ontwerp, bouw en optimaliseer je moderne data-oplossingen in de Azure Cloud. Je bouwt robuuste data pipelines en werkt actief mee aan een toekomstbestendig, AI-ready dataplatform voor Medicore.

Het toenemende gebruik van Medicore en UP is de aanleiding om het huidige dataplatform continu te evalueren en door te ontwikkelen. Je analyseert de huidige situatie en doet aanbevelingen op basis van jouw kennis en ervaring om zo de performance, schaalbaarheid en stabiliteit van de Medicore producten te verbeteren. Jouw nadruk ligt hier op structurele verbeteringen voor de lange termijn, maar je denkt ook aan mogelijke verbeteringen op de korte termijn.

De belangrijkste taken zijn:

  • Informatiebehoeften ophalen bij stakeholders en vertalen naar concrete datamodellen voor zowel interne projecten als productontwikkeling;
  • Ontsluiten en modelleren van data voor dashboards, analytics en AI-toepassingen;
  • Ontwerpen en ontwikkelen van schaalbare data-oplossingen in Azure;
  • Bouwen en optimaliseren van data pipelines met onder andere MySQL, CUBE en DuckDB;
  • Werken met data tools en platformen op Azure zoals Databricks, Microsoft Fabric en Synapse;
  • Ontwikkelen van (interne) datawarehouse;
  • Samenwerken met data visualiseerders, analisten en AI-specialisten aan innovatieve projecten.

Wat vragen wij van je als Data Engineer?

  • Afgeronde HBO- of WO-opleiding;
  • Minimaal 5 jaar ervaring binnen BI en/of Data Engineering;
  • Je hebt ruime ervaring met het analyseren van datastromen en het signaleren van verschillen tussen de huidige en gewenste situatie;
  • Ervaring met dimensionaal datamodelleren en logical modelling;
  • Ervaring met Python, CUBE en DuckDB;Kennis van moderne data-architecturen;
  • Affiniteit met AI en cloudtechnologie;
  • Kennis van Databricks, Microsoft Fabric of Synapse is een pré;
  • Uitstekende beheersing van Nederlands en Engels;

Naast technische kennis en ervaring hechten wij minstens zoveel waarde aan de juiste soft skills. Je organiseert je werk effectief, communiceert helder met je collega’s en stelt de juiste prioriteiten. Je ziet problemen als kansen en pakt uitdagingen planmatig en oplossingsgericht aan. Je bent leergierig en voelt je verantwoordelijk voor de kwaliteit van het product en de gezamenlijke resultaten.

Bij Medicore werken 100 gepassioneerde medewerkers. Allemaal knappe koppen die elke dag hard werken aan het verbeteren van de zorg. Wij zorgen er als werkgever voor dat onze medewerkers knap blijven en nog knapper worden. Hoe we dat doen? Door te investeren in ontwikkeling, faciliteren van trainingen en opleidingen en het bieden van een goede werk/privé balans.

We stellen het op prijs om zelf de juiste kandidaat te vinden en doen onze werving dus graag zelf. Acquisitie naar aanleiding van deze vacature wordt dan ook niet op prijs gesteld en niet behandeld.

Misschien is deze ook interessant voor jou

title: Data Engineering Manager — Lead AI/Analytics Platform
description:
Metyis, Amsterdam, is seeking a senior Data/AI Architect to lead data platform architecture and end-to-end pipelines using Azure, Databricks, and Python. You will drive the technical roadmap, ensure governance and scalable ETL/ELT solutions, and work with data scientists to deliver data products.

You will mentor a small team, manage stakeholders, and champion cloud-native analytics in a fast-growing, diverse environment.

title: Data Engineer – Energy Forecasting & Optimization
description:
Bij Powerselect ontwikkel je forecastingmodellen en optimalisatie-algoritmes die thuisbatterijen, warmtepompen, laadpalen en andere energie-assets intelligent aansturen. Jouw analyses en modellen maken direct het verschil voor onze klanten én voor de energietransitie.

Jouw uitdaging

Powerselect ontwikkelt een onafhankelijk Energy Management System (EMS) waarmee huishoudens optimaal gebruikmaken van duurzame energie. Ons platform voorspelt energieverbruik, zonneproductie en dynamische energieprijzen en bepaalt vervolgens automatisch de meest efficiënte aansturing van energie-assets.

Als Data Engineer – Energy Forecasting & Optimization ben jij verantwoordelijk voor het ontwikkelen en verbeteren van de algoritmes achter deze intelligente aansturing. Je vertaalt grote hoeveelheden data naar betrouwbare voorspellingen en slimme optimalisaties die dagelijks in productie worden gebruikt.

Je werkt op het snijvlak van data engineering, softwareontwikkeling en energietechnologie. Daarbij krijg je veel vrijheid om nieuwe technieken te onderzoeken en direct toe te passen binnen ons platform.

Je kunt rekenen op

Als Data Engineer – Energy Forecasting & Optimization kun je rekenen op:
Bij Powerselect krijg je de kans om te werken aan innovatieve software die dagelijks impact heeft op de energietransitie. Je komt terecht in een ambitieus team waar veel ruimte is voor eigen initiatief, technische verdieping en persoonlijke ontwikkeling.

Wat ga je doen?

Maak het verschil als Data Engineer – Energy Forecasting & Optimization

In deze functie ben je verantwoordelijk voor het bouwen, testen en in productie brengen van de datapipelines, forecastingmodellen en optimalisatie-algoritmes die dagelijks honderden energie-assets aansturen.

Je vertaalt complexe berekeningen naar robuuste, schaalbare productiecode. Niet alleen het model is interessant, maar vooral hoe het betrouwbaar blijft draaien en aantoonbaar waarde levert voor onze klanten.

Kortom, jouw dagelijkse werkzaamheden bestaan onder andere uit:

  • Het bouwen en onderhouden van datapipelines voor meetdata, marktinformatie, forecasts en apparaatdata;
  • Het ontwikkelen van schaalbare, productieklare code voor data- en AI-oplossingen;
  • Het ontwikkelen van forecastingmodellen voor energieverbruik, zonneproductie, dynamische energieprijzen en de beschikbaarheid van energie-assets;
  • Het ontwikkelen van optimalisatie-algoritmes voor de intelligente aansturing van thuisbatterijen, warmtepompen, laadpalen en andere energie-assets;
  • Het testen, valideren en optimaliseren van modellen in productie;
  • Het analyseren van prestaties en gerealiseerde energiebesparingen;
  • Het vertalen van technische analyses naar heldere inzichten voor klanten en collega's;
  • Het actief bijdragen aan de verdere ontwikkeling van ons Energy Management Platform, inclusief de onderliggende data-infrastructuur.

Wat neem je mee?

Je bent een data engineer in hart en nieren: je bouwt, test en onderhoudt productiesystemen, en je krijgt energie van het vertalen van complexe berekeningen naar code die het dagelijks moet doen. Je bent nieuwsgierig naar hoe energie daadwerkelijk door een woning beweegt, maar wilt dat vooral vastleggen in werkende, schaalbare software.

Dit is geen data analyst-rol: we zoeken iemand die modellen ook bouwt, test en in productie zet, en die op termijn ook onze onderliggende data-infrastructuur (database, data fetching) mede inricht en optimaliseert.

Verder neem je mee:

  • Een afgeronde hbo- of wo-opleiding richting Informatica, Data Engineering, Wiskunde, Data Science / AI of een vergelijkbare technische opleiding;
  • Ervaring met data engineering en het ontwikkelen van software voor productieomgevingen;
  • Ervaring met Python;
  • Ervaring met het verwerken en analyseren van grote hoeveelheden data;
  • Affiniteit met forecasting, optimalisatie en algoritmeontwikkeling;
  • Een gestructureerde en analytische werkwijze;
  • Goede communicatieve vaardigheden;
  • Een proactieve en zelfstandige werkhouding;
  • Goede beheersing van de Nederlandse en Engelse taal.

Ervaring met één of meerdere van onderstaande technieken is een pré:

Data engineering & software

  • SQL en datamodellering
  • Orchestratie, bijvoorbeeld Airflow, Prefect of Dagster
  • Cloud platforms, bijvoorbeeld Azure
  • CI/CD en geautomatiseerd testen
  • Git en productiecode-praktijken
  • API-integraties met externe systemen

Forecasting & optimalisatie

  • MILP / optimalisatietechnieken
  • Pyomo
  • PuLP
  • CVXPY
  • OR-Tools
  • Gurobi
  • CPLEX
  • HiGHS
  • Machine Learning
  • Deep Learning
  • Feature Engineering
  • Backtesting
  • Counterfactuals
  • Baseline-analyses

Je kunt rekenen op

Als Data Engineer – Energy Forecasting & Optimization kun je rekenen op:
Bij Powerselect krijg je de kans om te werken aan innovatieve software die dagelijks impact heeft op de energietransitie. Je komt terecht in een ambitieus team waar veel ruimte is voor eigen initiatief, technische verdieping en persoonlijke ontwikkeling.

Dit bieden wij jou nog meer:

  • Een uitstekend bruto maandsalaris tussen de €4.392,- en €5.825,- op basis van een fulltime dienstverband, afhankelijk van jouw kennis en ervaring;
  • 25 vakantiedagen en 13 ATV-dagen op basis van een fulltime dienstverband;
  • Een goede pensioenregeling conform CAO Metaal & Techniek;
  • Een winstdelingsregeling afhankelijk van het bedrijfsresultaat;
  • Volop mogelijkheden om jezelf te ontwikkelen via opleidingen en cursussen;
  • Flexibele werktijden waar de functie dit toelaat;
  • Bedrijfsfitness via Bedrijfsfitness Nederland;
  • Mogelijkheid om een fiets te leasen via Lease a Bike;
  • Een informele werksfeer met korte lijnen en betrokken collega’s;
  • Een actieve personeelsvereniging met leuke activiteiten en evenementen.

Aanvullende voorwaarden:

  • Mogelijkheid tot hybride werken;
  • Werken binnen een innovatieve Business Unit met veel ruimte voor eigen initiatief;
  • De kans om mee te bouwen aan een snelgroeiend softwareplatform voor de energietransitie;
  • Internationale samenwerking met leveranciers, partners en klanten;
  • Mogelijkheid om (internationaal) te reizen wanneer de functie of projecten daarom vragen;
  • Vergoedingen voor overnachtingen conform de geldende regelingen;
  • Parttime werken behoort, afhankelijk van de functie, tot de mogelijkheden.

Over Van Gooi

Over Van Gooi

Powerselect is de nieuwste Business Unit van Van Gooi en richt zich volledig op slimme energieoplossingen voor woningen. Met een onafhankelijk Energy Management System sturen wij momenteel vooral thuisbatterijen aan. De komende jaren breiden we ons platform verder uit met warmtepompen, laadpalen en PV-omvormers. Zo helpen we huishoudens optimaal gebruik te maken van duurzame energie, dynamische energieprijzen en slimme automatisering.

Als onderdeel van Van Gooi combineren we de slagkracht van een gevestigde technische organisatie met de snelheid en innovatiekracht van een groeiende startup. Binnen Powerselect krijg je veel vrijheid, werk je in een klein gespecialiseerd team en bouw je mee aan een product dat een belangrijke bijdrage levert aan de energietransitie.

Jouw werkgebied
Je werkt vanuit onze locatie in Utrecht, waar softwareontwikkeling, data engineering en productontwikkeling nauw samenwerken. Afhankelijk van de projecten heb je rechtstreeks contact met internationale fabrikanten van thuisbatterijen, laadpalen, warmtepompen en andere energie-assets.

Binnen het team krijg je veel vrijheid om technische keuzes te maken en actief mee te denken over de verdere ontwikkeling van ons Energy Management Platform.

title: Fresh Foods Clerk
description:
About Us

Join us at WinCo Foods, where we're more than just a grocery retailer - we're a growing family of over 140 supermarkets in 10 states with over 22,000 employee owners. Our purpose is to make the lives of our customers and employee owners better by offering the lowest possible prices to feed their families. Currently, WinCo is the second largest Employee-Owned company in the United States. With more than 500 millionaire employee-owners in our Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP). Our benefits, including top-tier medical plans and tuition support set us apart. In your role, you'll be instrumental in making a real impact in the communities we serve, embodying our purpose every day.

Overview

Job Summary

Assist customers by providing over-the-counter service and customer service throughout the Fresh Foods department. Operates and maintains the fresh food production areas (Deli/Seafood/Pizza), prepares the areas for sales, fries food, operates the rotisserie oven, prepares ready-to-bake/baked pizzas, etc. Receives inventory, verifies receipt of ordered product, and stocks in designated areas. Consistently provides friendly, courteous service to internal and external customers. Performs other related work. Generally works 6-8 hour shifts between 5:00 am and 10:00 pm.

Typical Duties and Responsibilities

  • Seeks opportunities to welcome, engage, serve, and thank customers. Maintains an atmosphere of friendly, enthusiastic customer service with an emphasis of taking care of the customer.
  • Takes orders, answers questions, and performs suggestive selling.
  • Prepares, stocks, displays, straightens, and rotates product in fresh food areas (Deli/Seafood/Pizza).
  • Prepare production items according to recipes, food safety procedures, and/or specified cooking times
  • Handles frozen product.
  • Inspects all product for quality and freshness
  • Prepares case by putting the product in fresh pans, rotating product, putting product back, filling, etc.
  • Places proper signage on all products which includes pricing, description, code dating, and COOL information on all required products.
  • Cleans and maintains department equipment such as fryers, slicers, etc. by breaking down and reassembling equipment, operating dish washer and hand washing dishes, cleaning all appropriate parts with sanitizing solution.
  • Maintains clean and sanitary department by washing parts, tables and wrapping stations; taking trash and paper to the appropriate balers; cleans floors and coolers; cleaning and maintaining glass display counters on the inside and out; etc.
  • Receives inventory, stocks, verifies receipt of ordered product and orders.
  • Follows strict sanitary guidelines and completes associated records.
  • Performs other duties as assigned or needed.
  • Understands and follows all food safety procedures and requirements.

Requirements

Ability to:

  • Work varied shifts in a 24/7 operation; including night, weekends and holidays.
  • Communicate (hearing & speech) effectively with customers to receive orders and perform customer relation skills.
  • Conduct visual inspections, read and follow production guides, recipes and product labels, log production quantities, temperature readings, etc. on proper forms.
  • Perform basic math (add, subtract, divide and multiply) and compute weights and measures.
  • Perform duties with mental alertness involving potential hazards with respect to related procedures, equipment (e.g., knives) and work aides.
  • Complete training course and meet minimum time standards of productivity and accuracy.
  • Wear hair net, beard net and gloves and other personal protective equipment as required.
  • Use cleaning chemicals and handle related food products.
  • Stand, walk and move rapidly for extended periods of time.
  • Bend, stoop, twist, turn and reach over the counter and in tight areas frequently.
  • Lift up to 50 lbs. occasionally and reach, push and pull racks.
  • Handle refrigerated goods (-20°F to 28°F)
  • Work around machinery emitting heat (400°F rotisserie and 325°F hot shortening).
  • Must be 16 years of age or older.
  • Perform primary duties efficiently and accurately.

Additional Requirements:

  • Food Handlers Certification (Per State Laws)

Machines and Equipment Operated:

  • Cash Register
  • Film over wrapper, digital scales, etc.
  • Knives and other kitchen utensils.
  • Electric Slicers
  • Deep fryers, ovens, etc.
  • Oil filtering machine
  • Dishwasher
  • Trash compactor
  • Cardboard bailer
  • Hand, pallet jack
  • Conveyor ovens

The above statements are intended to describe the general nature of work performed by the employees assigned to this job. All employees must comply with Company policies and applicable laws. The responsibilities, duties and qualifications required of personnel may vary.

EEO/Inclusivity

As the WinCo Foods community continues to grow, our variety of perspectives and wide range of experiences are essential to our strategy and success. We are committed cultivating and celebrating an inclusive environment in which all employees are valued and respected.

Fraud alert: WinCo advises job seekers to be cautious of unsolicited job offers and to verify the authenticity of any communication claiming to be from WinCo by checking the official WinCo careers website.

Pay Range

USD $21.82 - USD $26.60 /Hr.

title: 13609 - Community Integration Practitioner
description:
At S.U.C.C.E.S.S., you will be able to grow and develop alongside a diverse team of professionals and enjoy great benefits and perks. Experience what it is like to join a purpose-driven organization and make meaningful contributions to our community. Explore our amazing new opportunities.


Division: Integrated Services for Newcomers

Program: Settlement & Family Services - ISIP

Employment Type: Permanent Full-Time (35 hours/week)

Number of Positions: 1

Compensation: $24.32 - $25.04 per hour

About the Position:

Deliver outcome-oriented settlement program to eligible clients. The Community Integration Practitioner delivers settlement services for seniors, women, men and youth under the following components:

a) Needs Assets Assessments and Referrals, b) Information and Orientation, c) Employment Related Services, d) Community Connections and e) Support Services.

Reports to: Senior Settlement Program Manager

Key Duties & Responsibilities:

  • Performs formal review of newcomer needs across a broad spectrum of settlement areas (e.g. language, employment, housing, community connections, etc.)
  • Develops Settlement Plans and follow-up support for newcomers based on identified needs with consideration of government, professional, business and community services available
  • Performs clients’ data entry
  • Refers or arranges clients to appropriate services as needed (e.g. crisis counselling)
  • Provides newcomers with client-centered settlement and integration information and orientation services about Canada plus the community they intend to settle
  • Delivers one-on-one consultations via various communication methods (e.g. in-person, email, online and by phone)
  • Provides information and orientation through workshops, group sessions and classes
  • Liaises with government, professional groups, businesses, schools and community services as necessary to ensure provision of up-to-date, accurate and detailed information to newcomers and client settlement needs
  • Facilitates guided visits for newcomers to foster familiarization with existing government and community resources
  • Plans and implements large and small events
  • Performs cultural interpretation between clients and service providers
  • Performs interpretation for workshop speakers where applicable
  • Translates resources for newcomers
  • Plans, implements and assists in events such as job fairs, community networking events and more.
  • Conducts outreach to local community organizations (e.g. public libraries, community recreation and senior’s centres, government institutions, schools, food banks, cultural and faith-based institutions, and other local community and social networks) in order to conduct program promotion and recruit new clients
  • Provides settlement assistance and support to newcomers arriving in YVR
  • Attends program meetings on service delivery issues
  • Provides up-to-date information to the supervisor within the service region regarding changes to community services, government departments and procedures
  • Works on improving program service outcomes and day-to-day services for newcomers by participating in professional development programs as assigned
  • Documents clients’ needs, settlement plans, attendance records, and program outcomes to client database
  • Performs other related duties as assigned by supervisor

Education, Training and Experience:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Social or Human Sciences
  • Experience in working with newcomers, refugees, temporary foreign workers, naturalized citizens and international students
  • Experience with multicultural clientele and immigrant related services
  • Possession of Certified Career Development Practitioner (CCDP) Certification is considered as an asset
  • Experience in conducting workshops and events
  • Experience in one-on-one settlement service delivery
  • Knowledge of settlement information and resources
  • Knowledge of the local geographic area

Job Skill and Abilities:

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Excellent interpersonal and intercultural communication skills
  • Ability to work independently and as a part of a team
  • Second language may be an asset when required to meet operational needs in serving communities with specific language requirements
  • Excellent technical skills in MS Office and web-based applications (e.g. MS Teams and Zoom)
  • Excellent resource, time management and organizational skills
  • Excellent attention to detail and commitment to excellence in service delivery
  • Excellent group facilitation skills
  • Ability to work with individuals and communities facing cultural adjustment challenges
  • Ability to design, promote, deliver and facilitate orientation and education workshops

Additional Information:

  • Criminal Record Check Required
  • Able to work evenings and weekends as required

About S.U.C.C.E.S.S.:

S.U.C.C.E.S.S. is a multicultural social services agency and registered charity located on the unceded Coast Salish lands of the xʷməθkʷəy̓əm (Musqueam), Sḵwx̱wú7mesh (Squamish), and Səl̓ílwətaʔ/Selilwitulh (Tsleil-Waututh) Nations, S.U.C.C.E.S.S. has been helping Canadians and newcomers to achieve their full potential on their Canadian journey since 1973. We are one of the largest social service agencies in Canada, with offices in BC, Ontario and internationally/abroad. We offer programs and services in the areas of immigration, newcomer settlement, English-language training, employment and entrepreneurship, family, youth and seniors programming, health education, community development, affordable housing and seniors care.

At S.U.C.C.E.S.S., we take care of our communities and our people!


Our staff is the source of our success and we make it a priority to ensure work-life balance for our staff. We offer a range competitive and comprehensive benefit packages to ensure the well-being our staff. Subject to the type of employment, benefit packages may include:

  • Additional agency holidays (3 additional statutory holidays)
  • 3 weeks annual vacation (starting) and up to 6 weeks (maximum)
  • Company-funded pension (GRRSP)
  • Extended health & dental plan
  • Employee & family assistance programs
  • Access to wellness programs, and more


S.U.C.C.ES.S. is an equal opportunity employer. We are dedicated to building an inclusive environment that embraces diversity of thought, backgrounds and experiences. We are committed to the equitable treatment of all individuals and will continue to embed diversity and inclusion principles within our policies, procedures, services, and activities.

Interested applicants should forward their applications by 11:59PM, October 5, 2026.

While we appreciate all applications, only those selected for an interview will be contacted.

title: Harness Manufacturing Intern (Summer 2027)
description:
Astranis builds advanced satellites for high orbits, expanding humanity’s reach into the solar system. Today, Astranis satellites provide dedicated, secure networks to highly-sophisticated customers across the globe— large enterprises, sovereign governments, and the US military. With five satellites on orbit and many more set to launch soon, the company is servicing a backlog of more than $1 billion of commercial contracts.

Astranis is the preferred satellite communications partner for buyers with stringent requirements for uptime, data security, network visibility, and customization. Astranis has raised over $750 million from some of the world’s best investors, from Andreessen Horowitz to Blackrock and Fidelity, and employs a team of 450 engineers and entrepreneurs. Astranis designs, builds, and operates its satellites out of its 153,000 sq. ft. headquarters in Northern California, USA.

Harness Manufacturing Intern (Summer 2027)

Internships at Astranis typically last for twelve weeks, and are hourly roles designed for students who are currently enrolled at a four-year university.

As an Intern, you will have an amazing opportunity to work on hard problems — we pride ourselves on giving everyone at Astranis a chance to do meaningful work on challenging projects, no matter their seniority. Many past interns have designed and tested hardware/software that is currently in space or heading to space shortly on on of our satellites, and many of them are now full-time employees at Astranis.

If you have already graduated from a four-year university, please apply to be an Associate Engineer.

Role

  • The Harness Manufacturing Intern will support the design, build, and continuous improvement of wire harness and cable assembly processes. This role provides hands-on exposure to production environments, manufacturing documentation, quality systems, and process optimization in a low/medium volume production setting.
  • Support manufacturing engineers with process documentation and work instruction review
  • Assist with wire harness and cable assembly builds, including cutting, stripping, crimping, labeling, and lacing
  • Participate in quality inspections
  • Help analyze manufacturing issues such as defects, rework, and throughput constraints
  • Assist with equipment qualification, tooling and fixture improvements, and test setups
  • Support DFM/DFA feedback to engineering teams
  • Collect and review production data for process improvement initiatives

Requirements

  • Currently pursuing a four-year degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related technical field
  • A passion for hardware development, including working in a fast-paced environment and hands-on design and development
  • Ability to handle multiple tasks and prioritize
  • Strong communication skills
  • Familiarity with spacecraft systems and operation
  • Must be onsite 5 days a week

Bonus

  • Hands-on experience in designing, building, and testing any type or hardware
  • Experience working a laboratory or industrial environment
  • Experience in CAD
  • Direct electrical or mechanical design experience

title: Senior Technical Business Analyst

title: Data Engineer
description:
Bouw de datalaag van ons platform vanaf de grond op

Bij Green Collective draait alles om een slim, duurzaam Mendix Platform. De volgende stap? Een volwaardige data- en BI-laag in Snowflake, gevoed vanuit dat platform. Als Data Engineer krijg jij die klus: je bouwt de complete keten van data uit Mendix, via modellering in Snowflake, tot dashboards waarmee collega’s kunnen sturen.

Je bent verantwoordelijk voor de volledige data-pijplijn en de technische keuzes daarin. Je werkt nauw samen met onze Mendix developers (die de bron kennen) en de product owner (die de businessdefinities bewaakt). Concreet:

  • Je leest de OData/REST-API’s van ons Mendix-platform (Mendix Cloud) uit en bepaalt de slimste extractiestrategie (full load of incrementeel).
  • Je zet orchestratie, scheduling, monitoring en alerting op voor betrouwbare dataflows.
  • Je richt Snowflake in en beheert het: databases, schemas, warehouses, rollen, kostenbeheer en security, inclusief zorgvuldige omgang met gevoelige contractdata conform de AVG.
  • Je modelleert ruwe data naar een bruikbaar dimensioneel model en bewaakt de datakwaliteit.
  • Je zet datasets, views en dashboards klaar voor BI-tooling en richt waar mogelijk een self-service laag in.
  • Je haakt aan bij Mendix-releases om te voorkomen dat schemawijzigingen je pipelines breken, en signaleert wanneer brondata ontbreekt.

Wat breng je mee?

  • Aantoonbare ervaring met Snowflake (of een vergelijkbaar cloud data warehouse zoals BigQuery of Redshift).
  • Sterke SQL-vaardigheden, bij voorkeur met ervaring in dbt.
  • Ervaring met het bouwen van ETL/ELT-pipelines en API-integraties.
  • Kennis van dimensioneel modelleren (star schema’s, slowly changing dimensions).
  • Ervaring met BI-tooling zoals Power BI, Tableau of Looker.
  • Je schakelt zelfstandig tussen techniek en business en durft door te vragen bij onduidelijke databehoeften.
  • Affiniteit met Mendix/low-code is een pré, maar geen vereiste. Goede beheersing van Nederlands en Engels.

Wat bieden we?

Een rol met veel eigenaarschap: jij bouwt de data-infrastructuur vanaf de grond op. Je werkt direct samen met Mendix developers, de product owner en de performance manager, en krijgt de ruimte om zelf tooling en werkwijze (bijvoorbeeld dbt en orchestratie-tooling) mee te bepalen. Daarnaast: hybride werken, flexibele werktijden en een informele werkomgeving met korte lijnen. Verder een marktconform salaris (€4500,- tot €5800,- bruto per maand), met goede secundaire voorwaarden (pensioen, reiskosten, 27,5 vakantiedagen).

title: Lead AI Solutions Delivery Engineer
description:
Company Overview



Docusign brings agreements to life. Over 1.5 million customers and more than a billion people in over 180 countries use Docusign solutions to accelerate the process of doing business and simplify people’s lives. With intelligent agreement management, Docusign unleashes business-critical data that is trapped inside of documents. Until now, these were disconnected from business systems of record, costing businesses time, money, and opportunity. Using Docusign’s Intelligent Agreement Management platform, companies can create, commit, and manage agreements with solutions created by the #1 company in e-signature and contract lifecycle management (CLM).


What you'll do



As a AI Solution Deployment Engineer, you will be on the front lines, embedded directly with strategic enterprise customers to solve complex business problems using Docusign’s proprietary Agentic capabilities, third-party AI integrations, and existing tech stacks. You will bridge the gap between business and technology, defining customer workflows, designing bespoke architectures, writing code, and engineering prompts to deliver tangible business outcomes. You will leverage Docusign’s IAM Platform, Docusign and third Party MCP servers, APIs, and third party integrations with leading AI ecosystems (like OpenAI, Microsoft CoPilot, and Claude) to optimize enterprise agreement lifecycles against contract populations exceeding millions of agreements. By capturing insights from these field deployments, you will collaborate cross-functionally with Docusign’s product and engineering teams to shape our long-term AI roadmap. This role is a perfect fit if you thrive in client-facing environments and have a proven track record deploying GenAI and LLMs in production.

This position is an individual contributor role reporting to the Sr. Director, Value Delivery Realization.

Responsibility

  • Design and lead cross functional customer-facing engagements to develop and deploy a modern Agentic vision of Agreement Management business processes

  • Design, build, and deploy AI enabled workflows and solutions that integrate Docusign AI capabilities including but not limited to, Docusign’s MCP Server and APIs, Docusign Web Forms backed by APIs to third party systems, Custom Extractions, Docusign skills in 3rd party agentic platforms (e.g. Docusign’s integration with Open AI, Claude Cowork, Microsoft CoPilot, Harvey and Legora) and other similar customer Agentic Tech stacks to automate and optimize customer business processes

  • Execute deployment 'firsts' to prove out, capture, and productionize new Agentic implementation patterns, repeatable use cases and toolkits

  • Run technical demos, trainings, and workshops for technical and non-technical audiences

  • Partner directly with customer stakeholders, Docusign product, engineering, success, services and partner team members and third party system integrators to translate open-ended operational business requirements into production level AI enabled business solutions

  • Memorialize repeatable deployment strategies and contribute insights and learnings back to Docusign product and engineering teams

  • Develop robust data pipelines, containerized microservices, distributed system architectures, and system context management repositories to ensure autonomous AI tools operate accurately and reliably

  • Maintain strong knowledge of the latest developments in LLM capabilities, implementation patterns, and AI product development stacks

  • Synthesize field learnings, establish repeatable configuration scripts and deployment patterns, and develop cross functional data based recommendations to establish and deliver product consulting toolkits to establish enterprise-deployable implementation guides

  • Partner with our Partner Enablement and larger partner organization to equip the partner ecosystem to implement well-architected solutions by contributing repeatable deployment best practices and blueprints

  • Evaluate human and AI-generated code critically for correctness, quality, security, performance, and compliance within isolated cloud environments


Job Designation



Hybrid: Employee divides their time between in-office and remote work. Access to an office location is required. (Frequency: Minimum 2 days per week; may vary by team but will be weekly in-office expectation)

Positions at Docusign are assigned a job designation of either In Office, Hybrid or Remote and are specific to the role/job. Preferred job designations are not guaranteed when changing positions within Docusign. Docusign reserves the right to change a position's job designation depending on business needs and as permitted by local law.


What you bring



Basic

  • Bachelor's or advanced degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Computer Engineering, Statistics, Operations Research, etc.or equivalent practical experience

  • 12+ years of experience in software engineering, deployment-focused engineering, or customer-facing technical delivery roles, in an established technology company, including AI focused startups or scale-ups

  • 18-24 months experience implementing LLMs, production-grade GenAI applications, autonomous agents, and or orchestration frameworks for production level software, with a preference for experience designing agent-based or LLM-powered applications beyond simple API calls, including multi-step workflows, orchestration, and failure handling

  • Experience working directly with customers during POCs, architecture reviews, and technical evaluation

  • Experience with Python, Java, C++ or systems fundamentals

Preferred

  • Strong communication and customer engagement skills for conducting customer discovery and conveying and synthesizing technical concepts to/from diverse stakeholders, including non-technical audiences

  • A passion for driving and taking responsibility for customer outcomes, rather than just making customer recommendations

  • A bias toward action and a “learning posture” in the ever changing world of AI and LLMs with the ability figure things out on the fly

  • Excitement about building and operating AI agents in production, learning with customers, and then sharing those learnings with cross functional teams

  • Prior experience as a forward deployed engineer, customer-facing technical lead, startup CTO, enterprise architect or software engineer with consulting experience

  • Experience deploying autonomous agents or AI orchestration frameworks within highly regulated environments such as finance or healthcare

  • Deep understanding of data security, compliance frameworks, and isolated enterprise cloud deployments

  • Ability to collaborate cross functionally and “love of learning” posture to support the rapid development in the AI space

  • Willingness and ability to travel 25–50% of the time to customer sites as required


Life at Docusign

title: R&D Specialist

description:
Position Summary:

The R&D Specialist plays an important role in supporting product development, innovation, and quality within the R&D team. This position is responsible for preparing and evaluating sauce formulations and customer samples, conducting laboratory testing, maintaining an organized and well-controlled R&D environment, and supporting documentation and regulatory activities as needed.

The R&D Specialist works closely with R&D, Regulatory, Quality, and Operations teams to ensure samples and testing are completed accurately and on time. This role requires strong attention to detail, good organization, and the ability to work effectively in a fast-paced food manufacturing environment.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Prepare and organize sauce and food product samples for internal testing, customer evaluations, and product development activities.
  • Follow established formulations, procedures, and test methods accurately and consistently.
  • Conduct laboratory testing and analysis of R&D samples, including pH, Brix, viscosity, water activity, salt, and other applicable measurements.
  • Support shelf-life studies, stability testing, and sensory evaluations, including sample preparation, testing, data collection, and documentation.
  • Maintain accurate, complete, and organized records of formulations, test results, samples, and other R&D activities.
  • Maintain a clean, organized, and safe R&D laboratory, including proper labeling, storage, inventory, and handling of ingredients and samples.
  • Ensure ingredients, samples, and finished products are properly identified, dated, and stored under the appropriate conditions.
  • Support preparation and shipment of customer samples, ensuring samples are prepared accurately, packaged appropriately, and delivered on schedule.
  • Work closely with R&D team members to support product development trials, reformulations, and process improvement activities.
  • Support plant trials and production activities when required, including sample collection, testing, and documentation.
  • Communicate test results, observations, and potential issues clearly and promptly to the appropriate team members.
  • Follow all company policies and procedures related to food safety, workplace safety, quality, sanitation, and confidentiality.
  • Maintain and operate laboratory equipment properly and report equipment issues or maintenance needs.
  • Assist with other R&D projects and activities as required.

title: Inventory Control

Full-time 7am to 4pm with breaks. Some flexibility will be needed to close out monthly and quarterly shipments.

After a 30-day waiting period full-time employees become eligible for Medical, Dental and Vision insurance, paid holidays and paid time off that increases with longevity. After 90 days you can participate in 401K.

title: Medior Data Engineer
description:
Wij zijn op zoek naar een Medior Data Engineer

Locatie Utrecht Opleidingsniveau WO Werkervaring 3+ Vereiste taal Nederlands

Wie zoeken wij?

Bijt jij je graag vast in complexe materie, maak jij de code snel eigen en bouw je van daaruit aan systemen waarmee je mensen écht verder helpt? Spreekt het je aan om bij te dragen aan vraagstukken rondom klimaatverandering en waterbeheer? Dan zijn wij op zoek naar jou.

Bij Nelen & Schuurmans werken al jaren technisch aangelegde hydrologen met interesse in data engineering, maar we draaien we het om: wij zijn op zoek naar een Data Engineer die bereid is zich te verdiepen in de wereld van hydrologie.

Je gaat werken met Data Pipelines, FME-workflows, Django-applicaties en andere technische oplossingen. Je bent inhoudelijk gedreven, betrokken en creatief genoeg om de vraag achter de vraag te vinden. Niet om puur alleen een oplossing te leveren, maar om met onze applicaties verschil te maken voor de klanten die voor complexe uitdagingen staan.

Wat doen wij?

Binnen de afdeling zetten wij ons actief in voor het regionale waterbeheer. We leveren advies en werken aan applicaties voor verschillende thema’s binnen het waterbeheer, zoals de basisregistratie ondergrond (BRO), waterveiligheid, of de sturing & optimalisatie van watersystemen. Zo zijn wij voor ongeveer de helft van alle waterschappen actief in het operationele waterbeheer. We beheren, sturen en optimaliseren hun waterbeheer aan de hand van operationele scripts in FEWS. Data Engineering in het waterbeheer wordt hierbij steeds belangrijker.

We realiseren datakoppelingen voor Flood Early Warning Systemen (FEWS), Beslissingsondersteunende Systemen voor water (BOS) of bijvoorbeeld voor de BRO. Ook bouwen we applicaties (variërend van Django-applicaties, Python-aangestuurde modules tot QGIS plug-ins), die helpen om de klantvraag te beantwoorden.

Een onderdeel van de werkzaamheden zal bestaan uit het creëren en verbeteren van dashboards, met bijvoorbeeld PowerBI of Tableau. Binnen hydrodynamische modelstudies (bv. Met D-Hydro, Rana HCC, HEC-HMS) help je bij het visueel maken van resultaten en denk je mee over het gebruik van AI-tools om processen te versnellen.

Hoe ziet een dag eruit als Data Engineer?

Als Data Engineer werk je vaak aan meerdere projecten tegelijk, waardoor geen dag hetzelfde is. Zo begin je de ochtend bijvoorbeeld met het uitwerken van een architectuur en bijbehorende uitgangspunten voor een datakoppeling in een van onze dashboards. Daarna schuif je aan bij een overleg met ontwikkelaars om een Django applicatie door te spreken.

Rond 12:30 lunch je samen met collega’s in de kantine. Na de lunch wandel je met een groepje door de Utrechtse binnenstad om even op te frissen voor de middag.

Die middag duik je in code: je bouwt en optimaliseert scripts en werkt aan nieuwe functionaliteiten. Vervolgens tref je de laatste voorbereidingen voor een werksessie die je morgen organiseert bij een gemeente, provincie of waterschap.

Aan het einde van de dag werk je je mail bij en zie je een uitnodiging binnenkomen voor het tweewekelijkse kennisuurtje op donderdagmiddag. Het thema deze keer: hoe klimaatscenario’s worden opgesteld en hoe we deze kunnen verwerken in onze adviezen.

Dit vragen wij van jou

  • Je hebt een WO-diploma en kan op academisch niveau denken en analyseren.
  • Je hebt ervaring en plezier in het bouwen van applicaties, data-analyses en opzetten van data koppelingen.
  • Je vindt het leuk om naar oplossingen te zoeken, denkt mee met je collega’s en klanten en hebt een scherp vermogen om problemen te doorgronden.
  • Je hebt interesse om te werken aan thema’s zoals klimaatadaptatie, waterbeheer en waterveiligheid.
  • Je hebt ervaring met Python en scripting. Je weet hoe je onderhoudbare en leesbare code opstelt. Kennis van Django en Prefect zijn een pre.
  • Je bent bereid plannen, ideeën en aanpakken uit te werken en te communiceren, voor gesprekken en offertes.

We denken dat je nog meer waarde kan toevoegen als je al interesse hebt in het opbouwen en onderhouden van klantrelaties. Ook zien we het als meerwaarde als je iemand bent die zich wil blijven ontwikkelen, en je het lef hebt om feedback te geven zodat ook anderen kunnen leren. Je kan zowel zelfstandig als in een team werken en je wilt graag dat jouw werk goede resultaten oplevert.

Dit bieden we jou

Bij Nelen & Schuurmans staan weervoor dat werken uitdagend en leuk moet zijn. Je komt bij ons terecht in een club van academisch opgeleide en ambitieuze collega’s, waarin veel ideeën worden bedacht en creativiteit te zien is. Lopendebandwerk wordt zoveel mogelijk vermeden. Enthousiasme en gezelligheid staan voorop: er wordt regelmatig samen gesport of geborreld in de Utrechtse binnenstad.

Daarnaast hebben we een werkplek in het mooie historische centrum van Utrecht op 5 minuten van het Centraal Station.

Wat kan je nog meer verwachten als je bij ons werkt?

  • Goed salaris en een winstdeling
  • Participatieregeling
  • Opleidingstraject met veel aandacht voor persoonlijke en teamontwikkeling
  • Ruimte voor eigen initiatieven en innovatieve ideeën
  • 29 verlofdagen
  • Bedrijfsactiviteiten: uitjes, borrels, de jaarlijkse barbecue en het jaarlijkse weekendje weg
  • Reiskostenvergoeding, thuiswerkvergoeding en pensioenregeling

title: Founding Brand & Communications Lead
description:
About Meshy

Meshy is building the generative AI layer for 3D. Developers, creators, game studios, and enterprise teams use Meshy to turn ideas into production-ready 3D assets in minutes instead of weeks. We’re a Silicon Valley company with a global team, growing fast, and now at the point where the category we’re creating needs a name, a story, and a voice.

Why This Role Exists

Today, Meshy is known as a very good AI 3D tool. That’s not enough. The next phase requires Meshy to be understood as a company with a defined category position, a long-term vision, and real cultural weight in AI and creative software.

You’ll be the person who answers these questions and then makes the whole company answer them the same way:

  • What does Meshy stand for in AI, 3D, and creative tools?

  • Why should developers, creators, game companies, and enterprise buyers care about Meshy now?

  • What is the single story that connects our product, our founders, our customers, the press, and our industry partners?

This is a founding brand role. You will write, not just direct.

What You’ll Own

  • Company positioning, brand architecture, core messaging, and the long-term narrative.

  • Translating hard technical capability in AI and 3D into stories that are clear, credible, and memorable.

  • One consistent voice across the website, product launches, funding announcements, founder talks, employer brand, customer stories, and sales collateral.

  • Executive narrative with the founders and leadership team: keynotes, interviews, points of view, and industry agenda-setting.

  • Major product launches and brand campaigns, from creative concept through to shipped content.

  • A reusable messaging framework that Growth, Sales, BD, PR, and Product all actually use.

  • Proof of industry impact through customer, creator, studio, and partner stories.

What We’re Looking For

  • 8–15 years in brand strategy, brand marketing, corporate narrative, product marketing, or editorial/content strategy.

  • You have led a repositioning, category creation, or brand rebuild at a technology company—as the owner of it, not a contributor to it.

  • A portfolio we can read: website narrative, brand manifesto, a major launch, a founder keynote, or an integrated campaign.

  • You can tell a technical story to developers, creators, enterprise buyers, press, and investors—and change the register for each.

  • Exceptional English writing and editing. You personally write the things that matter most.

  • Demonstrated cross-functional influence: you’ve gotten founders, Product, Design, Marketing, and Sales to adopt one narrative and stay on it.

  • Comfortable operating as a hands-on individual contributor in an early-stage environment.

Bonus Points

  • Background in generative AI, creative tools, developer tools, gaming, 3D, design software, or high-growth B2B SaaS.

  • You’ve built a brand for a product whose category didn’t fully exist yet, rather than maintaining an established one.

  • You hold both technical credibility and cultural resonance—developers trust you, and the work still has emotional pull.

  • Experience taking a global or China-founded technology company into the U.S. market.

  • Founder brand, thought leadership, or executive communications experience.

This Role Is Probably Not for You If

  • Your work is primarily PR and media relations without positioning work behind it.

  • Your background is in content marketing, SEO, social media, or community management.

  • You’re a visual creative director who owns design systems and art direction.

  • You come from consumer or lifestyle brands and haven’t worked on technical products.

title: Food Safety / Sanitation

title: VP, Talent & Organizational Development
description:
Overview

As our VP, Talent & Organizational Development, you’ll help drive Concora Credit’s Mission to enable customers to Do More with Credit – every single day.

The impact you’ll have at Concora Credit:

The VP, Talent & Organizational Development, will report to the COO to build and run Concora Credit's enterprise talent strategy — from entry-level roles through identifying and developing director-and-above leaders on an upward trajectory to succession planning for the company's most critical roles. This is a hands-on, build-and-run mandate: the successful candidate will design new programs from scratch, not inherit a mature function, and will personally operate at the intersection of org design, organizational development, succession planning, and executive coaching. The role is a strategy owner and orchestrator, working cross-functionally and in collaboration with Talent Acquisition, the broader HR team, and the Senior Leadership Team, who are the key partners in establishing and executing these strategies. This role is not recruiting or training but focused on talent architecture.

We hire people, not positions. That's because, at Concora Credit, we put people first, including our customers, partners, and Team Members. Concora Credit is guided by a single purpose: to help non-prime customers do more with credit. Today, we have helped millions of customers access credit. Our industry leadership, resilience, and willingness to adapt ensure we can help our partners responsibly say yes to millions more. As a company grounded in entrepreneurship, we're looking to expand our team and are looking for people who foster innovation, strive to make an impact, and want to Do More! We’re an established company with over 20 years of experience, but now we’re taking things to the next level. We're seeking someone who wants to impact the business and play a pivotal role in leading the charge for change.

Responsibilities

As our VP, Talent & Organizational Development, you will:

  • Own and drive Concora Credit's multi-year enterprise talent and leadership strategy, reporting to the COO and in close partnership with the SVP of HR — not a plan handed off for others to execute, but one this role personally builds and runs.
  • Design and operationalize the company's “talent architecture” model across three stages: Build Early Experience (college cohorts and rotational programs), Gain Exposure (structured cross-functional exposure and always-on scouting for strategic roles), and Grow Integration (ongoing coaching and formal preparation before — not after — a promotion into broader enterprise scope).
  • Set and track the KPIs that determine whether the leadership strategy is working, and report progress against the finalization timeline (programs finalized Q1 2027; every senior leader engaged in talent and leadership growth by 2027).
  • Act as the connective layer across the organization: set the enterprise talent and leadership agenda and partner with Talent Acquisition and the broader HR team on execution, keeping strategy and delivery aligned as the function grows.
  • Partner with the COO, SVP, HR, and business leaders on organizational structure, role design, and span-of-control decisions as the company scales.
  • Lead or support enterprise-wide change management and cultural-alignment work tied to organizational redesign, new leadership models, or major initiatives.
  • Build and maintain the reporting and dashboards that track every talent and leadership-development activity — program participation, bench-strength coverage, trajectory distribution, retention/attrition in critical roles, and progress against the finalization timeline.
  • Report regularly to the COO and CEO on program health, leadership pipeline coverage, and where the company remains exposed on succession or critical-role risk.

These duties must be performed with or without reasonable accommodation.

We know experience comes in many forms and that many skills are transferable. If your experience is close to what we're looking for, consider applying. Diversity has made us the entrepreneurial and innovative company that we are today.

Qualifications

Requirements:

  • 12–15+ years of progressive experience in talent management, leadership development, succession planning, or organizational development, including direct ownership and accountability for enterprise-wide programs — not execution support for someone else's strategy.
  • A demonstrated track record designing, building, and running talent and leadership programs from scratch inside a growing, evolving company — this is a build role, not a maintain role.
  • Direct experience across the full mix this role requires: organizational design, organizational development, succession planning, and executive coaching. Candidates who have only done one or two of these will struggle with the scope.
  • A track record advising and coaching senior executives directly — comfortable facilitating candid, sometimes difficult, talent conversations with a CEO, COO, or SLT.
  • Working knowledge of adult learning principles, leadership competency frameworks, and talent assessment/diagnostic tools.
  • Strong analytical skills — able to define metrics, build dashboards, and use data (not just anecdote) to decide where the company should focus its talent investment.
  • Strong consulting and influence skills; able to shape enterprise strategy as a peer to the executive team, not just execute what's handed down.

Education:

  • Relevant certification (e.g., SHRM-SCP, SPHR, or equivalent executive coaching credential) preferred, not required.
