title: Managerial Finance Subject Matter Expert
description:
Overview

About NLU

Founded in 1886, National Louis University (NLU) is a private, nonprofit institution committed to expanding access to high-quality education for working adults and diverse learners. With campuses in Chicago and Florida and robust online programs nationwide, NLU focuses on career-connected degrees that integrate academic rigor with real-world application. The university is nationally recognized for innovation in workforce-aligned education and for its deep commitment to student success, equity, and upward mobility.

About the Model

Learn and Earn in 3 (LE3) is a reimagined undergraduate model for full-time working adults. Students earn their degree, B.S. in Business Management, in 2.5-3 years while remaining employed full time, receiving course credit for time spent at work. All courses are related to workplace and leadership skills.

LE3 uses a focused quarter structure designed for depth and application:

  • Academic courses (major and general education) run in 4-week blocks, with students taking one course at a time

  • Each quarter also includes a 12-week Professional Skills Seminar focused on durable skills such as communication, teamwork, leadership, and self-advocacy

  • Courses are fully virtual and blend asynchronous learning with one intentional live session per week

What makes a course an LE3 course?

In this model, we believe in what we call the Learning-Doing Loop. This Loop means that there is a strong connection between learning in the classroom and current professional experiences. All LE3 courses are career connected and highly applied, designed for adults who are working full time. They are built around reflection and growth, with a focus on building practical artifacts rather than purely academic products. Finally, they are focused on building durable skills, with a heavy emphasis on self-awareness, leadership, communication, and decision-making.

LE3 faculty are partners in student success, helping students connect learning to their professional lives and apply skills immediately at work.

Position Overview

We are seeking experienced Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) to support the design and development of the following course within the LE3 program:

  • MGT 441 - Managing Money and Resources: Managers make financial decisions every day, even if they aren't accountants. In this course, you'll build confidence interpreting financial information, evaluating budgets, and making resource decisions that support organizational goals. You'll explore key concepts such as cash flow, profitability, and return on investment while learning how financial decisions affect people, operations, and performance. You will build the skills needed to interpret financial information and make decisions that support effective use of organizational resources.

The SME will collaborate closely with LE3 curriculum designers to ensure each course is relevant, clear, accessible, workplace-connected, and aligned to the LE3 pillars and aligned with course and program objectives.

Please note, that while this position is remote, we are currently only able to employ individuals residing in the following states: Arizona, California, Colorado, Florida, Georgia, Illinois, Indiana, Iowa, Kentucky, Louisiana, Maryland, Massachusetts, Michigan, Minnesota, Missouri, Nevada, New Jersey, New York, North Carolina, Oklahoma, South Carolina, Texas, Virginia, Washington, and Wisconsin.

Essential Responsibilities

Subject Matter Expert (SME)

  • Provide expertise in managerial finance, budgeting, resource allocation, cash flow, profitability, return on investment, and financial decision-making.

  • Translate current management and business practice into practical learning outcomes, assignments, case studies, and discussion prompts.

  • Develop accessible, inclusive learning materials that help learners apply financial concepts to workplace decisions and organizational goals.

  • Create real-world examples, activities, and assessments related to interpreting financial information, evaluating budgets, managing resources, and communicating financial decisions.

  • Ensure course content reflects the needs of non-financial managers and builds confidence using financial information without requiring an accounting background.

  • Incorporate current industry practices, relevant financial tools, and emerging approaches to data-informed management and resource planning.

  • Connect financial decisions to their impact on people, operations, performance, risk, and long-term organizational sustainability.

  • Collaborate with course designers and the LE3 curriculum team to ensure content is coherent, engaging, aligned with durable skills and leadership development, and appropriate for work-integrated learning.

Collaborative & Administrative

  • Work closely with the LE3 curriculum team and course designers to maintain consistency and high-quality student experiences.

  • Reflect on learner performance trends and share insights that support continuous course and program improvement.

  • Participate in virtual meetings, curriculum reviews, and quality assurance processes as needed.

Qualifications

Minimum Requirements

  • Master’s degree or higher in Business, Management, Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a closely related field.
  • 3+ years of professional experience involving budgeting, financial analysis, resource planning, operational management, business strategy, or related management responsibilities.

  • Demonstrated ability to explain financial concepts clearly to non-financial audiences.

  • Experience applying concepts such as cash flow, profitability, budgeting, cost management, financial performance, and return on investment in workplace settings.

  • Ability to connect financial and resource decisions to leadership, operational performance, employee impact, and organizational goals.

  • Experience developing training, curriculum, assessments, learning materials, or coaching resources is preferred.

  • Commitment to accessible, inclusive, learner-centered instruction and practical work-integrated learning.

  • Comfort collaborating virtually and using digital tools such as Zoom, Google Workspace, Slack, learning-management systems, and common spreadsheet or financial-analysis tools.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with work-integrated learning or experiential education models.
  • Professional experience outside of academia in fields such as HR, management, finance, project management, coaching, negotiation, or digital transformation.

  • Relevant industry credentials.

Time Commitment

  • Project-based contract work aligned to course development timelines.

  • Estimated 10-15 hours per week during active development periods (may fluctuate based on project scope and deliverables).

  • Participation in virtual meetings, content reviews, and SME advisory discussions as needed.

  • Occasional availability during standard business hours for collaboration with the LE3 curriculum and design teams.

  • Flexible scheduling with the understanding that deadlines for content development, review cycles, and quality assurance must be met.

Why join LE3? Why join NLU?

  • Be part of a movement redefining college for working adults.

  • Join a collaborative, future-focused faculty team.

  • Support students to thrive: academically, professionally, and personally.

  • Engage in meaningful work that blends teaching and mentorship.

  • Contribute to a pioneering model of higher education that integrates learning, earning, and leadership development.

NLU Inclusion Statement:

National Louis University is deeply committed to serving its community, advancing access and equity, and ensuring that all individuals are welcomed and valued. We are dedicated to fostering a culture where diversity, equity, and inclusion remain at the core of who we are. These are more than just words to us: they are truly a way of life for the NLU community. We recognize that differences in abilities, age, ethnicity, gender (identity and expression), race, religion, sexual orientation, socio-economic status, and background bring richness to our work environment. We affirm diverse perspectives, innovative contributions, and authentic presentations of self from every member within the NLU community. We believe inclusion is grounded in the actions we intentionally take each day. Our goal is to inspire and empower NLU employees and community members to cultivate an environment where we collectively focus on uplifting and advancing our institutional culture.

Compensation and Benefits

At National Louis University, we offer our employees an innovative environment to work together and inspire the ideas that will make an impact. Our institution values Adjunct Faculty's role in advancing our teaching mission and preparing our students for successful careers. Adjunct Faculty have access to training resources for professional development, access to shared governance as a part of our Adjunct Council, retirement plans, educational opportunities, and paid time off. A more complete list of Adjunct Faculty Benefits can be found here.

Adjunct Faculty are paid by course or assignment each term. These rates vary by college and number of credit hours for the course/assignment. While the specific amount will be indicated in an electronic contract that is issued to the Adjunct Faculty member when the course is assigned, an overview of standard rate structure is available below:

2025 Adjunct Faculty Rate Structure

    • Official Transcripts for all related degrees, licenses/certificates will be required upon hire

Optional Additional Attachments:

  • Sample Syllabus
  • Additional Licenses/Certifications
  • Course Evaluations

title: Material Movement & Margin Sr. Analyst
description:
Turn every load, lane, and ton into a better business decision.

MATERIAL MOVEMENT & MARGIN SENIOR ANALYST

Salary Range: Starting from $85,000/year

Why This Role Matters

CR&R is building a more rigorous view of what it costs - and what it earns - to move material across our network. In this highly visible role, you'll connect operations, finance, fleet, disposal, and commodity data to show where margins are created or lost and give leadership clear recommendations to reprice, reroute, renegotiate, or exit unprofitable movements.

What You'll Do

  • Build and maintain load- and lane-level contribution margin models that combine tip fee revenue, commodity proceeds, disposal cost, and transportation cost into clear unit economics by load, ton, and ton-mile.
  • Create Power BI dashboards and recurring analysis that track cost per ton, cost per ton-mile, revenue, lane contribution, asset utilization, and margin leakage across the business.
  • Evaluate internal fleet versus subcontracted hauling economics, validate carrier invoices and rate terms, and build fact-based support for make-versus-buy decisions, negotiations, and RFPs.
  • Analyze routing, payload efficiency, disposal and processing economics, commodity buy/sell spreads, and fuel recovery, then present actionable recommendations to operations and corporate leadership.

What We're Looking For

  • 3 - 5 years of financial, data, logistics, or operations analysis experience, including hands-on experience building cost-to-serve, profitability, or unit-economics models; bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Logistics, Supply Chain, Business Analytics, or a related field.
  • Advanced Excel and Power BI/DAX skills, strong reconciliation and financial discipline, and the ability to translate complex data into clear business actions. Waste, heavy logistics, transportation, SQL, Python/R, or commodity-market experience is preferred.

Pay & Schedule

  • Salary Range: Starting from $85,000/year
  • Full-time, Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., based in Stanton, California. Occasional travel to CR&R operating sites in California and Arizona; additional hours may be needed periodically.

title: Sr Associate, Consumer Products, CPG & Beauty
description:
The Opportunity:
The Sr Associate, Consumer Products will support the growth of Mattel's Consumer Products business across UCANZ by managing an assigned portfolio of licensees and executing licensing plans. Working closely with internal and external partners, this role contributes to commercial growth by managing licensee relationships, supporting the end-to-end licensing lifecycle, and ensuring licensed products are delivered in line with Mattel's brand standards and business objectives.

The role is responsible for the day-to-day management of assigned licensee partnerships, identifying commercial opportunities, coordinating product development and retail execution, and collaborating cross-functionally to deliver successful licensed consumer products.

What Your Impact Will Be:
Business & Licensing Execution

  • Execute licensing plans across an assigned portfolio of licensees within UCANZ.
  • Identify commercial opportunities, emerging consumer trends and whitespace opportunities, providing recommendations to the Senior Manager.
  • Support the identification, evaluation and onboarding of new licensing partners.
  • Contribute to the end-to-end licensing lifecycle including opportunity identification, business case development, negotiations, product development, launch and ongoing partner management.
  • Coordinate product development activities to ensure products meet Mattel brand standards, consumer needs and commercial objectives.
  • Support Direct-to-Retail (DTR) initiatives where appropriate.
  • Assist with contract administration and licensing documentation.
  • Monitor business performance, royalty forecasts and commercial opportunities, providing regular reporting and recommendations.
  • Maintain accurate sales forecasts and support quarterly forecasting cycles.

Licensee Account Management

  • Manage the day-to-day relationship with an assigned portfolio of licensees, acting as the primary business contact.
  • Conduct regular business reviews to understand business performance against forecasts, commercial objectives and royalty expectations.
  • Identify opportunities to expand existing partnerships and drive incremental growth.
  • Support the onboarding and integration of new licensees.
  • Monitor sales performance and provide updated forecasts as part of quarterly business reviews.
  • Prepare regular updates on business performance, opportunities and commercial risks.


Retail & Product Development

  • Partner with licensees to develop retail programs that support Mattel's brand and retail strategies.
  • Work with Sales, Marketing and Franchise teams to identify product opportunities and support commercial execution.
  • Coordinate product development and creative approval processes to maintain brand integrity.
  • Support retailer engagement alongside Consumer Products leadership where appropriate.


Marketing Plans

  • Partner closely with Brand Marketing, Sales, Franchise, Consumer Insights, Finance, Legal and Product Design teams to deliver integrated licensing plans.

What We’re Looking For:

  • Marketing/Business degree or other relevant tertiary qualification.
  • 4-5 years' experience in consumer products, licensing, FMCG, retail or another relevant commercial environment.
  • Experience managing relationships with external partners, licensees or key commercial customers.
  • Understanding of the end-to-end licensing lifecycle, including partner management, product development and commercial execution.
  • Strong commercial acumen with the ability to analyse sales, royalty and market data to identify business opportunities.
  • Experience working cross-functionally with Marketing, Sales, Finance, Legal and Product Development teams.
  • Strong communication, stakeholder management and negotiation skills.
  • Excellent organisational and project management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities.
  • Experience within the consumer products, entertainment or licensing industry is advantageous.
  • Understanding of the UCANZ retail environment is desirable.

KEY CHARACTERISTICS

  • Positive attitude.
  • Commercially curious with a growth mindset.
  • Strong relationship-building and influencing skills.
  • Collaborative and team-oriented.
  • Proactive and solutions-focused.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving capability.
  • High attention to detail and organisational skills.
  • Demonstrates ownership and accountability within their area of responsibility.

*The pay range is indicative of projected hiring range, however base pay will be determined based on a candidate’s work location, skills and experience. Mattel offers competitive total pay programs, comprehensive benefits, and resources to help empower a culture where every employee can reach their full potential.

Don’t meet every single requirement? At Mattel, we are dedicated to an inclusive workplace and a culture of belonging. If you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we still encourage you to apply. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles. Join Mattel's Talent Community and start receiving exciting updates about our company, our employees, and our culture. Also, interested in signing up for job alerts? Do so here!

How We Work:
We are a purpose driven company aiming to empower generations to explore the wonder of childhood and reach their full potential. We live up to our purpose employing the following behaviors:

  • We collaborate: Being a part of Mattel means being part of one team with shared values and common goals. Every person counts and working closely together always brings better results. Partnership is our process and our collective capabilities is our superpower.

title: Analytical consultant
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Would you like to be part of a team servicing the biggest FMCG retailers in Denmark? In this role, you will work very closely with the assigned client, helping them to make better decisions based on research and sales data. You will build great relationships with the clients through market analysis, insights and recommendations.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Client Partnership & Advisory

  • Act as a trusted advisor by delivering analytical insights, recommendations, reports, presentations, and day-to-day data support.
  • Build strong client relationships through proactive stakeholder management and continuous alignment on analytical priorities.
  • Support client retention and satisfaction by providing business-focused solutions, workshops, and analytical training sessions.
  • Identify business challenges, opportunities, and growth drivers, recommending relevant NielsenIQ solutions.

Analytics & Insights

  • Analyze market, category, and sales data to uncover trends and opportunities.
  • Transform complex datasets into clear, actionable insights and recommendations.
  • Contribute to presentations and strategic discussions with clients and internal stakeholders.
  • Utilize NielsenIQ's data platforms, tools, and solution portfolio to support client objectives.

Business Impact

  • Drive customer satisfaction and improve Net Promoter Score (NPS) through high-quality support and business sparring.
  • Challenge established thinking and support clients in making informed decisions that drive growth.
  • Help clients maximize the value they receive from NielsenIQ's data, services, and expertise.

ABOUT YOU

QUALIFICATIONS & REQUIREMENTS

title: Assistant Controller
description:
Company Overview

Established in 1987, Allied Residential is an employee owned, Washington-based multifamily property management firm with over 20,000 units of market rate, affordable, and mixed-use communities in our management portfolio.

Our focus and culture are centered around people – not only our fellow Allied team members, but all of those we interact with every day including clients, residents, rental prospects, service vendors, and supply providers. Internally, our team thrives in a culture of integrity, collaboration, and growth. With professional training, career advancement, and a supportive environment, we empower our people to lead with purpose and make a lasting impact.

Position Summary

We are seeking an experienced Assistant Controller to help lead Allied's property accounting function. The Assistant Controller reports to the Controller and directly supervises a group of property accountants, with responsibility for the quality, timeliness, and consistency of their work. This role reviews monthly property financials, reconciliations, journal entries, accruals, and owner reporting; provides backup coverage when accountants are on PTO or positions are open; and helps resolve accounting issues with property operations and clients.

This is a hands-on leadership role. The Assistant Controller must be equally comfortable mentoring accountants, reviewing detailed accounting work, stepping in to complete work when needed, communicating with other in the Accounting and other departments, working with clients, improving workflows in Yardi and related systems, and other accounting-related responsibilities and projects as assigned.

Key Responsibilities

Leadership

  • Supervise, train, and develop assigned property Accountants, with clear expectations for quality, deadlines, and accountability.
  • Coordinate workload and backup coverage for PTO, vacancies, and peak close periods, stepping in directly as necessary.
  • Support performance reviews, hiring, onboarding, and long-term development of the property accounting team.

Financial Reporting & Controls

  • Review monthly property financial statements and owner reporting for accuracy, completeness, and timeliness.
  • Review and assist with bank reconciliations, balance sheet reconciliations, journal entries, accruals, allocations, and other key account activity.
  • Ensure assigned properties meet monthly close deadlines and follow Allied accounting policies and client requirements.
  • Identify errors, unusual variances, and process gaps; work with accountants and operations to resolve and document corrections.

Property Accounting Operations & Coverage

  • Provide hands-on accounting support and direct coverage for Property Accountants during PTO, vacancies, and workload spikes.
  • Review and approve applicable funds transfers, property mortgage payments and owner distributions, reserve and security deposit activity, and other assigned cash transactions within Allied approval policies.
  • Assist with management fee, billback, intercompany, payroll/reimbursable expense, and other property or corporate reconciliations as assigned.

Client, Audit & Compliance Support

  • Serve as an accounting point of escalation for assigned properties and communicate with clients, Portfolio Managers, and property teams as needed.
  • Support year-end close, CPA and audit requests, 1099s, tax filings, and other regulatory reporting under the direction of the Controller.
  • Help document and enforce accounting procedures, internal controls, and appropriate segregation of duties.

Systems & Process Improvement

  • Serve as a hands-on resource for assigned accountants and property accounting workflows, including Yardi and related tools.
  • Help maintain data integrity, consistent accounting setup, and appropriate user workflows.
  • Identify and implement practical process improvements that make reporting more accurate, timely, and efficient.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or Business Administration.
  • Minimum 5 years of progressive accounting experience, including property management accounting.
  • Minimum 2 years of supervisory or team leadership experience.
  • Strong experience with Yardi property management accounting software (required).
  • Advanced Excel proficiency.
  • Strong understanding of property management industry accrual and cash accounting.
  • Experience in multifamily property management required.
  • CPA preferred.
  • Strong and clear professional communication skills, whether through email, virtually (Teams, Zoom) or in-person.

What We're Looking For

  • High integrity and strong judgment.
  • Both professional and personable.
  • Clear, direct communicator.
  • Detail-oriented with strong follow-through and the ability to see the bigger picture.
  • Comfortable in a fast-moving, growth-oriented environment.
  • A leader who takes ownership, solves problems, and jumps in where needed.

Compensation & Benefits

  • Competitive salary based on experience.
  • 152 hours (19 days) PTO annually, plus carry-over up to 120 hours and longevity PTO at 6 and 10 years
  • 9 paid holidays.
  • Comprehensive health benefits-including medical, dental, vision, life, and disability-effective the 1st of the month after 60 days (Kaiser Permanente, Guardian, Mutual of Omaha).
  • HSA and FSA through Lively.
  • Employee Assistance Plan (EAP).
  • 401(k) with employer match (25% of contributions up to 4% of eligible pay).
  • Continuous professional development and advancement opportunities.

Equal Opportunity Employer

Allied Residential proudly provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, veteran status, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other protected status.

Mission Statement

Creating Communities | Exceeding Expectations

If you're ready to bring your leadership, accounting expertise, and commitment to excellence to a collaborative and fast-paced environment, apply today and make a meaningful impact in our organization's financial success.

title: Staff Data Analyst, Lean and Process Improvement, Co Manufacturing
description:
The Opportunity:

Mattel is seeking a Staff Data Analyst, Lean and Process Improvement, Co Manufacturing, to lead complex process improvement initiatives across Product Supply Organization. Reporting to the Director, Contract Manufacturing & Process Improvement, this role will own diagnostics, solution design, implementation and sustainment of Lean driven improvements that increase visibility, reduce waste, improve service, strengthen governance and enable more effective decision making.

This is a strategic individual contributor role for a highly analytical, structured problem solver who can move from current processes or data to insight to action. The ideal candidate will be comfortable working with operations teams, senior leaders, facilitating process redesign discussions, building business cases and translating complex operational challenges into practical, scalable solutions.

What Your Impact Will Be:

  • Lead value stream diagnostics: Own current state and future state assessments across Global Procurement, Manufacturing, Co Manufacturing Teams and Key Stakeholders to identify issues and opportunities.
  • Identify process wastes and performance gaps: Use Lean tools such as value stream mapping, SIPOC, A3 problem solving, 5 Whys, root cause analysis, Kaizen, standard work and control plans to identify bottlenecks, rework, manual workarounds, unclear ownership, decision delays and data quality gaps.
  • Develop the improvement roadmap: Build and maintain a prioritized pipeline of process improvement opportunities, supported by business impact, complexity, resource needs, risk, timeline and stakeholder readiness.
  • Translate data into actionable insights: Analyze operational, financial and supply chain data and processes to identify trends, performance drivers, recurring issues and improvement opportunities.
  • Build performance visibility: Develop dashboards that enable operations and top management decision making processes, such as; scorecards and leadership reporting that track cycle time, service, schedule adherence, capacity utilization, supplier performance, inventory health, quality trends, rework, issue aging, cost drivers and initiative benefits.
  • Create business cases for change: Quantify expected value from improvement initiatives, including productivity, lead time reduction, cost avoidance, service improvement, risk mitigation, working capital improvement and decision speed.
  • Redesign processes and operating models: Partner with business owners to define future state workflows, process maps, RACIs, governance routines, decision rights, escalation paths, standard work, documentation and control mechanisms.
  • Drive implementation from concept through sustainment: Lead pilots, implementation plans, adoption tracking, training materials, stakeholder communications, testing, cutover support and post implementation reviews.
  • Facilitate Lean events and working sessions: Plan and lead cross functional workshops with Product Supply, Contract Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Procurement, Quality, Engineering, Finance, IT and external partners to align on problems, options, decisions and execution plans.
  • Strengthen data quality and process governance: Define consistent metrics, data definitions, source of truth expectations and reporting routines to improve confidence in Product Supply and co manufacturing decision making.
  • Partner on systems and reporting enablement: Work with IT, analytics and business teams to document business requirements, improve data flows, automate manual reporting and support adoption of digital tools that enable process visibility and control.
  • Influence senior stakeholders: Prepare executive ready recommendations, readouts and decision materials that clearly communicate findings, tradeoffs, risks, benefits and required actions.
  • Coach others on Lean ways of working: Build process improvement capability across the team by coaching stakeholders on Lean tools, problem solving routines, data backed decision making and sustainment practices.
  • Track benefits and accountability: Establish clear success measures, monitor initiative progress, validate realized benefits and ensure improvements are embedded into day to day operations.
  • Promote continuous improvement culture: Help Product Supply move from reactive issue resolution to proactive performance management through standard routines, root cause discipline, ownership clarity and scalable best practices.

This role will work closely with the Director, Contract Manufacturing, Product Supply leadership, Manufacturing, Contract Manufacturing, Global Supply Chain Planning, Procurement, Quality, Engineering, Product Development, Finance, IT, Data and Analytics, regional supply teams and external co manufacturing partners.

The role will also prepare insights and recommendations for senior Product Supply leaders and cross functional executives to support operating decisions, transformation priorities and performance improvement.

What We’re Looking For:

Must Haves

  • Bachelor degree in Supply Chain, Operations, Industrial Engineering, Business, Data Analytics, Statistics, Finance or a related field.
  • 6 to 10 years of experience in process improvement, supply chain, manufacturing operations, strategy, operations excellence, business analytics or management consulting.
  • Demonstrated experience leading complex process improvement initiatives from diagnostics through implementation and sustainment.
  • Deep knowledge of Lean methodologies, process design, root cause analysis, value stream mapping, standard work, operating model design and change management.
  • Strong analytical capability with the ability to work with large, complex datasets and translate insights into practical business recommendations.
  • Experience building dashboards, scorecards, executive readouts and performance management tools.
  • Advanced Excel and PowerPoint skills, with experience using Tableau, Power BI, SQL, Google BigQuery or similar tools preferred.
  • Strong business judgment, structured problem solving and ability to operate with ambiguity.
  • Proven ability to influence leaders and stakeholders without direct authority.
  • Strong executive communication skills, including the ability to simplify complex information, frame decisions and present clear recommendations.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities, lead working sessions and drive accountability across cross functional teams.
  • Comfort working in a global, matrixed environment with internal teams and external manufacturing partners.

Preferred Qualifications

  • MBA, Master degree or advanced degree in a relevant discipline.
  • Lean Six Sigma Green Belt, Black Belt or equivalent process improvement certification.
  • Experience in consumer products, manufacturing, supply chain, toy industry, retail supply chain or seasonal product environments.
  • Experience with ERP, planning, procurement, quality, manufacturing or supplier management systems.
  • Experience supporting contract manufacturing, vendor manufacturing or third party production networks.

title: UNAVAILABLE
description:
Overview

As a patient-focused organization, University of Utah Health exists to enhance the health and well-being of people through patient care, research and education. Success in this mission requires a culture of collaboration, excellence, leadership, and respect. University of Utah Health seeks staff that are committed to the values of compassion, collaboration, innovation, responsibility, integrity, quality and trust that are integral to our mission. EO/AA

This position provides assistive care to patients. The incumbent facilitates the efficient delivery of patient care, supports the professional role of the licensed staff, and provides support and assistance as directed by licensed staff in rendering basic healthcare to the patient. This position also assists with clerical functions as a multi-skilled auxiliary worker. This position provides direct patient care and may be required to access and administer medications within their scope of practice and according to state law.

Corporate Overview: The University of Utah is a Level 1 Trauma Center and is nationally ranked and recognized for our academic research, quality standards and overall patient experience. Our five hospitals and eleven clinics provide excellence in our comprehensive services, medical advancement, and overall patient outcomes.

Responsibilities

Essential Functions

  • Prepares patients for examinations and diagnostic procedures according to clinic procedures such as recording temperatures, pulse rate, blood pressure and responses to standardized medical history questions.
  • Reports all observed patient concerns and changes in condition to a licensed staff member.
  • Performs Clinical Laboratory Improvement Amendments (CLIA) Waved Lab tests as identified by department and reports results to the appropriate personnel.
  • Performs additional skills such as suture removal, straight catheterization and injections (IM, Subq and intra-dermal).
  • Acts as a chaperone for health care providers during patient examination as requested and assists with procedures.
  • Monitors and cleans assigned patient examination rooms, unit areas and unit equipment reporting outdated supplies, stock levels and restock set levels of items and necessary equipment repairs.
  • Answers telephones, forwards telephone messages and under the direction of licensed staff schedules appointments, procedures and diagnostic tests.
  • Assists in routine clerical functions such as filing of medical information in patient's records, locating and compiling department charts, obtaining medical records from other providers and entering charges for billing purposes.
  • Attends and completes mandatory education including infection prevention and control, safety, CPR, equipment usage and procedures according to hospital and department policies.
  • May perform patient phlebotomy in accordance with clinic procedures and physician orders after specialized training.
  • May apply leads and monitors for diagnostic procedures such as EKG and ultrasound scan under the direct supervision of licensed personnel.
  • May assist inpatient and family education by providing educational material and general health information to patients and family members.
  • May assist with transportation of patients to ancillary departments or inpatient units as directed by licensed staff.
  • May instruct in Basic Life Support (BLS) requirements.

title: Data Engineer Kapitaalmarkten
description:
Als Azure data-engineer (DevOps engineer) bij de afdeling Datagedreven Kapitaalmarkten (DAK) ben je verantwoordelijk voor het ontsluiten, structureren en prepareren van data voor toepassing binnen het toezicht op de kapitaalmarkten. In onze Azure-cloudomgeving werk je met grote hoeveelheden (miljoenen tot miljarden records) gestructureerde en ongestructureerde data, verspreid over Databricks, SQL-databases en Azure Storage (flat files/blobs). Je bouwt mee aan een modern dataplatform, ontwikkelt structurele informatieproducten en speelt een actieve rol in kennisdeling, innovatie en standaardisatie. Je hebt daarom affiniteit met het werk van data-analisten en begrijpt hoe datapreparatie, datamarts, analyses, risicomodellen en dashboards bijdragen aan effectief toezicht.

Je richt deze omgevingen in zodat data-analisten, toezichthouders en andere interne en externe gebruikers direct aan de slag kunnen met kwalitatief hoogwaardige data. Naast je technische rol fungeer je als consultant op het gebied van datakwaliteit en security. Aangezien de AFM ook privacygevoelige data ontvangt, houd je rekening met de security-aspecten die daarbij komen kijken. Je draagt daarnaast bij aan de optimalisatie van de data-operaties door automatisering en het toepassen van DevOps-, DataOps en MLOps.

Een greep uit je werkzaamheden:

  • Data voorbereiden en structureren: Je ontwerpt en implementeert oplossingen voor het integreren en structureren van data in diverse opslagvormen, waaronder Databricks, SQL en Azure Storage.

  • Automatiseren en CI/CD: Je ontwikkelt en beheert CI/CD pipelines (met Azure DevOps), zodat veranderingen op een geautomatiseerde en soepele wijze worden uitgerold.

  • Innovatie: Je ondersteunt de adoptie van nieuwe databricks features zoals Declarative Automation Bundles, Unity Catalog en Genie.

  • Technisch advies en kwaliteitsbewaking: Je fungeert als technisch consultant en draagt bij aan de verbetering van datakwaliteit en security binnen de organisatie.

  • Samenwerking en kennisdeling: Je werkt nauw samen met collega’s binnen het platformteam en deelt actief je kennis en best practices over data-engineering en DevOps.

Afdeling en team

Binnen je rol werk je nauw samen met een multidisciplinair team, waaronder data engineers, data management specialisten en een integrator. Jullie collecteren, verwerken en analyseren gegevens om betrouwbare en waardevolle inzichten te verkrijgen. Daarbij speel je een sleutelrol in het ontwikkelen en onderhouden van modellen die toezichthouders helpen snel en effectief te werken. Je maakt deel uit van de afdeling Datagedreven Kapitaalmarkten (DAK), een team van professionals die gezamenlijk werken aan het verbeteren van het toezicht op financiële markten. Binnen deze afdeling is er veel ruimte voor persoonlijke ontwikkeling, terwijl je samenwerkt met experts op het gebied van data-analyse, toezicht en financiële markten. De afdeling streeft naar voortdurende verbetering en biedt een stimulerende werkomgeving die gericht is op het behalen van impactvolle resultaten.

Dit vragen we:

Opleiding & ervaring: HBO/WO werk- en denkniveau, minimaal 3 jaar ervaring met dataverwerking in MS Azure Cloud.

Technische vaardigheden: Ervaring met CI/CD (Azure DevOps pipelines), Git, Visual Studio (Code), SQL-programmering, bij voorkeur ook Python en Powershell.

Data & cloud expertise: Kennis van Databricks, Azure Data Factory en T-SQL, en basiskennis van identity en access management (Entra ID).

Database modellering: Inzicht in modellering, normalisering (1/2/3NF) en modelleerprincipes zoals Inmon en Kimball.

Werkwijze & mindset: Ervaring met Scrum, DevOps-mentaliteit gericht op automatisering, iteratie en eigenaarschap.

Persoonlijke eigenschappen: Initiatiefrijk, resultaatgericht, zelfstandig werkend en een teamplayer.

Certificeringen & ambitie: Kennis van of certificeringen zoals dp-300 en az-400 zijn een pré; ambitie om processen te verbeteren en kennis te delen.

Please note: Dutch language proficiency is required for this position. Candidates with a basic level of Dutch who are actively improving their language skills are also encouraged to apply. Additionally, applicants must currently reside in the Netherlands.

title: Infrastructure Engineer w/active Top Secret clearance
description:
Overview

LMI is a new breed of digital solutions provider dedicated to accelerating government impact with innovation and speed. Investing in technology and prototypes ahead of need, LMI brings commercial-grade platforms and mission-ready AI to federal agencies at commercial speed.

Leveraging our mission-ready technology and solutions, proven expertise in federal deployment, and strategic relationships, we enhance outcomes for the government, efficiently and effectively. Headquartered in Tysons, Virginia, LMI is committed to delivering impactful results that strengthen missions and drive lasting value.

Responsibilities

LMI is seeking a skilled Infrastructure Engineer to design, implement, automate, operate, and sustain the foundational computing platforms supporting enterprise applications, data, and mission services across a network of new and existing secure facilities. The Infrastructure Engineer will ensure that physical, virtual, and cloud-based environments remain reliable, secure, scalable, recoverable, and supportable. This is an execution-oriented role supporting a fast-paced, milestone-driven prototype effort with near-term deliverable commitments. Success requires strong compute, storage, operating-system, virtualization, platform, automation, and lifecycle-management fundamentals rather than expertise limited to a specific vendor.

Primary Duties Include:

  • Enumerate and document the infrastructure baseline across geographically dispersed sites, including compute, storage, operating systems, virtualization, cloud services, backup, recovery, and platform dependencies.
  • Design current-state, transition-state, and target-state infrastructure for secure facilities, data centers, cloud environments, and operational sites.
  • Engineer physical, virtual, containerized, and cloud-based platforms based on mission, performance, availability, security, and recovery requirements.
  • Establish platform standards, configuration baselines, reusable patterns, implementation procedures, and lifecycle roadmaps.
  • Implement secure configurations, patching, hardening, encryption, access controls, and privileged-administration practices in coordination with cybersecurity personnel.
  • Develop and validate backup, restoration, disaster-recovery, and continuity procedures for mission-critical services and data.
  • Monitor infrastructure health, performance, capacity, utilization, configuration compliance, and emerging lifecycle constraints.
  • Diagnose complex infrastructure issues involving compute, memory, storage, operating systems, virtualization, cloud services, and supporting dependencies.
  • Automate infrastructure provisioning, configuration, patching, testing, monitoring, scaling, backup, recovery, and compliance using repeatable infrastructure-as-code and configuration-management practices.

FOUNDATIONAL SKILLS

  • Compute, storage, operating systems, virtualization, containers, and cloud infrastructure.
  • Platform architecture, availability, scalability, performance, and capacity engineering.
  • Backup, restoration, disaster recovery, and continuity of operations.
  • Identity, authentication, authorization, encryption, and privileged-access fundamentals.
  • Secure configuration, patch management, system hardening, and vulnerability remediation.
  • Infrastructure monitoring, telemetry, logging, and performance analysis.
  • Network, distributed-system, application-hosting, and data-platform fundamentals.
  • Automation, scripting, APIs, configuration management, infrastructure as code, and version control.
  • Configuration, change, release, incident, problem, capacity, and technology-lifecycle management.

Location: This position is based in the Washington, DC metro area, with travel to program locations.

Travel: This position requires approximately 25-50% travel to support activities across multiple program locations.

Qualifications

Required:

    • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
    • 8+ years of experience designing, implementing, operating, or sustaining enterprise infrastructure, including in classified environments.
    • Strong understanding of compute, storage, operating systems, virtualization, cloud, backup, recovery, and platform-security principles.
    • Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot complex infrastructure issues across multiple technical domains.
    • Experience engineering capabilities for SCIF or other accredited classified environments, including multi-enclave systems and security boundaries.
    • Working knowledge of the Risk Management Framework (NIST SP 800-37 / 800-53) and experience advising senior leaders.
    • Active Top Secret Clearance (SCI eligibility) required.
    • Excellent communication skills both verbally and in writing. Ability to develop papers, reports, and briefings targeted to senior decision makers.

Nice to Have:

    • Relevant infrastructure, cloud, systems engineering, automation, or cybersecurity certification.
    • Experience integrating cross-domain solutions (CDS) into enterprise architectures.
    • Experience supporting Special Access Program (SAP) facilities, systems, or environments.
    • Experience designing or standing up network or security operations centers (NOC/SOC), including 24x7 coverage models.

TS/SCI clearance with SAP eligibility is required for this position. TS/SCI clearance with SAP eligibility is required for this position. title: Staff Software Engineer, Payroll Calculation
description:
About the payroll calculation team

Payroll is one of the most mission-critical systems a company runs. It has to be correct, compliant, explainable, scalable, and trusted by every employee who depends on it. At Rippling, payroll is also one of our biggest product and engineering frontiers: we’re expanding upmarket to serve much larger companies, scaling internationally across new jurisdictions, and rebuilding core calculation infrastructure for a future where payroll is more automated, transparent, and intelligent.

The Payroll Calculation team owns the systems that determine earnings, deductions, taxes, loans, garnishments, pensions, contributions, and jurisdiction-specific payroll logic. These systems sit at the intersection of distributed systems, product engineering, compliance, data modeling, and customer experience. A great payroll calculation platform does more than produce the right number; it helps admins and internal teams understand why that number is right.

As Rippling serves larger enterprise customers and expands native payroll into more countries, the team is building the technical foundation for payroll at global scale. That means designing calculation frameworks that are configurable, versioned, auditable, debuggable, and explainable, while evolving the architecture to support dramatically more volume and complexity.

We’re looking for a Staff Software Engineer to help lead this work. This is a hands-on technical leadership role for an engineer who wants to build mission-critical systems, set architectural direction, develop exceptional teams, and make payroll accurate, understandable, and dependable at global scale.


What you will do

  • Lead architecture and technical strategy for Rippling’s payroll calculation systems.
  • Write critical production code and lead from the front on high-impact technical initiatives.
  • Design frameworks that make payroll logic configurable, versioned, testable, explainable, scalable, and easy to debug.
  • Leverage AI to make payroll logic easier to build, validate, explain, and operate, without compromising accuracy, auditability, or control.
  • Build systems that support enterprise-scale payroll for large employers with complex legal-entity structures and approval workflows.
  • Help expand Rippling’s native payroll capabilities across new countries and jurisdictions.
  • Drive improvements in distributed systems, database performance, caching, reliability, and operability.
  • Partner cross-functionally with product, design, payroll operations, HRIS, and other engineering teams to deliver end-to-end customer outcomes.
  • Mentor senior and mid-level engineers across payroll calculation areas such as platform, earnings, deductions, taxes, and jurisdiction-specific logic.

What you will need

  • Staff-level experience designing and scaling complex production systems where correctness and auditability are critical.
  • Strong engineering fundamentals across architecture, data modeling, distributed systems, databases, caching, and reliability.
  • A track record of setting technical direction and leading complex initiatives across multiple teams.
  • Strong product judgment and the ability to connect platform decisions to customer outcomes.
  • Excellent communication skills and comfort driving alignment across engineering, product, and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment where priorities and requirements evolve quickly.
  • Payroll experience is helpful but not required. We value engineers who have worked on other high-integrity domains where correctness, auditability, and customer trust are essential.

Additional Information

Rippling is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, veteran or military status, or any other legally protected characteristics, Rippling is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities who need assistance during the hiring process. To request a reasonable accommodation, please email accommodations@rippling.com


Rippling highly values having employees working in-office to foster a collaborative work environment and company culture. For office-based employees (employees who live within a defined radius of a Rippling office), Rippling considers working in the office, at least three days a week under current policy, to be an essential function of the employee's role.


This role will receive a competitive salary + benefits + equity. The salary for US-based employees will be aligned with one of the ranges below based on location; see which tier applies to your location here.

title: Data Engineer
description:
Medior

Bij BONANA bouwen we slimme RevOps oplossingen voor ambitieuze B2B bedrijven. HubSpot vormt daarbij de kern van de tech stack van onze klanten, en jij zorgt ervoor dat die kern gevoed wordt met schone, betrouwbare data. We zoeken een pragmatische Data Engineer die specialist is in integraties en migraties, en precies weet hoe je data goed in HubSpot krijgt.

Wat je gaat doen

Jij bent de engineer die zorgt dat systemen met elkaar praten en data altijd klopt. Geen eindeloze architectuursessies, maar hands‑on bouwen aan oplossingen die werken. Je werkt nauw samen met onze Solution Engineers en consultants. Zij vertalen de klantbehoefte naar een ontwerp; jij zorgt dat de technische uitvoering solide is.

Wat je doet...

Data Integraties

Je bouwt en onderhoudt koppelingen tussen HubSpot en andere systemen zoals ERP's, financiële tools en andere bronnen. Je werkt hierbij voornamelijk met n8n en bent in staat ook maatwerk te bouwen via REST en GraphQL API's.

Data Migraties

Je migreert data van legacy systemen naar HubSpot. Je zorgt voor een schone datastructuur, goede mapping en een betrouwbaar eindresultaat, zonder verrassingen achteraf.

CRM Data Kwaliteit

Je begrijpt hoe een CRM werkt en weet hoe data gemodelleerd moet zijn om bruikbaar te zijn voor sales, marketing en operations. Je denkt mee over de juiste objectstructuur, veldkeuzes en relaties binnen HubSpot.

Hands-on Engineering

Je schrijft Python en SQL waar nodig, en hebt geen moeite met het debuggen van API calls, het bouwen van workflows in n8n of het oplossen van data inconsistenties.

Onze kernwaarden

Wat je mee brengt...

  • 2-4 jaar ervaring als Data Engineer, integration developer of een vergelijkbare rol, bij voorkeur in een B2B omgeving.

  • Je hebt ervaring met HubSpot, of hebt in het verleden gewerkt met een ander CRM zoals Salesforce of Pipedrive en weet hoe CRM data gestructureerd moet zijn.

  • Je hebt aantoonbare ervaring met het integreren van systemen via API's en het migreren van data tussen platforms.

  • Je hebt bij voorkeur ervaring met n8n. Verlikbare tools zijn prima, maar n8n is onze tool of choice. SQL en Python beheers je goed.

  • Je bent niet op zoek naar een omgeving met grote data warehouses en ML pipelines. Je vindt het juist leuk om concrete, overzichtelijke problemen goed op te lossen.

  • Je kunt bondig aangeven wat je doet en waarom, en schuwt het niet om aan te geven als iets technisch niet haalbaar is of anders moet.

Wat je van ons krijgt...

Geld & groei

  • Marktconform salaris tussen €4.000 - € 5.200

  • 8% vakantiegeld

  • Winstdeling als we samen winnen

  • €750 persoonlijk ontwikkelbudget + extra groeigeld

  • 1 gratis boek per kwartaal (ja, echt)

Wij werken met een transparant salarishuis van 5 levels, van junior tot director. Ben je verder dan de rol die hier staat? Solliciteer alsnog. Wij kijken naar wat je meebrengt...

Mobiliteit & gear

  • € 450 mobiliteitsbudget per maand óf een NS Business Card als je liever met de trein reist

  • MacBook Pro + randapparatuur

Tijd & flexibiliteit

  • 27 vakantiedagen

  • Bij BONANA ben je vrij op je eigen verjaardag, alvast gefeliciteerd!

  • Mogelijkheid om 10 extra vrije dagen bij te kopen

  • Flexibel werken in overleg

  • Onkostenvergoeding €73 per maand
    Het proces.

  • Intro-call (20 min)
    Past de rol, past het moment, past het salaris?

  • Verdiepingsgesprek (60 min)
    In gesprek met 2 van je toekomstige collega's. We duiken in je ervaring, jij duikt in ons. Op kantoor in Utrecht.

  • Case (60 min)
    Een echt data-vraagstuk uit onze praktijk rond. Je krijgt 'm ter plekke, zodat we zien hoe je denkt, niet hoe mooi je een deck maakt. (En jij ziet in dat uur precies hoe wij werken, handig, vóór je tekent)

  • Founder-call (30 min)
    Korte introductie met één van onze founders, zodat je precies weet waar we heen gaan en welke rol jij daarin speelt.

title: Cloud Software Engineer (OpenStack, Python), Intelligence Community Mission Program, Fort Meade, MD
description:
Cloud Software Engineer (OpenStack, Python), Intelligence Community Mission Program, Fort Meade, MD

Summary:

  • Job Title: Cloud Software Engineer, Level 3 (OpenStack, Python)
  • Openings: 1
  • Security Clearance: Active TS/SCI with Full Scope Polygraph (FSP) required.
  • Work Type: Onsite at Fort George G. Meade, MD, in a secure government facility
  • Job Type: Full-time
  • Benefits: Our client provides full benefits
  • Program Name: Enterprise engineering program for SIGINT mission systems, covering cloud infrastructure, AI/ML software, and data dissemination process modernization
  • Agency name: Intelligence Community (IC) customer, Fort George G. Meade, MD
  • Start Date: Immediate, upon offer acceptance and clearance transfer

BizFirst is assisting our client with recruiting a skilled and experienced Cloud Software Engineer. This position supports the following program: an enterprise engineering program that supports signals intelligence (SIGINT) mission systems through cloud infrastructure, AI/ML-driven software, and modernization of data dissemination processes for an Intelligence Community customer. The position is onsite at Fort Meade, MD, and the role is open now for an immediate start.

Our client is a Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Business that has supported U.S. defense and intelligence missions since 2012. Its systems, software, and data science engineers work side by side with government teams to model, design, integrate, and deploy complex mission systems, and the company also builds rugged RF hardware for specialized SIGINT applications. Led by a U.S. Navy veteran with more than 30 years of DoD mission experience, the company supports programs alongside many of the largest national security integrators and has a long-established presence in Maryland near Fort Meade.

What will you do

Build and enhance software for intelligence mission systems while designing and managing the cloud infrastructure it runs on. You will develop, maintain, and enhance complex software systems to documented requirements, review and test components against design requirements, and help decide when commercial or government off-the-shelf (COTS/GOTS) products should replace new development. You will analyze usage and work processes to find and fix problem areas, and design, deploy, and manage cloud infrastructure using OpenStack and comparable platforms. This role suits an experienced software engineer with strong Linux, scripting, and Python skills and hands-on private cloud experience.

Responsibilities:

  • Develop, maintain, and enhance complex and diverse software systems based on documented requirements.
  • Review and test software components for adherence to design requirements, and document test results.
  • Provide design decision support on using COTS and GOTS products in place of new development.
  • Analyze usage and work processes, and investigate problem areas.
  • Design, deploy, and manage cloud infrastructure using OpenStack and comparable platforms.
  • Automate tasks on Linux with Bash, shell, and Python scripts.

Requirements:

  • Active TS/SCI clearance with Full Scope Polygraph.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Engineering or Computer Science and twelve (12) years of software engineering experience. Sixteen (16) years of software engineering experience may substitute for the degree.
  • Experience designing, deploying, and managing cloud infrastructure using OpenStack and other comparable platforms.
  • Experience developing, maintaining, and enhancing complex software systems based on documented requirements.
  • Experience reviewing and testing software components and documenting test results.
  • Proficiency with the Linux/Unix command line and scripting (Bash, shell).
  • Python programming skills.
  • Solid understanding of cloud technologies.
  • Ability to work onsite at Fort Meade, MD.

Desired Skills

  • AWS or Azure certification.
  • Experience working in a DevOps environment with CI/CD pipelines.
  • Experience building or operating cloud environments for Intelligence Community or DoD customers.

Benefits (provided by our client):

  • Medical, dental, and vision coverage for the employee and family, 100% employer-paid (HMO HSA Silver plan), plus a Health Savings Account
  • Five weeks (200 hours) of paid leave per year
  • Eleven (11) paid federal holidays per year
  • 401k with an employer contribution equal to 10% of salary
  • Reimbursement for approved training, up to three days (24 hours) per year, including books and related conference or class travel
  • Reimbursement of professional fees, such as IEEE membership and licenses
  • Short-term and long-term disability insurance
  • Term life insurance equal to annual salary, up to $100K
  • Referral matching bonus program

een leuk en gezellig kantoor in jouw buurt, waar je altijd kunt ’thuiswerken’. We bieden iedereen flexibele (thuis)werktijden. Heb je een zware dag gehad? title: Project Coordinator - Compliance
description:
GeoStabilization International (GSI), Access Limited, and RoadGuard together form a leading infrastructure solutions platform dedicated to protecting people and strengthening critical infrastructure across North America and New Zealand.

GSI is the premier geohazard mitigation firm specializing in emergency slope stabilization, landslide repair, grouting, and micropiles through innovative design-build delivery. Access Limited brings over a century of steep-slope expertise and operates North America’s largest fleet of spider excavators, delivering complex rockfall and geotechnical solutions in the most challenging environments. RoadGuard, founded in 2024, unites industry-leading roadway safety companies providing guardrail, bridge railing, highway signage, fencing, and specialty fabrication services.

Across all our businesses, we are driven by innovation, extreme ownership, technical excellence, and a relentless commitment to measurable results that improve safety and infrastructure resilience.

Operations & Compliance Coordinator

POSITION SUMMARY

Lead compliance, regulatory adherence, and operational coordination across RoadGuard, GSI, and Access Limited project portfolios. Serve as the critical bridge between engineering, field operations, procurement, and client management—ensuring rigorous documentation and flawless compliance tracking at every stage.

As the RoadGuard East compliance lead, you'll own IFTA and fleet compliance, fuel reconciliation, EZPass management, oversized vehicle permits, ECMS support, prequalifications, and NY EBO compliance. Collaborate seamlessly across contracts, prequalifications, RoadGuard East operations, and job setup and logistics to support the Director of Operations in preventing compliance gaps and keeping projects on time and on budget.

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Contract Review & Risk Analysis: Review contracts against bid estimates to identify cost gaps (traffic control, permitting, labor) and compliance risks; escalate findings to management
  • Insurance & Bonding Coordination: Manage bond, insurance, and OCIP coordination to ensure adequate coverage for labor, liability, and specialized hazards
  • DOT Prequalification Management: Oversee NJ/PA/DE DOT prequalification including DC18 forms, employer verification, and certifications; coordinate DBE/EEO documentation
  • Project Setup & Field Coordination: Execute B2W to ProContractor mapping, bid portal submissions, site visits, and field data collection
  • Schedule & Budget Oversight: Monitor project schedules and budgets, flag variances, maintain documentation, and facilitate communication between internal teams and clients
  • Compliance Portfolio Leadership: Own the RoadGuard East compliance program—IFTA, fleet tracking, fuel reconciliation, EZPass, oversized permits, ECMS, and NY EBO compliance

KEY COMPETENCIES

  • Attention to Detail: Errors cascade into cost overruns, compliance violations, and reputational risk—this is non-negotiable
  • Multitasking & Prioritization: Juggle concurrent demands across contracts, RoadGuard East compliance, procurement, and job setup
  • Communication: Bridge internal teams and external partners (clients, DOT, insurers, bonding companies) with clarity and professionalism
  • Technical Proficiency: Advanced Excel skills (formulas, data organization, reporting); comfort with Word and web-based project management/accounting platforms
  • Contract & Compliance Expertise: Identify missing or conflicting terms, cost overruns, and compliance risks before they become problems
  • Proactive Risk Management: Flag risks, deadlines, and data gaps before they escalate

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • High school diploma or equivalent
  • 2+ years of experience in project coordination, construction compliance, contract administration, or operations support
  • Demonstrated contract review and compliance identification experience
  • Intermediate proficiency in Excel, Word, and web-based project management/accounting platforms
  • Exceptional attention to detail and organizational skills
  • Professional communication and multitasking abilities
  • Working knowledge of IFTA, fleet compliance, DOT, ECMS, EZPass, oversized vehicle permits, and NY EBO regulations

AUTHORITY & OWNERSHIP

  • Review contracts for compliance and risk; provide assessment and recommendations to management
  • Own the RoadGuard East compliance portfolio independently: IFTA, fleet tracking, fuel reconciliation, EZPass, oversized permits, ECMS, and NY EBO compliance
  • Manage and maintain driver qualification files, equipment registration, prequalifications, and compliance records
  • Identify and communicate compliance risks, schedule threats, and budget concerns directly to the Director of Operations

title: Adult Services Clinician
description:
Overview

Career opportunities abound at SOUND! SOUND Behavioral Health is growing, and we are hiring an Adult Services Clinician in Auburn, WA! We offer a supportive working environment, excellent and abundant supervision, and opportunities for professional growth.The clinician will help clients understand their behaviors, teach clients how to change their responses to unfavorable situations, and assist clients in developing healthier coping mechanisms.

Sound clinicians are focused on demonstrating compassion, patience, and understanding when treating clients. We believe in and advocate for Diversity, Equity, Justice, and Inclusion for our team and clients.

Schedule: Monday- Friday 8:00 AM - 5:00 PM

Location: 4238 Auburn Way N Auburn, Washington 98002 United States

Accepting Applications until October 2nd, 2026.

Responsibilities

GENERAL SUMMARY

The clinician in this Job is responsible for providing a range of intensive outpatient services to an assigned group serving the overall adult population. Intensive case management services with outreach and engagement services are required.

Interventions may be time limited or longer term and will be part of an outcome-oriented treatment plan developed within a managed care framework, which includes periodic reviews for appropriateness of services and intensity. The individual in this Job will participate actively in the treatment planning and review process, including supporting documentation of the clinical services performed.

The individual in this Job will be required to work with primary care physicians, DSHS programs, and inpatient facilities, mental health residential facilities, and other adult servicing agencies to develop a comprehensive treatment plan for clients with significant behavioral health problems in the community.

Case management includes coordination and consultation with other service providers and community resources, and referrals to facilitate meeting the clients' needs.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS AND DUTIES

• Provides direct services and/or internal and external organization referrals for clients.

• Develops treatment plans and maintains accurate and timely clinical records according to organization policy.

• Performs outreaches/services to community locations to engage clients in care.

• To comply with County and State standards there will be service intensity expectations.

• Prepares necessary reports, summaries and progress notes, and incorporates into clinical records.

• Performs consultations and liaison duties with other agencies and resources on behalf of the client.

• Assists clients to remain stable in the community, thereby reducing the use of hospitals or involuntary treatment services.

• Monitor medication regimes and treatment compliance.

• Monitor utilization of services and the success of outcome measures.

• Participates in team member meetings, consultations, case presentations and in service training.

• Participates in ongoing program development and assessment.

• Performs other duties as assigned.

KEY WORK RELATIONSHIPS

Develops and maintains collaborative working relationships across departments, engaging with clients, team members, management and leadership in a manner that values diverse perspectives and lived experiences. Contributes to a respectful and inclusive work environment by practicing cultural humility, promoting equity in services and decision-making,and supporting efforts that foster a sense of belonging for all.

Qualifications

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE

  • Master's degree in social work, psychology, or a counseling-related field, with a strong emphasis on working with families and community agencies required.

  • A minimum of one year of clinical experience as a clinician or case manager and demonstrated skills in clinical assessment and treatment plans, preferred.

KNOWLEDGE, ABILITIES, AND SKILLS

  • Possesses excellent judgment, effective communication and strong collaboration skills.
  • Understands the principles of individual therapy, group therapy and/or case management approach to providing services.
  • Possesses strong working knowledge of the physical and/or behavioral health and support resources of King County and is familiar with state and local health delivery systems, including knowledge of various funding principles and clinical services mandates.
  • Understands recovery concepts in behavioral health; synthesizes and applies, as appropriate to their work at Sound.
  • Ability to learn new tasks and skills quickly, and to manage and prioritize multiple tasks, while simultaneously managing crises.
  • Able to demonstrate the capacity to appreciate and work well with the complex and diverse population. .

CERTIFICATES, LICENSES & REGISTRATIONS

  • Washington State driver’s license and insurable driving record required.

  • Must obtain and maintain a Washington State Agency Affiliated Counselor (AAC) credential through the Washington State Department of Health as required under RCW 18.19 – Counselors.

  • Must pass a criminal background check.

SENSORY/PHYSICAL/MENTAL REQUIREMENTS

The requirement described below are representative of those required to successfully perform the essential functions of this position. Reasonable accommodations may be made through the interactive ADA accommodation process to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Sensory:

  • Communicate effectively with clients, colleagues, and community partners in person by telephone, and through virtual platforms.
  • Hear and understand conversations in person and over the phone in office and community settings.
  • Read and interpret written materials, clinical documentation, policies, and electronic health records.
  • Observe and assess client behavior, emotional state, and environmental safety cues during clinical interactions.
  • Use visual acuity to review documentation, reports, and electronic systems.

Physical:

  • Sit for extended periods while completing documentation, virtual meetings, and computer-based work.
  • Frequently use hands and fingers to operate a computer keyboard, phone, and other office equipment.
  • Occasionally stand, walk, bend, or reach while interacting with clients or retrievingfiles or materials.
  • Travel within the community as required to meet with clients, attend meetings, or conduct outreach.
  • Lift or move items such as files, laptops, or office materials (typically up to 10–20 pounds).
  • Maintain the ability to engage clients in both office and community-based environments.

Mental:

  • Maintain concentration and attention to detail while documenting clinical services and reviewing records.
  • Analyze complex client situations and apply clinical judgment in accordance with professional standards and organizational policies.
  • Manage multiple tasks, deadlines, and priorities in a fast-paced clinical environment.
  • Demonstrate emotional regulation and professionalism when working with individuals experiencing behavioral health crises or distress.
  • Exercise sound decision-making and problem-solving skills in both routine and urgent situations.
  • Maintain confidentiality and adhere to ethical, legal, and regulatory requirements including HIPAA.
  • Adapt to changing client needs, program requirements, and organizational priorities.

PROTECTED HEALTH INFORMATION (PHI) ACCESS

All information (written, verbal, electronic, etc.) that a team member encounters while working at Sound is considered confidential. Sound team members may encounter protected health information in the regular course of their work. This position may be exposed to and required to deal with highly confidential and sensitive material and must adhere to Sound policies, guidelines, and all applicable laws and regulations at all times.

LIMITATIONS AND DISCLAIMERThe above Job description is meant to describe the general nature and level of work performed; it is not intended as an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities and required skills for the Job. Team members will be required to follow any other Job-related instructions and to perform other duties requested by their supervisor in compliance with Federal and State laws. Requirements are representative of minimum levels of knowledge, skills and/or abilities necessary to perform each duty proficiently. Continued employment remains on an “at-will” basis.

Perks at Sound!

All Team Members at Sound working 40 hours per week will be eligible for the following benefits:

  • Medical, Dental & Vision Insurance: Premium 100% paid by Sound for team member and child coverage to age 26, depending on plan selected. Spouse/Domestic Partner coverage available at team member’s cost.
  • Life Insurance (2x annual salary + additional $25,000): paid by Sound
  • Long Term Disability Insurance (60% monthly salary): paid by Sound
  • Retirement Plan: Sound contributes 3% to team member’s plan; team member is 100% vested.
  • Retirement Plan - 401(k) Plan, pre-tax and/or Roth: team member may contribute to their own plan.
  • Health Savings Account: Sound contributes $1,133.33 (individual) or $2,266.67 (family) for eligible team members, pro-rated for new hires in first year.
  • Flexible Spending Accounts: for health care and dependent day care costs (pre-tax)
  • EAP: Employee Assistance Plan
  • Vacation: 18 days per year, increasing with years of service
  • Holidays: 9 days per year
  • Sick Leave: 12 days per year
  • Bereavement Leave: for death in the family
  • Parking: Free at all Sound sites
  • Training: Free in-house professional training and $400 annually + 3 paid days approved off-site training
  • Service Award: at 5, 10, 15, 20, 25, 30, 35 & 40 years of service
Compensation range: $31.90-$34.65 per hour

title: Solutions Engineer
description:
Solutions Engineer

About Discernis
Discernis builds AI driven document intelligence for high stakes legal work. Because our customers handle privileged and regulated matters that most cloud AI cannot touch, we run on premises and in customer controlled environments as well as in the cloud. That makes security, reliability, and reproducibility core product features, not afterthoughts. We work with AmLaw firms and enterprise legal teams where accuracy, explainability, and data control are non negotiable.

The Role
You will be the technical bridge between our customers and our product, owning the technical side of the sale and the success of every pilot that follows. In the room, you will go toe to toe with sophisticated technical buyers, the IT, security, and infrastructure leaders at large law firms who decide whether a product is safe to run on their terms. After the sale, you will own the pilot: making sure it is deployed well, that it earns trust, and that it converts into a long term deal. You will work hand in hand with our founder, sales, and engineering team, and you will be the person who turns technical credibility into revenue.

What You Will Do

  • Partner with our account executives as the technical lead on enterprise deals, running demos, proofs of value, and deep technical discovery

  • Interface with technical buyers on architecture, deployment, and data handling, including our on premises and customer controlled deployment model

  • Own security reviews and technical questionnaires, translating our compliance posture into answers that satisfy demanding firms

  • Lead pilots end to end, from deployment and onboarding through to the results that justify a full commitment

  • Own the technical relationship after the sale: drive adoption, resolve issues, and identify expansion opportunities

  • Serve as the two way channel between customers and engineering, carrying real world feedback back into the product

  • Help productize and streamline how we deploy, onboard, and support customers as we scale

What You Bring

  • Experience in a solutions engineering, sales engineering, forward deployed, or technical customer success role, ideally selling technical products to enterprise buyers

  • Enough technical depth to hold your own with IT and security leaders: comfort with APIs, deployment models, cloud and on premises infrastructure, and security fundamentals

  • The ability to move fluidly between a sales conversation and a technical one, and to translate cleanly between them

  • A track record of running successful pilots or onboardings that turned into lasting, expanding accounts

  • Excellent communication and presence with senior, skeptical stakeholders

  • Strong ownership instincts and follow through, especially when a deal or a deployment depends on it

  • Bonus: familiarity with Kubernetes, Docker, or Linux, and experience selling or deploying into law firms, legal, eDiscovery, or another regulated enterprise market

Why This Role

  • Real influence over both revenue and product at a company at the ground floor

  • Meaningful early equity and direct work with the founder and leadership team

  • A technical product in a market where few competitors can follow us on premises, so your technical credibility is a genuine differentiator, not a formality

Location
This role is based in New York City and is primarily in person.
