description:
Position Summary

South Bay Solutions is seeking a highly detail-oriented Precision Masking Technician to support our new powder coating operation serving the semiconductor and medical device industries.

This position is responsible for accurately masking machined metal components prior to powder coating using a variety of masking materials and techniques. The ideal candidate understands that masking directly impacts product quality and customer acceptance.

This is a precision manufacturing position requiring patience, creativity, efficiency, and exceptional attention to detail.


Essential Responsibilities

· Interpret work instructions, engineering drawings and masking requirements.

· Apply high-temperature masking tapes, silicone plugs, caps, discs and custom masking solutions.

· Develop creative masking techniques for complex geometries.

· Protect critical surfaces, threaded holes, sealing surfaces and precision machined features.

· Verify masking before parts enter the powder coating process.

· Remove masking after curing without damaging coated surfaces.

· Inspect completed parts for masking defects.

· Maintain masking inventory and recommend new masking products.

· Participate in continuous improvement activities to reduce masking time while maintaining quality.

· Assist with part preparation, hanging and packaging as required.

· Maintain clean work area using 6S principles.


Required Qualifications

· 2+ years masking experience in:

o Powder coating

o Industrial painting

o Aerospace

o Precision metal finishing

· Ability to read blueprints

· Excellent hand dexterity

· High attention to detail

· Experience using:

o High-temperature tapes

o Silicone plugs

o Silicone caps

o Liquid masking

o Custom masking fixtures

· Ability to work independently


Key Skills

· Detail oriented

· Excellent hand-eye coordination

· Creative problem solving

· Process improvement mindset

· Time management

· Quality focused

· Organized

· Mechanically inclined


Physical Requirements

· Lift up to 40 lbs

· Stand throughout shift

· Excellent manual dexterity

· Color vision sufficient to distinguish masking requirements

· Use of PPE



Schedule

Day Shift | Monday – Friday | 6:00 AM – 2:35 PM


Benefits

  • Health Insurance (Medical/Dental/Vision)
  • Life insurance policy
  • Safe Harbor 401(K) plan
  • 401(k) match

title: Front Entrance Experience Specialist
description:
The Opportunity

The Front Entrance Experience Specialist owns the front entrance experience for the Memphis Grizzlies, creating a welcoming, professional, and secure environment for everyone who enters the building. This role combines access control and public safety support with thoughtful, personalized hospitality that helps employees, candidates, business partners, and guests feel expected, recognized, and cared for.

More than completing a check-in, the Front Entrance Experience Specialist anticipates needs, notices important details, and takes ownership of the arrival experience while consistently upholding access, confidentiality, and safety standards.

The ideal candidate is equally comfortable verifying credentials, navigating sensitive interactions, and welcoming all guests with warmth and professionalism. They understand that exceptional hospitality is not always about a grand gesture. It is about being prepared, creating meaningful connections, and making each interaction feel intentional.

In This Role You Will

Front Entrance Hospitality and Experience

  • Own a polished, welcoming, and personalized front entrance experience that reflects the organization’s culture, brand, and service standards.
  • Greet and check in candidates, vendors, contractors, business partners, executives, special guests and visitors with warmth, discretion, and professionalism.
  • Review expected arrivals, meetings, interviews, deliveries, games, and events to ensure the front entrance is prepared and welcoming to guests.
  • Verify appointments and access requirements, notify the appropriate employee of each arrival, and manage the check-in experience until the visitor is connected with their host.
  • Anticipate visitor needs, communicate delays, and take ownership of questions or concerns by coordinating with the appropriate internal teams.
  • Maintain a welcoming, organized, and presentation-ready lobby and identify opportunities to improve the front entrance experience.

Public Safety, Access, and Emergency Support

  • Serve as the first point of screening and sound judgment regarding who and what enters the building.
  • Verify visitor purpose and credentials, maintain visitor logs, and issue, track, and collect visitor badges.
  • Coordinate access for vendors, contractors, deliveries, and scheduled visitors in accordance with access-control and confidentiality procedures.
  • Monitor the front entrance, maintain situational awareness, and address or escalate unauthorized access, prohibited items, unusual activity, or other concerns.
  • Balance hospitality with security by applying access requirements consistently, respectfully, and professionally.
  • Remain composed during difficult interactions and seek support from Public Safety or emergency responders when a situation exceeds the position’s authority or training.
  • Follow emergency procedures and assist with notifications, evacuations, shelter-in-place protocols, and medical response coordination.
  • Document incidents, access concerns, and follow-up needs accurately and promptly while protecting confidential information.

Administrative Support and Operational Readiness

  • Manage the multiline phone system and route calls with professionalism, accuracy, and care.
  • Receive and coordinate deliveries, mail, packages, and visitor parking validation.
  • Maintain accurate visitor, access, delivery, and operational records and communicate relevant facility updates.
  • Conduct opening, closing, and front-of-house readiness checks, addressing or reporting cleanliness, safety, presentation, and maintenance concerns.
  • Submit work orders and coordinate follow-up with the appropriate teams.
  • Support arena events, meetings, employee activities, and other operational needs within the reasonable scope of the role.
  • Maintain confidentiality regarding all guests and organizational activity.
  • Other duties as assigned.

The Experience You Will Bring

  • Minimum of an associate degree required; bachelor’s degree preferred.
  • Three or more years of experience supporting visitor access, facility operations, building security protocols, access control processes, CCTV, or a related area.
  • Two or more years of guest services, reception, hospitality, or other high-visibility customer-facing experience.
  • Strong hospitality instincts with the ability to notice details, anticipate needs, personalize interactions, and take ownership of concerns.
  • Sound judgment, emotional intelligence, professionalism, discretion, and situational awareness.
  • Ability to remain calm, communicate clearly, and balance thoughtful service with access, safety, and confidentiality requirements.
  • Professional presence and comfort interacting with employees, candidates, executives, VIP, special guests and/or visitors.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills, including accurate incident documentation.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office and the ability to learn visitor-management, CCTV access-control, phone, and incident-reporting systems.
  • Ability to build effective working relationships across departments and with external partners.
  • Flexibility to work early mornings, evenings, weekends, holidays, games, and special events as needed.

Nice to Have:

  • Experience using Cisco, RingCentral, or another multiline phone system.
  • Experience in an arena, stadium, entertainment venue, premium hospitality environment, corporate office, or other high-traffic facility.
  • Experience supporting high-profile arrivals or using visitor-management and access-control systems.
  • Knowledge and appreciation of basketball, sports, entertainment, and the fan experience.

What Success Looks Like

  • Visitors, candidates, employees, and business partners are welcomed professionally and experience a smooth, efficient check-in process.
  • Visitor notifications, access procedures, and front entrance operations are executed accurately and consistently.
  • Front entrance operations remain organized, professional, and responsive throughout the day.
  • Access and safety concerns are identified, documented, and escalated appropriately when needed.
  • Employees and departments view this role as a dependable, service-oriented point of contact for visitor management and front entrance support.

Physical and Scheduling Requirements

  • Ability to remain stationary and/or move throughout the reception, lobby, and facility areas for extended periods.
  • Ability to occasionally lift or move packages, supplies, or materials weighing up to 25 pounds.
  • Ability to work a flexible, full-time schedule that may include evenings, weekends, holidays, games, and special events as required by business needs.
  • Ability to respond appropriately and move throughout the facility during emergency or high-priority situations.

What We Offer

At the Memphis Grizzlies, we strive to support our team members through all stages of life with robust and attractive benefits, financial and wellness options and great perks. In addition to offering a competitive salary, we have other great benefits and perks.

Keeping You Healthy

  • Industry leading health coverage
  • Short and Long-term disability
  • Team Member and Dependent Life Insurance
  • Group Voluntary Benefits
  • Wellness programs through EAP and Headspace

Discounts and Perks

  • Matching 401(k)
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • Tuition Reimbursement
  • Team Store Discounts
  • Happy Hours and other fun activities
  • Qualified parking and game night meals
  • NBA Sponsored Discount Programs
  • Employee Referral Bonuses
  • Employee Recognition Programs

Taking Time Off

  • Generous Paid Time Off
  • Holiday Pay
  • Paid Parental Leave

‎

Memphis Basketball LLC is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to treating all applicants and team members fairly based on their abilities, achievements and experience without regard to race, national origin, sex, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or any other classification protected by law.

Applicant Safety: The Memphis Grizzlies have been made aware of bad actors using our company's name for fake employment opportunities using social media and instant messaging platforms. The Memphis Grizzlies will never require candidates to send or deposit money in exchange for, or as a condition of, an offer of employment. The Grizzlies will also never ask for any sensitive personal information such as social security numbers, dates of birth, or bank account details via email, social media or messaging platforms, or during interviews. If you are contacted by anyone claiming to represent the Memphis Grizzlies and cannot confirm they are with our company, please contact us with the details.

title: Senior Data Ops Engineer, Data Activation & Products - Activision
description:
Job Title:

Senior Data Ops Engineer, Data Activation & Products - Activision

Requisition ID:

R028025

Job Description:

Your Mission

We are looking for a Site Reliability Engineer to help improve the reliability, observability, and operational maturity of our data platforms, Kubernetes-based deployment systems, internal applications, and cloud environments.

This role sits at the intersection of SRE, DevOps, and data. The ideal candidate is comfortable operating production systems, troubleshooting across infrastructure and applications, and helping teams deploy and support services more safely.

The role does not require someone to be a data engineer, but they should be excited about the systems that support modern data engineering, including Databricks, Spark, Airflow/Astronomer, streaming pipelines, event systems, internal tools, and backend services.

We are especially interested in a creative, curious engineer who enjoys learning new technology and using AI-accelerated development practices to solve problems faster and more thoughtfully. You should be excited to experiment with agentic development tools, automation frameworks, and emerging platform capabilities, while applying sound engineering judgment.

This role has the option to be based in our Los Angeles (Pen Factory) office and follows an onsite work schedule of Monday through Thursday or be remote. Work arrangements may change at the company’s discretion to meet business needs.

Priorities can often change in a fast-paced environment like ours, so this role includes, but is not limited to, the following responsibilities:

  • Monitor service health, respond to alerts, and participate in incident response for cloud, Kubernetes, application, and data platform environments.
  • Investigate reliability issues across Kubernetes, networking, DNS, application runtime behavior, Databricks jobs, Spark workloads, orchestration systems, event systems, and dependent services.
  • Support the reliability of internal applications, APIs, workers, streaming consumers, event-driven services, and deployment workflows used by data engineering and business teams.
  • Build and maintain dashboards, alerting, runbooks, and operational documentation that improve detection and recovery speed.
  • Improve observability for Databricks environments, including job health, Spark streaming workloads, structured streaming metrics, cluster behavior, failures, latency, throughput, and cost signals.
  • Help route Spark streaming metrics, operational logs, event-system signals, and platform health signals into monitoring tools such as Grafana.
  • Contribute to alerting patterns for Databricks workflows, Airflow/Astronomer DAGs, dbt jobs, data freshness, pipeline failures, event lag, dead-letter queues, and production data dependencies.
  • Contribute scripts and automation that reduce repetitive operational work and improve environment hygiene.
  • Support release and deployment reliability by validating changes, improving rollback readiness, and strengthening change safety.
  • Partner with data engineers, analytics engineers, and software engineers to improve reliability across pipelines, services, internal tools, event systems, and data products.
  • Participate in post-incident follow-up and help close corrective actions that prevent recurrence.
  • Support platform modernization and migration efforts, including orchestration platform changes, deployment system improvements, and shared reliability standards.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in SRE, DevOps, cloud infrastructure, platform engineering, software engineering, data platform operations, or related production-support roles.
  • Hands-on experience supporting Kubernetes-based workloads, deployment systems, cloud infrastructure, or production application environments.
  • Familiarity with Linux, HTTP, DNS, containers, Kubernetes, Git-based workflows, and scripting in Bash, Python, or similar languages.
  • Experience with monitoring, logs, metrics, dashboards, alerting, and incident management practices.
  • Comfort working with event systems such as Kafka, Google Pub/Sub, Kinesis, or similar technologies, including topics, subscriptions, consumers, retries, lag, and dead-letter queues.
  • Strong troubleshooting mindset, clear communication, and comfort operating in a production-support environment.
  • Interest in data platforms, data engineering systems, orchestration, streaming workloads, event-driven architecture, internal developer tools, and production data services.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with Kubernetes deployment and release tooling such as Helm, ArgoCD, or similar GitOps workflows.
  • Experience with CI/CD automation using GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, or similar pipelines.
  • Familiarity with infrastructure as code using Terraform or similar provisioning tools.
  • Familiarity with Databricks, Spark, Spark Structured Streaming, Airflow, Astronomer, dbt, Kafka, Pub/Sub, object storage, or lakehouse architectures.
  • Experience with observability tools such as Grafana, Prometheus, Cloud Monitoring, Datadog, Splunk, or similar platforms.
  • Experience supporting internal applications, APIs, event-driven services, streaming consumers, or backend workers.
  • Exposure to data reliability concepts such as freshness, latency, completeness, pipeline health, data quality checks, and dependency-aware alerting.
  • Exposure to SLOs, SLAs, error budgets, postmortems, or formal reliability practices.

What Success Looks Like

  • Kubernetes and deployment workflows are easier to operate, monitor, and troubleshoot.
  • Databricks, Spark, streaming, orchestration, event-driven, and dbt environments have clearer dashboards, alerts, and runbooks.
  • Spark streaming metrics, event-system health signals, and platform logs are easier to access, visualize, and operationalize through tools such as Grafana.
  • Incidents are detected faster, resolved more efficiently, and followed up with meaningful corrective actions.
  • Data engineers, analytics engineers, and software engineers can deploy changes more safely and with greater confidence.
  • Repetitive operational work is reduced through automation and better platform standards.
  • Platform migrations and modernization efforts are supported with strong reliability, observability, and operational practices.

Our World

At Activision, we strive to create the most iconic brands in gaming and entertainment. We’re driven by our mission to deliver unrivaled gaming experiences for the world to enjoy, together. We are home to some of the most beloved entertainment franchises including Call of Duty®, Crash Bandicoot™, Tony Hawk’s™ Pro Skater™, and Guitar Hero®. As a leading worldwide developer, publisher and distributor of interactive entertainment and products, our “press start” is simple: delight hundreds of millions of players around the world with innovative, fun, thrilling, and engaging entertainment experiences.

We’re not just looking back at our decades-long legacy; we’re forging ahead to keep advancing gameplay with some of the most popular titles and sophisticated technology in the world. We have bold ambitions to create the most inclusive company as we know our success comes from the passionate, creative, and diverse teams within our organization.

We’re in the business of delivering fun and unforgettable entertainment for our player community to enjoy. And our future opportunities have never been greater — this could be your opportunity to level up.

Ready to Activate Your Future?

Rewards

We provide a suite of benefits that promote physical, emotional and financial well-being for ‘Every World’ - we’ve got our employees covered! Subject to eligibility requirements, the Company offers comprehensive benefits including:

  • Medical, dental, vision, health savings account or health reimbursement account, healthcare spending accounts, dependent care spending accounts, life and AD&D insurance, disability insurance;
  • 401(k) with Company match, tuition reimbursement, charitable donation matching;
  • Paid holidays and vacation, paid sick time, floating holidays, compassion and bereavement leaves, parental leave;
  • Mental health & wellbeing programs, fitness programs, free and discounted games, and a variety of other voluntary benefit programs like supplemental life & disability, legal service, ID protection, rental insurance, and others;
  • If the Company requires that you move geographic locations for the job, then you may also be eligible for relocation assistance.

Eligibility to participate in these benefits may vary for part time and temporary full-time employees and interns with the Company. You can learn more by visiting .

In the U.S., the standard base pay range for this role is $102,800.00 - $190,204.00 Annual. These values reflect the expected base pay range of new hires across all U.S. locations. Ultimately, your specific range and offer will be based on several factors, including relevant experience, performance, and work location. Your Talent Professional can share this role’s range details for your local geography during the hiring process. In addition to a competitive base pay, employees in this role may be eligible for incentive compensation. Incentive compensation is not guaranteed. While we strive to provide competitive offers to successful candidates, new hire compensation is negotiable.

title: Data Scientist met liefde voor Data Engineering en AI gezocht
description:
Data Scientist met liefde voor Data Engineering en AI gezocht

Ben jij zo’n Data Scientist die niet alleen blij wordt van modellen bouwen, maar ook van zorgen dat ze landen in de praktijk?Voor een mooie opdracht bij een grote speler in de logistieke sector zoeken wij vanuit IBS een Data Scientist die graag de brug slaat tussen data science, data engineering, AI en businessvraagstukken.

Je gaat aan de slag in een multidisciplinair team met developers, een data engineer/scientist, tester, designer en product owner. Een compact team met een sterke can-do mentaliteit, waar de lijnen kort zijn en waar zichtbaar resultaat belangrijker is dan grote plannen zonder actie.

Wat deze opdracht interessant maakt?

Je werkt aan bestaande en nieuwe modellen, procedures en ETL-processen. Je denkt mee over datakwaliteit, monitoring, databaseprocessen en de verdere inzet van AI en data science binnen een complexe operationele omgeving. Dit doe je door vanuit je discipline de lead te pakken en aan te sturen.

We zoeken iemand die energie krijgt van:

Het ontwikkelen, onderhouden en verbeteren van modellen en algoritmes

Het automatiseren en optimaliseren van databaseprocessen

Het opzetten van monitoring rondom outliers, model drift en data drift

Het vertalen van businessvragen naar concrete data-oplossingen

Het werken in een Agile/Scrum team met een pragmatische instelling

Het bouwen aan oplossingen die technischsterk zijn, maar vooral ook werken in de praktijk

Qua stack is ervaring met onder andere Python, Pandas, Scikit-learn, Statsmodels, Random Forests, XGBoost, Power BI, Oracle/PL-SQL en Microsoft SQL Server relevant. Ervaring met Linux, Docker en release management is mooi meegenomen.

Je bent analytisch sterk, proactief, open in de samenwerking en je vindt het leuk om business en techniek met elkaar te verbinden. Je hoeft niet alleen de perfecte code te schrijven, maar snapt ook waarom een oplossing wel of niet werkt voor de mensen die ermee moeten werken.

De opdracht is in de regio Rotterdam en vraagt om meerdere dagen per week op locatie werken. Daar staat tegenover dat je terechtkomt in een omgeving waar data direct raakt aan processen, operatie en besluitvorming.

Lijkt dit je interessant, of ken je iemand die hier goed op zou passen?

title: Cloud Engineer Data & Intelligence , Almelo
description:
Wat maakt deze rol uniek?

Veel Cloud Engineer rollen draaien om het bouwen van oplossingen voor klanten. Bij Adwise ga je verder. Je werkt aan ons eigen AI-first platform: een schaalbaar ecosysteem waarin data, AI, agents, digital twins en business intelligence samenkomen. Niet als experiment naast de business, maar als strategische motor voor hoe wij en onze klanten in de toekomst werken.

Dat betekent:

Van project naar platform

Je werkt niet aan losse implementaties, maar aan een product met lange termijn impact. Een platform dat continu doorontwikkeld wordt en steeds slimmer wordt door data, feedback en nieuwe AI-toepassingen.

AI-agents en digital twins als kern

Je bouwt mee aan een ecosysteem waarin AI-agents klanten en medewerkers ondersteunen in hun werk. Denk aan slimme analyses, geautomatiseerde workflows, betere besluitvorming en digital twins die marketingprocessen voorspelbaarder en schaalbaarder maken.

Cloud als groeigebied

We beseffen dat Cloud voor veel engineers relatief nieuw terrein is. Je hoeft dus niet alles al tot in detail te beheersen. Belangrijker is dat je een stevige cloudbasis hebt, nieuwsgierig bent en het vermogen hebt om snel nieuwe technologie eigen te maken.

Veel eigenaarschap in een klein team

Geen logge organisatie of eindeloze lagen. Je werkt in een klein, ambitieus team waarin je direct invloed hebt op architectuur, keuzes, richting en kwaliteit.

Techniek, business en gebruikers samenbrengen

Je begrijpt niet alleen hoe je iets bouwt, maar ook waarom. Je denkt mee over de waarde voor consultants, marketeers, developers, klanten en de organisatie als geheel.

Ruimte om te experimenteren

Je krijgt bewust tijd om te bouwen, testen en nieuwe technologie te verkennen. Minimaal 10% van je tijd staat in het teken van innovatie, experiment en ontwikkeling.

Kort gezegd: je bouwt niet alleen cloud-infrastructuur. Je bouwt mee aan een agentic platform dat fundamenteel verandert hoe wij met data, AI en marketing werken.

Wat ga je doen?

Je werkt met een team aan het ontwerpen, bouwen en onderhouden van onze cloud-infrastructuur binnen Google Cloud. Daarbij combineer je technische diepgang met een goed begrip van de businesscontext, gebruikersbehoefte en de fase waarin ons platform zich bevindt: ambitieus, innovatief en volop in ontwikkeling.

Concreet ga je aan de slag met:

  • Het ontwikkelen en beheren van serverless oplossingen, onder andere met Cloud Run.
  • Het bouwen, optimaliseren en onderhouden van data pipelines, ETL-processen en multi-tenant oplossingen.
  • Het werken met BigQuery, data warehouses, NoSQL en datamodellen voor schaalbare data-oplossingen.
  • Samen met andere engineers en software developers ontwikkel en koppel je AI-agents en A2A-ketens.
  • Het meedenken over MCP, CLI’s, API’s, integraties en tooling.
  • Het borgen van security, data-isolatie, authenticatie en autorisatie.
  • Het zorgen voor monitoring, performance, betrouwbaarheid en onderhoudbaarheid.
  • Het signaleren van kansen om AI slimmer, sneller of waardevoller in te zetten voor Adwise en onze klanten.

Je voert dus niet alleen uit wat gevraagd wordt. Je denkt actief mee hoe AI slimmer, sneller en waardevoller kan worden ingezet. Je stelt vragen als: welke data ontbreken nog, welke processen kunnen slimmer en welke AI-toepassing levert écht waarde op voor consultants, klanten en collega’s? Daarbij weet je complexe technologie terug te brengen naar schaalbare, begrijpelijke en onderhoudbare oplossingen.

Je werkt in een omgeving waar nog niet alles vastligt. Dat vraagt om iemand die niet wacht op perfecte kaders of uitgewerkte tickets, maar kansen signaleert, ideeën concreet maakt en verantwoordelijkheid pakt om het platform verder te brengen.

Wie zoeken we?

Je bent iemand die graag bouwt. Niet alleen nadenkt, maar ook doet. Je krijgt energie van nieuwe technologie, maar weet ook dat impact pas ontstaat wanneer complexe oplossingen praktisch, betrouwbaar en bruikbaar worden.

Je hoeft geen Google Cloud-expert van dag één te zijn. We beseffen dat Google Cloud voor veel engineers relatief nieuw terrein is. Wat we belangrijker vinden, is dat je een sterke technische basis hebt, nieuwsgierig bent en het leuk vindt om nieuwe technologie te ontdekken en om te zetten naar oplossingen die echt waarde leveren.

Wat je meebrengt:

  • Ervaring met cloudtechnologie, bij voorkeur Google Cloud. Ervaring met AWS of Azure is ook een sterke basis.
  • Kennis van serverless architecturen.
  • Ervaring met development en het bouwen van schaalbare oplossingen.
  • Begrip van security, zoals authenticatie, autorisatie en data-isolatie.
  • Sterke communicatieve vaardigheden richting technische én niet-technische collega’s.
  • Nieuwsgierigheid naar AI, agents, automatisering en nieuwe cloudtoepassingen.
  • Je spreekt en schrijft vloeiend Nederlands.

De grootste impact ontstaat op het snijvlak van techniek, processen en menselijk gedrag. Daarom werk je niet alleen samen met developers, maar ook met consultants, marketeers, operations en management.

Waarom Adwise?

  • Je krijgt de ruimte om te experimenteren en te innoveren met 15% innovatietijd en toegang tot de nieuwste tools en technieken.
  • We delen kennis in gezamenlijke brainstorms, kennissessies en events.
  • Je krijgt veel vrijheid, vertrouwen en flexibele werktijden, inclusief mogelijkheid tot workation.
  • Je ontwikkelt jezelf continu via de Adwise Academy, coaching en innovatietijd.
  • Je werkt samen met 125+ digital minds binnen één van de meest toonaangevende agencies van Nederland.
  • Een cultuur waarin we samen leren, creëren, vieren en groeien.
  • En bovenal: je bouwt mee aan de #1 agency van Nederland, waar technologie, creativiteit en data samenkomen om klanten een beslissende voorsprong te geven.

Diversity, Equity & Inclusion statement

“Bij Adwise geloven we dat je pas echt impact maakt, wanneer verschillende perspectieven samenkomen. Juist door unieke achtergronden, ervaringen, persoonlijkheden en ideeën te omarmen, creëren we écht betekenisvolle oplossingen die onze opdrachtgevers, onze organisatie, onze eigen Adwisers en de wereld om ons heen verder helpen.”

“We streven ernaar dat iedereen die bij of met de Wise Fundaments Group (Adwise, Adwise Academy en Wisepeople) werkt, evenals potentiële nieuwe medewerkers zich elke dag welkom, veilig en volwaardig onderdeel voelen van de Groep.”

title: Medior Data Engineer
description:
Bij IG&H helpen we onze klanten om koplopers in hun markt te worden door de business technology expert te zijn waarop ze kunnen vertrouwen in de voortdurend veranderende digitale wereld. We doorbreken silo’s en brengen consultingvaardigheden samen met diepgaande expertise in data, technologie en organisatieverandering om organisaties succesvol te transformeren. Wil jij hierin de lead nemen als Data Engineer?

We zijn op zoek naar een Data Engineer om datagedreven producten te ontwerpen, te bouwen en een nieuwe databackbone te creëren voor onze data science-projecten. De Data Engineer zal de lead nemen om onze klanten naar het volgende niveau van datahandling en data-automatiseringsmogelijkheden te brengen. Verder zal je (technische) leiderschapsvaardigheden, ervaring en visie toepassen om efficiënte datatoepassingen te creëren.

Wij zoeken iemand die:

  • De lead neemt in het ontwerpen en bouwen van herbruikbare datamodellen en -oplossingen.

  • Datapijplijnen ontwikkelt, inclusief ETL-processen, en data lakes en data warehouses opzet.

  • Analysemethoden operationaliseert en toepast in de praktijk.

  • De benodigde cloudinfrastructuur inricht en beheert.

  • Gewend is om te werken in een commercieel gerichte en/of consulting organisatie.

  • Graag werkt in een teamsetting met collega’s met verschillende vaardigheden.

  • Zich thuis voelt in een omgeving met zeer gemotiveerde mensen die zich richten op het leveren van de hoogste kwaliteit aan klanten.

Over het Data & AI team

Wij helpen onze klanten innoveren en gebruikmaken van de nieuwste data- en AI-technologie. Het Data & AI-team bestaat uit 30 data-experts (Data Scientisten, Analisten en Consultants) die nauw samenwerken met de 30 engineers in ons Technology-team en nog eens 20 datawetenschappers bij de zusterbedrijven van IG&H. Het team levert data science en analytische projecten en heeft in de afgelopen twee jaar meer dan 40 (Gen)AI-projecten gerealiseerd voor onze klanten in Retail, Financial Services en Health.


Wat breng je mee:

  • Jij hebt een BSc of MSc diploma in een technisch veld, zoals Data Science, Computer Science, Fysica of Engineering.

  • Jij hebt 2 tot 6 jaar werkervaring

  • Jij beheerst de Nederlandse en Engelse taal uitstekend, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk.

  • Jij hebt een engineering mindset, een passie voor data en datatechnologie, en een ambitie om jezelf verder te ontwikkelen.

  • Jij hebt ruime ervaring met SQL, Python en data processing frameworks en pakketten zoals PySpark en Pandas.

  • Jij hebt ervaring met Databricks, Snowflake of vergelijkbare dataplatformtechnologien.

  • Jij bent bekend met het ontwerpen en bouwen van deployment pipelines in Azure DevOps of GitHub Actions.

  • Jij hebt ervaring met werken volgens DevOps-methodologieën.

Wat wij jou bieden:

  • Werken bij een Great Place to Work met een prettige sfeer en enthousiaste collega's die je ondersteunen;

  • Mooie kans om een actieve bijdrage te leveren aan de verdere (internationale) groei van de organisatie;

  • We bieden per direct een vast contract (onbepaalde tijd);

  • Uitstekend salaris en arbeidsvoorwaarden;

  • Auto van de zaak/goede mobiliteitsregeling;

  • De mogelijkheid om parttime (32 uur) te werken, minimaal 4 dagen per week;

  • We ondersteunen incidenteel werken in het buitenland voor maximaal 4 weken per jaar;

  • 25 vakantiedagen met de mogelijkheid om meer op te nemen;

  • De mogelijkheid om na 3 jaar dienstverband een sabbatical op te nemen;

  • IG&H faciliteert een Healthy Human programma, waarbij je begeleiding krijgt bij alle aanpassingen in het leven, zoals het krijgen van een kind of mantelzorger zijn voor een ziek familielid;

  • Royale bonusregeling;

Waarom IG&H?

IG&H transformeert toonaangevende bedrijven in de gezondheidszorg, retail en financiële sectoren. Samen met onze wereldklasse technologiepartners helpen we onze klanten vooruit te komen en relevant te blijven, met inzichtelijk advies, geweldig ontwerp en ongeëvenaarde digitale platforms. Onze uitzonderlijke resultaten komen voort uit het succesvol afstemmen van mensen, bedrijfsvoering en technologie. Met meer dan 650 getalenteerde collega’s aan boord, mensen die veranderingen en uitdagingen echt omarmen, hebben we een unieke cultuur gecreëerd die zowel hoog durft als hoog zorgt. We trekken buitengewone mensen aan en inspireren hen om de grenzen te verleggen voor zichzelf en onze klanten.

Wat betekent dat voor jou?

Enerzijds is dit, als deze vacature bij je past, een geweldige plek om te werken. We hebben zeer tevreden medewerkers en klanten (NPS > 60) en groeien met dubbele cijfers, met het oog op verdere internationale uitbreiding. We staan nog maar aan het begin van dit spannende avontuur. Waarom zou je er geen deel van uitmaken?

We willen dat onze medewerkers een afspiegeling zijn van de diversiteit in de . We werken samen met een opmerkelijke mix van talenten, persoonlijkheden en culturen. IG&H is trots een werkgever te zijn die gelijke kansen biedt. Alle gekwalificeerde sollicitanten worden in overweging genomen voor een dienstverband, ongeacht nationaliteit, ras, religie, geslacht, genderidentiteit of -expressie, seksuele geaardheid, genetica, handicap of leeftijd. We geven om individualiteit, maar het belangrijkste is dat we trots zijn op onze collectieve prestaties en een geweldige werkplek.

title: Senior Exercise Planner
description:
Overview

What You’ll Be Doing

At Cadmus, our Homeland Security Line of Business provides clients with pragmatic solutions to their most important analytical and policy challenges. We bring together a team of outstanding professionals who have earned a reputation of responsive and client-focused support for a wide range of homeland security, intelligence, and counter-terrorism agencies at all levels of government. Our client-oriented approach, coupled with our profound and relevant subject matter expertise, enables us to bring an incisive edge to solving the most critical national security problems.

Cadmus seeks candidates to support upcoming homeland security exercises programs for both public and private sector clients, partners, and stakeholders. Successful candidates will lead the design, execution, and evaluation of homeland security exercises covering a range of hazards, including terrorism, cybersecurity, and natural disasters. Candidates may also support policy assessment and analysis, policy research, professional writing, and/or strategic planning in the homeland security or public policy fields. Some domestic travel is likely required for this position.

Please note this position is for a proposal effort, and offers will be contingent upon award.

Who We Are

Cadmus provides government, commercial, and other private organizations worldwide with technology-empowered advisory and implementation services. We help our clients achieve their goals and drive lasting, impactful change by leveraging transformative digital solutions and unparalleled expertise across domains.

At Cadmus, we look for team players and problem solvers who are driven to use their unique perspectives and intellectual curiosity to help deliver breakthrough solutions that achieve transformative goals. As a member of our team, you'll collaborate with leading experts to support our clients across the globe. We offer competitive compensation, outstanding health care and retirement benefits, a vibrant and collaborative work environment, and ample opportunities for professional growth.

Join Cadmus. Together, we are strengthening society and the natural world. For more information, visit cadmusgroup.com.

Responsibilities

  • Serve as a senior exercise planning and HSEEP subject-matter expert supporting government exercise programs.
  • Provide technical direction for the design, conduct, evaluation, and continuous improvement of complex homeland security, cybersecurity, and critical infrastructure exercises.
  • Advise clients on exercise strategy, program priorities, stakeholder engagement, scenario design, evaluation methodology, and improvement planning.
  • Lead complex, multi-stakeholder exercises involving federal, state, local, tribal, territorial, private-sector, and critical infrastructure participants, as applicable.
  • Oversee multiple exercise workstreams or project teams and ensure consistency across exercise products, schedules, methodologies, and client communications.
  • Lead planning meetings and facilitate executive briefings, workshops, tabletop exercises, after-action discussions, and other exercise-related sessions.
  • Establish exercise design approaches and provide final technical and quality-assurance review of major deliverables.
  • Guide the development of complex scenarios, exercise objectives, evaluation criteria, injects, analysis products, After-Action Reports, and Improvement Plans.
  • Resolve complex technical, stakeholder, schedule, and delivery challenges in coordination with project and client leadership.
  • Coach and mentor exercise planners, strengthen team capabilities, and promote consistent application of HSEEP principles and quality standards.
  • Support project leadership with work planning, resource coordination, risk management, and client relationship management.
  • Contribute to the development of exercise methodologies, tools, templates, lessons learned, and program-level recommendations.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree from an accredited institution in emergency management, homeland security, national security, public policy, political science, cybersecurity, or a related field.
  • Minimum of at least ten years of professional experience, with relevant professional supporting projects related to exercise planning, emergency management, homeland security, cybersecurity, critical infrastructure, or a related field; preference given to those with experience in homeland security, emergency management, and exercises.
  • Extensive experience leading the design, delivery, and evaluation of complex HSEEP exercises.
  • Demonstrated expertise in discussion-based exercise design and facilitation.
  • Demonstrated ability to advise clients on exercise strategy, exercise program management, and improvement planning.

title: Pilot in Command- Challenger 300
description:
The Pilot-in-Command (PIC) has command of, and the responsibility for the flight crew, passengers, cargo, the SAFE conduct of the flight, The Pilot-in-Command also provides guidance and coordinates the activities of every individual connected with the aircraft operation.

The Pilot-in-Command will adhere to proper Crew Resource Management (CRM) techniques and will accept input from all crew members prior to rendering a decision. Once rendered, the decision will be regarded as final by all crew members. No one, regardless of position, shall exert direct or indirect pressure to change the SAFETY or the conduct of a flight.

The Pilot-in-Command will not be subjected to coercion by any Craft Charter, LLC departmental managers or customers. Good judgment shall prevail at all times.

The Pilot-in-Command reports to the Chief Pilot, and indirectly, to the Director of Operations, He/she assumes the following duties and responsibilities:

  • Retains the final authority for the safe operation of the aircraft (14 CFR 91.3);
  • Directs the activities of the Second-in-Command, if applicable, ensuring flight crew members understand fully and completely what duties are expected of them;
  • Ensures that the assigned aircraft is airworthy and that all proper documents are on board the aircraft;
  • When operating conditions dictate, makes decisions regarding the start, delay, cancellation, or deviation of a flight from a planned destination;
  • Ensures that the proper amount and grade of fuel is loaded onto the aircraft;
  • Obtains a briefing on the weather, operating procedures, and any special instructions;
  • Prepares or supervises preparation of flight plan including considerations such as altitude, terrain, weather, range, weight, cruise control data, airport facilities, and navigational aids;
  • Ensures that weather and aircraft performance conditions can be met appropriate to the 14 CFR under which the flight is being conducted;
  • Ensures that a flight plan is filed;
  • Ensures that the aircraft weight and balance form/manifest is properly completed, signed, and distributed;
  • Promptly reports all known or suspected FAA violations or incidents to the Chief Pilot;
  • Maintains a current medical certificate as required by Craft Charter, LLC, and notifies the Chief Pilot if a medical (physical or mental) condition may impair his/her ability to perform a flight;
  • Ensures that the VOR checks and other aircraft equipment checks are performed properly;
  • Ensures that crew members provide all passengers with the appropriate briefing for each phase of flight;
  • Ensures that emergency equipment such as life rafts, life vests, etc. as well as provisions for passenger comfort are aboard, Ensures that all cargo is properly secured;
  • Ensures the preparation of flight logs, reporting of mechanical irregularities, and recording of maintenance, by maintenance personnel when maintenance is performed en route;
  • Ensures that all maintenance write-ups are passed to the maintenance personnel and that Flight Following is alerted to the current status of the aircraft;
  • Determines the applicability of the regulations to each flight if pertains to either Part 91 or Part 135 operation;
  • Ensures that a copy of the General Operations Manual is aboard the aircraft; ? Determines that the flight crew is adequately rested; Ensures that the aircraft is clean and prepared for flight with all aircraft stores and that appropriate catering provisions are on board;
  • Operates the aircraft at favorable altitudes, while taking into account turbulence, oxygen requirements, and passenger comfort;
  • Must be thoroughly knowledgeable of the General Operations Manual, 14 CFR, Operations Specifications, Flight Manuals, and other instructions pertinent to assigned duties;
  • Maintains regular/frequent radio or telephone contact with the flight department management during the course of a trip to ensure operational messages are promptly conveyed between the flight crew and the base.

The Pilot in Command may delegate the above referenced functions to subordinates; however, the Pilot-in-Command remains solely responsible for any delegated functions.

title: Data Engineer (medior/senior)
description:
Vandaag een idee, volgende week live bij de klant.
Bij Pipple duurt het geen half jaar voor je iets bouwt dat er echt toe doet. Je zit aan tafel bij de klant, ontdekt samen wat er nodig is, en gaat bouwen - metAzure,Airflow,Databricks, wat het project ook vraagt. Snel schakelen, direct zien wat het oplevert.

Wie is Pipple

Pippleis al sinds 2015 dé plek in Eindhoven waar wiskunde en AI samenkomen. Met zo'n vijftigPippelaarsbouwen we data- en AI-oplossingen voor uiteenlopende klanten: van PSV, waar we de AI-strategie mee vormgeven, totVanderlande,Bol en DAF. We geloven dat data pas waarde krijgt als het ook echt werkt in productie-en daar zorg jij voor.

De rol

Als Data Engineer bouw en onderhoud je het complete fundament waarop de data- en AI-huishouding van onze klanten draait. Je ontwerpt en beheert moderne dataplatforms en bouwt de benodigde koppelingen met uiteenlopende bronsystemen. Je transformeert en ontsluit deze data via robuuste pipelines (ETL/ELT), zodat analisten en business intelligence-teams direct beschikken over betrouwbare data voor hun analyses. Daarnaast zorg je voor de volledige (ML)Ops- en infrastructuurcyclus: van het veilig hosten en monitoren van Machine Learning-modellen in productie tot het inrichten van CI/CD, data governance en logging voor zowel data producten als modellen. Met tools en frameworks als Databricks, dbt, Airflow, Terraform en cloudproviders als Azure, AWS of GCP breng je alle componenten van het datalandschap samen.

Bij de ene klant koppel je complexe bronsystemen om een Analytics-platform te voeden dat duurzaamheidsdoelen inzichtelijk maakt; bij de andere zet je de hosting en monitoring neer voor een planningsmodel dat elke ochtend op verse data draait. Je zit daarbij vanaf het begin met de klant aan tafel, adviseert over technische keuzes en ziet jouw werk terug in systemen die dagelijks worden gebruikt.

Wat je meebrengt

Je houdt van structuur bouwen waar niemand meer over hoeft na te denken, en je denkt vanzelf in schaalbaarheid en datakwaliteit. Verder herken je jezelf in:

  • Ervaring met Python en SQL, en met tools/frameworks als Databricks, dbt, Fabric, Terraform of Airflow
  • Affiniteit met een cloudplatform (Azure, AWS of Google Cloud Platform)
  • Een afgeronde opleiding in bijvoorbeeld informatica, datascience, AIof econometrie
  • Een nieuwsgierige, pragmatische instelling!Je bouwt liever iets werkends dan een perfect plaatje op papier
  • Plezier in samenwerken, zowel met je Pipple-collega's als met de klant

Wat je krijgt

Voordat we iets van jouw vragen, investeren we eerst in jou: via de Pipple Academy, persoonlijke begeleiding en de ruimte om te experimenteren met nieuwe technologie. Je krijgt eigenaarschap over je projecten in plaats van een uitgestippeld pad, en je bouwt mee aan een team dat nog volop groeit — dus je invloed op hoe we werken is groot. Daarnaast: maandelijkse Pipple-dagen,TechTalks, een jaarlijkse wintersportvakantie met het hele team enpassendearbeidsvoorwaarden.

title: Data Engineer
description:
Bouw mee aan de toekomst van data bij MyParcel

Data is het kloppend hart van MyParcel. Elke dag versturen duizenden webshops en ondernemers pakketten via ons platform, en achter de schermen zorgen wij dat alle gegevens feilloos worden verwerkt. Of het nu gaat om verzendstromen, klantinzichten of financiële data – alles moet kloppen én klaar zijn voor de volgende stap.

Daar kom jij in beeld. Als Data Engineer ben jij degene die ervoor zorgt dat onze data betrouwbaar, veilig en schaalbaar beschikbaar is. Jij bouwt het fundament waarop onze analisten, developers en het management kunnen vertrouwen om de juiste beslissingen te nemen.

Je komt terecht in een hecht en enthousiast team, waar we samen werken aan slimme oplossingen, veel lachen en elke dag een beetje beter willen worden. Jouw werk heeft direct impact: van het optimaliseren van onze data pipelines tot het creëren van nieuwe inzichten die ons helpen groeien.

De functie

Als Data Engineer ben jij verantwoordelijk voor het bouwen en onderhouden van onze data-infrastructuur. Je vertaalt business behoeften naar betrouwbare en schaalbare data pipelines, bewaakt de kwaliteit en veiligheid van data. Je werkt nauw samen met data-analisten en developers, en bent dé schakel die ruwe data omzet in een stevig fundament. Jouw werk heeft direct impact: zonder jou geen goed gevulde dashboards en geen datagedreven groei.

  • Ontwerpen en onderhouden van datasystemen, datawarehouses en databases
  • Ontwikkelen en optimaliseren van ETL/ELT processen
  • Modelleren van datastructuren voor performance en schaalbaarheid
  • Waarborgen van datakwaliteit, integriteit en toegang
  • Kostenoptimalisatie van data processen
  • Documenteren van architectuur en dataprocessen
  • Adviseren over systeemwijzigingen in samenwerking met developers, analisten en management

Wat vragen we van jou?

  • HBO/WO werk- en denkniveau (richting Data, Informatica, Econometrie, Wiskunde etc.)
  • Aantoonbare ervaring in data engineering, datamodellering en performance optimalisatie
  • Kennis van SQL, Python
  • Ervaring met moderne data architecturen en BI tooling (Snowflake, dbt, Looker)
  • Bekend met principes van Data Governance en kwaliteitsframeworks
  • Analytisch sterk, communicatief vaardig en een teamspeler
  • Proactieve houding: je signaleert kansen en neemt initiatief
  • De Nederlands taal machtig (minimaal C1/C2 niveau)
  • Ervaring met Fivetran, Salesforce;
  • Ervaring in e-commerce/logistiek

Wat bieden wij jou?

  • Hybride werkbeleid (kantoor + thuis)
  • Functie is voor 32 tot 40 uur
  • 25 vakantiedagen (o.b.v. 40 uur)
  • Pensioenregeling
  • Laptop & benodigde middelen om je werk goed te doen
  • Ruimte voor persoonlijke en professionele ontwikkeling
  • Werken in een informele organisatie met passie voor e-commerce

LET OP!!: Startdatum voor deze functie is januari 2027

MyParcel is meer dan alleen verzenden. Wij gaan beyond delivery. Dit doen we niet alleen. Dit doen we samen. Je zal dan ook nauw samenwerken met jouw directe collega's, maar ook met de rest van het bedrijf sta je in contact. In onze informele en open werksfeer, hebben we veel oog voor elkaar. Iedereen moet zich ten alle tijd thuis voelen en zichzelf kunnen zijn. Benieuwd naar jouw collega's? Ontmoet hieronder alvast je teamleden!

title: Engineering Manager – Data Platform
description:
Position Overview:

This is a vacancy for a hybrid role with regular visits to our HQ in Tutzing, Germany or Amsterdam, the Netherlands. We encourage applications from all qualified candidates, regardless of gender identity. As we continue to scale and consolidate our Data Platform, we are seeking an experiencedEngineering Manager (m/f/x) to join our Product & Engineering department. In this role, you will own delivery across the full stack, from Java-based networking infrastructure and integration services, to Angular-powered user interfaces. You will be as comfortable talking about Netty pipelines and load balancing strategies as you are reviewing a component architecture or coaching an engineer through a performance conversation. We are a team that believes AI is a genuine engineering accelerant, not a gimmick. And we want our Engineering Manager to model that mindset and help their team develop it. Ready to make an impact?

You’ll get to take ownership of:

  • Leading, mentoring, and developing a mixed team of backend and frontend engineers, supporting career growth, performance management, and technical skill development.
  • Owning end‑to‑end delivery for your team's domain: planning, prioritisation, quality, and timeliness of releases, working closely with Product Management.
  • Setting and maintaining a high bar for engineering quality: driving code reviews, architectural decisions, and technical standards across both the backend (Java, networking) and frontend (TypeScript, Angular) layers.
  • Collaborating with Product Managers and senior leadership to align roadmap priorities with real customer and business value, and to push back when needed.
  • Staying technically close enough to the codebase to credibly challenge your engineers on design decisions, investigate complexity, and represent the domain in cross‑functional discussions, without being in the weeds on a daily basis.
  • Shaping how AI is used within your team - not just as an autocomplete tool, but as a genuine lever for automating workflows, accelerating problem‑solving, and improving the quality and throughput of engineering work.
  • Facilitating agile practices and ensuring smooth, predictable delivery processes across the team.

What will you learn during your apprenticeship:

We’d love to meet someone with:

  • 7+ years in software development, with at least 3+ years in an engineering leadership role managing product-focused engineering teams.
  • A strong backend engineering background, ideally in Java, with sufficient depth to challenge technical decisions, review designs, and engage meaningfully with your engineers on topics like networking, concurrency, integration protocols, and system architecture.
  • Enough frontend awareness (TypeScript, Angular or comparable) to understand the full picture and support your frontend engineers effectively, even if backend is your natural home.
  • Familiarity with the networking and integration space: HTTP/REST, asynchronous messaging (Kafka, AMQP, MQTT), and data integration protocols (AS2, EDI, GraphQL) - the kind of problems Lobster's platform is built to solve.
  • A genuine, hands‑on attitude toward AI‑augmented engineering: you use AI tools to increase your own effectiveness and actively encourage and coach your team to do the same.
  • Proven stakeholder management skills - able to navigate between engineering, product, design and senior leadership, and to translate technical complexity into business language without losing precision.
  • Solid people management experience: coaching, goal setting, performance management including underperformance, and developing engineers at multiple seniority levels.
  • Strong project management skills, with experience in Agile/Scrum environments and a pragmatic approach to process.
  • Fluent in English; German or Dutch language skills are a plus.

We’d love to hear from you:

You can look forward to:

  • Opportunity to work flexibly from home
  • Modern offices in Germany and the Netherlands
  • A personal Learning & Development budget
  • Up to 30 days of remote work per year from any EU country
  • Company Pension plan
  • 30 vacation days a year
  • 2 additional paid days off on Christmas Eve and New Year's Eve
  • Location-specific benefits packages (your recruiter will be happy to provide more details during your first chat)
  • Company-sponsored business travel
For this role, we are open to working with specialists based inGermany or the Netherlands. Whether you prefer workingon-site at our officesinTutzing,Amsterdam,orremotely from a location within one of these countries,we’rehappy to accommodate your preferred working style. Ifyou’reexcited about this role butdon’tmeet every qualification, we encourage you to apply! Lobster is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive environment where empathy and respect guide our interactions.

title: Senior Engineer - (Java/Software Development/AI) - Hybrid
description:
Why Join GEICO?

At GEICO, we offer a rewarding career where your ambitions are met with endless possibilities. Every day we honor our iconic brand by offering quality coverage to millions of customers and being there when they need us most. We thrive on relentless innovation to exceed our customers' expectations while making a real impact on local communities nationwide. Founded in 1936, GEICO is a member of the Berkshire Hathaway family of companies and one of the largest auto insurers in the United States.

Position Description

Our Senior Engineer works with our engineering team to innovate and build new systems, improve and enhance existing systems, and identify new opportunities to apply your knowledge to solve critical problems. You will lead the strategy and execution of a technical roadmap that will increase the velocity of delivering products and unlock new engineering capabilities, including shaping how applied AI and intelligent automation are incorporated into enterprise solutions where they materially improve business outcomes. The ideal candidate is a self-starter with deep technical expertise in their domain and a strong sense of which AI technologies are appropriate for various use cases, while ensuring solutions meet enterprise standards for reliability, security, and operability.

Position Responsibilities

  • Provide technical leadership to multiple areas and provide technical and thought leadership to the enterprise, including applied AI architecture, technology selection, and integration patterns across teams
  • Collaborate across team members and across the tech organization to solve our toughest problems, working with product, domain experts, and analytics partners to translate business needs into technical designs that may include AI components
  • Deliver high-quality services and software for a variety of domains, including AI-augmented workflows and intelligent services where appropriate, with accountability for the quality, usability, and performance of the solutions
  • Identify and evaluate opportunities to apply AI, intelligent automation, and agentic workflows to enterprise processes, distinguishing high-value use cases from hype-driven experiments
  • Utilize programming languages like Java, C#, or other object-oriented languages, SQL, and NoSQL databases, container orchestration services including Docker and Kubernetes, cloud tools and services across Azure/AWS/GCP, and integrate AI services, model APIs, and orchestration tooling into the platform stack
  • Work on end-to-end solutions that may span front-end implementations (Flutter, Angular, React) through API tiers and back-end domain services
  • Be a role model and mentor, helping to coach and strengthen the technical expertise and know-how of our engineering and product community, including applied AI patterns, production evaluation, and responsible deployment practices.
  • Influence and educate executives Design durable, observable AI workflows using orchestration and agent patterns (e.g., Temporal for long-running workflows; Fable and comparable agent frameworks), combining tools, APIs, business rules, and human-in-the-loop steps
  • Select and rationalize AI technologies for each use case—models, retrieval, vector stores, knowledge graphs, workflow engines—with clear tradeoffs on cost, latency, accuracy, security, and operability
  • Establish engineering patterns for evaluating, monitoring, and governing components in production, including testing, quality metrics, safety, fallback behavior, and incident response

Qualifications

  • Exemplary ability to design, perform experiments—including AI/LLM evaluation, measurement, and iterative improvement in production—and influence engineering direction and product roadmap
  • Extensive experience shipping LLM, generative AI, or intelligent automation solutions in production environments
  • Strong grasp of when to use agents, retrieval-augmented generation, classical ML, rules-based workflows, or hybrid approaches for a given business problem
  • Experience integrating AI into enterprise services via APIs, events, authentication, and observability patterns
  • Understanding of agent architectures, workflow orchestration, vector retrieval, and knowledge/context design
  • Extensive experience in leading and building full-stack application and service development, with a strong focus on SaaS products / platforms
  • Proven expertise in designing and developing microservices using GraphQL, gRPC, Java, Python, Kafka, with a deep understanding of both API and event-driven architectures, including integration of AI inference, retrieval, and async/agent workflows
  • Proven experience designing and delivering highly-resilient event-driven and messaging-based solutions at scale with minimal latency, including long-running, failure-tolerant workflows for multi-step AI processes
  • Fluency and specialization with at least two modern OOP languages such as Java, C#, C++, or Python including object-oriented design
  • Great understanding of open-source databases like MySQL, PostgreSQL, etc., and a strong foundation with NoSQL databases like Cosmos, Cassandra, Apache Trino, etc.
  • Knowledge of developer tooling across the software development life cycle (task management, source code, building, deployment, operations, real-time communication)
  • Fluency in test engineering and automated testing concepts, including evaluation and regression testing for non-deterministic AI components
  • Experience 6+ years full-stack development experience (Java/C#/Python/Go), with expertise in client-side and server-side frameworks
  • 4+ years of experience with architecture and design
  • 2+ years of applied AI, generative AI, or intelligent automation experience in production, or demonstrable ownership of AI-enabled platform capabilities
  • 2+ years of experience with AWS, GCP, Azure, or another cloud service

title: Product Lead, Visitors
description:
Envoy protects the places the world relies on most by unifying people, spaces, and communications in one secure, integrated workplace management platform and ecosystem. More than 16,000 workplaces around the world trust Envoy to run secure, compliant, and connected operations across every location.

From manufacturing sites and data centers to pharmaceutical labs, healthcare facilities, and corporate headquarters, Envoy makes safety, security and associated regulatory compliance something our customers can be proud of. The industry is littered with box-checking and arcane manual processes as the standard and we see our role as the company to bring experience, efficiency and simplicity everywhere. Great experiences bring great security – it's a requirement. We hope this problem space excites you and we hope you're ready to come sweat the details with us – we have a lot of customers counting on us! And it certainly won't be easy.

Learn more at

About the Role: Product management here at Envoy is the most critical role in ensuring customers and their end-users love the products they use. Every decision you make will directly impact tens of thousands of workplaces around the world and their millions of occupants, be them employees, visitors, contractors, etc. Envoy seeks to deliver next-level operational efficiency, data-drivenness, safety, and security for everyone involved, and our solutions must be highly thoughtful about this at scale. You will be responsible for this for your product or product line. This isn't an easy job, but if high stakes is your game, you'll enjoy things a lot.

We are currently looking for a product leader to own and evolve a large portion of Envoy Visitors, our flagship visitor management platform used by companies all around the world. Visitors is very powerful – customers are using it to meet strict regulatory compliances in their industries. They need to do background checks to make sure people aren't from sanctioned countries, they are requiring specific OSHA trainings of their contractors, they need full audit logs of all changes over hundreds of facilities, they need to provision access control credentials for specific vendors, there's a lot going on and at scale. What you'll be working on is absolutely critical to the safety and security of their operations so thoughtfulness is critical every day. There’s a lot of surface area, a lot of different customer needs, and a lot of opportunity to make big industry-changing decisions. It's what they've been waiting for.

We're currently a small and nimble product team looking to grow from leadership previously being spread throughout product design roles, product marketing, engineering management, and we even have some IC engineers running their products externally. Needless to say, we recognize this isn't going to scale, and we want to get ahead of it with your ownership and help. This brings inward opportunity too – as the product team grows, we'll need product line leaders and organizers, and we'd much rather promote from within when possible. But for now, this is an IC PM role as that's the immediate need.

This is a full-time, 5-day onsite role in San Francisco (410 Townsend St). Please remember we are a workplace company. We build products for workplaces and we believe that we can only become experts in something when we surround ourselves in it! We're happy to help move you out here if necessary. We also help with visa transfers if needed.

We hope this all sounds great to you so far!

As a baseline, you will need

  • 5+ years of experience in Product Management, preferably in B2B with enterprise exposure and 0-1 product building experience

  • An undergraduate degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a quantitative field

In this role, you will

  • Meticulously own vision, roadmap, strategy, and execution of your products

  • Launch products and be ultimately responsible for the success/failure of the products/features based on the goals/metrics you define.

  • Push for quality and urgency despite constant challenges for one or the other. You need to enjoy this battle.

  • Be the primary switchboard and gather feedback from customers directly, our sales/success teams, and others cross-functionally to create an opinion and get things iterated, built, and launched. You must be good at rational decision-making; not everyone will always agree, yet you'll still need their support.

  • Be the point person to customers during beta or high-iteration periods in products. And you'll run internal dogfooding.

  • Story-tell internally the importance of what we're building to engineering ICs, designers, researchers and the general company, encouraging bottoms up ownership, creative thinking and internal contribution.

  • Own much of pricing and packaging, and you'll ensure sales training happens as you expect for your products. There is no throwing-over-the-wall allowed here.

  • You'll bring your existing product processes and help us all elevate our product execution.

  • And yes, it has to be said, roles change over time; this job description is dynamic, you need to be comfortable in an environment where things can change a lot.

Your values: Every company is unique, with its own culture and community, and specific values that make things gel. There is no one general fingerprint for what makes a 'good' company or a 'bad' one, it's all dependent on your personal values and how well they map to the values of the company you're part of. It's therefore critical you and us match well together. As you explore the list below, please be real with yourself – is this the kind of environment you really want? If not "yes absolutely", it's best to not apply, trust us, you're going to have a bad time. If however, these describe you, you're going to have an amazing time here with friends you'll retain for years to come. We hope this describes you!

  • You have a passion for workplaces, have strong end-user intuition and demand products you yourself can proudly use daily

  • You thrive in ambiguous, low-guidance environments. You seek accountability and to own the success (and failure!) of everything you work on.

  • You have a high bar for everything you build, including the way it looks and feels, spending the time necessary to achieve quality to winning standards. Especially in Enterprise software, notorious for putting quality by the wayside.

  • You create and hold yourself and your team to success metrics. You are data-driven, relying on numbers to persuade versus necessarily just high-paying customer anecdotes.

  • You are impatient and expect things sooner than in a couple weeks, months or quarters

  • You have high empathy and humility and understand you're always learning. You're also aggressively a believer that everyone you work with must be this way too.

  • You rely on AI tooling and truly see it as a massive force multiplier and you are excited about constantly evolving yourself to best reap its benefits. You are also excited to share the AI discoveries that you're continuously making (and you expect the same of your peers too).

  • You believe teams being in-office are the best way to solve problems fast and build great products.

  • You look for all these same values from your current and future teammates and would be disappointed and even consider departing if we compromised too often. You want to be part of a like-minded team and culture.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE)

Location: New York, NY (in-person)

About Attention

At Attention, we’re transforming how go-to-market teams operate by turning every customer interaction into structured data, insights, and intelligent action. Our AI agents help organizations execute faster, learn continuously, and make every deal cycle more efficient and predictable.

What makes Attention exciting isn’t just the technology, it’s the moment and the mission. We’re building at the intersection of AI, automation, and the modern revenue stack, redefining how critical work gets done for years to come. This is a rare opportunity to build at an inflection point in both our company and the broader AI ecosystem.

We’re scaling quickly with strong product-market fit and support from world-class investors. The work is ambitious, the bar is high, and the opportunity for growth across personal, professional, and financial dimensions is unmatched. Our team is sharp, collaborative, and deeply committed to the mission. We move fast, operate with intensity, and take real ownership from early ideas through long-term outcomes.

If you thrive in ambiguity, push for excellence, and want to help shape the future of work alongside a team that raises the bar every day, we’d love for you to build with us.

The Role

As a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) at Attention, you’ll work directly with our customers to design, build, and deploy AI agents that automate critical GTM workflows. You’ll translate messy, high-value business problems into structured, production-ready solutions that drive measurable impact.

You’ll work across engineering, product, and customer success, building in the field, iterating fast, and feeding insights from real-world use back into the platform. This is a hands-on role for builders who move quickly, wear multiple hats, and take ownership from concept to deployment.


What You’ll Do

  • Build and deploy AI agents that automate workflows and generate structured outputs

  • Work directly with customers to map processes, identify opportunities, and deliver working solutions fast

  • Use your experience with automation/data orchestration tools (like Zapier, n8n, Retool) to connect systems, prototype logic, and ship production-ready automations

  • Ship end-to-end: scope, prototype, test, and harden workflows for reliability and scale

  • Collaborate with product and engineering to turn bespoke deployments into reusable platform capabilities

  • Ensure every agent you build is observable, maintainable, and tied to real business outcomes

  • Ship platform features alongside customer work: define scope, make prioritization calls, and build for the cases that scale rather than the one account in front of you

What You’ll Bring

  • Experience building and deploying production-grade software or automations

  • Proven experience with automation tools; you’ve built real workflows or tools and can move fast from idea to execution

  • Comfort scripting in Python or JavaScript and integrating APIs or webhooks when needed

  • Strong problem-solving skills and comfort with ambiguity

  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills; able to work closely with both technical and non-technical teams

  • Customer-facing experience; you’re comfortable leading conversations, managing relationships, and translating business needs into technical solutions

  • Curiosity about AI systems, automation, and structured data pipelines

Why This Role Matters

Forward Deployed Engineers are the connective tissue between our customers and our product. You’ll bring the Attention platform to life in the field, translating customer needs into tangible AI-driven workflows that move the needle on revenue.

You’ll operate with autonomy, see your work in production within days, and directly shape how companies adopt AI in their go-to-market motion.

If you’re a hands-on builder who moves fast, thrives in ambiguity, and wants to work at the intersection of engineering, product, and real customer impact, we’d love to meet you.

title: Mechanical & Product Design Engineer
description:
About The Company

At Corinex, we are driving the future of energy with cutting-edge Broadband over Power Line (BPL) technology. As a global leader in smart grid solutions, we enable utilities to enhance grid visibility, flexibility, and decarbonization, supporting the seamless integration of renewable energy, electric vehicles, and heat pumps into the power grid.


Headquartered in Vancouver, Canada, Corinex is the market leader in Europe, particularly in Spain, where our BPL solutions are deployed by major DSOs (Distribution System Operators) to improve grid operations. With successful implementations across global markets, our technologies accelerate the transition to a more sustainable, decentralized, and efficient energy infrastructure. Recognized as a key contributor to industry standards and a 2024 Deloitte Technology Fast 50 winner, Corinex is shaping the future of smart energy.



About the Role

Corinex is seeking an experienced Mechanical & Product Design Engineer to support the development and industrialization of hardware products for energy and smart-grid applications. The role focuses on mechanical design, product integration, prototyping, validation, and manufacturing readiness. Experience with the German BSI environment and certification processes is highly preferred.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design mechanical components, enclosures, assemblies, and hardware products from concept to production.
  • Create 3D CAD models in SolidWorks, engineering drawings, specifications, and manufacturing documentation.
  • Develop mechanical solutions involving PCB integration, connectors, cabling, thermal management, structural integrity, and installation requirements.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Product Design Engineering, Mechatronics, or a related field.
  • Several years of experience in mechanical design, product development, or hardware engineering.
  • Strong experience designing electromechanical products involving PCBs, connectors, cabling, or electronic hardware.
  • Advanced proficiency with SolidWorks or equivalent 3D CAD tools.
  • Strong knowledge of materials, tolerances, plastics, sheet metal, machining, assembly, DFM/DFA, and manufacturing processes.
  • Experience taking hardware products from concept and prototype through validation and production.
  • Strong hands-on problem-solving and cross-functional collaboration skills.
  • Professional English proficiency; German is strongly preferred.



Preferred Experience

  • Experience with BSI requirements or certification processes.
  • Experience in smart metering, smart grid, utilities, energy infrastructure, telecommunications, industrial electronics, or IoT hardware.
  • Familiarity with European compliance requirements such as CE, EMC, RoHS, REACH, electrical safety, and IP protection.
  • Experience working with certification bodies, test laboratories, suppliers, or contract manufacturers.
