title: Software Engineer, Agent Delivery
description:
About Pallet

Pallet is building AI Agents to transform the physical economy — a $12 trillion global industry. We’ve raised $50M from top investors, including General Catalyst, Bessemer Venture Partners, and Bain Capital Ventures. In under two years, we’ve achieved 700% revenue growth and are just getting started.

Our mission is to increase the efficiency of the global supply chain by automating the manual workflows that slow supply chain teams down — from scheduling and appointment setting to data entry and load management. Our flagship platform provides end-to-end visibility, control, and optimization, while our newest product, CoPallet, introduces AI Agents that can understand and execute requests in real time and integrate directly with customer systems.

As companies across the physical economy look to generative AI to drive efficiency, many are turning to Pallet to lead the way. With deep supply chain expertise and cutting-edge AI capabilities, we’re positioned to build the next $10B company powering the physical economy.

Join us and work alongside leaders from Google, DoorDash, YC, and more to shape the future of supply chain technology.

$135,000 - $180,000
Full-time / Onsite SF or NY (5 days/week) / ~25% Travel

About The Role

We’re hiring a Software Engineer, Agent Delivery to deploy production AI agents inside some of the world’s largest supply chain companies.

You’ll work directly with customer operators, engineers, and executives to understand how critical workflows actually run. Then you’ll design integrations, debug production systems, and ship AI-powered workflows into environments that are often undocumented, fragmented, and business-critical.

This role sits at the intersection of engineering, product, and customer operations. You’ll own deployments from initial discovery through production launch, spending time with customers both remotely and onsite, solving complex operational problems and turning those solutions into reusable product capabilities.

Success in this role is measured by outcomes: can you get systems live, make them reliable, and solve problems in environments you don’t fully control? Every deployment teaches us something new about how supply chain companies operate. The patterns you uncover become product features, and what you solve for one customer often becomes a capability we ship across the platform.

The impact you will have

  • Production Agent Delivery: Lead high-impact customer deployments from problem definition through production. Design and build production-grade AI agents, workflows, integrations, and supporting infrastructure that solve real customer problems and operate reliably at scale.
  • Transformational Customer Impact: Partner with customers to identify workflows where AI agents can fundamentally change how work gets done. Own the technical delivery from end-to-end design and prototyping through implementation, evaluation, deployment, and iteration.
  • Turn Ambiguity into Working Software: Embed deeply in customer workflows, understand how their teams and systems actually operate, and translate messy business requirements into clear technical solutions. Move quickly from an idea or manual process to a production system delivering measurable value.
  • Own the Architecture: Make architecture and design decisions across agent behavior, application logic, data, integrations, evaluations, security, and reliability. Ensure solutions meet customer requirements while establishing strong patterns for how Pallet agents should be deployed in production.
  • Integrate Into the Customer Stack: Connect Pallet agents to the systems, data, APIs, and tools customers already rely on. Work directly with customer engineering and operations teams to navigate technical constraints and make Pallet a reliable part of their production workflows.
  • Own Production Outcomes: Stay accountable beyond the initial build. Debug failures, improve agent quality, evaluate performance, and work across Pallet Engineering and Product to rapidly resolve issues that stand between a customer and a successful deployment.
  • Customer Immersion: Build relationships across the customer organization, from technical ICs and operators to executives. Develop a deep understanding of their workflows, constraints, and goals so that what you build solves the underlying problem—not just the initial request.
  • Build Once, Scale Many Times: Turn lessons from individual deployments into reusable agents, integrations, evaluations, frameworks, and implementation patterns. Help Pallet move from bespoke customer work toward repeatable products that can be deployed across many customers.
  • Shape the Product: Serve as a tight feedback loop between customers and Pallet’s Product and Engineering teams. Identify recurring needs, product gaps, and opportunities uncovered in the field, and help turn them into improvements to the core Pallet platform.

Who You Are

  • 1-3 years of experience building and owning production systems in high-growth startups or similarly demanding environments.
  • Strong experience working with APIs, integrations, authentication systems, and event-driven architectures.
  • Proven ability to debug complex systems in production.
  • Comfortable operating in ambiguous environments where documentation is incomplete, and requirements evolve quickly.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to build trust with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Experience working directly with customers is a strong plus

Our Tech Stack

  • Backend: Node + TypeScript on Encore.dev. Event-driven design with message passing and queues. Hosted on GCP
  • Database: PostgreSQL
  • LLMs: OpenAI, Anthropic, Google for foundation models; fine-tuned models on Vertex AI
  • Browser Automation: Playwright
  • Frontend: Next.js + React + TypeScript. Hosted on Vercel
  • Observability: Datadog for logging and metrics

The estimated salary range for this role is $135,000–$180,000, depending on experience and skill set. In addition to base salary, we offer competitive equity, benefits, and growth opportunities. Final compensation will be determined based on a combination of factors, including experience, qualifications, and location.

Our Benefits

We invest in our people the same way we invest in our product: seriously.

  • 🩺 Health, Vision, and Dental benefits
  • 🏝️ Take-what-you-need Paid Vacation
  • ➕ Life Insurance and Accidental Insurance
  • ❤️‍🩹 Short-Term Disability Coverage
  • 💸 Generous salary and equity for all staff
  • 🪜 401k option; helping you save for the future
  • 🧑‍🧑‍🧒‍🧒 Paid parental leave to support growing families
  • 📚 Yearly learning and development stipend
  • 🚌 Commuter benefits for Bay Area employees
  • 🚘 Uber ride stipend if you ever have to work late in the office
  • 🏡 Remote office home stipend to get you comfy in your space
  • 🍔 Daily catered lunches provided
  • ✈️ Onboarding trip to San Francisco HQ if you work remotely
  • 🥤 Monthly happy hours
  • 🎉 Annual Company Offsites; our last one was in Palm Springs CA 🌴

Workplace Policy

We are an in-person company. Our offices in San Francisco, New York City and London are where ideas get built, decisions get made, and the team gets stronger. We have invested in making them genuinely great places to spend your day, with catered lunches, monthly happy hours, and people who care about the work and each other.

Most of our team works in office five days a week. For select roles, we hire remotely across the U.S. Remote employees come to one of our offices for their first week to onboard and meet the team, and we cover the full trip.

Every role is different. Travel expectations are always shared upfront in the job description and confirmed in your first call with us.

Equal Opportunity

Pallet is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We make all employment decisions based solely on merit. We provide equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees without discrimination on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, disability status, or any other applicable legally protected characteristic. We prohibit any form of discrimination or harassment. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including hiring.

Candidate Privacy Notice

Please review Pallet’s Candidate Privacy Notice here.

Accommodations

Pallet complies with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA), as amended by the ADA Amendments Act, and all applicable state or local laws. We will reasonably accommodate qualified individuals with a disability during the application process and throughout employment as required by law.

If you need any assistance or accommodations due to a disability, please contact us at recruiting@pallet.com.

description:
tellent is directly looking for:

Data Engineer - Amsterdam

About the Role

We are at a pivotal scaling point where our data ambitions have outpaced our current setup, and we need a Data Engineer to architect the professional-grade foundations of our platform. This role exists to bridge the gap between "getting data" and "engineering data," moving us from manual syncs to a fully automated ecosystem. By building custom pipelines and implementing a robust orchestration layer, you will directly enable our Operations teams and leadership to transition from basic reporting to sophisticated, AI-ready data products. Your primary focus will be on Infrastructure-as-Code, orchestration, and building a resilient "plumbing" system that serves as the backbone for our entire Product and GTM strategy.

Your 12-Month Journey

  • During the first 3 months:you will learn about our existing stack (GCP, BigQuery, Airbyte, dbt) and understand the current pain points in our data flow. You will identify and execute "low-hanging fruit" improvements to our product usage analytics, providing immediate value to the Product and GTM teams. You’ll begin designing the blueprint for our custom data pipelines and the migration strategy for moving our infrastructure intoTerraform.
  • Within 6 months:You will have deployed our new orchestration layer (e.g., Airflow or Dagster) and successfully transitioned our first set of custom pipelines to production. Collaborating with the Analytics Engineer, you will enable a unified view of our customer journey by successfully merging product usage data with CRM and billing data. At this point, a significant portion of our data infrastructure will be defined as code, reducing manual overhead and increasing deployment reliability.
  • After 1 year:you will take full strategic ownership of the data platform and its long-term architecture. You will act as the go-to technical expert for the leadership team, advising on the scalability of new data-driven features. You will lay the groundwork for AI and Machine Learning initiatives by ensuring our data warehouse has the right quality controls, governance, and low-latency access patterns in place.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Architect Scalable Infrastructure-as-Code:Take our existing foundations to the next level by migrating all GCP and BigQuery resources into Terraform. You will establish automated CI/CD patterns to ensure our entire data environment is reproducible, version-controlled, and enterprise-ready. You will make sure that we are using efficient data patterns, e.g., Change Data Capture (CDC), event-driven pipelines, or real-time streaming.
  • Deploy State-of-the-Art Pipelines: Design, deploy, and operate high-quality production ELT pipelines. You will implement a modern orchestration layer (e.g., Airflow or Dagster) to build custom Python-based integrations while maintaining and optimizing our existing syncs.
  • Champion Data Quality & Performance:Act as the guardian of our data platform. You will implement rigorous testing and monitoring protocols to ensure data is accurate and timely, including but not limited to pipeline health metrics, data freshness SLAs, alerting integration with DataDog. You will proactively identify BigQuery bottlenecks, optimizing query performance and resource utilization.
  • Technical Roadmap & Ownership:scope and architect end-to-end data flows from production source to warehouse. Manage your own technical backlog, prioritizing infrastructure stability over technical debt. You will ensure platform security and SOC2 compliance through PII masking, data contracts, and robust access controls.
  • Collaboration:You will work in a tight loop with the Analytics Engineer to turn raw data into actionable products. You will partner daily with DataOps and RevOps to understand business requirements, with occasional strategic syncs with DevOps and R&D to align on production schema changes and global infrastructure standards.

What You Bring

  • Solid experiencein Data Engineering, with a track record of building and evolving data ingestion infrastructure in cloud environments.
  • The Modern Data Stack:Familiarity with dbt and Airbyte/Fivetran. You understand how these tools fit into a broader ecosystem.
  • Expertise inBigQuery(partitioning, clustering, IAM) and the broader GCP ecosystem; Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform).
  • Hands-on experience withAirflow, Dagster, or similar orchestration tools. You know how to design DAGs that are resilient and easy to debug.
  • DevOps practices in the data context:familiarity with CI/CD best practices as they apply to data (data testing, automated deployments, containerization/Docker, basic Kubernetes knowledge).
  • Programming:Expert-level Python and advanced SQL. You are comfortable writing clean, testable, and modular code.
  • Comfortable in a fast-paced environment
  • Project management skills:capable of managing stakeholders, explaining complicated technical trade-offs to non-technical users, and taking care of own project scoping and backlog management.
  • Fluency in English, both written and spoken, at a minimum C1 level

What We Offer

  • Flexibility to work from home in the Netherlands and from our beautiful canal-side office in Amsterdam
  • A chance to be part of and shape one of the most ambitious scale-ups in Europe
  • Work in a diverse and multicultural team
  • €1,500 annual training budget plus internal training
  • Pension plan, travel reimbursement, and wellness perks
  • 28 paid holiday days + 2 additional days to relax in 2026
  • Work from anywhere for 4 weeks/year
  • An inclusive and international work environment with a whole lot of fun thrown in!
  • Apple MacBook and tools

Tellent is a leading Talent Management Suite designed to empower HR & People teams across the entire employee journey. Our all-in-one platform combines an Applicant Tracking System (Tellent Recruitee), an intuitive HRIS (Tellent HR), and powerful Performance Management software (Tellent Grow).

title: Sr Data Engineer
description:
Senior Data Engineer

Job Description

Overview

Location: Pittsburgh preferred, or remote, U.S.-based

Type: Full-time technical role

An Industry Defining Company

Karoo is a venture-backed startup, prior to Series A, on a mission to transform cardiovascular care. Our platform is designed to empower large provider groups and health systems to succeed in value-based care contracts with payers by improving patient outcomes and reducing cost of care through better coordination, analytics, and disease management. While our initial focus is cardiology, we are building a scalable operating system for managing complex conditions across the healthcare spectrum.


This is a rare opportunity to join a mission-driven founding team at a pivotal stage and help define the future of healthcare technology, with the power to improve the lives of patients with cardiovascular disease, the number one cause of death in America today.

The Role


Karoo Health is seeking a skilled and dedicated developer to join our Engineering team. As a software engineer at Karoo Health, you show a clear passion for quality and love to bring software to life. You are energized by the idea of building something new and want to work on problems that matter.


In order to do this job well, you must be a curious and eager problem solver with a hunger for building well-designed, high-quality solutions. You have a passion for great work and strive to produce simple solutions to complex problems. Knowing there are always multiple answers to a problem, you know how to engage in a constructive dialogue to find the best path forward.


When applying, please include a description of why you’re interested in this role.

What You'll Do


  • Design and Architect Data Systems: Lead the design, construction, installation, and optimization of highly reliable, scalable, and secure data architecture.
  • Design Core Healthcare Data Models: Own the design and evolution of foundational data models and schemas from the ground up, leveraging industry standards such as TUVA, OMOP and FHIR to translate clinical, operational, product, and reporting needs into scalable table structures, entities, and relationships.
  • Develop Data Pipelines: Build and maintain complex, production-grade data pipelines that ingest, process, enrich and normalize large volumes of healthcare data ensuring consistency, usability, and data integrity across downstream applications.
  • Data Quality and Governance: Establish and enforce data quality standards, monitoring, and validation processes to ensure the accuracy, completeness, and consistency of data used for analytics.
  • Performance Optimization: Implement query tuning, indexing, and partitioning strategies to maximize the performance and efficiency of data processing systems and data retrieval.
  • Cloud Infrastructure: Design and deploy scalable, secure, cloud infrastructure leveraging infrastructure-as-code best practices.
  • Safeguard Data: Ensure strict compliance with healthcare data regulations (e.g., HIPAA, HITRUST) and implement data security best practices.
  • Build and Maintain EMR Integrations: Develop direct, bi-directional integrations with electronic medical record platforms.

What We're Looking For


  • Deep, hands-on experience working with healthcare data, including healthcare data standards and common data models such as TUVA, OMOP, or FHIR.
  • Demonstrated experience designing core data models and schemas from scratch, including translating business, clinical, product, or user requirements into scalable data structures.
  • Experience mapping raw healthcare data into standardized healthcare data models, including resolving data quality, normalization, terminology, and structural inconsistencies.
  • Hands-on experience integrating directly with EMR/EHR platforms, ideally including eClinicalWorks, AthenaOne, Epic, or comparable systems.
  • Experience with healthcare data regulations (e.g., HIPAA, HITRUST) and data formats (e.g. FHIR)
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field, or equivalent work experience
  • Minimum 5 years of dedicated professional experience in a Data Engineering role, preferably within a startup or fast-paced healthcare technology environment.
  • Expert proficiency in SQL and at least one programming language used for data processing (Python or Scala).
  • Deep experience designing and managing Data Warehouses (e.g., Snowflake, Google BigQuery, AWS Redshift) and experience with Data Lake technologies (e.g., S3, Delta Lake).
  • Demonstrated hands-on experience with Big Data processing frameworks like Apache Spark or Dask.
  • Deep understanding of cloud platforms (AWS preferred) and cloud-native development, including services like S3, Lambda, and RDS.
  • Hands-on experience with workflow orchestration tools such as Apache Airflow or AWS Step Functions for managing data pipelines.
  • Expert knowledge of system architecture, scalability, and performance optimization for data systems.
  • Experience with test automation, CI/CD, and DevOps best practices for data deployments.
  • Ability to work independently and make high-impact technical decisions.
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States and not require employer sponsorship now or in the future

Why Join Us

  • Competitive salary and equity in an early-stage startup.
  • Opportunity to define the technical solution from the ground up
  • Possibly fully remote work environment with flexible hours
  • Health benefits, learning stipends, and professional development support
  • A collaborative and transparent company culture that values creativity and ownership

title: Data-engineer
description:
(Data-engineer) As a Senior Data Engineer, you get the chance to play a crucial role. In this challenging position, you are responsible for developing, implementing and maintaining robust data infrastructures that are essential for efficiently managing data ecosystems. You will work daily in an innovative environment where technology and data analysis go hand in hand. Your tasks include designing data pipelines that collect, transform and analyze data from various sources. This enables the organization to quickly and effectively gain insight into important financial data. Additionally, you are also responsible for optimizing existing systems, thereby contributing to the overall efficiency of data processes. What makes this position particularly interesting is the ever-growing demand for data-driven decisions within the sector. You have the opportunity to directly influence strategic business decisions by delivering reliable and scalable data products. The challenges you face are diverse: from managing large amounts of data to ensuring data quality and security. This requires not only technical skills, but also creative problem-solving abilities. You work together with a team of enthusiastic professionals in an inspiring work environment where innovations are encouraged. You have access to the latest tools and techniques, and get the chance to continuously learn and develop yourself. If you have a passion for data and want to use it to improve financial processes, then this role is perfect for you! Develop your career in a sector that is always in motion and play a key role in the future.

Required Education

For a position as Senior Data Engineer, you typically need an HBO or university education in a technical field such as Computer Science, Technical Computer Science, Mathematics or Data Science. If you want to progress from HAVO/VWO to a relevant follow-up education, the Nature & Technology (N&T) profile is most suitable, with mathematics and computer science being particularly important subjects. Besides formal education, several years of work experience with data management, programming and data infrastructure is essential for a senior position. In some cases, extensive practical experience combined with relevant certifications can compensate for lower formal education.

Required Skills

As a beginning data engineer, you often start as a junior developer, data analyst or database specialist to build technical skills. From a senior data engineer position, you can grow to lead data engineer, data architect or even head of data, where you lead teams and make strategic decisions. The logical steps are from technical execution to team leadership and ultimately to strategic management of data infrastructure. The field has excellent prospects due to the explosive growth of big data and AI applications in virtually all sectors.

AI Impact on the job

AI transforms the role of the data engineer through automation of data processing and analysis tasks. Advanced AI tools require skills in machine learning, data integration and cloud technology, alongside traditional programming knowledge. Given the increasing demand for data analysis and AI-driven solutions, prospects for data engineers remain positive, but they must continue to upskill to remain relevant in an increasingly automated environment.

Bij Sopra Steria – Financial Economic Crime (FEC) voorzien we banken en financiële instellingen van digitale tools om risico’s te beheren, klanten te beschermen en de impact van financiële economische criminaliteit te beperken. Als poortwachters van het financiële systeem spelen banken een cruciale rol in de bescherming van onze economie tegen criminele inmenging. Daardoor worden financiële instellingen onderworpen aan steeds strengere regelgeving en toezicht. Tegelijkertijd maken wereldwijde economische instabiliteit en steeds geavanceerdere, technologiegedreven financiële criminaliteit het werk van banken steeds moeilijker.

Enkele cijfers: Naar schatting wordt jaarlijks 16 miljard euro aan crimineel geld witgewassen in Nederland. Minder dan 1% van de criminele geldstromen die via het mondiale banksysteem gaan, wordt daadwerkelijk gestopt. Daarom moeten banken hun aanpak radicaal veranderen in de strijd tegen FEC. Gelukkig zijn er tactische veranderingen die banken snel kunnen doorvoeren om het effect van financiële economische criminaliteit te verminderen.

Ben je enthousiast over deze rol en klaar om samen met ons de wereld vorm te geven? Dan kijken we uit naar jouw reactie!

title: Mission Execution Lead (US)
description:
CHAOS Industries is redefining modern defense with a multi-product portfolio that gives the ultimate advantage—domain dominance. The company's products are powered by Coherent Distributed Networks (CDN™), empowering warfighters, commercial air operators, and border protection teams to act faster, adapt rapidly, and stay ahead of evolving threats.

CHAOS Industries was founded in 2022 and has raised a total of $1 billion in funding from leading investors, including 8VC, Accel, and Valor Equity Partners. The company is headquartered in Los Angeles, with offices in Washington, D.C., San Francisco, San Diego, and London. For more information, please visit .

Role Overview:

This role is responsible for driving CHAOS’ growth across the United States by aligning our technical capabilities with the operational needs of military and commercial customers. You will lead high-impact engagements end-to-end—opening doors, shaping requirements, securing commitments, and guiding post-award implementation. Your success depends on staying close to the customer, present in their environment, and engaged at every stage of the mission.

The ideal candidate is a disciplined planner, a skilled coordinator, and a flawless executor—someone who thrives in dynamic operational settings and knows how to translate field requirements into decisive action. You should be just as comfortable in a suit and tie as you are stepping out of a tactical vehicle. Just as important, you must be a true team player: someone who collaborates seamlessly with engineering, leadership, and fellow operators to drive shared success and ensure unified delivery.

Expect every day to be different. Stay hungry—seek out problems early, identify gaps before they become failures, and be the first to deliver solutions. This role requires initiative and presence: go where the customer is, build trust, learn continuously, support your team, drive momentum, and execute with absolute precision.

Responsibilities:

  • Understand and translate the customer needs. Military and commercial customers are demanding, each operating with their own language, expectations, and mission pressures. This role requires the initiative to seek out opportunities, build trust in the customer’s environment, and translate their needs into clear, actionable requirements for CHAOS. You are the customer’s voice inside CHAOS and CHAOS’ voice in front of the customer—ensuring alignment, clarity, and a unified path to execution.
  • Execute, execute, execute. This role is centered on delivering end-to-end execution for the customer. You will coordinate and plan every phase of engagement—from initial site surveys and environmental assessments, to developing and delivering tailored customer training, to running controlled demonstrations and full-scale operational exercises. Success means anticipating requirements, eliminating friction, and ensuring the customer experiences a seamless, confident deployment of CHAOS capabilities.
  • Know our product – know the mission. This role operates on CHAOS’ front line. Success requires a deep understanding of our technology, capabilities, and internal resources—and the ability to align them precisely with mission demands and end-user requirements. When executed well, this role becomes the bridge that makes CHAOS the customer’s most trusted and reliable tactical partner.
  • Get out of the office. Be wherever the customer needs us—at corporate headquarters, a military installation, inside the Pentagon, or forward in the field. Build trust by engaging at every level, from tactical operators to senior strategic leaders, learning their challenges and earning their confidence through presence and performance.

Minimum Requirements:

  • Problem solving mentality. Fight for information, build a team, be creative, a thought leader and relish the opportunity to take on a difficult problem.
  • Program/Project Management: Proven experience in developing requirements, scoping programs, and delivering to customers in the defense industry.
  • Enjoy getting your hands dirty – literally: CHAOS is an engineering-first company with a hardware component. This role will involve getting hands-on with hardware in the field with customers.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, both written and verbal. You will interface with customer stakeholders across the entire hierarchy—from day-to-day operators to senior leaders. Your job is to capture their insights, frame them in the right operational context, and deliver them clearly to CHAOS engineering, product management, and senior leadership, ensuring the customer’s voice directly shapes our decisions and capabilities.
  • Risk tolerance: We intend to go with our customers to where they need us most to deliver. Hazardous duty pay for approved locations.
  • Travel: Willingness and ability to travel up to 50% to customer sites across the United States and abroad in support of mission requirements.
  • Security Clearance: Active security clearance, or the ability to obtain one.

Preferred Requirements:

  • Experience: Radar, RF, sensor, weapons systems, defense technology or communications experience.
  • Prior Military Experience: Extensive experience with U.S. military operations, or a background in military engineering or advanced defense technologies.
  • Travel experience: Comfortable deploying as part of a team within the United States or overseas to support operational engagements; capable of operating in remote environments and proactively planning for and mitigating risks to reputation, mission, and personnel.

Why CHAOS?

  • Health Benefits: Medical, dental, and vision benefits 100% paid for by the company
  • Additional benefits: 401k (+ 50% company match up to 6% of pay), FSA, HSA, life insurance, and more
  • Our Perks: Free daily lunch, ‘No meeting Fridays’, unlimited PTO, casual dress code
  • Compensation Components: Competitive base salaries, generous pre-IPO stock option grants, relocation assistance, and (coming soon!) annual bonuses

title: Expert Data Engineer
description:
Expert Data Engineer

Will you join our AdInsights team?

By building the data products that help advertisers understand how their campaigns are performing. AdInsights brings together data from across the bol ecosystem, transforms it into reliable and meaningful advertising insights, and makes those insights available through advertiser-facing dashboards and APIs.
Your work enables advertisers to evaluate their results and make better-informed decisions about their campaigns.

Advertising insights are created by combining large amounts of data from different sources across bol. The challenge is to aggregate this data effectively and efficiently, and turn it into reliable insights that advertisers can access through dashboards and APIs.
You will build scalable data pipelines and models that ensure advertisers receive consistent and trustworthy information about their campaign performance. Data quality, maintainability and performance are essential, because advertisers rely on these insights to understand the value of their advertising investments.

As an Expert Data Engineer in AdInsights, you are a deep technical expert within the team. You take on the most complex data engineering challenges behind advertiser insights and help the team make strong choices in data modelling, pipeline design, quality, observability and scalability. Your scope is primarily within AdInsights, while you actively align with adjacent teams when shared data definitions, dependencies or reporting consistency require it.
You work on the hardest AdInsights data problems: combining data from many sources, improving metric consistency, strengthening data quality, and making sure advertiser-facing dashboards and APIs remain reliable as the advertising business grows. You look beyond the immediate implementation and translate your experience into pragmatic improvements that help the team build better data products.

  • Define and improve the technical approach for AdInsights data pipelines, models and aggregation logic
  • Solve complex data engineering challenges in combining advertising and commerce data from multiple sources
  • Improve data quality, observability, testing and operational reliability within the team
  • Help the team make better trade-off decisions around performance, scalability, cost and maintainability
  • Align with adjacent teams on shared datasets, metric definitions, data contracts and dependencies
  • Bring data engineering knowledge to other engineers and help raise the craft level of the AdInsights team
  • Act as a technical sparring partner for engineers, analysts and product managers when decisions depend on data engineering depth
  • Translate relevant data engineering practices and learnings into practical improvements for AdInsights
  • Take ownership of difficult technical problems while helping others make better technical decisions independently

Advertisers need confidence that the numbers they see are complete, consistent and timely. In this role, you make that possible by building the data foundations that turn complex source data into metrics they can trust.
The quality of the pipelines and models you build directly affects the trust advertisers place in our dashboards and APIs. By making advertising data accurate, consistent and accessible, you help advertisers make better decisions and improve the value they get from advertising on bol.

To be successful as Expert Data Engineer, you need:

  • Expert-level SQL and Python skills, with strong experience in data modelling and analytical data products
  • Experience building and operating large-scale data pipelines, preferably with Airflow and dbt or comparable tooling
  • Strong understanding of cloud data warehouses; BigQuery experience is a plus
  • A strong focus on data quality, observability, performance, cost and maintainability
  • Ability to turn complex data from multiple sources into reliable, reusable datasets and metrics
  • Ability to influence technical decisions and explain trade-offs to engineers, analysts, product managers and stakeholders
  • Experience raising the data engineering craft level of a team
  • Experience with advertiser-facing data products, dashboards, APIs, Java or Kotlin is a plus

  • Advertising Impact Driver

    Your work directly helps advertisers understand campaign performance and make informed decisions.

  • Data Puzzle Solver

    You enjoy bringing together data from different sources and turning it into clear, reliable insights.

  • Quality-Minded Builder

    You care about scalable engineering, trustworthy metrics and solutions that remain maintainable as the platform evolves.

  • Single-Source Seeker

    You prefer working with simple datasets from one well-defined source. This role involves combining data from across a complex ecosystem.

  • Independent Builder Preference

    You would rather receive a complete specification and work mostly on your own. Here, you collaborate to clarify reporting needs and shape the solution.

  • Dashboard-Only Thinker

    You are mainly interested in visual reporting. This role focuses on the data engineering foundations that power both dashboards and APIs.

You’ll join AdInsights, a team in the advertising domain that builds the data foundations behind advertiser insights. The team works on the pipelines, models and services that turn complex advertising and commerce data into reliable campaign performance information.
You’ll collaborate closely with engineers, analysts, product managers and advertising stakeholders to translate reporting needs into data products that are accurate, scalable and useful in practice.

title: Assistant FSO w/active Top Secret clearance
description:
Overview

LMI is a new breed of digital solutions provider dedicated to accelerating government impact with innovation and speed. Investing in technology and prototypes ahead of need, LMI brings commercial-grade platforms and mission-ready AI to federal agencies at commercial speed.

Leveraging our mission-ready technology and solutions, proven expertise in federal deployment, and strategic relationships, we enhance outcomes for the government, efficiently and effectively. Headquartered in Tysons, Virginia, LMI is committed to delivering impactful results that strengthen missions and drive lasting value.

Responsibilities

LMI is seeking a motivated Assistant Facility Security Officer (Assistant FSO) to support personnel, physical, and industrial security operations for a multi-site, TS/SCI enterprise IT program spanning multiple government facilities, including SCIF and SAP environments. Working under the direction of the Program FSO/Security Lead, this individual will help execute daily security activities, maintain compliance with federal security requirements, and ensure consistent security posture across dispersed program locations.

Primary duties include:

  • Support the Program FSO in maintaining compliance with the National Industrial Security Program Operating Manual (NISPOM) and applicable DoD/IC security policies.
  • Assist with personnel security operations, including clearance processing, reinvestigations, briefings, debriefings, and visit authorization requests.
  • Coordinate physical security activities across facility locations, including access control, badge management, visitor escorting, and secure space monitoring.
  • Support ICD 705‑compliant SCIF operations, including documentation updates, ongoing accreditation maintenance, facility inspections, and liaison activities with government security officials.
  • Assist in managing DD Form 254 compliance, classification guidance distribution, and sponsorship coordination for SCI/SAP access.
  • Maintain security logs, incident reports, Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), and required documentation for audits, inspections, and recurring compliance activities.
  • Support delivery of security education, awareness, and training to program staff, reinforcing proper handling of classified material and secure environment protocols.
  • Aid in cleared workforce onboarding/offboarding processes, including indoctrinations, access updates, and departure requirements.
  • Gather site-level security observations and contribute to risk mitigation planning across multiple facilities.
  • Coordinate closely with facility teams, program management, and government representatives to ensure consistent execution of security requirements.
  • Provide on-site presence at various program locations as needed to support security walkthroughs, events, construction activities, and classified operations.

Location: This position is based in the Denver CO area, with travel to other program locations.

Travel: This position requires approximately 0-25% travel to support activities across multiple program locations.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Bachelor’s degree in a related field OR equivalent experience.
  • 2–4 years of industrial or personnel security experience supporting federal or classified environments.
  • Familiarity with NISPOM and general DoD/IC security requirements.
  • Experience supporting SCIF or SAP operations, secure facility procedures, or classified programs.
  • Working knowledge of clearance processing workflows and security documentation requirements.
  • Strong organizational skills and ability to maintain accurate, compliant records across multiple locations.
  • Ability to coordinate with government security officials and respond to time‑sensitive security tasks.

Nice to Have:

  • Experience supporting SCIF accreditation, inspections, or secure facility operations.
  • Experience supporting geographically dispersed security operations or multi-site programs.

Clearance Requirements

TS/SCI clearance with SAP eligibility is required for this position. Applicants selected will be subject to a government security investigation and must meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information. LMI will only consider applicants with current security clearances. Please note that only U.S. citizens are eligible for a security clearance.

Target salary range: $50,000 - $70,000

title: Thermal Engineer, Thermal Protection Systems (TPS)
description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

About the Team

The Thermal Engineering team enables Anduril's rapid hardware development cycle by ensuring advanced defense systems perform reliably in demanding real-world environments. The team works across high-power, tightly integrated products where thermal architecture, analysis, testing, and cross-functional design decisions directly affect product performance, reliability, and mission success.

About the Role

We are looking for a Thermal Engineer specializing in Thermal Protection Systems (TPS) to join our team. In this role, you will own the design, analysis, and validation of thermal protection for hypersonic and high-speed flight systems operating in extreme aerothermal environments.

This role is ideal for someone with deep expertise in aerothermal heating, ablative material response, and high-temperature thermal analysis — someone who can work across first-principles hand calculations, material response modeling, and detailed CFD to guide fast, high-consequence design decisions for systems where thermal survival is the critical constraint.

What You'll Do

  • Own TPS design, material selection, and thermal analysis for hypersonic and high-speed flight vehicles, including missiles, reentry systems, and advanced flight platforms.
  • Perform aerothermal heating analysis using engineering correlations, boundary-layer methods, and CFD to define the thermal environment across flight trajectories.
  • Conduct ablation and material response modeling to predict TPS recession, in-depth thermal response, and structural thermal margins under mission-representative conditions.
  • Evaluate and select TPS materials, including carbon phenolic, PICA, silicone-based ablators, ceramics, and high-temperature composites, based on aerothermal loads, mass constraints, and manufacturability.
  • Partner with aerodynamics, structures, propulsion, and systems engineers to integrate TPS into vehicle design while managing mass, volume, and performance tradeoffs.
  • Define and execute thermal and material characterization tests, including arcjet testing, furnace testing, and instrumented flight-article thermal testing.
  • Build and maintain thermal models spanning hand calculations through detailed FEA/CFD to predict system performance, establish design limits, and support qualification.
  • Present TPS status, risks, tradeoffs, and recommendations in internal design reviews and customer-facing technical reviews.
  • Support failure reviews and root-cause investigations using test data, thermal analysis, and first-principles reasoning.

Required Qualifications

  • MS or PhD in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Applied Physics, or a related field with a focus on aerothermodynamics, heat transfer, thermal sciences, or materials science.
  • 2+ years of experience in TPS design, aerothermal analysis, or high-temperature material response for aerospace or defense systems.
  • Strong first-principles understanding of aerodynamic heating, ablation, high-temperature heat transfer, and material thermal response.
  • Experience with material response modeling tools such as FIAT, CMA, TITAN, or equivalent ablation/thermal response codes.
  • Experience supporting thermal design for hypersonic vehicles, reentry systems, missiles, rocket nozzles, or other systems operating in extreme aerothermal environments.
  • Ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. Top Secret security clearance.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with aerothermal CFD tools such as DPLR, US3D, Loci-CHEM, CFD++, ANSYS Fluent, or STAR-CCM+ for high-speed reacting flow analysis.
  • Experience with arcjet testing, thermal characterization testing, or flight-article thermal instrumentation.
  • Experience with high-temperature materials including carbon phenolic, carbon-carbon, PICA, SLA-561V, silicone-based ablators, or ceramic matrix composites.
  • Experience with radiation modeling tools such as NEQAIR, HARA, or equivalent nonequilibrium radiation solvers.
  • Experience using MATLAB, Python, or similar tools for trajectory-based heating analysis, thermal margin assessment, or engineering trade studies.
  • Familiarity with NASA TPS heritage tools and databases (TPSX, CEA, CBAero).
  • Experience supporting PDR/CDR, qualification testing, or flight programs.
  • Strong motivation to support Anduril's mission of defending the United States and allied partners.
US Salary Range
$140,000—$186,000 USD

Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

  • No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

  • Please always verify communications:
    • Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address.
    • Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.

  • Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

  • What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

With caring and great resources at hand, we know what it takes to help people live fuller, happier, healthier lives. Our employees show their commitment to the people we support every day, and we all deliver on our promise to provide innovative and comprehensive services to individuals with developmental disabilities.


For your next career move, apply with us at ADAPT Community Network! Wherever you work among our many locations around New York City, ADAPT offers paid training, competitive benefits, and we foster a team culture of learning, support, collaboration and career growth.


SUMMARY

The Assessment Specialist conducts Home Enabling Supports (HES) assessments and develops person-centered HES Plans for individuals with intellectual and developmental disabilities (I/DD). Working under the direction of the HES Program Development Manager and working closely with individuals, families, Care Managers, and vendors, the Assessment Specialist identifies opportunities to promote independence, safety, health, and community participation through assistive and enabling technology. The position is responsible for completing assessments, identifying appropriate technology solutions, developing HES Plans, and ensuring required documentation meets OPWDD and program standards. Assessments may be conducted in the individual's home or remotely.


Program Description

ADAPT Community Network is one of eight providers across New York State selected by the New York State Office for People With Developmental Disabilities (OPWDD) to provide Home Enabling Supports (HES), a Home and Community-Based Services (HCBS) Waiver service. HES provides access to assistive and enabling technologies for people with intellectual and developmental disabilities living at home or in the community. The service is designed to promote independence, increase safety, improve health outcomes, support community participation, and reduce reliance on staff. ADAPT's HES service area includes all five boroughs of New York City.


ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

The duties and responsibilities of the Assessment Specialist, Home Enabling Supports, include, but are not limited to the following:

  • Conduct comprehensive HES assessments to identify individual needs, goals, and opportunities for technology-based solutions that promote independence and safety.
  • Develop person-centered HES Plans based on assessment findings and the individual's goals, preferences, and needs.
  • Evaluate and recommend appropriate assistive and enabling technologies based on assessment findings and HES goals.
  • Collaborate with individuals, families, Care Managers, vendors, and other stakeholders throughout the assessment and planning process.
  • Ensure assessments, HES Plans, and related documentation comply with OPWDD requirements and established program standards.
  • Maintain accurate and timely records and complete required documentation within established timeframes.
  • Participate in activities that support effective program operations, quality, and compliance.
  • Perform other related duties as assigned.

QUALIFICATIONS

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

  • At least one (1) year of experience conducting technology assessments, including direct or supervised experience assessing, implementing, or supporting technology-based solutions for individuals; and
  • One of the following: A credential in enabling or assistive technology, such as Enabling Technology Integration Specialist (ETIS) or Assistive Technology Professional (ATP); -OR- A clinical background with at least two (2) years of experience working with individuals with intellectual and/or developmental disabilities in a related field, such as Occupational Therapy, Physical Therapy, Speech Therapy, Rehabilitation Counseling, or Social Work.
  • Experience with person-centered planning and service delivery preferred.
  • Strong communication, interpersonal, organizational, and documentation skills.
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively with individuals, families, Care Managers, vendors, and other stakeholders.
  • Ability and willingness to travel throughout ADAPT's service area, including the five boroughs of New York City, for in-home assessments and related activities.
  • Commitment to ADAPT Community Network's mission and to supporting individuals with intellectual and developmental disabilities to live as independently and fully as possible.


COMPENSATION: $40-$45/hour [part-time hours, flexible]


At ADAPT, we value diversity, equity, inclusion, accessibility, and belonging. We strive to ensure that our employees are comfortable bringing their whole, authentic self to work and that the people we support can also be their authentic selves. We value diverse backgrounds, opinions, ideas, and ways of thinking. We aim to build an inclusive and diverse workforce that is empowered and supported with leaders who create diverse and inclusive teams. We continuously seek opportunities for the organization to foster a more positive, respected, united, and collaborative culture.


ADAPT Community Network is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. Qualified candidates of diverse ethnic and racial backgrounds and status are encouraged to apply for vacant positions at all levels.

title: Staff Scrum Master – Embedded Software & Firmware
description:
Pivotal is the leader in the emerging market of electric Vertical Takeoff and Landing (eVTOL) aircraft. We design, develop, and manufacture light eVTOL aircraft and are renowned for the BlackFly aircraft the world's first light eVTOL to fly manned missions and enter the consumer market.
Efficient, compact, and simple, Pivotal aircraft are designed for a wide range of consumer, public service, and defense applications. Our distinctive tilt-aircraft architecture and scalable platform have been flying for over 10 years. Last year we announced our next-generation aircraft, the Helix, which is rapidly progressing toward general release and scalable production in 2026.
Mobility is one of the most highly-valued areas of modern technology investments. This is the right company, in the right space, the right strategy, at the right time. If you are ready for adventure, we invite you to join our amazing team and grow with us.

About the job


Pivotal is seeking a Scrum Master to support the development and delivery of embedded software and firmware for our next-generation aircraft. This role will work closely with firmware, software, systems, hardware, DevOps, and verification teams to establish clear priorities, maintain execution cadence, identify and remove blockers, and drive work from definition through integration and verification.

This is a hands-on execution role in a fast-paced aerospace development environment. The successful candidate will understand how software is actually developed, integrated, tested, and released in complex hardware products and will be comfortable working across low-level embedded software, device drivers, firmware, automated test, DevOps infrastructure, and aircraft integration.
The Scrum Master will own the operating rhythm of the team while helping engineering leadership maintain visibility into scope, schedule, dependencies, risk, and delivery.

Responsibilities

  • Lead Agile/Scrum execution for embedded software, firmware, DevOps, and software verification teams, including sprint planning, daily standups, backlog refinement, reviews, retrospectives, and release planning.
  • Partner with engineering leads and product owners to maintain a prioritized, actionable backlog with clearly defined scope, acceptance criteria, dependencies, and completion criteria.
  • Drive work to closure by identifying blockers, establishing owners and due dates, and following actions through completion.
  • Maintain development plans and execution status across Jira, GitLab, Smartsheet, and Microsoft Project, ensuring that detailed team execution aligns with program-level milestones.
  • Coordinate development activities spanning embedded firmware, low-level software, hardware abstraction layers, device drivers, communications interfaces, bootloaders, diagnostics, DevOps, test automation, and software verification.
  • Track dependencies between software, electrical hardware, systems engineering, GNC, test, manufacturing, and aircraft integration teams.
  • Support release planning, build and integration schedules, regression testing, hardware-in-the-loop testing, aircraft testing, and production software releases.
  • Work with engineering teams to define and maintain appropriate Definition of Ready and Definition of Done criteria, including code review, testing, documentation, integration, and verification requirements.
  • Use GitLab and Jira data to monitor sprint health, backlog maturity, development throughput, defects, aging work, and release readiness.
  • Identify schedule, resource, technical, and integration risks early and ensure they are communicated and actively managed.
  • Support defect triage and prioritization across development, integration, verification, and flight-test activities.
  • Facilitate cross-functional technical discussions when dependencies or competing priorities prevent execution.
  • Continuously improve team processes while avoiding unnecessary ceremony or administrative overhead.
  • Help engineering leadership translate program milestones into executable software development plans and provide clear, fact-based status against those plans.
  • Promote accountability, transparency, and predictable execution while maintaining the flexibility required in a rapidly evolving aircraft-development program.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 5+ years of experience supporting software or firmware development teams in aerospace, automotive, robotics, autonomous systems, industrial controls, or another complex hardware/software environment.
  • 3+ years of experience as a Scrum Master, technical program manager, software project manager, engineering project manager, or similar execution-focused role.
  • Strong working knowledge of Jira and GitLab, including backlogs, issues, boards, releases, defects, and development workflows.
  • Experience developing and maintaining integrated schedules using Smartsheet and/or Microsoft Project.
  • Strong understanding of the software development lifecycle, including requirements, architecture, implementation, code review, continuous integration, integration testing, verification, release, and defect management.
  • Experience working with embedded software or firmware teams and enough technical understanding to follow discussions involving low-level software, drivers, hardware interfaces, communications protocols, and software/hardware integration.
  • Experience coordinating software verification, automated testing, regression testing, and release readiness.
  • Strong organizational skills and demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities, dependencies, and deadlines simultaneously.
  • Ability to communicate clearly with engineers, functional managers, program leadership, and other cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Demonstrated ability to identify execution problems early and drive teams toward resolution rather than simply reporting status.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience developing aircraft, automotive, robotics, autonomous systems, or other safety-critical products.
  • Experience working directly with embedded C/C++, Python, RTOS-based systems, device drivers, bootloaders, or hardware abstraction layers.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, build systems, automated testing, Git workflows, branching strategies, and release management.
  • Experience with GitLab CI/CD or comparable DevOps environments.
  • Experience coordinating Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL), Software-in-the-Loop (SIL), bench testing, vehicle integration, or flight-test activities.
  • Familiarity with requirements and verification management tools such as Jama.
  • Understanding of requirements traceability, verification methods, configuration management, and change control.
  • Familiarity with aerospace or automotive software development standards and practices, including DO-178C, ARP4754A, ISO 26262, ASPICE, or similar frameworks.
  • Experience managing software defects and technical debt alongside new feature development.
  • Scrum Master, PMI-ACP, PMP, CSM, PSM, or similar certification.

Attributes aligned with Core Values

  • Safety Above All: Demonstrates a proactive safety mindset by embedding safety into daily work, identifying and mitigating risks, encouraging open dialogue about safety concerns, and continuously improving practices and protocols.
  • Customer Focus: Puts customers at the center of every action by understanding their challenges, delivering meaningful value, and supporting their success.
  • Work Better Together: Seeks and values diverse perspectives, builds cross-functional relationships, and fosters trust through empathetic, fact-based communication and commitment to shared decisions.
  • Be the Pilot: Drives results with clarity and purpose by focusing on what matters most, adapting to change, taking initiative, and owning outcomes.
  • Embrace the Unknown: Navigates ambiguity with resilience and bold thinking, challenges the status quo, and combines innovative ideas with practical approaches to overcome obstacles and drive progress.
  • Respect for People: Fosters a high-performance culture grounded in respect, professionalism, and support by balancing high expectations with a healthy, collaborative environment and being a trusted, dependable teammate.
Applicants must be eligible for employment in the United States and willing to work onsite at our HQ office in Palo Alto, CA.
Pivotal offers a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, vision, and 401k plans.

title: Data Fusion & AI Engineer – TRSC Solutions (Defence Technology)
description:
Company Description

BSS Holland BV is dedicated to enhancing safety and operational effectiveness for citizens, first responders, and armed forces.We deliver innovative products, turnkey solutions, and specialized services to defense and homeland security organizations.Our core competencies include C4I (Command, Control, Communications, Computers & Intelligence), sensor integration, and manned, unmanned, and remote-controlled systems.By accelerating our customers’ OODA-loops (Observe–Orient–Decide–Act), we empower professionals with critical missions to perform effectively in complex operational environments.

Role Description

As a Data fusion & AI Engineer, you operate at the intersection of sensors, data architectures, artificial intelligence, and operational use within a TRSC context.You design and deliver solutions that fuse heterogeneous sensor data (UAS, Intelligence, Surveillance and Reconnaissance sources, external feeds) into reliable, time-critical situation understanding for operators and commanders.You are expected to actively use AI-aided development tools to accelerate modelling, prototyping, and iteration while retaining full ownership of assumptions, validation, and system behavior under stress.

Key responsibilities

  • Design and implement multi-sensor, multi-source data-fusion pipelines
  • Develop and apply AI / machine-learning models for detection, classification, tracking, and context generation
  • Integrate georeferenced data, imagery, and metadata into coherent operational views
  • Contribute to TRSC chains, from sensing through decision support toward effectors
  • Design edge and hybrid architectures where latency, bandwidth, and resilience are critical
  • Validate and improve models based on exercises, mission data, and realistic scenarios
  • Apply AI-assisted development workflows for experimentation, refactoring, testing, and documentation

Your profile

You combine academic depth with a strong sense of operational reality.You understand that data fusion is not a purely mathematical problem, but a decision-making challenge under uncertainty, time pressure, and noise.You view AI not as magic, but as a tool that only creates value when it is trusted, explainable, and usable by operators.

Background & Skills (Indicative)

  • Education at BSc or MSc level in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Engineering, or a related field - or equivalent demonstrated capability
  • Strong foundation in data fusion, sensor fusion, probabilistic methods, or machine learning
  • Programming experience (e.g. Python, C/C++, Java) and experience with data and ML frameworks
  • Experience or strong interest in Intelligence, Surveillance and Reconnaissance, UAS, geospatial data, simulations, or edge computing
  • Hands-on use of AI-aided development tools in daily engineering workflows
  • Ability to translate models and assumptions into robust, fieldable systems

Autodidacts Welcome

Formal education is not the only path. If you are largely self-taught, highly curious, driven, and can demonstrate a strong track record (e.g. projects, deployments, open-source contributions, or operational prototypes), we strongly encourage you to apply.

Security & Eligibility

Due to security and clearance considerations, candidates from NATO member states are preferred.Final eligibility is subject to applicable security screening requirements.

What We Offer

  • Work on strategically relevant TRSC capabilities with direct operational impact
  • A high degree of technical autonomy and responsibility
  • Small, expert teams with short decision lines and minimal bureaucracy
  • Close collaboration with operators, integration partners, and exercise environments
  • Competitive compensation and clear opportunities for professional growth

Why Join Us?

At BSS, data fusion is not an academic end state it is a forward position.You build while reality pushes back: sensors fail, networks degrade, and time is scarce.If you are motivated by turning complex data and AI into actionable tactical advantage, this role is designed for you.
