title: Senior Data Integrity Engineer
description:
Ben jij een ervaren IT professional met een ervaring binnen een GMP-omgeving? Begrijp je hoe data door verschillende systemen en processen stroomt en wil je jouw expertise inzetten om de betrouwbaarheid en integriteit van data binnen de farmaceutische industrie te waarborgen? Dan zoeken wij jou!

Wij zijn op zoek naar een Senior Data Integrity Engineer die complexe dataflows en systemen kan doorgronden en onze klanten adviseert over data integrity, risico’s en de nodige controles.

Wat zal je doen?

Als Senior Data Integrity Engineer gebruik je jouw technische en analytische expertise om klanten te ondersteunen bij complexe vraagstukken rond data integrity binnen een gereguleerde omgeving. Je werkt op het snijvlak van data, IT, processen en GMP.

Jouw Belangrijkste Taken

  • Je analyseert datastromen, IT-systemen en processen en brengt in kaart waar data wordt aangemaakt, verwerkt, opgeslagen en uitgewisseld.
  • Je identificeert kritische data, interfaces en risico’s die een impact kunnen hebben op de integriteit en betrouwbaarheid van data.
  • Je beoordeelt hoe data door verschillende systemen beweegt en waar mogelijke risico’s ontstaan voor volledigheid, nauwkeurigheid, consistentie en traceerbaarheid.
  • Je beoordeelt onder andere audit trails, toegangsrechten, elektronische records en interfaces vanuit een data integrity-perspectief.
  • Je ondersteunt klanten bij het bepalen van de nodige controls en maatregelen om risico’s rond data integrity te beheersen.
  • Je werkt mee aan data integrity assessments en vertaalt je bevindingen naar concrete verbetermaatregelen.
  • Je werkt samen met QA, IT, QC, productie en andere stakeholders om data integrity binnen processen en systemen te verbeteren.

Wie ben jij?

  • Je hebt een bachelor- of masterdiploma in een IT-, technische, wetenschappelijke of life sciences-richting.
  • Je hebt meerdere jaren relevante ervaring binnen data integrity, quality, compliance, IT, CSV of een vergelijkbaar technisch domein.
  • Je beschikt over een analytische en technische basis en voelt je comfortabel met complexe systemen, processen en datastromen.
  • Je hebt bij voorkeur ervaring binnen een GMP-omgeving of een andere sterk gereguleerde sector, zoals pharma, biotech, medical devices of life sciences.
  • Ervaring met Data Integrity, GMP, CSV of quality/compliance is een sterke plus.
  • Je hebt een goed begrip van dataflows, databases, interfaces en communicatie tussen systemen.
  • Kennis van audit trails, elektronische records, data governance en data management is een plus.
  • Je bent analytisch, kritisch en nauwkeurig en krijgt energie van het identificeren van risico’s en verbeterpunten.
  • Je communiceert vlot met zowel technische als niet-technische stakeholders.
  • Je hebt een goede kennis van het Nederlands en Engels.

Wat bieden wij?

  • Een technisch uitdagende rol: je werkt op het snijvlak van engineering, automation, GMP en validatie.
  • Een sterke technische omgeving: je werkt samen met ervaren Automation, Engineering en Validation & Testing-experten.
  • Veel afwisseling: je combineert technische vraagstukken met validatie, testing en klantencontact.
  • Een dynamische werkomgeving: je komt terecht in een organisatie waar expertise, initiatief en samenwerking centraal staan.
  • Een aantrekkelijk totaalpakket: een marktconform salaris, leaseauto, verzekeringen, onkostenvergoeding,...
  • Work-life balance: hybride werkomgeving met flexibele werkuren en maar liefst 37 vakantiedagen.

Let’s get together!

Heb je interesse in deze rol én denk je dat jij degene bent die wij zoeken? Neem dan contact op met Madhuri Singh via or +31 62 56 33 044.

title: Signals Analyst, Level 2, Intelligence Community Mission Program, Fort Meade, MD
description:
Signals Analyst, Level 2, Intelligence Community Mission Program, Fort Meade, MD

Summary:

  • Job Title: Signals Analyst, Level 2
  • Openings: 1
  • Security Clearance: Active TS/SCI with CI Polygraph or above required.
  • Work Type: Onsite at Fort George G. Meade, MD, in a secure government facility
  • Job Type: Full-time
  • Benefits: Our client provides full benefits.
  • Program Name: SIGINT mission support program covering collection systems engineering, target development, analysis, and reporting
  • Agency name: Intelligence Community (IC) customer, Fort George G. Meade, MD
  • Start Date: Immediate, upon offer acceptance and clearance transfer

BizFirst is assisting our client with recruiting a skilled and experienced Signals Analyst. This position supports the following program: a signals intelligence (SIGINT) mission support program that provides collection systems engineering, target development, analysis, reporting, and mission software development for an Intelligence Community customer. The position is onsite at Fort Meade, MD, and the role is open now for an immediate start.

Our client is a Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Business that has supported U.S. defense and intelligence missions since 2012. Its systems, software, and data science engineers work side by side with government teams to model, design, integrate, and deploy complex mission systems, and the company also builds rugged RF hardware for specialized SIGINT applications. Led by a U.S. Navy veteran with more than 30 years of DoD mission experience, the company supports programs alongside many of the largest national security integrators and has a long-established presence in Maryland near Fort Meade.

What will you do

Develop and apply the techniques and tools that turn signals intelligence (SIGINT) into answers for mission customers. You will collect, evaluate, analyze, document, locate, and present information according to established requirements and priorities, and use SIGINT and collateral report repositories along with your own research to advance target development. You will work with packet and stream protocols and other IP-based technologies, and use the software applications and databases that support SIGINT target development. This role suits a seasoned analyst with at least seven years of SIGINT experience in the Intelligence Community or the U.S. military who is comfortable on the Linux command line.

Responsibilities:

  • Develop techniques and tools to collect, evaluate, analyze, document, locate, and present information in line with established requirements and priorities.
  • Research SIGINT and collateral report repositories, and bring independent research into target development.
  • Analyze packet and stream protocols and other advanced technologies over IP.
  • Use the software applications and databases that support SIGINT target development.
  • Apply knowledge of data and voice communications technologies and network protocols to analytic problems.
  • Write Bash, shell, or Python scripts to support analysis on Linux systems.

Requirements:

  • Active TS/SCI clearance with CI Polygraph or above.
  • Seven (7) years of experience performing as a Signals Analyst supporting the Intelligence Community or U.S. military. Candidates with or without a degree are considered; the experience requirement is the same.
  • Experience developing techniques and tools for collecting, evaluating, analyzing, documenting, locating, and presenting information according to established requirements and priorities.
  • Familiarity with SIGINT and collateral report repositories, and the ability to show how you have used independent research to enhance target development.
  • Experience with packet and stream protocols and other advanced technologies over IP.
  • Experience using software applications and databases associated with SIGINT target development.
  • Proficiency with the Linux/Unix command line and scripting (Bash, shell, and/or Python).
  • Familiarity with data and voice communications technologies and network protocols.
  • Ability to work onsite at Fort Meade, MD.

Desired Skills

  • Experience with Apache NiFi.
  • Military SIGINT background, such as Army 35N or 35S, Navy CTR, or Air Force 1N2.
  • Formal SIGINT analytic training or qualifications.

Benefits (provided by our client):

  • Medical, dental, and vision coverage for the employee and family, 100% employer-paid (HMO HSA Silver plan), plus a Health Savings Account
  • Five weeks (200 hours) of paid leave per year
  • Eleven (11) paid federal holidays per year
  • 401k with an employer contribution equal to 10% of salary
  • Reimbursement for approved training, up to three days (24 hours) per year, including books and related conference or class travel
  • Reimbursement of professional fees, such as IEEE membership and licenses
  • Short-term and long-term disability insurance
  • Term life insurance equal to annual salary, up to $100K
  • Referral matching bonus program

title: Lead Brand Creative Project Manager
description:
The Opportunity:

The Lead Brand Creative Project Manager is responsible for leading the planning, prioritization, execution, and delivery of creative projects across the Brand Creative organization. This role serves as the operational hub between Brand Creative and cross-functional partners to ensure creative work is executed efficiently, delivered on time, and aligned with brand priorities and business objectives. Partnering closely with the Brand Creative Leader, this individual owns the day-to-day management of the creative workflow, including project intake, prioritization, resource planning, scheduling, and delivery. The role drives operational excellence by establishing clear processes, proactively managing risks, resolving roadblocks, and enabling seamless collaboration across Brand Marketing, Product Design, Packaging, Digital, Creative Operations, Production, external agencies, and other key partners. Success in this role requires exceptional project management capabilities, strong organizational and communication skills, and the ability to manage multiple complex initiatives in a fast-paced, highly collaborative environment.

What Your Impact Will Be:

Creative Project Leadership

  • Lead the end-to-end management of Brand Creative projects from intake through final asset delivery.
  • Develop and maintain project plans, timelines, milestones, deliverables, resource plans, and project schedules.
  • Monitor project progress, proactively identify risks, remove obstacles, and communicate status to stakeholders.
  • Ensure projects are delivered on time, within scope, and aligned with business priorities.

Creative Operations & Workflow Management

  • Own the intake, prioritization, scheduling, and tracking of all Brand Creative work.
  • Partner with the Brand Creative Leader to establish priorities, balance workload, and optimize creative resources.
  • Manage multiple concurrent projects while ensuring deadlines, quality standards, and business commitments are achieved.
  • Continuously improve creative workflows, project management processes, and operational efficiency to increase team effectiveness.

Cross-Functional Partnership

  • Serve as the primary project management partner between Brand Creative and Brand Marketing, Product Design, Packaging, Digital, Creative Operations, Production, Licensing, external agencies, and other cross-functional teams.
  • Facilitate project kickoffs, milestone reviews, status meetings, and post-project evaluations.
  • Clarify project scope, responsibilities, timelines, dependencies, and approval processes across stakeholders.
  • Build strong collaborative relationships that enable effective decision-making and successful project execution.

Execution & Delivery Excellence

  • Coordinate the end-to-end creative development process, including concept development, design reviews, stakeholder feedback, approvals, production, and final asset delivery.
  • Ensure creative assets are delivered accurately, meet quality expectations, and adhere to established brand standards.
  • Track project milestones, deliverables, approvals, and asset delivery while maintaining clear project documentation.
  • Anticipate changing business priorities and develop thoughtful solutions to maintain project momentum and successful execution.

Business Operations & Continuous Improvement

  • Develop reporting and project dashboards that provide visibility into workload, timelines, risks, and project status.
  • Identify opportunities to improve processes, simplify ways of working, and enhance collaboration across the creative organization.
  • Support implementation of new tools, systems, and best practices that improve creative operations and overall team performance.
  • Lead special projects and operational initiatives in support of the Brand Creative organization.

What We’re Looking For:

  • 5–8 years of experience in creative project management, marketing, advertising, design, production, or creative operations.
  • Proven experience managing multiple complex projects simultaneously in a fast-paced, highly matrixed environment.
  • Experience partnering with creative teams and cross-functional business partners to deliver integrated marketing and brand initiatives.
  • Agency, consumer products, entertainment, retail, or in-house creative organization experience preferred.
  • Experience supporting integrated creative campaigns across digital, social, packaging, retail, experiential, and print channels is preferred.
  • Strong project management expertise with exceptional planning, prioritization, and organizational skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple competing priorities while meeting aggressive deadlines.
  • Excellent verbal, written, and presentation communication skills.
  • Strong stakeholder management and relationship-building capabilities with the ability to influence without direct authority.
  • Ability to anticipate issues, solve problems proactively, and navigate ambiguity in a dynamic business environment.
  • Strong understanding of creative development, production workflows, asset management, and approval processes.
  • High attention to detail with a commitment to quality and operational excellence.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office and project management platforms; experience with creative workflow management tools is preferred.
  • Demonstrated a growth mindset by staying curious and continuously learning, embracing challenges, and improving themselves.

Don’t meet every single requirement? At Mattel, we are dedicated to an inclusive workplace and a culture of belonging. If you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we still encourage you to apply. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles. Join Mattel's Talent Community and start receiving exciting updates about our company, our employees, and our culture. Also, interested in signing up for job alerts? Do so here!

How We Work:
We are a purpose driven company aiming to empower generations to explore the wonder of childhood and reach their full potential. We live up to our purpose employing the following behaviors:

  • We collaborate: Being a part of Mattel means being part of one team with shared values and common goals. Every person counts and working closely together always brings better results. Partnership is our process and our collective capabilities is our superpower.
  • We innovate: At Mattel we always aim to find new and better ways to create innovative products and experiences. No matter where you work in the organization, you can always make a difference and have real impact. We welcome new ideas and value new initiatives that challenge conventional thinking.
  • We execute: We are a performance-driven company. We strive for excellence and are focused on pursuing best-in-class outcomes. We believe in accountability and ownership and know that our people are at their best when they are empowered to create and deliver results.

Who We Are:
Mattel is a leading global toy and family entertainment company and owner of one of the most iconic brand portfolios in the world. We engage consumers and fans through our franchise brands, including Barbie, Hot Wheels, Fisher-Price, American Girl, Thomas & Friends, UNO, Masters of the Universe, Matchbox, Monster High, MEGA and Polly Pocket, as well as other popular properties that we own or license in partnership with global entertainment companies. title: Extraction Technician
description:
We are an employee focused medical cannabis organization dedicated to transforming lives through compassionate care and expert guidance. Our mission is to remove barriers to access, fight the stigma surrounding cannabis, and improve the well-being of our patients through the power of the plant. With a commitment to education, advocacy, and personalized support, we strive to make a meaningful impact in the communities we serve.

Join Our Team Today!

The Extraction Technician works in a laboratory environment to extract cannabinoids, terpenes, and other compounds from cannabis flower to be used in various processed cannabis products. Extraction Technicians will be trained to complete various processes including solvent and solventless extraction, post-extraction processing, and product formulation. Extraction Technicians will follow the direction of supervisory staff to adhere to standard operating procedures and Department of Health regulations when producing company-protected formulations of finished products.

This position will be working Monday - Friday from 7:00am - 3:30pm

Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Preparation of equipment and plant materials for extraction of crude cannabis oil
  • Ensure that all extraction and post-processing activities are conducted in accordance with strict quality and safety standards, regulatory compliance requirements, and all other applicable legal and food safety regulations. Safely operate, clean and maintain extraction production equipment including solventless, supercritical fluid and solvent extraction systems, distillations systems, pumps, filters, and evaporators according to our SOP's
  • Safely handle hazardous materials (Pressurized Gasses, Ethanol, etc.), and adhere to safe chemical handling and disposing procedures defined by SOP's and MSDS
  • Safely handle and dispose of cannabis waste according to processes defined in SOP's
  • Produce reliable and precise data for completion of all required batch, equipment, quality, inventory and state mandated seed to sale documentation
  • Accurately fill out all associated logs and tracking records
  • Cleaning and maintenance of equipment and ancillary supplies
  • Maintaining inventory records of supplies, materials, and equipment and preparing requisitions as needed
  • Maintaining material safety data sheets for all chemicals and products
  • Following all standard operating procedures regarding product creation and lab safety
  • Running extraction equipment to ensure attainment of daily production and efficiency goals
  • Maintaining equipment health by performing daily, weekly, monthly, and yearly checks
  • All other duties as assigned

Skills and Requirements:

  • Must be able to use a variety of different extraction techniques to optimize extraction of active components from plant materials. Extraction techniques could include, but are not limited to, wipe film distillation, steam distillation, traditional solvent-based extraction, and chromatography-based approaches
  • Demonstrated ability to work with laboratory equipment to process raw materials
  • Ability to work in a team environment to meet or exceed key performance metrics
  • Ability to perform basic math; including addition, subtraction, division, and multiplication
  • Comfortable with mathematical calculations, formula interpretation, weights, measurements, and chemical reactions.
  • Able to manage processes, present technical Information, and work efficiently with little to no supervision.

Physical Requirements:

This is a labor-intensive position, working in a laboratory environment with exposure to greenhouse and manufacturing environments. This position is in an environment that frequently has a strong cannabis odor. This position will frequently be in-contact with cannabis in its cured, ground, and flash-frozen form. This position has direct exposure to finely ground cannabis product that can irritate airways. This position requires direct contact with certain solvents and chemicals used for extraction. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is frequently required to:

  • Sit, walk, and stand for extended periods of time, including crouching and stooping
  • Utilize hearing protection equipment and other PPE to maintain safety and compliance
  • Communicate clearly and effectively with team members and leadership through talking and hearing
  • Use hands and fingers to operate, handle, and/or feel objects, tools, and/or controls; and reach with hands and arms
  • Lift and/or move up to 75 pounds
  • The employee must be physically capable of performing manual labor tasks required for the proper management of -extraction facility, including meeting activity performance metrics, lifting/carrying product totes, pushing carts, moving and adjusting equipment, etc.
  • Will be required to wear varying degrees of personal protective equipment for specific tasks (some tasks require partial PPE; some will require full PPE)

title: Senior Manager, Software Development Engineer in Test
description:
Senior Manager, Software Development Engineer in Test

Disney Entertainment and ESPN Product & Technology Technology is at the heart of Disney's past, present, and future. Disney Entertainment and ESPN Product & Technology is a global organization of engineers, product developers, designers, technologists, data scientists, and more - all working to build and advance the technological backbone for Disney's media business globally. The team marries technology with creativity to build world-class products, enhance storytelling, and drive velocity, innovation, and scalability for our businesses. We are Storytellers and Innovators. Creators and Builders. Entertainers and Engineers. We work with every part of The Walt Disney Company's media portfolio to advance the technological foundation and consumer media touch points serving millions of people around the world.

Here are a few reasons why we think you'd love working here:

  • Building the future of Disney's media: Our Technologists are designing and building the products and platforms that will power our media, advertising, and distribution businesses for years to come.
  • Reach, Scale & Impact: More than ever, Disney's technology and products serve as a signature doorway for fans' connections with the company's brands and stories. Disney+. Hulu. ESPN. ABC. ABC News... and many more.
  • Innovation: We develop and implement groundbreaking products and techniques that shape industry norms and solve complex and distinctive technical problems.

Job Summary

The DEEP & Technology team is seeking a highly experienced Senior Manager (M3) to lead and scale our Quality Engineering organization supporting various commerce, data and advertising systems. In this role, you will provide strategic, operational, and technical leadership across multiple quality engineering teams, ensuring robust test automation, reliability, and business impact at scale. You will develop and execute a quality strategy that drives measurable improvement in system reliability, speed of delivery, and product excellence, partnering closely with executives, engineering leadership, and cross-functional business units. Ideal candidates are visionary people leaders with a proven track record of growing high-performing teams, implementing transformational quality programs, and delivering significant value in complex and rapidly evolving environments.

Responsibilities and Duties of the Role

Organizational Leadership & Transformation

Lead, inspire, and develop multiple quality engineering teams and people leaders (managers/technical leads), fostering a culture of technical excellence, inclusion, and continuous learning. Define the multi-year vision and strategic roadmap for quality engineering across the advertising platform, aligned with company business and technology goals. Champion organizational transformation, driving the adoption of best-in-class practices, tools, and quality metrics at scale.

Technical Thought Leadership

Set the technical direction for large-scale test automation architecture, cloud-native solutions, and intelligent testing initiatives (AI/ML-driven testing, autonomous pipelines, etc.). Sponsor and guide the evolution of shared automation frameworks, tools, and platforms across product and engineering teams. Ensure timely resolution and prevention of high-severity outages through organizational postmortems, root cause analysis, and systemic improvements.

Strategic Planning & Execution

Develop, communicate, and execute the quality engineering strategy across multiple product groups, balancing innovation, risk, and operational needs. Oversee resource planning, hiring, and organizational design to ensure scaling and allocation of quality engineering talent to meet evolving business needs. Take ultimate responsibility for quality governance, compliance, and traceability across all product lines within your scope.

Cross-Functional & Executive Partnership

Build and maintain strong working relationships with senior leadership in engineering, product management, data science, product operations, and business teams. Articulate quality risks, trade-offs, and long-term strategies to executive stakeholders; provide regular reporting on quality metrics and organizational outcomes. Lead cross-functional initiatives to ensure test automation and quality engineering are embedded early and effectively throughout the development lifecycle.

Required Education, Experience/Skills/Training

  • 10+ years of experience in software quality engineering, test automation, or software development, with 5+ years managing managers or leading multi-team organizations.
  • Proven track record of scaling and transforming quality engineering functions in complex, cloud-native, high-scale environments.
  • Demonstrated experience defining and driving organizational strategy, advocating for quality at the senior/executive level, and influencing business outcomes.
  • Expertise in modern test automation frameworks, CI/CD, and emerging trends in software quality.
  • Knowledge of software engineering practices and agile approaches.
  • Strong desire for establishing and improving product quality.
  • Experience conducting security and performance tests for identity and access management systems and platforms.
  • Hands on experience testing (manual and automated) identity and access management systems and platforms.
  • Advanced proficiency with Python or modern OO languages; experience with ad-tech or large-scale systems is a plus.
  • Willingness to take challenges head on while being part of a team.
  • Strong communication, stakeholder management, and mentoring skills.
  • B.S. in Computer Science (or equivalent degree or work experience)

The hiring range for this position in California is $171,600 - $230,100 per year and in New York is $179,700 - $241,000 per year. The base pay actually offered will take into account internal equity and also may vary depending on the candidate's geographic region, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience among other factors. A bonus and/or long-term incentive units may be provided as part of the compensation package, in addition to the full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits, dependent on the level and position offered.

title: Senior Data Engineer (IICS & Redshift) (Independent Contractor)
description:
CompassX is a boutique business and technology consulting firm. We help Fortune 500 and high-growth clients deliver their most strategic initiatives, from enterprise transformations to digital and data-driven projects. With over 15 years of proven results, we’ve expanded across industries including financial services, pharmaceuticals, aerospace, consumer products, and quick service restaurants.

We are honored to be recognized as a three-time winner of Consulting Magazine’s Best Boutique Firms to Work For, and previously recognized as a “Best Place to Work” in Southern California and one of INC.’s 5000 fastest-growing private companies in the U.S.

This is a short-term, project-based engagement best suited to an experienced 1099 independent contractor who's comfortable moving fast in an ambiguous, fast-paced environment.

You'll be working within the client's data integration and warehousing stack, helping build and maintain pipelines that move and shape data for downstream reporting. You'll work closely with client-side stakeholders as well as the CompassX team, so clear communication and the ability to translate technical work into business context matters as much as the engineering itself. You'll collaborate closely with a small group of engineers and analysts, so the ability to work autonomously while staying tightly aligned with the team is essential.

What You'll Do

  • Design, build, and maintain ETL/ELT pipelines using IICS to integrate data from source systems into the warehouse
  • Develop and optimize data models and structures within Amazon Redshift
  • Write production-quality SQL and Python to transform, validate, and automate data workflows
  • Build and support Power BI data models that feed reporting and dashboards for business stakeholders
  • Implement data quality checks and validation logic to ensure accuracy and traceability across pipelines
  • Document data flows, models, and pipeline logic to support handoff and long-term maintainability
  • Work closely with client-side stakeholders as well as the CompassX team, translating technical work into business context
  • Collaborate with a small group of engineers and analysts, working autonomously while staying tightly aligned with the team

What You'll Bring

  • Hands-on experience with IICS (Informatica Intelligent Cloud Services) for data integration
  • Experience working with Amazon Redshift as a data warehouse platform
  • Strong SQL skills and solid grounding in ETL/ELT pipeline design
  • Proficiency in Python for data engineering workflows
  • Experience building Power BI data models, ideally including a strong grasp of data modeling best practices for reporting layers
  • Comfort working with cloud-based data infrastructure (AWS preferred, given the Redshift environment)
  • An eye for data quality and validation — this is a pharma environment, so accuracy and traceability matter
  • Strong communication skills, with experience collaborating directly with client stakeholders
  • Bonus: familiarity with Veeva, particularly in a pharma or life sciences context
Our consultants say CompassX is a place where they can truly find their own path. As part of a smaller firm, they see the impact of their work, have an identity, and know their voice matters. They value the freedom to take the reins of their careers, shape their client work, and maintain a direct line to leadership.

With CompassX’s focus on serving local Southern California clients, consultants not only build lasting relationships but also see the results of their work in the communities where they live.

At CompassX, you won’t just follow a path - you’ll create one.

title: Asset Management Lead
description:
Responsibilities

Peraton is seeking an Asset Management Lead to join our team of qualified and diverse individuals on our Department of State (DOS) Bureau of Diplomatic Technology (DT) Consular Affairs Enterprise Infrastructure Operations (CAEIO) Program. CAEIO provides IT Operations and Maintenance to modernize legacy networks, applications, and databases supporting consular applications services globally.

The Asset Management Lead will be a member of the Asset & Acquisition Team, responsible for managing the procurement process for all acquisitions obtained by the contractor or the Government. This role manages and tracks accurate assets inventories, supports hardware and software reviews, and ensures accurate inventory records. The manager also facilitates maintenance renewals, software entitlements, and warranty supports while identifying market trends and resolving procurement challenges to ensure timely acquisition of goods and services.

Core Work Schedule: Monday - Friday, 8:00 AM - 5:00 PM (flexible)

Location: This position is currently remote. The candidate must be local to the DMV. The number of days remote/in office is subject to change based on program or government requirements.

Day to Day Roles and Responsibilities:

  • Support the entire acquisition life cycle, from pre-award planning through solicitation preparation, contract award, contract administration and contract close-out.
  • Support acquisition planning by preparing source selection documents, including evaluation criteria, justifications and approvals, synopses, and requests for proposals/quotes/bids, while also developing and providing detailed cost estimates in support of Independent Government Cost Estimates (IGCEs).
  • Assist government procurement agencies in developing acquisition strategies, work statements, and evaluation plans, and qualifying vendors.
  • Coordinate procurement activities, including financial forecasting, name brand and sole-source justifications, acquisition planning, vendor coordination, and market research.
  • Collaborate with architecture and engineering teams to identify assets needed to support program tasks and projects. Collaboratively create a technical refresh roadmap per applicable refresh cycles.
  • Follow stringent procurement processes based on requirements and Supply Chain Risk Management process to create compliant packages.
  • Leverage a network of over 1,000 vendors and original equipment manufacturer (OEM) partners, product development, and industry analyst resources to identify opportunities for alternate product development.
  • Provide detailed specifications, statements of work, and justification documentation.
  • Route and track the status of procurement packages for Government approval.
  • Review invoices and obtain signed receiving reports from vendors and Government personnel.
  • Provide oversight and maintenance of contract files through contract close out.
  • Facilitate and prepare file information in response to audits.
  • Track orders and confirm system lead times, delivery dates, and costs.
  • Draft and route Receiving Reports for requester and COR validation and signature.

Qualifications

Basic Qualifications:

  • High School diploma/equivalent and 6 years of experience.
  • U.S. citizenship and an active SECRET Government Security Clearance.
  • Demonstrated experience managing/ leading acquisition and asset management staff in a complex, distributed enterprise IT environment.
  • Experience with enterprise IT planning, experience managing inventory and assets, and managing procurements in support of Federal Government clients in a complex, distributed enterprise IT environment.
  • Demonstrated support for lifecycle asset management to include audit response and asset tracking in support of Federal Government clients in a complex, distributed enterprise IT environment.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Demonstrated experience analyzing organizational IT procurements, identifying opportunities to reduce costs through innovative procurement vehicles, reducing service/support levels to procure necessary support to deliver organizational needs, and analyzing inventory to reduce the number of maintenance and support agreements.
  • ITIL Foundation Level Certification (or higher)
  • ServiceNow expertise particularly with the CMBD module. Experience building and maintaining a CMDB in ServiceNow a big plus.

Peraton is a next-generation national security company that drives missions of consequence spanning the globe and extending to the farthest reaches of the galaxy. As the world’s leading mission capability integrator and transformative enterprise IT provider, we deliver trusted, highly differentiated solutions and technologies to protect our nation and allies. Peraton operates at the critical nexus between traditional and nontraditional threats across all domains: land, sea, space, air, and cyberspace. The company serves as a valued partner to essential government agencies and supports every branch of the U.S. armed forces. Each day, our employees do the can’t be done by solving the most daunting challenges facing our customers. Visit peraton.com to learn how we’re keeping people around the world safe and secure.

Target Salary Range

$86,000 - $138,000. This represents the typical salary range for this position. Depending on the position, employees may be eligible for overtime, shift differential, and a discretionary bonus in addition to base pay.

title: Posting Supervisor - Los Angeles, CA
description:

The Posting Supervisor ensures our organization is following any industry and payer billing changes that affect our organization. Major functions include performing day-to-day operations as directed by the Director of Revenue Cycle.
Over one hundred years ago, Planned Parenthood was founded on the idea that everyone should have the information and care they need to live strong, healthy lives and fulfill their dreams. Founded 52+ years ago, Planned Parenthood Los Angeles is one of the largest providers of reproductive health care services in Los Angeles County. The Planned Parenthood Los Angeles (PPLA) team works together to provide high-quality, affordable reproductive health care to women, men, and young people across Los Angeles County. At PPLA, you will discover a culture of like-minded individuals who are eager to make positive contributions to their community and to the Planned Parenthood mission.

  • Minimum five (5) years’ experience as a Medical Biller/Encounter Representative required.

  • Review, troubleshoot, and resolve complex account problems.

title: Shop Welding Instructor
location: Aurora, United States; Denver, United States
description:
Job Description Requirements
Position Purpose
The Welding Trainer will be responsible for developing, training, and supporting welders in both Stainless Steel and Carbon Steel welding processes. This position will work closely with Production, Quality, Engineering, and Operations to ensure welders are properly trained, qualified, and capable of consistently producing quality welds while meeting production requirements.
The individual should be a strong hands-on welder with the ability to effectively teach, coach, troubleshoot, and develop other welders.
Primary Responsibilities
Welding Training & Development
  • Train new and existing welders in Stainless Steel and Carbon Steel welding.
  • Provide hands-on instruction in GTAW/TIG, GMAW/MIG, FCAW, and other applicable welding processes.
  • Evaluate individual welder skill levels and identify training needs.
  • Develop and execute training plans for new, existing, and underperforming welders.
  • Demonstrate proper welding techniques and production methods.
  • Train employees on proper joint preparation, fit-up, welding parameters, travel speed, torch/electrode angle, heat input, and weld sequence.
  • Provide coaching and corrective feedback to improve welder performance.
  • Establish and maintain standardized welding practices.
Welder Qualification
  • Support and/or conduct welder qualification testing as required.
  • Assist with maintaining accurate welder qualification and continuity records.
  • Ensure welders are qualified for the applicable processes, positions, materials, and thicknesses.
  • Train welders to properly follow approved Welding Procedure Specifications (WPS).
  • Identify when additional training, testing, or requalification is required.
Quality & Process Improvement
  • Work closely with Quality to reduce weld defects, rework, repairs, and failed weld tests.
  • Troubleshoot recurring welding problems and identify root causes.
  • Assist with corrective actions related to welding quality.
  • Monitor welding techniques and processes on the production floor.
  • Improve first-pass weld acceptance and overall welding consistency.
  • Partner with Production and Engineering to improve welding processes, equipment, and work methods.
Production Support
  • Provide technical welding support to Foremen, Supervisors, and Production teams.
  • Troubleshoot welding equipment and process issues.
  • Assist Production when welding problems impact schedule or quality.
  • Help identify whether issues are related to welder technique, equipment, materials, fit-up, consumables, or process parameters.
  • Support Production while maintaining established quality and safety standards.
Safety
  • Promote safe welding practices throughout the facility.
  • Train employees on proper PPE, hot-work practices, ventilation, and welding safety.
  • Reinforce safe handling and storage of welding gases and consumables.
  • Identify and correct unsafe welding practices.
Required Skills & Technical Knowledge
The candidate should have strong working knowledge and hands-on experience with:
  • GTAW/TIG welding
  • GMAW/MIG welding
  • FCAW welding
  • Stainless Steel welding
  • Carbon Steel welding
  • Pipe welding preferred
  • Structural/fabrication welding
  • Fillet welds
  • Groove welds
  • Butt joints
  • Weld fit-up
  • Heat input and distortion control
  • Welding consumables
  • Shielding gases
  • Welding equipment setup and troubleshooting
  • Blueprint reading
  • Weld symbols
  • WPS interpretation
  • Basic weld inspection principles
Stainless Steel Knowledge
Strong knowledge of Stainless Steel welding, including:
  • 304/304L
  • 316/316L
  • Stainless contamination prevention
  • Heat control
  • Distortion control
  • Purging/back purging
  • Interpass temperature
  • Proper tungsten selection
  • Shielding gas selection
  • TIG welding techniques
  • Stainless Steel cleaning and finishing requirements
Carbon Steel Knowledge
Knowledge of:
  • Preheat requirements
  • Interpass temperature
  • Heat input
  • Distortion control
  • Consumable selection
  • Hydrogen cracking prevention
  • Fillet and groove weld requirements
  • MIG and Flux-Core welding
Codes & Standards
Experience with the following is preferred:
  • AWS D1.1
  • AWS D1.3
  • ASME B31.3
  • Welding Procedure Specifications (WPS)
  • Procedure Qualification Records (PQR)
  • Welder Qualification Records
  • Welder continuity requirements
The candidate should be capable of explaining applicable welding requirements to production welders and ensuring work is performed according to approved procedures.
Certifications / Qualifications
Required or Preferred
  • AWS Certified Welder experience or equivalent qualification experience
  • Demonstrated proficiency in Stainless Steel TIG welding
  • Demonstrated proficiency in Carbon Steel welding
  • Experience with GMAW/MIG and FCAW
  • Welding school or technical training preferred
  • 5+ years of professional welding experience preferred
  • Previous Lead Welder, Welding Trainer, Welding Instructor, or similar experience preferred
Additional Preferred Certifications
  • AWS Certified Welding Inspector (CWI)
  • AWS Certified Welding Educator (CWE)
  • AWS Certified Welder
  • OSHA safety training
  • Train-the-Trainer certification
  • Lean Six Sigma or Continuous Improvement experience
Note for HR: CWI/CWE should be considered a preferred qualification unless the position will have formal inspection responsibilities.
Training & Leadership Skills
The candidate should demonstrate the ability to:
  • Teach both experienced and inexperienced welders.
  • Explain technical welding concepts in a simple and understandable manner.
  • Demonstrate proper welding techniques.
  • Identify and correct poor welding habits.
  • Provide constructive feedback.
  • Work effectively with different learning styles.
  • Develop training plans.
  • Evaluate employee progress.
  • Document training activities.
  • Communicate effectively with Production, Quality, Engineering, and Operations.
  • Lead by example.
  • Hold employees accountable to established welding standards.
Lean & Continuous Improvement
Experience with Lean Manufacturing and Continuous Improvement is preferred.
The candidate should understand or have experience with:
  • Standard Work
  • 5S
  • 5-Why
  • Root Cause Analysis
  • PDCA
  • Visual Management
  • First-Pass Yield
  • Rework Reduction
  • Waste Reduction
  • Continuous Improvement
The Welding Trainer should actively look for opportunities to improve welding quality, productivity, consistency, and training effectiveness.
Suggested Performance Metrics
The position may be measured using:
  • Welder qualification pass rate
  • First-pass weld acceptance
  • Weld rework percentage
  • Failed weld tests
  • Time required to qualify new welders
  • Training hours completed
  • Reduction in repeat weld defects
  • Welding-related production downtime
  • Welder skill progression
  • Compliance with WPS requirements

    • Enjoy access to accessible and supportive colleagues in other departments, including Surgery, Pathology, and Hematology/Oncology.
    • Serve a humble patient population who are deeply grateful for our healthcare services provided to their community.

About the Area
SCPMG San Bernardino County Service area serves a population in the northeastern section of the LA Basin that’s as diverse topographically as culturally. With relatively easy access to both mountain and beach outdoor activities including hiking, skiing at Big Bear and Mt. Baldy, water-skiing on Lake Arrowhead, mountain biking, apple picking in Yucaipa or a drive to the coast, there is something for everyone. The communities within the area have excellent schools and neighborhood parks and affordable options for home-buying – a great for families. With easy access to all the culture and activities of Los Angeles, without the traffic and hassle, Physicians and staff members enjoy the seasons, with fall colors and prominent views of snow-capped mountains. Our communities offer a variety of dining, entertainment, and cultural options in close proximity to the Medical Centers.

Working Here
Cultivated over a 70-year history — the region’s first Medical Center in Southern California — San Bernardino County (SBC) Service Area’s culture is one of teamwork, respect, integrity, and diversity. Located in the Inland Empire and known to be the “go to” Medical Centers in San Bernardino County. Our area is characterized by its tremendous growth and innovation\: with over 1000 physicians who have trained and previously worked across the country the service area is infused with youthful energy as well as diverse and innovative ideas. San Bernardino County Service Area is the largest area in the Southern California region, with 2 hospitals (in Fontana and Ontario) and over 19 medical office buildings. San Bernardino County Service Area offers a wide range of tertiary and specialty services, as well as numerous academic opportunities. SBC is home to 9 residency and fellowship programs, is a clinical rotation site for the Bernard J Tyson Kaiser Permanente School of Medicine as well as a host for medical students and residents from other nearby institutions. It’s breadth and depth offer physicians a myriad of opportunities for leadership, teaching, academic pursuits, specialization, and social activities. Wellness and life balance are actively promoted; the area’s nurturing, family environment fosters good health—mental and physical—further enabling its team to contribute to the diverse communities we serve within the San Bernardino County.

title: Signals Analyst, Level 1, Intelligence Community Mission Program, Fort Meade, MD
description:
Signals Analyst, Level 1, Intelligence Community Mission Program, Fort Meade, MD

Summary:

  • Job Title: Signals Analyst, Level 1
  • Openings: 1
  • Security Clearance: Active TS/SCI with CI Polygraph or above required.
  • Work Type: Onsite at Fort George G. Meade, MD, in a secure government facility
  • Job Type: Full-time
  • Benefits: Our client provides full benefits.
  • Program Name: SIGINT mission support program covering collection systems engineering, target development, analysis, and reporting
  • Agency name: Intelligence Community (IC) customer, Fort George G. Meade, MD
  • Start Date: Immediate, upon offer acceptance and clearance transfer

BizFirst is assisting our client with recruiting a skilled and experienced Signals Analyst. This position supports the following program: a signals intelligence (SIGINT) mission support program that provides collection systems engineering, target development, analysis, reporting, and mission software development for an Intelligence Community customer. The position is onsite at Fort Meade, MD, and the role is open now for an immediate start.

Our client is a Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Business that has supported U.S. defense and intelligence missions since 2012. Its systems, software, and data science engineers work side by side with government teams to model, design, integrate, and deploy complex mission systems, and the company also builds rugged RF hardware for specialized SIGINT applications. Led by a U.S. Navy veteran with more than 30 years of DoD mission experience, the company supports programs alongside many of the largest national security integrators and has a long-established presence in Maryland near Fort Meade.

What will you do

Develop and apply the techniques and tools that turn signals intelligence (SIGINT) into answers for mission customers. You will collect, evaluate, analyze, document, locate, and present information according to established requirements and priorities, and use SIGINT and collateral report repositories along with your own research to advance target development. You will work with packet and stream protocols and other IP-based technologies, and use the software applications and databases that support SIGINT target development. This role suits an analyst with at least three years of SIGINT experience in the Intelligence Community or the U.S. military who is comfortable on the Linux command line.

Responsibilities:

  • Develop techniques and tools to collect, evaluate, analyze, document, locate, and present information in line with established requirements and priorities.
  • Research SIGINT and collateral report repositories, and bring independent research into target development.
  • Analyze packet and stream protocols and other advanced technologies over IP.
  • Use the software applications and databases that support SIGINT target development.
  • Apply knowledge of data and voice communications technologies and network protocols to analytic problems.
  • Write Bash, shell, or Python scripts to support analysis on Linux systems.

Requirements:

  • Active TS/SCI clearance with CI Polygraph or above.
  • Three (3) years of experience performing as a Signals Analyst supporting the Intelligence Community or U.S. military. Candidates with or without a degree are considered; the experience requirement is the same.
  • Experience developing techniques and tools for collecting, evaluating, analyzing, documenting, locating, and presenting information according to established requirements and priorities.
  • Familiarity with SIGINT and collateral report repositories, and the ability to show how you have used independent research to enhance target development.
  • Experience with packet and stream protocols and other advanced technologies over IP.
  • Experience using software applications and databases associated with SIGINT target development.
  • Proficiency with the Linux/Unix command line and scripting (Bash, shell, and/or Python).
  • Familiarity with data and voice communications technologies and network protocols.
  • Ability to work onsite at Fort Meade, MD.

Desired Skills

  • Experience with Apache NiFi.
  • Military SIGINT background, such as Army 35N or 35S, Navy CTR, or Air Force 1N2.
  • Formal SIGINT analytic training or qualifications.

Benefits (provided by our client):

  • Medical, dental, and vision coverage for the employee and family, 100% employer-paid (HMO HSA Silver plan), plus a Health Savings Account
  • Five weeks (200 hours) of paid leave per year
  • Eleven (11) paid federal holidays per year
  • 401k with an employer contribution equal to 10% of salary
  • Reimbursement for approved training, up to three days (24 hours) per year, including books and related conference or class travel
  • Reimbursement of professional fees, such as IEEE membership and licenses
  • Short-term and long-term disability insurance
  • Term life insurance equal to annual salary, up to $100K
  • Referral matching bonus program

title: Head Coach - Mystère
description:
***Le poste étant situé aux États-Unis, la description de poste est disponible uniquement en anglais.***
***As this position in based in the United States, the job description is available in English only.***
_______________________________________________
Head Coach
Coaching
Life at Cirque is about sharing our passion and about creating wonder with talented colleagues, all the while delivering at the highest quality in a fast-moving environment. Boldness and curiosity are a part of our DNA and hopefully a part of yours too. Together, we work hard, juggle priorities, shift trajectories, have loads of fun and, above all, dare to reinvent ourselves and meet new challenges.
The Head Coach is a professional in the management of Human Performance. As a Head Coach you will report operationally to the show Artistic Director/Artistic Manager, and functionally to the Director of Coaching for Cirque du Soleil Entertainment Group (“CDSEG”). You will ensure the safety of our Artists and manage the risk associated with Human Performance (e.g. skill acquisition and decision making, acrobatic content, use of equipment, movement techniques, longing, spotting…). You will oversee the team of Artist Coaches in the performance of their duties, while overseeing the cast of the show regarding Acro-Artistic performance. You will ensure the quality of daily training, plan performance improvement, and maintain the quality of acrobatic performances in all acts and tableaux. Our Coaches demonstrate the following traits: Humility, Curiosity and an Insatiable Appetite for Learning.
Key Responsibilities
  • The foremost responsibility of the Head Coach at Cirque du Soleil (“CdS”) is to ensure the supervision and safety of the Artists. Our Coaching team plays an essential role in Human Performance Risk Management.
  • Partner with Performance Medicine, forming a Human Performance team to create and implement Injury Risk Reduction strategies while supporting Artists to execute their duties.
  • Follow the Governance & Standards set by the Director of Coaching (see the Coaching Handbook and behave in accordance with our Coaching Code of Conduct).
  • Create and maintain an Artist-centered environment suitable to the learner’s Stage of Skill Acquisition, ensuring appropriate progressions are used in Artist preparation and readiness assessments.
  • Enhance and sustain overall performance by observing and correcting acrobatic execution while using a professional body of knowledge to develop plans of action.
  • Monitor and document an Artist’s progress to make informed decisions and share information with the Artist Management team while collaborating on decisions.
  • Promote the CdS Durability by Design Pillars of: Prepare, Perform and Recover. Oversee Human Performance interventions, such as: warm up, physical conditioning, workload management, recovery, rotations and training schedules.
  • Oversee the content of all training and acrobatic performances.
  • Ensure that information regarding Human Performance is communicated with Artists, Artistic Direction, Stage Management and the Human Performance team.
  • Contribute to the selection of Coaches and Artist Coaches, ensuring their integration as well as their supervision, while providing the necessary personal and professional support.
  • Hold regular meetings with the Coaching team to ensure circulation of information and to create moments for exchange, feedback, problem solving and professional development.
  • Engage in professional development and continued education opportunities.
  • Ensure required documentation and administrative tasks are met, including but not limited to: integration and reintegration plans, risk assessments, performance and action plans, Aurora notes, ATM management, Coaching/Accident/Near Miss Reports. (see the Coaching Handbook).
  • Validate integration and reintegration plans, risk assessments, performance and action plans.
  • Trigger Near Miss Report, validate accident reports and review CAPA with Health and Safety management post SIRF/Near Miss Report.
  • Initiate approval request for act changes and complete checklist for new act integration and major changes.
  • Participate in projects for the improvement and evolution of CdS practices, as requested by the Director of Coaching and Human Performance Design and Management Direction.
  • Deliver the Coaching portion of the Artist evaluations related to their performance.
  • Complete other job-related duties as requested.
Job Requirements
  • Degree in physical activity sciences or a combination of studies and experience offering both a theoretical and practical structure for the study of physical activity, sports, movement and circus arts (e.g. Level 3 certificate from the National Coaches Certification Program of the Canadian Coaches Association).
  • At least 6 years of previous experience in group management (athletes and/or coaches) and training planning (long-term development); knowledge and/or experience in circus arts/disciplines an asset.
  • Fluent in English, both written and spoken; knowledge of another language an asset.
  • Working knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite.
  • Organizational and planning skills.
  • Communication and management skills in a context of diversity.
  • Autonomy.
  • Capacity to establish and maintain close relationships.
  • Ability to deal with uncertainty and ambiguity.
  • Verification of the right to work in the United States for Cirque du Soleil Entertainment Group, as demonstrated by completion of the Form I-9 upon hire and the submission of acceptable documentation (as noted on the Form I-9) verifying one’s identity and work authorization.
When you think of your ideal workplace, what comes to mind? For us, it looks (and really is) like this:
  • Teamwork – we thrive with collaborative teams, regardless of titles or departments;
  • Respect – when we ask someone to join our team, it’s because we trust and respect you;
  • Integrity – whether you work behind-the-scenes or in the office, you’re being counted on. We are a team and integrity goes a long way here, and like we mentioned previously, trust is important;
  • Authenticity – we want you to bring your full self to work, this is a place where you don’t need to fit into a box to belong; diverse perspectives foster even more creativity in the workplace. We embrace the human behind the employee number;
  • Being heard – you have access to everyone in the organization, use your voice on development questions or suggestions on how to improve the experience. We value open and transparent communication, and we want you to be heard!
Cirque du Soleil Entertainment Group is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate against applicants or employees because of their race, creed, color, age, religion, sex, disability, sexual orientation, marital status, military status, national origin or ancestry.

ABOUT BREAKTHROUGH SUMMERBRIDGE

Founded in 1978 at San Francisco University High School, Breakthrough Summerbridge (BTSB) is an intensive year round academic enrichment and advocacy program. Through our middle school programming, we prepare ambitious students from under-resourced circumstances to enter and thrive in well-matched high schools, for the purpose of securing admission to, succeeding in, and graduating from college. title: Data Engineer
description:
Wil jij als Data Engineer met jouw werk miljoenen mensen helpen slimme keuzes te maken? Bij Bencom Group bouw je aan een toekomstbestendige datainfrastructuur die écht impact heeft. Kom werken in een ambitieus team dat innovatie en consumentgerichte oplossingen centraal stelt.

Wat ga je doen?

Als Data Engineer werk je samen met collega’s aan een betrouwbare, veilige en schaalbare datainfrastructuur op Azure. Je bent medeverantwoordelijk voor het ontwerp, de bouw en het onderhoud van onze datapijplijnen – van bron tot visualisatie.

  • Je ontwikkelt en beheert ETL-processen met PySpark in Azure Synapse Notebooks
  • Je integreert interne en externe databronnen in Azure Data Lake
  • Je monitort, test en optimaliseert pipelines en waarborgt databeveiliging
  • Je werkt nauw samen met collega’s van Data Science en Development
  • Je onderzoekt en implementeert nieuwe technologieën waar ze meerwaarde bieden

Een typische werkdag? Die start met een stand-up met je collega’s Olle, Tom, Nadim en Ronny. Daarna kijk je of alle pipelines goed zijn gelopen en begin je met de bouw of optimalisatie van een nieuwe data-oplossing. Je werkt zelfstandig, maar nooit alleen – en je ideeën worden serieus genomen.

Wat breng je mee?

We zoeken iemand die zijn of haar sporen al heeft verdiend in de datawereld. Je hoeft geen tien jaar ervaring te hebben, maar je moet wel weten wat je doet.

  • Je hebt een HBO- of WO-opleiding afgerond (bijv. informatica, data science)
  • Je hebt ervaring met ETL/ELT, SQL, Python, en datamodellering.
  • Je hebt kennis van Azure, Synapse, en bij voorkeur ook PySpark (of je leert dit snel)
  • Je werkt gestructureerd en vindt het belangrijk dat dingen gewoon kloppen
  • Je denkt mee over hoe iets slimmer of beter kan
  • Je woont in Noord-Nederland en bent 32 tot 40 uur per week beschikbaar

Over de Bencom Group

Binnen Bencom Group maken we keuzes eenvoudiger. Via onze vergelijkingssites en app, met jaarlijks miljoenen gebruikers, bieden we onafhankelijke en heldere informatie over complexe markten. Zo helpen we mensen met vertrouwen de juiste keuze te maken.

Met ruim 70 collega’s in Groningen en Amersfoort blijven we werken aan innovatieve oplossingen en slimme technologieën om onze dienstverlening te verbeteren. Zo lopen we voorop in een snel veranderende markt en bieden we altijd betrouwbare, actuele informatie.

Wat mag je van ons verwachten?

We zijn een nuchter bedrijf met een sterke datacultuur. Geen eindeloze meetings of interne politiek, maar gewoon samenwerken aan slimme oplossingen die werken.

  • Een rol met veel technische diepgang, afwisseling en ruimte voor initiatief
  • De mogelijkheid om jezelf verder te ontwikkelen via trainingen of cursussen;
  • Een marktconform salaris, 25 vakantiedagen (op basis van een 40-urige werkweek), een bonusregeling, pensioenbijdrage en reiskostenvergoeding (vanaf 10 km);
  • Hardware die aansluit op jouw wensen, zodat je effectief kunt werken
  • Regelmatig leuke borrels en teamuitjes.

Is je interesse gewekt?

Acquisitie naar aanleiding van deze vacature wordt niet op prijs gesteld.

title: GovTech Data Engineer
description:
We are seeking a Data Engineer to join the Asset Intelligence Platform (AIP) team. The

successful candidate will be responsible for transforming raw ingested cyber asset data

into structured, query-able models and building the dashboards and visualizations that

enable government agencies to understand their attack surface, prioritize vulnerabilities,

and respond to incidents.

This role is critical to achieving AIP's mission of reducing the government's attack surface

by turning data connectivity into actionable intelligence.

The Asset Intelligence Platform is a collaboration between the Cybersecurity Group (CSG),

Government IT Security Incident Response (GITSIR), and Government Productivity

Engineering (GPE). The platform addresses critical gaps in the government's federated IT

environment specifically the information collection gap and vulnerability scanner gap

to enable effective threat prioritization and remediation tracking.

The Data Engineer operates at the intersection of platform infrastructure and agency value

receiving ingested data from the Platform Infrastructure Engineer and shaping it into

insights that the Business Analyst delivers to agencies. This role owns the data layer

between raw ingestion and decision-ready output.

Key Responsibilities

Data Modelling and Transformation

Design and maintain data models that unify cyber asset information from diverse

sources (WOG central systems, agency-specific data sources, vulnerability

scanners, CMDBs)

Build and maintain transformation pipelines that clean, normalise, enrich, and

relate ingested data into a coherent asset inventory

Establish and enforce data quality standards deduplication, completeness

checks, schema validation, and lineage tracking

Evolve the data model as new data sources are onboarded, ensuring backward

compatibility and minimal disruption to existing dashboards

Dashboard and Visualisation Development

Build dashboards that address agency-specific use cases including asset visibility,

vulnerability prioritisation, patch tracking, and incident response readiness

Collaborate with the Business Analyst to develop compelling data narratives

selecting the right metrics, views, and drill-downs that connect data to agency

decision-making

Iterate on dashboard designs based on agency feedback, balancing clarity with

analytical depth

Maintain and update existing dashboards as underlying data models or agency

requirements evolve

Platform Data Operations

Validate successful data ingestion in coordination with the Platform Infrastructure

Engineer confirming completeness, freshness, and schema conformance

Monitor data pipeline health, investigate anomalies, and resolve data quality issues

Optimise query performance and data refresh schedules to ensure dashboards

remain responsive and current

Document data models, transformation logic, and dashboard specifications for

operational continuity

Insights and Collaboration

Partner with the Business Analyst to identify patterns and insights within ingested

data that support agency engagement

Provide technical input on feasibility and effort when new agency use cases are

proposed

Contribute to defining what 'good' looks like for asset visibility coverage metrics,

quality scores, and completeness indicators

Requirements

Essential

Minimum 3 years of experience in data engineering, analytics engineering, or

business intelligence development

Strong proficiency in SQL and experience with data transformation frameworks

(e.g., dbt, Apache Spark, or equivalent)

Hands-on experience building dashboards and visualizations with BI tools (e.g.,

Power BI, Tableau, Grafana, Superset, or platform-native tooling)

Experience designing data models for operational or analytical use cases star

schemas, entity resolution, or graph-based asset relationships

Ability to work with messy, heterogeneous data from multiple sources and produce

clean, reliable outputs

Understanding of data quality practices including validation, deduplication, lineage,

and monitoring

Desirable

Experience with cyber asset data CMDBs, vulnerability scanners (Qualys,

Tenable, Rapid7), endpoint management platforms, or network discovery tools

Familiarity with attack surface management concepts including asset ownership,

exposure scoring, and vulnerability lifecycle

Experience with the Singapore government IT landscape, GCC (Government

Commercial Cloud), and WOG shared services

Familiarity with data pipeline orchestration tools (e.g., Airflow, Dagster, Prefect)

Experience with Python for data manipulation and automation

Prior experience in cross-functional teams working alongside infrastructure

engineers and business analysts

Competencies

Analytical Rigor: Ability to make sense of complex, heterogeneous data and

produce models that are both correct and useful

Outcome Orientation: Focuses on delivering insights that drive agency action, not

just technically correct outputs

Collaboration: Effective at working across disciplines partnering with Business

Analysts on storytelling and Platform Infrastructure Engineers on data ingestion

Adaptability: Comfortable working with imperfect data from diverse agency

environments and iterating toward progressively better coverage and quality

Communication: Able to explain data models, quality trade-offs, and dashboard

logic to non-technical stakeholders

title: Lead Packing - 2nd shift
description:
The Packaging & Logistics Lead is responsible for overseeing daily packaging operations and coordinating all internal shipping and receiving activities to support efficient material flow throughout the facility. This role ensures products are packaged accurately, safely, and in accordance with company quality standards. The position also manages the loading and unloading of trucks, verifies incoming and outgoing materials, and maintains accurate documentation and inventory records. Working closely with Production, Warehouse, and Quality teams, the Packaging & Logistics Lead helps support on-time order fulfillment, minimize delays, and maintain an organized, safe working environment. This role serves as the primary on-floor leader for packaging processes and shipping/receiving tasks.


Packaging Operations

  • Lead day-to-day packaging activities to ensure products are packaged according to specifications and quality standards.
  • Set up, operate, and troubleshoot packaging equipment as needed.
  • Ensure correct labels, materials, and packaging supplies are used for each product.
  • Monitor packaging throughput and coordinate with Production to maintain workflow efficiency.
  • Train and guide packaging team members on safe and effective work practices.
  • Verify quality of packaged goods and escalate issues to Quality or Production.
  • Maintain cleanliness and organization in the packaging area following 5S standards.
  • Register production and quality data accurately in the ERP system.

Shipping & Receiving

  • Coordinate the loading and unloading of inbound and outbound trucks.
  • Verify incoming shipments for accuracy, damage, and proper documentation.
  • Prepare outbound shipments, ensuring materials are staged, wrapped, labeled, and documented correctly.
  • Move materials safely using forklifts, pallet jacks, or other warehouse equipment.
  • Update logs, system entries, and paperwork for all shipping and receiving transactions.
  • Stage materials for production and ensure they are delivered to the correct locations.

Inventory & Documentation

  • Maintain accurate counts of packaging materials and report shortages to the supervisor/manager.
  • Perform routine cycle counts or assist with inventory audits.
  • Ensure all packaging, shipping, and receiving documentation is completed accurately and on time.
  • Support traceability requirements by properly labeling and tracking materials.

Safety & Compliance

  • Enforce all safety policies, PPE requirements, and safe material-handling procedures.
  • Conduct or support safety checks on equipment, tools, and work areas.
  • Immediately report unsafe conditions, near misses, and incidents.
  • Ensure packaging and logistics activities comply with company procedures and quality standards.

Team & Workflow Support

  • Act as the on-floor lead for packaging and logistics activities, helping coordinate priorities and tasks.
  • Assist with training new team members in packaging and shipping/receiving processes.
  • Communicate production needs, material shortages, or delays to appropriate internal teams.
  • Support continuous improvement initiatives in packaging, material flow, and workplace organization.

Qualifications:

  • Technical diploma or equivalent experience in manufacturing or industrial operations.
  • Proven experience in a production environment, preferably with profiling and packaging machinery.
  • Strong mechanical and troubleshooting skills.
  • Experience with ERP systems and forklift operation (license preferred).
  • Excellent leadership, communication, and organizational skills.
  • Commitment to safety, quality, and continuous improvement.

This job description in no way states or implies that these are the only duties to be performed by this employee. He or she will be required to follow any other instructions and to perform any other duties requested by his or her supervisor.

title: Azure data-engineer
description:
Als Azure data-engineer (devops engineer)bij de AFM ben je verantwoordelijk voor het ontsluiten, structureren en prepareren van data voor uiteenlopende domeinen. In onze Azure cloudomgeving bevindt de data zich verspreid over Databricks, SQL-databases en Azure Storage (flat files/blobs). Je richt deze omgevingen in zodat zowel interne als externe gebruikers – waaronder toezichthouders – direct aan de slag kunnen met kwalitatief hoogwaardige data.

Naast je technische rol fungeer je als een consultant op het gebied van datakwaliteit en security. Aangezien de AFM ook privacygevoelige data ontvangt, houd je rekening met de security-aspecten die daarbij komen kijken. Je draagt daarnaast bij aan de optimalisatie van de data-operaties door automatisering en het toepassen van een DevOps- en DataOps mindset.

Je wordt onderdeel van de afdeling Datagedreven Toezicht. Deze afdeling heeft decentrale Business-DevOps-teams en een platformteam met datamanagementspecialisten, data-engineers, data-infrastructuurspecialisten.

Een greep uit je werkzaamheden:

  • Data voorbereiden en structureren: Je ontwerpt en implementeert oplossingen voor het integreren en structureren van data in diverse opslagvormen, waaronder Databricks, SQL en Azure Storage.
  • Automatiseren en innoveren: Je ontwikkelt en beheert CI/CD pipelines (met Azure DevOps), zodat veranderingen op een geautomatiseerde en soepele wijze worden uitgerold.
  • Technisch advies en kwaliteitsbewaking: Je fungeert als technisch consultant en draagt bij aan de verbetering van datakwaliteit en security binnen de organisatie.
  • Samenwerking en kennisdeling: Je werkt nauw samen met collega’s binnen het platformteam en deelt actief je kennis en best practices over data-engineering en DevOps.

Dit vragen we:

  • Opleiding & ervaring: HBO/WO werk- en denkniveau, minimaal 3 jaar ervaring met dataverwerking in MS Azure Cloud.
  • Technische vaardigheden: Ervaring met CI/CD (Azure DevOps pipelines), Git, Visual Studio (Code), SQL-programmering, bij voorkeur ook Python en Powershell.
  • Data & cloud expertise: Kennis van T‑SQL, Azure Data Factory of Databricks, en basiskennis van identity en access management (Entra ID).
  • Database modellering: Inzicht in modellering, normalisering (1/2/3NF) en modeleerprincipes zoals Inmon en Kimball.
  • Werkwijze & mindset: Ervaring met Scrum, DevOps-mentaliteit gericht op automatisering, iteratie en eigenaarschap.
  • Persoonlijke eigenschappen: Initiatiefrijk, resultaatgericht, zelfstandig werkend en een teamplayer.
  • Certificeringen & ambitie: Kennis van of certificeringen zoals dp-300 en az-400 zijn een pré; ambitie om processen te verbeteren en kennis te delen.

Wat we bieden:

  • Je start met een jaarcontract met uitzicht op een vast dienstverband
  • Inschaling in schaal G, afhankelijk van kennis en ervaring ontvang je een bruto jaarsalaris tussen € 65.000 en € 105.000 (36 uur, incl. 13e maand en vakantiegeld)
  • 36-urige werkweek, werkdagen in overleg (bijv. 4x9)
  • 199,5 vakantie-uren per jaar (bovenop je standaard roostervrije dag)
  • Een laptop en een smartphone
  • Uitgebreide trainings- en opleidingsmogelijkheden
  • Volledige vergoeding van OV-reiskosten (2e klas)
  • Thuiswerkvergoeding voor thuiswerkdagen
  • Bijdrage aan een sportschoolabonnement
  • Aantrekkelijke secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden zoals een fiets- en deviceregeling en vergoeding voor je thuiswerkplek

Meer informatie?

Voor vragen over de vacature neem je contact op met Linda Brandenburg via linda.brandenburg@afm.nl of 06-11799680.

title: Klantendienstmedewerker Alarmcentrale VAB
description:
• Wil je elke dag mensen éch uit de nood helpen?
  • Wil jij deel uitmaken van het succesverhaal van VAB?
  • Ben je gepassioneerd door het ondersteunen van klanten en vind je voldoening in het bieden van hulp en oplossingen?
  • Zoek je naar een dynamische werkomgeving waarin geen enkele dag hetzelfde is?

Dan ben jij de bijstandverlener die we zoeken! Bij VAB stellen we de tevredenheid van onze klanten voorop en jouw bijdrage hieraan is van onschatbare waarde!

Hoe ziet je dag eruit als bijstandverlener? Stel je voor: het is ochtendspits en plotseling staat een gestrande auto midden op de weg, of een bestuurder is vastgelopen met een lekke band na een ontmoeting met een naald. Misschien begint iemand zijn dag met een lege batterij. Maar geen zorgen, want jij bent de held die hen telefonisch bijstaat in hun tijd van nood.

Als bijstandverlener ben jij de essentiële schakel die de situatie snel en efficiënt afhandelt. Je biedt niet alleen praktische assistentie, maar ook een professionele en geruststellende aanwezigheid. Je documenteert nauwkeurig alle details en coördineert de benodigde hulp om de situatie naar tevredenheid van de klant op te lossen. Kortom, jij bent de betrouwbare en professionele partner die ervoor zorgt dat mensen zich tijdens hun pechmoment op de weg ondersteund en ontzorgd voelen.

Herken jij jezelf in onderstaande eigenschappen? Dan ben jij dé geschikte kandidaat voor VAB!

  • Je zoekt een voltijdse baan en je bent flexibel tussen maandag en zondag tussen 7:30u en 23:00u.
  • Naast de Nederlandse taal spreek je ook vlot Frans en Engels.
  • Je hebt relevante werkervaring waar klantencontact en/of bijstandverlening centraal stond.
  • Je kan jezelf vlot verplaatsen naar Zwijndrecht, ook in de vroege en late uren.
  • Het oplossen van complexe vraagstukken zie je als een uitdaging waar je altijd een passende oplossing voor kan vinden.
  • Je beschikt over voldoende PC kennis om vlot nieuwe programma's aan te leren.
  • Klantvriendelijkheid, empathie en een positieve instelling zijn bij jou top of mind!

title: LVN - Floor Leader

The Licensed Vocational Nurse (LVN) functions under the direct supervision of our medical assistants on staff. The LVN provides nursing care to clients, within the LVN scope of practices – as delegated by treatment team.

2. Provides Nursing Care to all patients of all ages


3. Identifies self as nurse responsible patient care to patients, family and physicians


4. Provides nursing care for all patients within scope of LVN practice


5. Gathers data relevant to the patient’s individual needs and age group


a. Elicits important information concerning the patient’s progress


b. Gathers data regarding patient needs while providing direct patient care


1) Documents nursing observations according to hospital charting standards


2) For the benefit of the patient, the nurse and the physician to visit the patient together


3) Administers medications and treatments per hospital policy


c. Reports symptoms, reactions and progress of patient to the clinical supervisor and/or charge nurse and appropriate action has been taken
