5. Must have good interpersonal skills

7. Must demonstrate initiative and good judgment

9. Must be able to set and revise priorities based on changes in the situation


10. Furthers his/her education by attending in-service classes, staff meetings, continuing education classes and reading of current professional material

title: UNAVAILABLE
description:
Overview

As a patient-focused organization, University of Utah Health exists to enhance the health and well-being of people through patient care, research and education. Success in this mission requires a culture of collaboration, excellence, leadership, and respect. University of Utah Health seeks staff that are committed to the values of compassion, collaboration, innovation, responsibility, integrity, quality and trust that are integral to our mission. EO/AA

This position provides assistive care to patients. The incumbent facilitates the efficient delivery of patient care, supports the professional role of the licensed staff, and provides support and assistance as directed by licensed staff in rendering basic healthcare to the patient. This position also assists with clerical functions as a multi-skilled auxiliary worker. This position provides direct patient care and may be required to access and administer medications within their scope of practice and according to state law.

Corporate Overview: The University of Utah is a Level 1 Trauma Center and is nationally ranked and recognized for our academic research, quality standards and overall patient experience. Our five hospitals and eleven clinics provide excellence in our comprehensive services, medical advancement, and overall patient outcomes.

Responsibilities

Essential Functions

  • Prepares patients for examinations and diagnostic procedures according to clinic procedures such as recording temperatures, pulse rate, blood pressure and responses to standardized medical history questions.
  • Reports all observed patient concerns and changes in condition to a licensed staff member.
  • Performs Clinical Laboratory Improvement Amendments (CLIA) Waved Lab tests as identified by department and reports results to the appropriate personnel.
  • Performs additional skills such as suture removal, straight catheterization and injections (IM, Subq and intra-dermal).
  • Acts as a chaperone for health care providers during patient examination as requested and assists with procedures.
  • Monitors and cleans assigned patient examination rooms, unit areas and unit equipment reporting outdated supplies, stock levels and restock set levels of items and necessary equipment repairs.
  • Answers telephones, forwards telephone messages and under the direction of licensed staff schedules appointments, procedures and diagnostic tests.
  • Assists in routine clerical functions such as filing of medical information in patient's records, locating and compiling department charts, obtaining medical records from other providers and entering charges for billing purposes.
  • Attends and completes mandatory education including infection prevention and control, safety, CPR, equipment usage and procedures according to hospital and department policies.
  • May perform patient phlebotomies in accordance with clinic procedures and physician orders after specialized training.
  • May apply leads and monitors for diagnostic procedures such as EKG and ultrasound scan under the direct supervision of licensed personnel.
  • May assist inpatient and family education by providing educational material and general health information to patients and family members.
  • May assist with transportation of patients to ancillary departments or inpatient units as directed by licensed staff.
  • May instruct in Basic Life Support (BLS) requirements.
  • May perform IV access.
  • May perform other duties based on department assigned.
  • At the discretion of department operational and patient care needs, this position is required to work rotating schedules, which may include variable hours, weekends, nights, and holidays to meet the staffing and patient care demands of a 24/7 complex health system. Regular, reliable, and punctual attendance during assigned shifts is considered an essential function of the role.

Knowledge / Skills / Abilities

  • Demonstrated availability to work variable and rotating shifts, including nights, weekends, and holidays, in a 24/7 patient care environment.
  • Ability to perform the essential functions of the job as outlined above.
  • Demonstrated phlebotomy skills.
  • Demonstrated human relation and effective communication skills.
  • Demonstrated proficiency in the specific clinic's specialty skills within six weeks of hire. *Specialty skills may not be performed until after the new hire completed basic competency testing.*
  • Ability to withstand the physical demand of being on your feet for long periods of time, of moving and lifting patients and of reaching for and handling equipment.

Qualifications

Licenses Required

  • Current RQI Healthcare Provider eCredential through the University of Utah Health RQI system. The eCredential is to be obtained within 30 days of hire.
  • One of the following
    • Current Advanced EMT certification with the State of Utah.
    • Current certification as a Certified Medical Assistant (CMA) through AAMA
    • Current certification to practice as a Paramedic in the State of Utah.
    • Currently credentialed in ABR-OE (Assessment-Based Recognition in Order Entry) through AAMA.
    • Current certification as a Registered Medical Assistant (RMA) through AMT
    • Current certification as a National Certified Medical Assistant (NCMA) through NCCT.
    • Current Clinical Medical Assistant Certification through NHA.
    • Current certification as a NRCMA - Medical Assistant through the National Association for Health Professionals.
* Additional license requirements as determined by the hiring department.

Qualifications (Preferred)

Working Conditions and Physical Demands

Employee must be able to meet the following requirements with or without an accommodation.

  • This position involves intermediate working conditions in a healthcare setting that may exert up to 50 pounds and may consistently require lifting, carrying, pushing, pulling, or otherwise moving patients or objects, such as medical equipment, while providing patient care. Workers in this position may be exposed to infectious diseases and may be required to function around prisoners or behavioral health patients. Incumbents face exposure to potentially dangerous contaminated bodily fluids, blood, used needles and other contaminants as part of the daily hazards of the job.

Physical Requirements

Non Indicated

description:
Montlawn Memorial Park & Funeral Home - Raleigh, NC

title: Senior Android Apps Engineer – ArcTAK Lead
description:
Who We Are

At Firestorm, we are building the future of expeditionary defense manufacturing and autonomous systems. Modern conflict has exposed a fundamental problem: the systems needed most by operators are often too expensive, too slow to produce, and too difficult to sustain at scale. Firestorm exists to change that.
We develop mission-adaptable aerial systems and deployable manufacturing infrastructure designed to put capability directly into the hands of the warfighter. From modular unmanned aircraft to xCell — our deployable microfactory — our goal is to make defense systems rapidly deployable, adaptable, and producible at the point of need.
We are looking for builders, operators, and problem-solvers who want to work on meaningful technology with real-world impact.

About the Role

Firestorm builds modular autonomous aircraft designed to adapt across missions, payloads, and deployment environments.
We are seeking an Android Applications Engineer, Tactical Assault Kit (TAK) to join our team at our San Diego office. In this role, you will design and develop solutions across the TAK ecosystem to support real-time communication, situational awareness, and mission execution for defense and tactical operations. You will rapidly grow into the lead developer on a small team, taking on ownership of this product at that time. Working alongside other senior engineers and cross-functional teammates, you'll apply your strong skills to build, test, and deploy capabilities that directly serve frontline operators.
You would be a good candidate for this position if you fit the following description: You have extensive experience in Android and Java engineering. You possess leadership skills and are eager to mentor other engineers. You're curious about real-world tactical challenges and are motivated to build solutions which work in demanding environments. You thrive on collaboration, working with developers, quality assurance, operators, and product managers to deliver impactful results. You welcome rapidly evolving technologies and are comfortable iterating quickly to stay ahead of shifting requirements. You hold yourself to high standards in coding, testing, and documentation. You're always looking to improve.

What You’ll Do

  • Design and implement ATAK plugins, features, and integrations in Java.
  • Lead the full development lifecycle of ATAK-based application solutions.
  • Work closely with a manager to plan release goals, timelines, and cycles.
  • Assist with sprint planning for junior developers.
  • Review code from junior developers and assist in their skills development.
  • Author build instructions, testing instructions, release notes and other technical documents.
  • Contribute to and navigate official TAK repositories, maintaining alignment with community standards and coordinating with external stakeholders.
  • Engage with TAK community initiatives to stay current on feature updates and best practices.
  • Create UI assets and ensure interface designs are optimized for ease of use in austere and high-intensity environments.
  • Apply knowledge of industry-standard protocols (i.e. MAVLink, Link 16, OMNI) to develop secure solutions for cross-platform interoperability.
  • Support the evaluation and integration of UAS systems into TAK workflows.
  • Participate in client-facing engagements with government, military, and commercial stakeholders, including gathering feedback and delivering product demonstrations.
  • Implement and maintain best practices for secure data handling, network configurations, and user access controls.
  • Work closely with cross-functional teams (software, hardware, operations) to align TAK capabilities with broader organizational objectives.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's or advanced degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
  • 8+ years of software development experience with a strong focus on Java.
  • 5+ years of experience developing for Android, including familiarity with Android Studio IDE, Android SDK, Gradle build system, and Jetpack libraries.
  • Ability to seamlessly integrate C++ code into Android applications using the Android NDK and JNI.
  • Experience implementing encryption, authentication, and secure communication methodologies in restricted environments.
  • Background in secure DevOps practices, including test automation and CI/CD pipelines.
  • High proficiency in Android architecture fundamentals, including the Activity lifecycle, Services, Broadcast Receivers, and Content Providers.
  • Customer-facing communication skills, with the ability to translate technical concepts for non-technical audiences.
  • U.S. citizenship is required, alongside the ability to obtain U.S. Government security clearance.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Deep knowledge of the TAK ecosystem (ATAK, TAK Server, etc.), including plugin development and system integration.
  • Full understanding of the Cursor-On-Target message formats and its different sub-schemas.
  • Demonstrated success building and maintaining ATAK/TAK solutions, including plugin creation and lifecycle management.
  • Hands-on familiarity with the TAK Product Center, including code contributions, community collaboration, and plugin lifecycle management.
  • Background in defense or tactical UX, with an understanding of operator constraints, workflows, and operational requirements.
  • Experience with real-time video streaming systems (RTSP, SRT) connected to TAK platforms.
  • Knowledge of unmanned aerial systems, including flight dynamics, sensor feeds, and communication protocols.

Work Environment

  • This role is based in San Diego, CA.
  • We welcome candidates who are local or open to relocating; relocation assistance is available and may be included in the offer package where appropriate.

Compensation

US Salary Range: $145,000 – $165,000 USD
The posted salary range reflects an estimate based on a variety of compensation factors, including but not limited to relevant experience, education, certifications, specialized skills, geographic location, and business needs. Actual compensation may vary, and this range is subject to change as our compensation structure or market conditions evolve.

Benefits & Perks

Our culture fosters collaboration, respect, and trust, empowering passionate people to do their best work. We offer a competitive salary, comprehensive benefits, and opportunities for career growth. In addition to an opportunity to take part in an innovative, collaborative and fast-growing business with a highly motivated and skilled team, we also take pride in taking care of our employees. Here are just a few ways that we show our appreciation:
  • We offer comprehensive medical, dental, and visions plans
  • 401(k) Retirement Savings Plan to invest in your long-term retirement goals
  • Equity grants for new hires
  • Unlimited PTO
  • Extremely generous company holiday calendar, including a holiday hiatus in July & December.
  • Generous Parental Leave
  • Lifestyle Spending Account
  • FSA
  • DCFSA
  • HSA
  • Hospital Indemnity insurance
  • Critical Illness insurance
  • Accident insurance
  • Basic Life/AD&D, short-term and long-term disability insurance, 100% covered by Firestorm. Plus, the option to purchase additional life insurance for you and your family.
  • Mental Health Resources: We provide free mental health resources 24/7 including therapy and more. Additional work-life services, such as free legal and financial support, are available to you as well.

Export Control Compliance

To conform to U.S. government export control regulations, including the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) and Export Administration Regulations (EAR), you must be a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident of the U.S., protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3), or otherwise eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State or U.S. Department of Commerce.

title: Family Advocate
description:
About YWCA

YWCA of Metropolitan St. Louis (YWCA) has been serving the community for more than 120 years, providing essential, wraparound services that support women and families throughout their time in our programs. Each year, YWCA serves approximately 10,000 women and their families, offering a multitude of services. YWCA is the largest provider of direct Head Start services in Missouri, operating 8 centers and 11 partner sites, and we are proud to hold the National Program of Excellence accreditation from the National Head Start Association.

Why Work With Us?

  • Meaningful Work - Every role at YWCA helps create positive change in the community.
  • Supportive Environment - Join a team that values collaboration and mutual respect.
  • Professional Development - Opportunities for training and career growth.
  • Work-Life Balance - Flexible scheduling and generous paid time off.
  • Competitive Benefits - Health, dental, vision coverage, retirement plans, and wellness programs.
  • Community Impact - Be part of programs that make a real difference for women, children, and families.

Our Signature Programs

  • Early Childhood Education & Childcare – Providing safe, nurturing environments for children to learn and grow.
  • Family Support Services – Helping families access resources and build stability.
  • Health & Wellness Initiatives – Promoting physical and mental well-being through community programs.
  • Advocacy & Outreach – Connecting individuals to opportunities and support systems that improve quality of life.


Submit your application and resume today. Join Us and Make a Difference Every Day!


Purpose

Ensure that the family of each enrolled child is afforded the opportunity to develop and implement an individualized plan of service based on their interest and needs. Operate as a liaison between the center and home setting in all functional areas while promoting family wellness and involvement through a case management process.


Formal Policy-Setting Responsibilities

Responsible for making recommendations that may or may not be acceptable at a higher level regarding the job's purpose, essential responsibilities, and operations.


Routine Decision-Making

Conduct timely follow-up on Family Assessments and Family Partnership Plan/Agreements, identify community resources, make timely referrals to families, monitor family files to ensure the accuracy and integrity of information and assist with application intake and data entry as needed.

Formal Supervisory Responsibility

N/A


Description

  • Ensure, through a case management system, that all families are provided an opportunity to participate in a Family Partnership Plan, complete a Family Assessment and provide timely resources and referrals as a result of identified needs and goals of parents and/or guardians during this process.
  • Implement goals, policies, procedures and activities designed to provide the full range of family support services in compliance with Head Start Performance Standards, including assisting with obtaining health and dental services, and other child/family services identified, as part of ongoing case management. Implement a formal system of follow-up with families on referrals to community agencies, to assure the satisfactory provision of services.
  • Establish, maintain and monitor an efficient record keeping system in line with program policies and procedures, with adequate provisions for confidentiality. Ensure accurate data entry and up to date records of all enrolled families and Child Plus data system by auditing of reports monthly, documenting all contact with families and follow-up on attendance, referrals and resources offered to parents and/or guardians.

Develop linkages between other family support service agencies to provide better service delivery. Help families identify and access needed resources including health, mental health, social services, education, and job training.

To perform this job satisfactorily, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. title: Senior Systems Administrator
description:
Build, secure, automate, and improve a growing Microsoft environment.

American Dental Companies is looking for a Senior Microsoft 365 Systems Administrator to take a hands-on role in the technology supporting our growing network of dental practices.

This is more than a traditional systems administration position. You'll work closely with IT leadership to strengthen our Microsoft environment, lead migrations, improve security and automation, establish scalable standards, and bring greater technical capability in-house.

What You'll Do

• Administer and optimize Microsoft 365, Entra ID, Exchange Online, Intune, Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive, Defender, and Windows environments.
• Lead Microsoft 365, email, office, and multi-location technology migrations.
• Manage endpoint configuration, compliance, Autopilot, Entra Join, and device standards through Intune.
• Strengthen identity and access using MFA, Conditional Access, SSO, RBAC, and least-privilege practices.
• Manage DNS and domain configuration, including SPF, DKIM, and DMARC.
• Build PowerShell and Microsoft Graph automation to reduce manual work and improve consistency.
• Serve as a senior escalation point for complex Microsoft, identity, endpoint, cloud, and systems issues.
• Develop documentation, standards, and repeatable processes that make our environment easier to support and scale.

What We're Looking For

We're looking for someone who combines strong technical depth with ownership and good judgment. You enjoy solving difficult problems, improving how systems work, and automating work that shouldn't be manual.

Qualified candidates will typically bring 5+ years of systems, cloud, or Microsoft 365 administration experience, with meaningful hands-on experience in Microsoft 365, Entra ID, Exchange Online, Intune, PowerShell, identity management, and endpoint administration.

Experience with Microsoft 365 migrations and distributed or multi-location organizations is strongly preferred. Microsoft certifications are welcomed, but real-world technical capability matters more than collecting credentials.

Benefits
American Dental Companies offers a comprehensive benefits package, including:

  • Medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • Paid time off
  • Paid holidays
  • Disability benefits
  • Other company-sponsored benefits

Eligibility and plan terms apply.

Why ADC

American Dental Companies is growing, and our technology environment is evolving with it. This role offers the opportunity to help shape how our systems are built, secured, automated, and scaled across a multi-location organization.

You'll have meaningful ownership, visibility with IT leadership, and the ability to make improvements that have a direct impact across the business.

We're looking for someone who wants to do more than maintain systems, someone who wants to help build a stronger technology environment as the organization grows.

title: Software Developer
description:

The position will apply working knowledge of Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM, Microsoft Power Platform, .NET technologies, application integration, and SQL Server to support system operations and address user and stakeholder requirements. The Journeyman Software Developer will collaborate with technical teams, government stakeholders, and business users to resolve application issues, implement system enhancements, support production environments, and participate in Agile/Scrum development activities.

title: Data Engineer
description:
Standplaats: Alkmaar Centrum| 36 uur | € 4.465 – € 6.343 bruto p/m + 17,05% IKB

Bouw jij mee aan data die écht het verschil maakt?

Jij bouwt graag met data. Maar alleen dashboards vullen? Dat is jou te weinig.
Bij Zaffier gebruik je jouw skills om sociale impact te maken in de regio Alkmaar.
Je bouwt aan datastromen, verbetert de infrastructuur en zorgt dat data helpt bij keuzes voor inwoners. Regels zijn voor jou een richtlijn, impact is het doel. Doe zoals jij doet.

Wat bieden wij jou?

  • Een salaris tussen € 4.465,- en € 6.343,- bruto per maand (schaal 11), afhankelijk van jouw ervaring.
  • Daarbovenop ontvang je een Individueel Keuze Budget (IKB) van 17,05% van je salaris. Hiermee bepaal je zelf wat het beste bij jou past: extra salaris, meer verlofdagen, afbetaling studieschuld, een sportabonnement.
  • De arbeidsovereenkomst betreft in eerste instantie een jaarcontract, met de intentie om dit na deze tijd om te zetten in een vaste aanstelling.
  • Ruimte voor persoonlijke groei en ontwikkeling.
  • Flexibele werktijden en de mogelijkheid om hybride te werken, zodat werk en privé goed in balans blijven.
  • Secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden zoals een pensioenregeling, reiskostenvergoeding en een thuiswerkvergoeding.
  • Wij zorgen ervoor dat jij goed van start gaat, met een laptop en telefoon die je ondersteunen in je werk.
  • Ontwerpen, bouwen en optimaliseren van ETL/ELT-processen en data pipelines (Azure-omgeving)
  • Ontsluiten van data uit applicaties, databases en API’s
  • Ontwikkelen en beheren van datawarehouses en datamodellen (star schema)
  • Ontwikkelen van professionele Power BI rapportages en dashboards (inclusief DAX)
  • Waarborgen van datakwaliteit, governance, security en AVG
  • Adviseren van beleid en management op basis van data-inzichten
  • Doorontwikkelen van onze data-architectuur en BI-omgeving

Waar kom je terecht?

Je werkt in het team Informatie & Automatisering (I&A) in Alkmaar Centrum.
Je bent de brug tussen techniek en beleid. Je werkt samen met data-analisten, informatiemanagers en collega’s uit de organisatie. Samen vertalen jullie databehoeften naar slimme oplossingen. Zo zorg je dat Zaffier nu én in de toekomst datagedreven werkt voor inwoners.

Wat breng je mee?

  • Wij zoeken een kandidaat die direct inzetbaar is en aantoonbare ervaring meebrengt.
  • Ervaring met ETL/ELT, SQL, Python en werken met cloudplatforms zoals Azure of AWS.
  • Kennis van datamodellering, data-architectuur en IT-security/AVG.
  • Een proactieve en nieuwsgierige houding; je zoekt uit, probeert, verbetert.
  • Je werkt graag samen en je hebt passie voor data én maatschappelijke impact.
  • HBO/WO werk- en denkniveau (bij voorkeur richting Data, IT of Bedrijfskunde).
  • Minimaal 3 jaar ervaring als Power BI Developer en/of Data Engineer.

Sterke kennis van:

  • SQL (complexe queries schrijven).
  • Ervaring met Microsoft Azure (bijv. Data Factory, Synapse, SQL Database).
  • Kennis van data security en AVG binnen een publieke omgeving.
  • Je werkt zelfstandig, proactief en bent analytisch sterk.
  • Ervaring met Python.
  • Ervaring binnen gemeentelijke of sociale dienstverlening
  • Ervaring met CI/CD of DevOps-werkwijzen

Klaar voor jouw volgende stap?

Wil jij bouwen aan een toekomstgerichte, datagedreven organisatie én zelf ook groeien? En voel jij je thuis bij onze kernwaarden begrip, vertrouwen, daadkracht en wendbaarheid? Dan past Zaffier bij jou.

title: Construction Materials Testing Technician
description:

Take Your Construction Career to the Next Level!

Kleinfelder, a Forbes' Top Employer for Engineers in North America, is committed to a people-first culture, technical excellence, and creating opportunities where employees can thrive!

We're looking for individuals with strong initiative, who will perform construction observation and materials testing services on various projects to verify conformance to construction plans and specifications.

Specific responsibilities include:

  • Following proper procedures
  • Completing work in a timely manner
  • Prepare daily field observation reports and materials testing data sheets
  • Performing accurate computations
  • Maintaining cordial relationships with coworkers, clients, contractors, etc.

This position may require travel from time to time.

Consideration for this position requires the following certifications or experience:

  • 1 year minimum of construction materials testing or inspection experience

Move Forward with Kleinfelder: Kleinfelder and its’ subsidiaries and affiliates, has been connecting great people to the best work since 1961. Connecting great people to the best work is our purpose – together, we deliver.

The expected salary range for the position is displayed in accordance with the Colorado Equal Pay for Equal Work Act. Final agreed upon compensation is based upon individual qualifications and experience. Salary range: $16.74 - $27.95. We will be accepting applications through 12/16/26.

title: Data Engineer
description:

Je ontwikkelt schaalbare oplossingen en draagt bij aan het verder professionaliseren van ons dataplatform. Want alleen de optelsom van al het talent zorgt dat we onze klanten kunnen helpen bij hun ambities. Wat we jou nog meer bieden:

Jij bent een creatieve en oplossingsgerichte professional met een passie voor data en technologie. Wat je nog meer in huis hebt:

title: Production Quality Intern (Winter 2027)
description:
Astranis builds advanced satellites for high orbits, expanding humanity’s reach into the solar system. Today, Astranis satellites provide dedicated, secure networks to highly-sophisticated customers across the globe— large enterprises, sovereign governments, and the US military. With five satellites on orbit and many more set to launch soon, the company is servicing a backlog of more than $1 billion of commercial contracts.

Astranis is the preferred satellite communications partner for buyers with stringent requirements for uptime, data security, network visibility, and customization. Astranis has raised over $750 million from some of the world’s best investors, from Andreessen Horowitz to Blackrock and Fidelity, and employs a team of 450 engineers and entrepreneurs. Astranis designs, builds, and operates its satellites out of its 153,000 sq. ft. headquarters in Northern California, USA.

Production Quality Intern (Winter 2027)

Four billion people do not have access to the internet. Astranis is going to change that. We are building the next generation of smaller, lower-cost telecommunications satellites to bring the world online. And to pull it off we have to reinvent microwave radio systems in space using SDRs.

Work with incredibly smart people who have flown things in space before. We are a well-funded team that moves fast. No prior space experience needed, you just need to enjoy getting your hands dirty with real hardware and be ok with struggling to do things that seem impossibly hard.

Our mission and our products are meant to connect the whole world and everyone in it, regardless of race, creed, or any other distinction. We believe in a diverse and inclusive workplace, and we encourage all people to come join our team and bring their unique perspective to help make us stronger.

Role

  • Work with Design, Production, Quality, and Test engineering teams to develop inspection and verifications procedures
  • Support root cause analysis efforts and implement corrective actions to mitigate non-conformance issues
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to gather relevant data and insights for continuous improvement in quality
  • Support process and systems development to improve production quality
  • Develop dashboards, metrics, and visuals to help identify and monitor factory health

Requirements

  • A passion for hardware development and manufacturing systems, including working in a fast-paced environment and hands-on design and development
  • Ability to handle multiple tasks and prioritize
  • Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written
  • Must be onsite 5 days a week

Bonus

  • Previous internship or coursework experience in a similar role
  • Experience with quality management systems or hardware manufacturing
  • Knowledge of programming languages such as Python, R, or SQL
  • Direct electrical or mechanical design experience
  • Demonstrated ability to debug hardware and software problems under time pressure
The base pay for this position is $29.00 per hour.
Base Hourly Pay
$29—$29 USD

Our mission and products are built for everyone, regardless of gender, race, creed, or background. We believe in a diverse and inclusive workplace, and we invite all people to join our team and bring their unique perspectives to make us stronger.

title: Back-End Developer Java
description:
Voor een innovatieve FinTech scale-up zoekt Kwery een gedreven Backend Java Developer. Deze snelgroeiende onderneming bouwt een SaaS-platform dat financiële processen digitaliseert en automatiseert.
Je vervoegt een sterk IT-team van zes professionals en krijgt volop ruimte om impact te maken.   • Daarnaast een volledige waaier aan extralegale voordelen zoals maaltijdcheques, mooie netto-onkostenvergoeding, groepsverzekering, uitgebreidde hospitalisatieverzekering, 13de maand, vakantiegeld, CAO90 en jaarlijkse teambonus! Extra's die echt het verschil maken!
  • Work hard, play hard. Je geniet van flexibele uren, 2 dagen thuiswerk na inwerkperiode en 26 vakantiedagen. Extra vakantiedagen nodig? Dat kan via het cafetariaplan!
  • Je komt terecht in een innovatieve organisatie die continu investeert in technologie. Een omgeving waar initiatief wordt aangemoedigd, verantwoordelijkheid vanzelfsprekend is en waar je alle kansen krijgt om uit te groeien tot een belangrijke spil binnen het bedrijf.
  • Tot slot kom je terecht in een vlakke organisatie binnen een hecht team van gepassioneerde collega's, waar samenwerking, kennisdeling en een no-nonsense mentaliteit centraal staan. Waar zowel de ervaren Tech Lead alsook een betrokken CTO altijd klaar staan om te sparren en technische vraagstukken te bespreken.

    Klaar voor jouw volgende hoofdstuk? Solliciteer dan snel!
Deze vacature ligt in het beheer van Charlotte Andries, solliciteren kan ook via charlotte@kwery.be

title: Program Coordinator
description:
Position Description:

Teya Diversified Services, LLC is seeking a Program Coordinator to provide administrative and operational support. Working closely with the Program Manager, this position will help coordinate the day-to-day administrative activities needed to support multiple projects, field personnel, suppliers, subcontractors, and Government customer requirements.

This is a full-time remote position. The Program Coordinator will maintain project records, coordinate site access and badging, contact suppliers and subcontractors, track requests and documentation, support work order and CMMS administration, and assist with travel, purchasing, invoicing, and other program logistics.

The position requires strong organization, follow-through, communication, and attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced federal contracting environment.

Duties and Responsibilities:

The Essential Duties and Responsibilities are intended to present a descriptive list of the range of duties performed for this position and are not intended to reflect all duties performed within the job. Other duties may be assigned.

• Provide day-to-day administrative and coordination support to the Program Manager and project teams supporting federal O&M work.

• Maintain organized program files, correspondence, logs, trackers, reports, and other contract and project documentation.

• Contact suppliers and vendors to request pricing, confirm availability, track orders and deliveries, and obtain supporting documentation as directed.

• Support subcontractor administration by coordinating communications, collecting required documentation, tracking status, and assisting with scheduling and site logistics.

• Coordinate site access, badging, credentialing, visitor requests, and related documentation for employees, subcontractors, vendors, and other project personnel.

• Assist with work order and CMMS administration, including data entry, status tracking, documentation, closeout records, and routine reporting.

• Track action items, due dates, deliverables, and recurring administrative requirements and follow up with responsible parties to support timely completion.

• Assist with employee and subcontractor mobilization, travel arrangements, lodging, transportation, and per diem documentation.

• Support purchasing activities, including purchase requests, vendor documentation, receipts, packing slips, and coordination with Procurement and Accounting.

• Assist with invoice and cost documentation by collecting, organizing, and routing supporting records for review and approval.

• Schedule meetings, prepare supporting materials, document action items, and assist with follow-up as needed.

• Support routine customer and internal reports, spreadsheets, presentations, correspondence, and other program deliverables.

• Communicate professionally with employees, suppliers, subcontractors, Government representatives, and internal Teya departments.

• Handle program, employee, customer, and company information with appropriate discretion and confidentiality.

• Collaborate with Contracts, Accounting, Project Controls, HR, Safety, Procurement, and other Teya resources to support successful program execution.

• Other duties as assigned.

Required Qualifications and Experience:

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to satisfactorily perform each essential duty. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made for qualified individuals with disabilities.

• High school diploma or equivalent required; associate degree or additional education in business administration, project coordination, or a related field preferred.

• Two (2) or more years of administrative, project coordination, office support, or related experience.

• Strong organizational skills and demonstrated ability to manage multiple tasks, deadlines, and priorities with consistent follow-through.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills and the ability to interact professionally with employees, customers, suppliers, subcontractors, and internal departments.

• Proficiency with Microsoft Office, including Outlook, Word, and Excel, and the ability to learn project, procurement, and work order management systems.

• Ability to maintain accurate records, organize supporting documentation, and handle confidential or sensitive information appropriately.

• Ability to work independently in a remote environment while maintaining regular communication, responsiveness, and accountability.

• Strong attention to detail, customer service orientation, and commitment to safety, quality, and compliance.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience supporting federal Government contracts, facilities, construction, O&M, or technical services.

• Experience coordinating vendors, suppliers, subcontractors, purchasing, or site access requirements.

• Experience with CMMS, work order, project management, procurement, or accounting systems.

• Familiarity with federal badging, credentialing, site-access, or security-related administrative processes.

• Experience supporting geographically dispersed teams or multiple concurrent projects.

Travel and Other Requirements

This position is primarily remote. Occasional travel to project, customer, or company locations may be required based on program needs.

Employment and assignment to specific federal contracts or project locations may be subject to federal background investigation, security, suitability, credentialing, badging, or site-access requirements, as applicable to the respective contract, customer, or project. The employee must be able to obtain and maintain any required eligibility, credentials, or access for assigned work.

Physical Demands and Working Conditions:

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the functions of this job. Employee must maintain a constant state of mental alertness at all times. Reasonable accommodations may be made for qualified individuals with disabilities.

Essential and marginal functions may require maintaining physical condition necessary for bending, stooping, sitting, walking or standing for prolonged periods of time; most of the time is spent sitting in a comfortable position with frequent opportunity to move about.

EEO Statement:

It is the company’s policy to select, place, train and promote the most qualified individuals based upon relevant factors such as work quality, attitude, and experience, to provide Equal Employment Opportunity for all employees in compliance with applicable local, state and federal laws and without regard to non-work-related factors such as race, color, religion/creed, sex, national origin, age, disability, marital status, veteran status, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, or other protected status. When applicable, the company’s policy of non-discrimination applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including but not limited to, recruiting, hiring, training, transfer, promotion, placement, layoff, compensation, termination, reduction in force, and benefits. It is the company’s business philosophy and practice to provide reasonable accommodation, according to applicable state and federal laws, to all qualified individuals with physical or mental disabilities.

title: Data and AI Engineer
description:
Job Title

Data and AI Engineer

Job Description

Enterprise Informatics is Philips' software business. Decisions about where to invest, which opportunities and accounts to prioritize, and how the business will perform depend on data from CRM, ERP, service, contracts and other enterprise systems. The Data and AI Engineer works at the intersection of business analysis, data analysis, data engineering and agentic AI. The role turns ambiguous business needs into well-defined analytical problems and scalable solutions, from data discovery and rapid prototyping through deployment and adoption. It is a hands‑on technical role requiring direct work in Python and SQL, alongside the ability to explain methods, data quality and business implications to senior stakeholders.

Your role:

  • Partner with Services, Sales Operations, Marketing, Business Operations and other stakeholders to translate ambiguous business questions into well‑defined analytical problems, challenge assumptions where needed, and communicate clear conclusions.
  • Find, acquire, explore, integrate and prepare data from enterprise systems such as Salesforce, SAP and ServiceNow, ensuring appropriate data quality, lineage, security and governance.
  • Analyze commercial, financial and operational data to explain performance and support recurring business cycles, including revenue and order‑intake bridges, pipeline, backlog, installed base and variance analysis.
  • Build and maintain curated datasets, Python/SQL data solutions, and semantic and metric layers on the Databricks Lakehouse and cloud platforms, with Azure preferred and AWS experience valued.
  • Rapidly prototype and productionize agentic AI solutions that put trusted insights into business users' hands. Design agent tools and skills, curate semantic metadata, create evaluation suites, and use modern AI development harnesses and coding agents while maintaining sound Git, testing and CI/CD practices.
  • Coordinate cross‑functional data, analytics and AI initiatives from requirements through deployment, testing, validation and adoption, working effectively across business and technical teams.
  • Proactively contribute to data and AI strategy and roadmap definition, evaluate emerging technologies, and share reusable methods and best practices across the team.

You’re a right fit if:

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Management, Data Science, Econometrics, Artificial Intelligence, Applied Mathematics, Statistics or an equivalent field. Minimum 5 years of relevant experience with a Bachelor's degree, or 3 years with a Master's degree, in data handling, analytics, data engineering, AI solution development or equivalent.
  • Strong hands‑on Python and SQL skills, including experience with Spark or PySpark, Delta Lake and practical software development practices.
  • Practical Databricks experience spanning notebooks, Lakehouse/Delta, jobs or workflows, applications or agents, and deployment pipelines.
  • Demonstrated hands‑on experience building agentic AI solutions beyond a proof of concept, including evaluation, testing and production‑readiness considerations.
  • Strong data analysis capability, including statistical methods, data processing, reconciliation, and the ability to explain why data sources or metrics disagree.
  • Experience with cloud platforms, preferably Azure; AWS experience is also relevant.
  • Ability to coordinate cross‑functional work, gather requirements, and communicate clearly in English with business leaders and technical stakeholders.
  • Practical analytics‑engineering experience with commercial and financial data, including revenue, subscription or licence models, pipeline, backlog and installed base, and related enterprise systems such as Salesforce, SAP and ServiceNow, ideally within a B2B software or technology business
  • Modern agent frameworks and protocols, LLM evaluation practices, semantic modelling, dbt or Databricks metric views, and Power BI.
  • Healthcare, medtech or another regulated industry is preferred

Compensation & benefits

Doing meaningful work should come with fair, transparent rewards. The base salary range for this role is €78.187 –€130.312. We determine pay within the range using objective factors, like the skills the role requires, your relevant experience and the responsibility you’ll have in this role, alongside internal equity and local market considerations. We’ll share the full approach with you during the interview process, so you can make a clear, informed decision.

How we work together

We believe that we are better together than apart. For our office‑based teams, this means working in‑person at least 3 days per week. Onsite roles require full‑time presence in the company’s facilities. Field roles are most effectively done outside of the company’s main facilities, generally at the customers’ or suppliers’ locations.

PeopleTec is currently seeking a Senior Analyst to support our Colorado Springs, CO location.

The Business / Program Analyst will provide analytical, programmatic, operational, and coordination support to Golden Dome-related efforts supporting the Missile Defense Agency and Army SETA mission areas. The analyst will support program managers, government leads, technical teams, and mission stakeholders by analyzing program functions, improving business processes, coordinating activities, tracking actions, preparing reports, and supporting data-driven decision-making across complex missile defense, Army space, and joint mission environments.

This position requires a mission-focused analyst with experience supporting classified defense programs, Army operational planning, homeland defense, space and missile defense activities, project coordination, risk management, training support, and senior leader decision products. The analyst will help align program activities with stated objectives, monitor execution progress, assess risks and opportunities, and recommend process improvements that support effective program performance.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Analyze program functions, processes, workflows, schedules, records, and activities to identify gaps, improve efficiency, and support successful execution of Golden Dome-related objectives.

  • Maintain program records, meeting archives, data repositories, planning products, and automated tracking systems to ensure timely access to accurate program information.
  • Support training planning, workforce readiness activities, exercise preparation, and implementation of program objectives through coordinated planning and follow-up.
  • Apply risk management, data analysis, operational planning, and process improvement methods to support integrated missile defense and Army space mission needs.

  • 15+ years of experience supporting DoD, Army, missile defense, space, homeland defense, or joint operational programs.

  • Experience reviewing program metrics, schedules, procedures, and activity reports to monitor progress against objectives.

  • Experience supporting senior managers, government customers, technical teams, and cross-functional stakeholders.

title: Analytics Engineer
description:
About Us:

Fireworks is the platform for specialized intelligence, enabling companies to build, train, and serve AI models tailored to their own data, workflows, and products. Founded by the team behind PyTorch and backed by AMD, Atreides, Benchmark Capital, Index Ventures, Lightspeed, NVIDIA, Sequoia Capital, and TCV, Fireworks powers production AI with hundreds of state-of-the-art open models across text, image, embedding, audio, and multimodal workloads. Today, Fireworks is a Series D company valued at $17.5 billion, bringing together an ambitious, collaborative team that's building the future of enterprise AI.

ABOUT US

Fireworks is the platform for specialized intelligence, enabling companies to build, train, and serve AI models tailored to their own data, workflows, and products. Founded by the team behind PyTorch and backed by AMD, Atreides, Benchmark Capital, Index Ventures, Lightspeed, NVIDIA, Sequoia Capital, and TCV, Fireworks powers production AI with hundreds of state-of-the-art open models across text, image, embedding, audio, and multimodal workloads. Today, Fireworks is a Series D company valued at $17.5 billion, bringing together an ambitious, collaborative team that's building the future of enterprise AI.

THE ROLE

We're hiring several Analytics Engineers to embed with the functions that run the business — Finance, Product-Led Growth, People, and Partnerships.

Our data org runs as a hub and spoke model. The central Data Platform team is the hub: it owns company-wide data infrastructure, modeling standards, data quality, reliability and observability, governance, and the developer experience everyone else builds on. You would be a spoke. You report into Data Platform, but you sit with your function, join its planning, and spend most of your time answering its questions with data — and the remainder engineering on top of the platform's shared infrastructure and standards.

That means you get both things analytics engineers usually have to choose between: real ownership of a domain, and a real platform underneath you. You own the analytics roadmap and execution for your function and you're the voice of its priorities back to the central team. You are not a ticket queue, and you are not building a private stack in a corner — your models reconcile to the same certified definitions everyone else uses.

THE STACK

BigQuery (warehouse) · Coalesce (transformation pipelines) · Sigma (reporting) · Castor (catalog) · Python · Git-based workflows. Domain systems vary — billing (Orb), CRM, PostHog, Rippling, Ashby, cloud marketplaces.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Own your function's data domain end to end — define what should be measured, model it, and be accountable for the numbers when someone asks where they came from.

  • Build and maintain pipelines in BigQuery and Coalesce, aligned with company data standards, certified definitions, and governance requirements.

  • Establish authoritative models for your domain that reconcile against the company's certified account, usage, and revenue definitions — not a second set of numbers.

  • Build the dashboards your team runs the business on, and make them trustworthy enough to replace spreadsheet exports and one-off pulls.

  • Contribute back to the platform — the frameworks, standards, and tooling you use are shared, and improvements you make land for everyone.

  • Surface problems before they're asked about — variance, anomalies, mix shifts, and completeness gaps should reach your stakeholders from you first.

  • Automate the manual. Once the core data is hardened, build the agentic and LLM-powered workflows that take the repetitive work off your team's plate — reconciliation, anomaly detection, routine reporting, operational handoffs.

DOMAINS WE'RE HIRING FOR

  • Finance — the order-to-cash pipeline end to end: usage metering, invoicing, revenue recognition, reconciliation, and the reporting that monthly close and board updates run on.

  • Product-Led Growth — the self-serve funnel from a developer reading our docs through signup, first API call, activation, and sustained paid usage, plus the instrumentation and experimentation behind it.

  • People — workforce intelligence and automation across the employee lifecycle, built on our HR and recruiting systems and handled with the sensitivity people data requires.

  • Partnerships — partner economics and revenue share with leading AI labs: numbers that tie to billing records, pass audit, and partners trust.

The technical bar is the same across all four. Apply once and tell us which domain fits you — if more than one appeals, say so and we'll figure it out in the first conversation.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

Required — all roles

  • 5+ years in data analysis, analytics engineering, and/or data engineering

  • Strong SQL proficiency — you can design a good schema, write your own queries, and not bog down the warehouse

  • Strong visualization proficiency — you can build your team the dashboards they need so they can leverage the data for efficient decision making

  • Working knowledge of data engineering — you already know how to put up a pull request, respond to code review feedback, etc.

  • Strong analytical thinking — you decompose ambiguous problems, find the root cause behind a number that moved, and turn a maybe into a defensible explanation

  • Clear communication with non-technical partners — you can translate system logic into terms your stakeholders can act on

  • A bias toward building systems over managing processes — you treat recurring manual work as a problem to solve

Preferred — all roles

  • Proficiency in Python for automation, data work, and integrations

  • Experience building LLM-powered agents or automation workflows on top of analytics — after the core numbers are hardened

  • Experience with modern BI and transformation tooling (Sigma, Looker, Tableau; dbt, Coalesce, or similar)

  • Background in AI infrastructure, developer tools, or usage-based platforms — token pricing, GPU-hour metering, model mix, and cost-per-request as first-class business metrics

  • Depth in one of the domains above — billing and revenue systems, product and web analytics and experimentation, HRIS/ATS platforms and workflow automation, or partner and marketplace economics

We don't expect every bullet. Tell us which ones you have.

WHY FIREWORKS?

  • Solve Hard Problems: Tackle challenges at the forefront of AI infrastructure, from low-latency inference to scalable model serving.

  • Build What's Next: Work with bleeding-edge technology that impacts how businesses and developers harness AI globally.

  • Ownership & Impact: Join a fast-growing, passionate team where your work directly shapes the future of AI — no bureaucracy, just results. You'll own your function's data and automation infrastructure, not sit in a ticket queue.

  • Learn from the Best: Collaborate with world-class engineers and AI researchers who thrive on curiosity and innovation.

Fireworks AI is an equal-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all innovators.

title: Staff Geological Engineer or Engineering Geologist
location: Seattle, Redmond, Tacoma, Bellingham, or Spokane, WA or Portland, OR
description:
As a Staff Geological Engineer or Engineering Geologist, you will support engineering geology projects with an emphasis on geological characterization, field mapping, subsurface exploration, and rock slope stability evaluations. You can expect to spend a significant portion of your time in the field observing explorations, mapping geologic conditions, documenting earthwork and foundation construction, and collecting field data that informs engineering analyses and design recommendations. You’ll also assist with report preparation, figures, technical calculations, and geotechnical analyses, such as slope stability, bearing capacity, settlement, deep foundation design, seismic evaluation, and numerical modeling. This position may also provide support to our engineering geology or geotechnical teams in other locations as needed.


Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Performs geotechnical engineering activities with an emphasis on geological characterization of sites, field mapping, and rock slope stability analysis.
  • Responsible for field explorations, field mapping, earthwork, foundation construction, and construction projects to help ensure work is completed consistent with project plans, specifications, and safety guidelines.
  • Responsible for preparing detailed and accurate field reports; assists with coordinating field exploration and mapping programs; gathers field data and samples; and coordinates samples for testing as needed.
  • Performs geotechnical analyses and calculations including slope stability, bearing capacity, settlement, deep foundation design, seismic evaluation, and related analyses using tools such as MathCAD, GeoStudio Suite, RocScience Suite, PLAXIS, and FLAC.
  • Develops moderately complex conceptual models under the supervision of a licensed engineer and completes complex numerical modeling analyses as assigned.
  • Prepares deliverables such as technical reports, memos, figures, tables, and charts; completes portions of technical reports; and provides occasional quality assurance/quality control support.
  • Supports project management tasks, including budget planning, general field report reviews, proposal development, and timely delivery of assigned work to the project manager within estimated scope and schedule.
  • Assists with permit applications in accordance with applicable local, state, and federal guidelines.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering Geology or Civil, Geological, Geotechnical, or Mining Engineering required; Master’s degree strongly preferred.
  • Previous internship or experience in geotechnical engineering preferred.
  • Engineer-In-Training (EIT) or Geologist-In-Training (GIT) certification.
  • Ability to adapt to changing project requirements and successfully work within a team.
  • Proven problem solving, and professional-level verbal and written communication skills are a must.
  • A valid driver’s license is required.
  • One year of driving experience in the United States. Consideration will be provided for international driving experience.
  • Desire and willingness to travel up to 25% of the time.

Physical Requirements/Work Environment

  • All candidates are subject to completing a background check, and reference check.
  • All candidates are required to participate in our medical surveillance program.
  • Ability to perform a wide range of physical activities and do heavy work including exerting up to 50 pounds of force on occasion.
  • Ability to perform consistent work on a PC with prolonged sitting and view of a monitor/screen.
  • Ability to travel for short-term and long-term assignments as needed.
  • All employees are responsible for conducting their work in a safe manner. This includes identifying potential safety hazards and reporting them to the designated project manager in a timely manner and participating in project safety briefings. This also includes wearing appropriate safety equipment when working in the field and completing all required health & safety training prior to beginning field work.

title: Senior Data Engineer Amsterdam
description:
Most "data engineer" roles are glorified plumbing: drag boxes around in a UI, babysit a scheduler, hope nothing breaks overnight. This is not that.

We are looking for a Senior Data Engineer who comes from software engineering and treats data pipelines like the production software they are. Version control, tests, modular design, code review. If you have ever looked at a 2,000-line notebook held together by hope and thought "this should be a properly structured repo", we should talk.

At Sytac you work inside the data platforms that run some of the Netherlands' largest companies: KLM, ABN AMRO, ING, Rabobank, Bol, Ahold. Real volume, real reliability requirements, real ownership. You join an enterprise team and ship to prod, with the autonomy to build it right instead of fast-and-sorry.

What you'll do

  • Build ETL/ELT in Python, PySpark, and SQL that is as maintainable as any backend service, modular, tested, versioned. Not a pile of one-off scripts.
  • Design Lakehouse environments using Medallion (Bronze/Silver/Gold) and proper dimensional/Star Schema modelling on Azure and GCP.
  • Own infrastructure as code (Terraform or Bicep) and containerized deployments on Docker and Kubernetes. No clicking through portals to ship.
  • Orchestrate with Apache Airflow and run real CI/CD for data (Azure DevOps/GitHub Actions) so pipelines deploy and test like applications.
  • Use AI seriously in your workflow, Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, and bring LLMs into pipelines where they earn their place, not as a buzzword.
  • Translate messy business logic into clean specs, set the quality bar with the code you write, and keep lineage and governance honest.

What we're looking for

You think like a software engineer first and a data person second. Clean, tested, reusable code is your default, not an aspiration.

  • 6+ years building production software, HBO/WO level of thinking.
  • Expert Python and SQL across PostgreSQL, MSSQL, and Oracle.
  • Deep Apache Spark/PySpark for distributed processing, plus pandas/polars for the smaller stuff.
  • Azure Databricks, Data Factory, and Synapse, and/or GCP (BigQuery, Dataflow).
  • Lakehouse/Data Lake environments with Star/dimensional modelling.
  • Apache Airflow for orchestration.
  • Git, Azure DevOps Pipelines, and CI/CD built specifically for data pipelines.
  • Docker and Kubernetes, day to day.
  • Kafka for streaming, Elasticsearch where it fits.
  • Data quality, lineage, and governance treated as first-class, not an afterthought.
  • AI-assisted development as a real part of how you work.
  • Strong stakeholder management, you can talk to the business and turn what they need into solid technical work.
  • Strong English. NL residency required, expats already living and working in the Netherlands are very welcome. We are not offering relocation for this role.

Nice to have (genuinely nice, not secretly required)

  • A JVM background: Scala, Java, or Kotlin is a real plus given the software-first angle.
  • Dutch language.
  • dbt, FastAPI, Terraform/Bicep.
  • GitHub Actions, Helm, ArgoCD.
  • OpenAI/Azure OpenAI and LLM integration in pipelines.

Life at Sytac

Working at Sytac means joining a community that prioritizes your growth. Our benefits package is designed for flexibility, learning, and adventure:

  • Unlimited Growth Days: Enjoy your professional development and Sytac activities!
  • The Best Gear: Pick a private laptop (<€4,000) with 50% paid by us, plus a tech budget.
  • Invest in You: A €2,400 annual growth budget for training and conferences.
  • Future Proof: We contribute 3.75% to your pension.
  • Legendary Trips: Join our annual ski trips, beach BBQs, and epic parties!

title: Data Engineer
description:
Data Engineer

Location: Birmingham

Hybrid Working

Permanent Full Time

Salary: up to £45,000


We’re looking for a Data Engineer to join a growing Data & Analytics team, helping to build and develop the data platform that supports reporting, analytics and emerging AI use cases across the organisation.


This is a broad Data Engineering position covering the full data lifecycle. You’ll work from the point data is connected at source, through ingestion, transformation and modelling, into the central data platform where it can be used effectively for reporting, analytics and more advanced applications.


The environment is centred around the Microsoft data stack, so we’re looking for someone with strong experience across either Microsoft Fabric or Azure data services, alongside solid SQL, data modelling and ETL capabilities.


What you’ll be doing

  • Designing and building reliable data pipelines to ingest data from a range of internal and external sources
  • Working with APIs and other integration methods to establish and maintain data feeds
  • Developing ETL/ELT processes to transform and model data for reporting and analytics
  • Designing appropriate database structures, schemas and data models
  • Ensuring data quality, integrity, security and performance across the data platform
  • Working extensively with SQL and the wider Microsoft data ecosystem
  • Supporting the development of reporting and self-service analytics solutions
  • Building and developing Power BI dashboards where required
  • Working with stakeholders to understand business requirements and translate them into effective technical solutions
  • Producing high-level solution designs and detailed technical designs
  • Exploring opportunities to use advanced analytics, machine learning and AI to derive additional value from data
  • Contributing to technical standards, development practices and continuous improvement across the wider data function


What we’re looking for

You’ll have a strong grounding in Data Engineering and be comfortable working across different stages of the data lifecycle rather than focusing solely on one area.


We’re particularly interested in experience with:


  • Microsoft Fabric and/or Azure data services
  • SQL / T-SQL
  • Data pipelines and ETL/ELT development
  • Data modelling and database design
  • Integrating data from APIs and multiple source systems
  • Python
  • Power BI, DAX and Power Query / M
  • Data quality and data management principles
  • Translating business requirements into technical solutions
  • Git and version control
  • Agile delivery environments
  • Experience working with Oracle databases and Oracle SQL would also be beneficial.


The opportunity

This is a good opportunity for a Data Engineer who wants exposure beyond simply building pipelines. You’ll work across ingestion, engineering, modelling, reporting and analytics, while also having the opportunity to contribute to newer AI and machine learning initiatives.


You’ll join a collaborative data team where you can take ownership of projects, influence technical approaches and help shape how data is used across the wider organisation.


If you are interested in this opportunity and would like to hear more, please apply for the opportunity with an updated CV and contact information.

A SYSTRA Brasil entrega soluções completas em todas as etapas: estudos, desenvolvimento de projetos, gerenciamento e fiscalização. Hoje, também apoiamos nossos clientes e parceiros na transição digital, ecológica e energética, sempre com foco na mobilidade do futuro.

Aqui, você terá contato com diversos projetos de mobilidade e infraestrutura de transportes, em um ambiente que valoriza o aprendizado contínuo e o desenvolvimento de cada profissional.

A confiança transporta o mundo, e para nós isso significa criar um ambiente onde todas as pessoas possam pertencer e crescer. Nossas vagas são inclusivas e abertas à diversidade de talentos que movem a mobilidade do futuro.

title: Data Engineer
description:
Ben jij gepassioneerd over data, datamodellering en systeemintegratie? Krijg je energie van het werken met de nieuwste technologieën en het optimaliseren van datastromen? Dan zoeken wij jou als Data Engineer bij Appèl in 's-Hertogenbosch!

Om onze expansie door te zetten, zijn wij op zoek naar een enthousiaste en ervaren Data Engineer die ons datateam komt versterken. Je hebt een passie voor Data Engineering, waarbij je verantwoordelijk bent voor het ontwerpen, uitbreiden en onderhouden van ons Appèl dataplatform. Je richt je op datamodellering, datamigratie en het koppelen van verschillende systemen met behulp van de meest geavanceerde technologie. Je zorgt voor betrouwbare en schaalbare datastromen die de basis vormen voor onze bedrijfsbeslissingen en geavanceerde analyses.

Je werkt nauw samen met multidisciplinaire teams om dataoplossingen te integreren en te optimaliseren, en je speelt een cruciale rol in het waarborgen van de datakwaliteit en dataintegriteit.

Bruto maandsalaris tussen €4.500,- en €6.000,-

Prachtige werkplek in een modern servicekantoor aan de A2

Mogelijkheid om hybride te werken

Mogelijkheid om deel te nemen aan het Appèl fietsplan

Dagelijks een heerlijke vitale en gezonde lunch in ons belevingscentrum

Gezellige borrels, personeelsuitjes en (sportieve) nevenactiviteiten

Wie zijn jouw collega's?

Martijn van de Graaf

Senior Informatieanalist /-architect

Je hebt passie voor eten en gastvrijheid

Je beschikt over goede communicatieve vaardigheden een goede beheersing van de Nederlandse taal in woord en geschrift

title: Software Engineer II, Data Analytics & Engineering
location: San Francisco, CA, US; Remote, US
description:
About Pinterest:

Millions of people around the world come to our platform to find creative ideas, dream about new possibilities and plan for memories that will last a lifetime. At Pinterest, we’re on a mission to bring everyone the inspiration to create a life they love, and that starts with the people behind the product.

Discover a career where you ignite innovation for millions, transform passion into growth opportunities, celebrate each other’s unique experiences and embrace the flexibility to do your best work. Creating a career you love? It’s Possible.

At Pinterest, AI isn't just a feature, it's a powerful partner that augments our creativity and amplifies our impact, and we’re looking for candidates who are excited to be a part of that. To get a complete picture of your experience and abilities, we’ll explore your foundational skills and how you collaborate with AI.

Through our interview process, what matters most is that you can always explain your approach, showing us not just what you know, but how you think. You can read more about our AI interview philosophy and how we use AI in our recruiting process here.

Job Title: Software Engineer II, Data Analytics and Engineering

Intro: We’re looking for a Software Engineer II, Data Analytics and Engineering to improve the quality, reliability and velocity of data science and product development at Pinterest. You’ll build scalable data foundations, analytics tooling and analysis pipelines that enable trusted, self-service access to datasets, insights and metric investigations across cross-functional teams.

What you’ll do:

  • Develop and document practical instrumentation and experimentation standards, then partner with product engineering teams to apply them to priority product development work.
  • Build and improve scalable analysis pipelines and tooling that produce reliable insights at scale and strengthen understanding of key data structures and metrics.
  • Create tools and processes that enable Data Scientists and Engineers to independently access trusted datasets, insights and metric definitions.
  • Identify data quality and discoverability gaps, advocate for targeted improvements and contribute to reliable, well-governed data practices.
  • Maintain clear documentation for tools, datasets, metrics and operating practices to make team data assets easier to use.
  • Partner with Product, Engineering, Data Science, Data Engineering and Business Intelligence teams to communicate actionable insights and inform product improvements.
  • Use AI to accelerate analysis, prototyping and iteration, while applying judgment and verification to ensure correctness, quality and responsible use.

What we’re looking for:

  • Minimum of 2 years of experience delivering analytics engineering or data solutions in a fast-paced, data-driven environment.
  • Experience using SQL and Python, R or a comparable programming language to work with large, high-dimensional datasets, including nested data structures, window functions, query optimization and data partitioning.
  • Experience building and operating data workflows, including workflow orchestration, ETL/ELT pipelines and DAG dependencies across complex datasets.
  • Experience translating open-ended partner needs into clear, impactful technical objectives and collaborating across Product, Engineering, Data Science, Data Engineering and Business Intelligence teams.
  • Demonstrated ability to use AI to improve speed and quality in day-to-day engineering workflows.
  • Strong track record of critically evaluating and verifying AI-assisted work through testing, data validation, source-checking or peer review.
  • High integrity and ownership: you protect sensitive data, avoid over-reliance on AI and remain accountable for final decisions and deliverables.
  • Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field such as Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics or a related discipline, or equivalent experience.
