title: Project Manager
description:
Why This Role Is Critical

As the need for nuclear energy grows, the future couldn’t be brighter. Join our vital mission to create lasting solutions for our planet’s greatest challenges. In this role, you are ready to shape the future of clean energy and make a long-lasting global impact. With us, anticipate engaging and challenging projects that deliver innovative solutions and value-added technologies helping power more than 38 million North American homes.

The Richland Nuclear Fuel Manufacturing Plant operates 24/7 to supply fuel to customers across the U.S. and internationally. The Plant Engineering group ensures safe, compliant, and reliable operation of plant infrastructure and process equipment. As a Project Manager, you provide structure, coordination, and execution discipline for engineering projects that maintain or improve plant performance.

What You’ll Do Day-To-Day

Role OverviewYou will plan, coordinate, and deliver maintenance projects, equipment upgrades, process improvements, and special production orders. Projects range from small tasks to multimillion dollar initiatives, all requiring strict nuclear safety, quality, and regulatory compliance. You will work closely with engineering, operations, nuclear safety, QA, maintenance, and contractors to ensure smooth execution within a continuous operation manufacturing environment.

Key Responsibilities

Feasibility & Intake

  • Document technical needs for equipment upgrades, plant improvements, or special production campaigns.
  • Assess feasibility based on nuclear process constraints, plant capabilities, and regulatory boundaries.
  • Identify impacts to production, critical equipment, and controlled areas.
  • Support preliminary risk assessments (nuclear safety, radiological protection, criticality safety, industrial hazards).
  • Develop concepts and execution scenarios to support go/no go decisions.Proposal Development
  • Create scopes, cost estimates, and schedules aligned with nuclear work planning requirements.
  • Prepare proposals for special production orders with unique customer specs and QA requirements.
  • Coordinate with engineering, QA, nuclear safety, and operations to define technical approaches and resource needs.
  • Identify outage windows or production slowdowns needed for intrusive work.

Project Planning & Initiation

  • Develop detailed project plans integrating nuclear safety controls and configuration management.
  • Lead planning reviews, hazard analyses, and readiness verifications.
  • Coordinate procurement and stakeholder communications.

Project Execution

  • Oversee daily project activities in compliance with plant procedures and safety bases.
  • Coordinate craft labor, engineering support, and contractors in controlled or radiological areas.
  • Track schedule and budget, escalate variances, and propose mitigations.
  • Align work with production priorities and limited operating windows.
  • Maintain configuration management and support testing, commissioning, and turnover to operations.

Closeout

  • Ensure completion and archiving of QA documentation and inspection records.
  • Validate updates to procedures, drawings, hazard analyses, and preventive maintenance plans.
  • Conduct lessons learned reviews and support financial closeout.

Key Competencies

  • Experience in regulated industrial or nuclear environments.
  • Ability to coordinate work in 24/7 operations.
  • Understanding of nuclear safety fundamentals.
  • Strong project management skills (scope, schedule, budget, risk, change control).
  • Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.
  • Effective communication and collaboration with multidisciplinary teams.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in nuclear fuel manufacturing or regulated nuclear facilities.
  • Familiarity with NQA-1, configuration management, and nuclear regulatory frameworks.
  • Experience with work planning, corrective action programs, and hazard analysis tools.
  • Proficiency with project management software, CMMS, and document control systems.
  • Progress toward CAPM or PMP certification.

What You'll Bring

  • Bachelor's Degree in related field
  • Minimum of 4 years related experience is or equivalent work experience in lieu of degree.
  • Business and/or technical expertise in a related technical or professional capacity.
  • Good communication skills to work effectively with all levels of staff and management, vendors and customers.
  • Good problem identification and problem resolution skills with emphasis on 'root cause' analysis.
  • Excellent report development and presentation skills.

Total Rewards Package

Total Rewards Package

  • Salary: $94,000 - $127,000 and may also include annual incentives and performance bonuses. The base salary range is a guideline. Individual total compensation will vary based on factors such as qualifications, skill level, competencies and work location.
  • Health & Wellness: Multiple medical plan options, dental & vision coverage, life insurance, long- and short-term disability, and optional supplemental plans (critical illness, accident, hospital indemnity, dependent life).
  • Retirement: 401(k) with employer match.
  • Paid Time Off: Up to 3 weeks of vacation, 8 sick days, and 13 paid holidays annually.
  • Extra Perks: Lifestyle spending account, employer paid mental health support, education reimbursement, professional development opportunities, adoption assistance, parental leave, and employee assistance programs.

About Framatome

Framatome has been shaping the future of nuclear energy in the U.S. for more than 60 years. Framatome Inc. is headquartered in Lynchburg, Virginia, with more than 2,400+ employees across North America supporting nearly every nuclear plant in the nation.

From our facilities in Virginia, Washington, North Carolina, Pennsylvania, Massachusetts and beyond, we deliver outage services, advanced nuclear fuel technologies, and next-gen reactor innovations that keep the lights on.

At Framatome, you will join a global team committed to creating reliable, carbon-free energy. Here, you can:

  • Solve complex nuclear challenges that directly impact the climate.
  • Build your career through technical fellowships, leadership roles, and global opportunities.
  • Do your best work in a culture that values safety, innovation, and well-being.

Framatome is an Equal Opportunity Employer, including Veterans, and Individuals with Disabilities.

Champaign, IL

$20.00–$24.00 per hour | Part-Time | PRN | On-Call


Looking for flexible work that fits your schedule?

If you're an experienced logistics or industrial maintenance technician looking to earn extra income without committing to a full-time position, this opportunity could be a great fit.


We're building an on-call team of Logistics Senior Technicians to support our warehouse operations when additional maintenance coverage is needed. This position is ideal for retired technicians, experienced mechanics, or anyone looking for supplemental income with a flexible schedule.

When work becomes available, we'll contact you 24–48 hours in advance to see if you're available. There is no set schedule and no guaranteed hours—you simply work when needed and when you're available.

Every shift is different.

You'll work alongside experienced maintenance professionals to quickly diagnose problems, make repairs, and help keep warehouse operations running safely and efficiently.   • Document completed repairs and work orders

This position supports advanced troubleshooting, repair, and maintenance of warehouse equipment and logistics facility systems as needed.

title: Synthetic Data Engineer

At a glance .

BlueGen.ai is a synthetic data platform at the forefront of generative AI and the next generation of privacy-enhancing technology.   • You have computer science and/or artificial intelligence knowledge at the MSc level
  • You have experience in machine learning and general programming, specifically:

.

title: Sr Analytics Analyst- Inbound Logistics
description:

Working collaboratively with cross-functional stakeholders, the Sr. Analytics Analyst translates business requirements into scalable analytics solutions that improve visibility and decision-making for operational, managerial, and executive leadership. Operating with a high degree of autonomy, this role is responsible for the continuous evolution of the department's analytics ecosystem by identifying opportunities to optimize business processes, strengthen analytics capabilities, and support the organization's evolving operational and strategic objectives.

What Your Impact Will Be:

  • Translate Operational Data into Actionable Insights: Analyze and transform inbound logistics and customs compliance data into meaningful, business-ready insights that improve operational visibility, identify trends and opportunities, and support strategic and operational planning.
  • Enable Informed Decision-Making: Provide timely, accurate, and trusted analytics that enable stakeholders to monitor performance, evaluate opportunities, respond to operational challenges, and make informed business decisions.
  • Deliver Scalable Analytics Solutions: Design, develop, implement, and maintain scalable analytics solutions, dashboards, reports, data models, and visualizations that expand self-service access to trusted information and adapt to evolving business requirements.
  • Improve Operational Efficiency: Identify opportunities to streamline business processes, reduce manual effort, eliminate repetitive tasks, automate reporting, and improve operational productivity through data-driven solutions.
  • Curate Business-Ready Datasets: Consolidate, cleanse, validate, and transform logistics and customs compliance data into trusted, reusable datasets that provide a consistent foundation for reporting, analytics, and decision-making.
  • Automate Analytics Workflows: Develop automated data pipelines, workflows, and reporting processes that improve efficiency, reduce manual intervention, and support recurring analytics and operational reporting activities.
  • Ensure Data Quality and Reporting Standards: Establish, maintain, and continuously improve data governance practices, business rules, metric definitions, and reporting standards to ensure consistent, accurate, and reliable analytics across the organization.
  • Partner Across Business Functions: Build collaborative relationships with Operations, Transportation, Customs Compliance, Finance, IT, Supply Chain, and other business partners to understand operational challenges and translate stakeholder requirements into impactful analytics solutions.
  • Champion Analytics Adoption: Drive the successful adoption of analytics solutions by engaging stakeholders, incorporating user feedback, providing user support and training, and promoting data-driven decision-making throughout the organization.
  • Drive Continuous Improvement: Identify opportunities to strengthen analytics capabilities and improve business processes by evaluating emerging technologies, implementing analytics best practices, and recommending innovative solutions that enhance organizational performance.
  • Support Strategic Business Initiatives: Lead and support cross-functional analytics projects, operational improvement initiatives, executive reporting, and strategic analyses that align with business objectives and deliver measurable value.
  • Perform Other Duties as Assigned: Complete additional responsibilities and special projects in support of departmental and organizational objectives.
  • Other Responsibilities: As Assigned by Manager

EXPERIENCE AND EDUCATION

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Data Analytics, Business Analytics, Supply Chain Management, Industrial Engineering, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Five (5) or more years of experience designing, developing, and delivering analytics solutions supporting logistics, transportation, customs compliance, supply chain, distribution, or other operational business functions.
  • Demonstrated experience translating business requirements into scalable analytics solutions through the development of business-ready datasets, automated data pipelines, reporting solutions, and analytics workflows.

REQUIRED KNOWLEDGE AND SKILLS

  • Strong knowledge of modern analytics technologies supporting data integration, automation, cloud-based analytics, and data visualization, including advanced SQL, Incorta, Tableau, Google Cloud Platform (GCP), Python, APIs, or comparable technologies.
  • Demonstrated analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to transform complex operational data into meaningful business insights that drive decision-making.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills with the ability to present complex analytical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences and build effective cross-functional partnerships.
  • Experience supporting analytics for global logistics, transportation, customs compliance, import/export operations, or other supply chain functions.
  • Ability to evaluate and leverage emerging technologies, including artificial intelligence (AI), to enhance analytics capabilities, improve operational efficiency, and support business process optimization.
  • Demonstrated growth mindset, intellectual curiosity, learning agility, and willingness to improve processes through new methods and technologies.

PREFFERED SKILLS

title: Wire Transfers & Payments Specialist
description:
If you are someone wanting to make a difference in the communities that we serve and join the strongest large bank in Kansas City, then Security Bank of Kansas City has a career for you. In addition to our compensation and benefits packages, Security Bank offers full-time employees 11 paid holidays, rewarding and challenging growth opportunities, generous paid time off and discounted banking services.


Position Summary:

The Wire Transfers & Payments Specialist for Security Bank of Kansas City is responsible for the accurate, timely, and secure processing of domestic and international wire transfers, electronic payments, and related banking transactions. This position is ideal for an early-career professional or someone transitioning into financial operations. This position serves as a key operational resource for customers, lenders, relationship managers, and Retail personnel while ensuring transactions comply with Bank policies, regulatory requirements, and applicable payment-network rules.


Essential Duties & Responsibilities

The duties include but are not limited to the following:

  • Process incoming and outgoing domestic and international wire transfers accurately within established deadlines.
  • Review wire requests for completeness, authorization, account information, and adherence to Bank policies and procedures.
  • Verify customer and transaction information and perform required callbacks or authentication procedures.
  • Monitor and manage wire queues, exceptions, rejects, returns, and corrections.
  • Research and resolve wire discrepancies and payment-related inquiries.
  • Process wire amendments, cancellations, recalls, and returns in accordance with applicable procedures.
  • Coordinate with correspondent banks, financial institutions, banking centers, third-party vendors, and customers to resolve payment issues.
  • Maintain accurate documentation, reports, and transactions records.
  • Process and monitor various electronic payment transactions which may include ACH, internal transfers, official checks, cashier’s checks, FedNow, RTP, and other payment services offered by the Bank.
  • Review transactions for completeness, accuracy, and compliance with established controls.
  • Research and resolve ACH returns, exceptions, rejects, and other payment discrepancies.
  • Assist with payment investigations, adjustments, and customer inquiries.
  • Meet daily processing deadlines and service-level expectations.
  • Follow established procedures designed to prevent fraud, errors, and unauthorized transactions.
  • Review transactions for potential fraud, unusual activity, or other risk indicators and escalate concerns appropriately.
  • Follow applicable requirements related to Bank Secrecy Act (BSA), Anti-Money Laundering (AML), Office of Foreign Assets Control (OFAC), and other applicable regulations.
  • Maintain appropriate confidentiality and safeguard customer and Bank information.
  • Complete required documentation and maintain appropriate audit trails.
  • Provide professional and responsive service to customers and Bank employees regarding wire transfers and payment services.
  • Additional duties/tasks as assigned.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Ga aan de slag als Senior Data Engineer bij Acda Consultancy en bouw, optimaliseer en schaal data-gedreven oplossingen die het verschil maken voor organisaties!

Wat zoeken wij?

Wij zoeken een Senior Data Engineer die denkt vanuit datakwaliteit, betrouwbaarheid en businesswaarde. Jij ontwerpt en optimaliseert toekomstbestendige data-architecturen en pipelines en neemt verantwoordelijkheid voor robuuste, efficiënte en schaalbare data-oplossingen. Je werkt graag in cross-functionele, agile teams, bent analytisch sterk en durft bestaande data-oplossingen kritisch te bevragen. Met jouw passie voor data en automatisering realiseer je platformen die organisaties beter laten sturen op inzichten en resultaten.

Je werkt vanuit ons kantoor in Nieuwegein aan moderne data-oplossingen voor onze klanten en adviseert collega’s over de beste aanpak tijdens het ontwikkelproces. Je ontwerpt en bouwt robuuste data-architecturen en pipelines, verwerkt en integreert data uit verschillende bronnen en zorgt dat deze direct bruikbaar is voor analytics, rapportages en AI-toepassingen. Daarnaast ben je verantwoordelijk voor het onderhouden, monitoren en opschalen van bestaande data-platformen, zodat ze betrouwbaar, efficiënt en toekomstbestendig blijven — zonder concessies te doen aan kwaliteit, veiligheid en performance.

Welke skills zoeken wij?

Minimaal 4 jaar ervaring als Data Engineer

Je hebt ervaring met data-architectuur & pipelines bouwen

Je beschikt over Cloud & programmeervaardigheden

  • Sterke communicatieve vaardigheden, vloeiend Nederlands en Engels

Wij bieden:

Een motiverende werkomgeving waar ambitie en transparantie hoog in het vaandel staan met:

  • Een competitief salaris(range is€4000 –€6000bruto per maand), aantrekkelijke pensioenregeling en de mogelijkheid om snel te groeien;
  • Aantrekkelijke mobiliteitsopties, waaronder leaseauto(€800), of eenmobilitetsbudget(€500);
  • Een maandelijkse vergoeding voor een mobiele telefoon van €80;
  • Laptopvan de zaak;
  • Op maat gemaakte trainingen voor professionele groei en leiderschapsontwikkeling;
  • Bonusregeling bij goed presteren;
  • 25vakantiedagen per jaar;
  • Vakantiegeld van 8% van het jaarsalaris;
  • Motiverende werkomgeving waar samenwerking met ambitieuze collega’s en erkenning voor je bijdragen hoog in het vaandel staan;

Locatie

Nieuwegein-hybride

Welkom bij het Data Team (DT)

Veel van onze klanten staan voor grote uitdagingen – de verwachtingen van hun
klanten en medewerkers veranderen sneller dan zij zich kunnen aanpassen.
Tegelijkertijd zorgen nieuwe toetreders tot de markt voor aanzienlijke verstoringen en
winnen zij marktaandeel. Om deze uitdagingen aan te gaan, hebben de klanten van
Acda Consultancy een partner nodig die hen kan helpen om data-gedreven digitale
oplossingen te ontwerpen en te realiseren, die direct en onderscheidend impact
hebben op hun bedrijfsvoering en besluitvorming.

Als onderdeel van het Data Team werk je vanuit ons kantoor in Nieuwegein aan
moderne data-oplossingen voor onze klanten. De belangrijkste taak van het Data
Team is het ontsluiten, verwerken en verrijken van data zodat deze betrouwbaar,
schaalbaar en direct bruikbaar is voor analytics, rapportages en AI-toepassingen.
In deze rol ontwerp en bouw je robuuste data-architecturen en -pipelines. Je werkt
met verschillende databronnen (gestructureerd en ongestructureerd), zorgt voor
efficiënte data-integratie en implementeert data-oplossingen in de cloud. Daarnaast
neem je verantwoordelijkheid voor het optimaliseren, monitoren en schalen van
bestaande data-platformen om te voldoen aan de groeiende behoeften van onze
klanten. Dit alles met als doel het snel leveren van waardevolle inzichten, zonder
concessies te doen aan kwaliteit, veiligheid en performance.

Welke skills zoeken wij?

We komen graag met je in contact als je aan de meeste van de volgende criteria
voldoet:

  • Je hebt een afgeronde HBO- of WO-opleiding in de richting van Informatica,
    Data Science, Software Engineering of een vergelijkbare opleiding;
  • Je hebt +4 jaar ervaring als Data Engineer;
  • Je communiceert goed en beheerst zowel het Nederlands als Engels
    uitstekend, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk;
  • Je hebt ruime ervaring met programmeertalen zoals Python en/of SQL (pré:
    Scala, Java);
  • Je hebt ervaring met het ontwerpen en bouwen van data pipelines (ETL/ELT)
    en data-integraties;
  • Je hebt kennis van en ervaring met moderne data-platformen en –
    architecturen, zoals data lakes, data warehouses en lakehouses;
  • Je hebt ervaring met cloudomgevingen (bij voorkeur Microsoft Azure; ervaring
    met AWS en/of GCP is een plus);
  • Je hebt gewerkt met tooling zoals Azure Data Factory, Databricks, Apache
    Spark, Airflow of vergelijkbaar;
  • Je hebt ervaring met databases en opslagoplossingen (bijv. SQL Server,
    PostgreSQL, Snowflake, BigQuery, Delta Lake);
  • Je hebt basiskennis van CI/CD, versiebeheer (Git) en Infrastructure as Code
    (pré: Terraform of Bicep);
  • Bonus: ervaring met data governance, datakwaliteit, security, streaming
    (Kafka/Event Hubs) en BI-tools (Power BI, Tableau).

Wat bieden wij jou?

Bij Acda Consultancy krijg je de kans om jezelf te zijn, het beste uit jezelf te halen in een high-performance organisatie en te groeien binnen ons snelgroeiende bedrijf . Je komt terecht in een ambitieuze omgeving waarin jij en je collega’s streven naar het beste resultaat en waar transparantie richting de werknemer centraal staat.

title: Big Data Architect IT Consultant Master
description:
Job Title: Big Data Architect, IT Consultant Master

Location: Washington, DC (20003)
Employment Type: Contract
Engagement Type: W2 or 1099 (No C2C)
Final Interview: In Person

Position Summary

Dhaka Technologies Limited Company (DTLC) is hiring a Big Data Architect (IT Consultant Master) on behalf of the District of Columbia Office of the Chief Technology Officer (OCTO). The consultant supports the design, development, implementation, and maintenance of an enterprise Big Data solution as part of the OCTO Data Modernization Effort. This role provides expertise for a Big Data and Data Lake system architecture that supports enterprise data operations for the District of Columbia government, including Internet of Things (IoT) and Smart City projects, the enterprise data warehouse, the open data portal, and data science applications. The architecture includes Databricks, Microsoft Azure platform tools such as Data Lake and Synapse, and data pipeline and ETL development tools such as StreamSets and Azure Data Factory. The platform is designed for District-wide use and integration with other OCTO enterprise data tools such as Esri, Tableau, MicroStrategy, API gateways, and Oracle databases. The selected consultant joins a collaborative senior data team supporting the District Chief Data Officer.

Key Responsibilities

  • Coordinate IT project management, engineering, maintenance, quality assurance, and risk management.
  • Plan, coordinate, and monitor project activities.
  • Develop technical applications to support users.
  • Develop, implement, maintain, and enforce documented standards and procedures for the design, development, installation, modification, and documentation of assigned systems.
  • Provide training on system products and procedures.
  • Perform application upgrades.
  • Perform monitoring, maintenance, and reporting on real-time databases, real-time network and serial data communications, and real-time graphics and logic applications.
  • Troubleshoot problems.
  • Ensure that the project life cycle complies with District standards and procedures.

Requirements

Required Skills and Experience

  • 16+ years planning, coordinating, and monitoring project activities
  • 16+ years leading projects and ensuring compliance with established standards and procedures
  • 5+ years implementing modern Big Data storage and analytics platforms such as Databricks and data lakes
  • 5+ years of knowledge of modern Big Data and data architecture and implementation best practices
  • 5+ years of knowledge of the architecture and implementation of networking, security, and storage on cloud platforms such as Microsoft Azure
  • 5+ years of operations experience for data platforms such as Databricks, including runtime, warehousing, pipelines, auditing, sharing, cost management, and user management
  • 5+ years deploying data tools and storage on cloud platforms such as Microsoft Azure
  • 5+ years of knowledge of data-centric systems for the analysis and visualization of data, such as Tableau, MicroStrategy, ArcGIS, Kibana, and Oracle
  • 5+ years querying structured and unstructured data sources, including SQL and NoSQL databases
  • 5+ years modeling and ingesting data into and between data systems through data pipelines
  • 3+ years with API and web services (REST and SOAP)
  • 3+ years with complex event processing and real-time streaming data
  • 3+ years deploying and managing data science tools and modules such as notebooks and R
  • 3+ years with ETL, data processing, and analytics using languages such as Python, Java, or R

Desired Qualifications

  • Databricks Certified Data Engineer Professional certification (highly desired)
  • 2+ years deploying apps, gateways, agents, and models on data platforms such as Databricks (nice to have)

Education

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Technology or a related field, or equivalent experience

Work Requirements

  • This contract is open to W2 or 1099 candidates only. Corp-to-Corp (C2C) candidates will not be considered.
  • The final interview will be conducted in person.

How to Apply

Qualified candidates should email their resume to talent@dhakatech.us with "Big Data Architect IT Consultant Master (808984)" in the subject line.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
RevoData is a boutique Data & AI consultancy and proud Databricks Gold partner. We focus exclusively on Databricks, allowing us to go deep and do things properly. We help companies across Europe unlock the value in their data, helping them design and build scalable platforms that support real business use cases.

We foster a no-ego, no-nonsense culture where collaboration, proactivity and knowledge sharing are part of everyday work.

Sound like your kind of environment? Then keep scrolling!

About you

You’re a builder who enjoys turning data platforms into something that actually works in production – not just something that looks good on a diagram.

You like being close to the tech, solving real problems, and improving things as you go.

As a Senior Data Engineer at RevoData, you work hands‑on in Databricks environments, helping clients design and build scalable data platforms that support real use cases.

We’d love to talk if

You build production-grade data platforms:
You’ve seen what breaks – and more importantly, how to prevent it. You think about structure, reliability, and maintainability from the start, not as an afterthought.

You know your way around Databricks beyond the basics
You have solid, hands‑on experience with the Databricks ecosystem – including Delta Lake, PySpark, SQL, and Unity Catalog. You understand how to design and implement scalable, maintainable solutions within a broader platform setup.

You make sensible design choices (and can explain them)
You don’t overengineer, but you also don’t cut corners that will hurt later. You understand trade-offs and can adjust based on the context you’re in.

You’re a Python & SQL engineer:
You write clean, maintainable code that runs in production – not just notebooks that “kind of work.”

You’re comfortable being “dropped into” a client environment
Sometimes things are messy. Sometimes requirements are vague. You ask the right questions, bring structure, and help move things from unclear to actionable.

You naturally take ownership
You don’t wait for perfect requirements. You move things forward, communicate clearly, and take responsibility for your work.

  • Databricks certifications (Data Engineer Associate, Professional etc.)
  • Databricks Champion status
  • Fluency in Dutch

What we offer

Tech Playground: Love experimenting? So do we. Play around with Databricks, Terraform, Terragrunt, Asset Bundles, CI/CD, monitoring & alerting tools, Cursor and more.

Unlimited Learning: Take advantage of our partner academies, weekly workshops, and lunch & learns.

Fun Clubs: Join our climbing club, padel club, language club or start your own club!

Work-Life Balance: We trust you to get the job done – whether you’re an early bird or a night owl. Our hybrid set up includes Wednesday’s at our HQ in NDSM, typically two days at the client’s office and the rest is up to you: work from home or join us at the office.

Wellbeing Budget: Monthly €75 net wellbeing budget to spend however you like – some recent spends have included gym memberships, bouldering shoes, a Calm-app subscription or a trip to the hairdresser!

Allowances: Every month work from home, travel & internet/phone allowance.

Additional Perks: Pension plan, permanent contract, lunch at the office, quarterly events, workations & a pet-friendly office in the heart of NDSM!

We'd love to meet you!

We value getting to know you better, and our final interview takes place in person at our Amsterdam office. Please note, we cannot provide visa sponsorships as we are not registered as a referee employer with the IND.

Additional info

  • RevoData has been growing quickly, and we’re ready for the next chapter – with multiple start dates available in 2026.
  • We are open to hiring at Senior level for this role. Our Senior salary range is €65,000-€90,000 per year. As part of the hiring process, candidates are benchmarked during the technical assessment. If your skills and experience align more closely with a different level, we will discuss the corresponding salary band with you.

title: Leave Administrator
description:
GFT is seeking a knowledgeable and service-oriented Leave of Absence Administrator to join our Human Resources team. This role provides an opportunity to make a meaningful difference in the employee experience by helping employees navigate leaves of absence and workplace accommodations during some of the most important and often complex moments in their lives.

The Leave of Absence Administrator will manage GFT's leave programs and serve as a trusted resource to employees, managers, HR Business Partners, Payroll, and our third-party administrator. The ideal candidate combines strong knowledge of leave administration and regulatory requirements with empathy, sound judgment, attention to detail, and a commitment to delivering an exceptional employee experience.

What you will be challenged to do

  • Deliver a consistent, responsive, and supportive employee experience throughout the leave and accommodation process
  • Manage multiple leave programs while ensuring compliance with federal, state, and local requirements
  • Serve as a trusted resource to employees and managers regarding leave eligibility, processes, documentation, and return-to-work requirements
  • Coordinate effectively across HR, Payroll, managers, employees, and external partners to ensure seamless administration
  • Identify opportunities to strengthen leave administration processes, policies, and overall program effectiveness

In this capacity you will be responsible for the following

  • Manage the end-to-end administration of leaves of absence, including FMLA, short- and long-term disability, military, personal, parental, and other company-sponsored leave programs
  • Guide employees and managers through leave options, eligibility requirements, documentation, timelines, and status throughout the leave process
  • Serve as the primary liaison among employees, managers, HR Business Partners, Payroll, and GFT's third-party leave administrator to ensure timely and accurate coordination
  • Maintain complete and accurate leave records and track employee absences within GFT's HCM system
  • Partner closely with Payroll to ensure accurate processing of pay and time related to employee leaves
  • Review workplace accommodation requests and partner with appropriate stakeholders to identify reasonable accommodation options in accordance with the ADA, applicable laws, and company policies
  • Monitor changes to federal, state, and local leave requirements and recommend updates to policies and procedures to maintain compliance
  • Support the administration of benefits programs and annual enrollment activities, including vendor testing and employee communications
  • Maintain confidentiality and exercise sound judgment when managing sensitive employee information and complex situations
  • Identify and implement process improvements that increase efficiency, consistency, and the employee experience

What you will bring to our firm

  • Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field
  • 3+ years of experience in Human Resources, benefits, or leave administration
  • Working knowledge of FMLA, short- and long-term disability, leaves of absence, and applicable state leave requirements
  • Understanding of ADA workplace accommodation requirements and the interactive process
  • Strong attention to detail with demonstrated ability to maintain accurate records and manage multiple cases simultaneously
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to explain complex information clearly and compassionately
  • Demonstrated ability to handle sensitive and confidential information with professionalism and discretion
  • Strong problem-solving, analytical, organizational, and customer-service skills
  • Experience working with HRIS/HCM and third-party benefits or leave administration platforms
  • Ability to collaborate effectively across HR, Payroll, business leadership, employees, and external partners

Preferred Qualifications

  • PHR or other relevant HR certification
  • Workday experience
  • Knowledge of workers' compensation requirements
  • Experience supporting leave administration within a multi-state organization
Compensation:The salary range for this role is $70,000 - $110,000. Salary is dependent upon experience and geographic location. Featured Benefits: • Hybrid (in-person and remote) work environment.• Comprehensive benefits package including wellness programs, parental leave, and pet insurance, in addition to medical, dental, vision, disability, and life insurance.• Tax-deferred 401(k) savings plan.• Competitive paid-time-off (PTO) accrual.• Tuition reimbursement for continued education.• Commitment to professional development, access to internal and external training programs, and support of active participation in professional organizations• Incentive compensation for eligible positions.

title: Industrial Engineer & Data Scientist Eindhoven Master 1-5 Years
description:
Are you an industrial engineer and data scientist interested in using your knowledge of data-driven insights to improve production processes in the automotive and high-tech industries? We would like to get in touch with you!

At Nobleo Manufacturing, we believe there are always opportunities to produce faster, better, and more cost-effectively. As an Industrial engineer & Data Scientist your role involves acquiring comprehensive knowledge of products and manufacturing processes at the customers’ sites, understanding the functionality, feasibility, risks, and applications of the product and processes involved. You will combine your engineering mindset with data-driven insights to improve these production processes in the automotive and high-tech industries.

Role and responsibilities

As an Industrial Engineer & Data Scientist, you will be actively involved in setting up, improving, and optimising production and business processes, sometimes being engaged directly from the development phase onward. With a strong data-driven approach and the use of Lean and Six Sigma methodologies, you initiate improvements, eliminate waste, and propose solutions that drive measurable results.

In this role you will develop and validate models and algorithms to simulate and optimize manufacturing processes, while defining and visualizing KPIs in collaboration with stakeholders using tools like Python, Excel, and Power BI. The improvements you introduce are quantifiable and contribute to the customers’ business objectives. When implementing process improvements, you consider essential preconditions such as safety, quality delivery reliability, and costs. In co-operation with stakeholders, you will (re)design processes necessary for the correct execution of the production process. Ultimately, your work contributes to achieving optimal production output, with a strong focus on increasing efficiency, ensuring quality, and reducing cost. You will take lead in improvement initiatives, ensuring that solutions are based on real production data.

What do we expect from you?

  • You have a (technical) master’s degree, preferably a strong affinity with manufacturing, engineering and data.
  • 1-5 Years of experience in a relevant technical environment (high-tech, automotive).
  • You have strong analytical skills and a structured, precise working style.
  • Besides being precise, you are also a result- and customer-oriented team player with strong communication skills.
  • Strong knowledge and skills in data analysis tools like Python, Excel and/or Power BI.
  • Affinity with programming and process simulation.
  • Entrepreneurial mindset and a passion for continuous improvement.
  • Fluent in Dutch and English, both written and spoken.
  • You are quality-conscious and enjoy contributing to improvement processes, both internally and externally.

What can you expect from Nobleo Manufacturing?

title: Machine Learning Engineer V
description:
What You'll Do

Avalara’s Content Engineering platform supports the compliance content that helps customers manage complex obligations across jurisdictions and product lines. Avalara is modernizing the compliance content lifecycle by building agentic scalable, reliable, cloud-native systems that make it faster and easier to onboard, validate, enrich, and deliver new content types.

This role exists to lead the design and delivery of enterprise-grade agentic applications and machine learning systems that integrate into Avalara’s products, platforms, and internal workflows. The Machine Learning Engineer V owns complex AI systems from architecture through production, including full-stack application integration, backend services, agent orchestration, model and agent evaluation, deployment, observability, support, and ongoing improvement.

This is not a pure machine learning operations role. This role requires a senior engineer who builds agentic systems, integrates them with mainstream applications, applies sound software development life cycle practices, and operates production AI capabilities as secure, reliable, scalable product systems. This role sits within Content Engineering team and you will be reporting to Senior Manager, ML Engineering. This is a #LI-Remote role.


What Your Responsibilities Will Be

  • Lead the architecture and delivery of enterprise-grade agentic applications that integrate with Avalara products, Content Engineering platforms, services, workflows, and user experiences.

  • Build end-to-end AI-enabled systems that include backend services, application programming interfaces, data access patterns, agent orchestration, retrieval, tool integration, user-facing application components, evaluation, deployment, monitoring, and production support.

  • Design reusable platform capabilities and cloud-native services that support new compliance content types and improve the compliance content lifecycle.

  • Make architecture decisions that improve scalability, reliability, resiliency, observability, maintainability, security, and operational efficiency.

  • Operationalize AI capabilities using modern orchestration and agentic frameworks to improve automation, accuracy, delivery speed, and system quality.

  • Integrate agents with enterprise applications, data sources, workflow systems, and cloud-native services while maintaining secure and maintainable system boundaries.

  • Establish engineering standards for software design, code quality, continuous integration and delivery, automated testing, deployment automation, observability, incident response, and production operations.

  • Improve platform performance, latency, throughput, reliability, and cost efficiency at scale.

  • Apply evaluation, monitoring, and deployment practices that improve AI-enabled system performance in production.

  • Work across model providers and model families to improve model selection, routing, quality, latency, reliability, and spend.

  • Partner with engineering, infrastructure, product, security, data, and domain teams to deliver measurable customer and business outcomes.

  • Mentor engineers, lead design reviews, create reusable engineering patterns, and raise team capability in distributed systems, cloud engineering, software architecture, full-stack development, and responsible AI adoption.


What You'll Need to be Successful

  • B.S. in Computer Science or Engineering.

  • 12+ years of experience in software engineering, machine learning engineering, applied machine learning, generative AI, enterprise application development, or production AI systems.

  • Experience building scalable, distributed production systems using cloud-native architecture and at least one major cloud platform, such as Amazon Web Services, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform.

  • Experience building enterprise agentic applications that use large language models, tools, workflows, retrieval, application programming interfaces, and application integration patterns.

  • Experience integrating AI capabilities into production applications, backend services, user workflows, developer platforms, or enterprise systems.

  • Strong software engineering skills in Python and experience designing backend services, application programming interfaces, distributed systems, and cloud-native platforms.

  • Full-stack engineering experience across backend services, application programming interfaces, relational databases, scalable data access patterns, frontend-backend contracts, authentication, and modern web technologies.

  • Experience applying the software development life cycle end to end, including requirements analysis, architecture, design, implementation, testing, release planning, deployment, monitoring, incident response, support, and continuous improvement.

  • Experience shipping and supporting production machine learning, large language model, or AI-enabled application systems beyond experimentation or research prototypes.

  • Hands-on experience with retrieval-augmented generation, embeddings, prompt design, evaluation, classification, agent tool-use patterns, small language models, or large language model-powered workflows.

  • Experience with cloud-native systems, asynchronous or distributed workflows, observability, monitoring, deployment automation, and production operations.

  • Ability to design for security, access control, governance, compliance, reliability, maintainability, resiliency, and cost efficiency.

  • Strong system design skills and ability to lead technically complex initiatives across multiple stakeholders.

  • Ability to mentor engineers, lead design reviews, and raise technical standards across teams.


Avalara is an AI-first Company

AI is embedded in our workflows, decision-making, and products. Success here requires embracing AI as an essential capability.

  • You’ll bring experience using AI and AI-related technologies, ready to thrive here.

  • You’ll apply AI every day to business challenges - improving efficiency, contributing solutions, and driving results for your team, our company, and our customers.

  • You’ll grow with AI by staying curious about new trends and best practices, and by sharing what you learn so others can benefit too.


How We'll Take Care of You

Total Rewards

In addition to a great compensation package, paid time off, and paid parental leave, many Avalara employees are eligible for bonuses.

Health & Wellness
Benefits vary by location but generally include private medical, life, and disability insurance.

Inclusive culture and diversity
Avalara strongly supports diversity, equity, and inclusion, and is committed to integrating them into our business practices and our organizational culture. We also have a total of 8 employee-run resource groups, each with senior leadership and exec sponsorship.


What You Need To Know About Avalara

We’re defining the relationship between tax and tech.

We’ve already built an industry-leading cloud compliance platform, processing over 54 billion customer API calls and over 6.6 million tax returns a year. Our growth is real - we're a billion dollar business - and we’re not slowing down until we’ve achieved our mission - to be part of every transaction in the world.

We’re bright, innovative, and disruptive, like the orange we love to wear. It captures our quirky spirit and optimistic mindset. It shows off the culture we’ve designed, that empowers our people to win. We’ve been different from day one. Join us, and your career will be too.

We’re An Equal Opportunity Employer

Supporting diversity and inclusion is a cornerstone of our company — we don’t want people to fit into our culture, but to enrich it. All qualified candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, age, gender, national orientation, disability, sexual orientation, US Veteran status, or any other factor protected by law. If you require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, please let us know.

title: Regional Dir Operations

Our executive team started their own careers as therapists working with patients, and we take great pride in promoting from within the company.We also have a team of clinicians who provide continuing training, as well as systems and proven protocols to help ensure everyone is providing therapy in the most effective way for the patients and the most compliant way to help ensure our SNF partners are covered.Why Reliant:

Responsibilities

Regional Director of Operations

Summary: Responsible for directing the clinical rehabilitation operations of multiple practices within a geographic market under the supervision of the Regional Vice President (RVP). The RDO is responsible for achieving specific financial, employee relations, customer service, and clinical objectives through strong leadership and effective management of staff and customers. Maintains professional conduct, including positive levels of interaction and rapport with facilities and clients. Represents Reliant Rehabilitation’s commitment to quality & service in all interactions with facility and clients, as well as adheres to Reliant Rehabilitation’s Policies and Procedures. Adheres to all state and federal regulations.Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Schedule and deploy clinical staff to meet facility program needs.
  • Directs the provision of quality patient care and provides patient care skills development opportunities as appropriate to ensure quality care in the facility, and delivers patient care as required within scope of practice.
  • Ensure Reliant Rehabilitation and Customer Policies and Procedures, and Patient Care Standards are met in assigned facilities.
  • Implementation and management of staffing objectives for their geographic area.
  • Serve as a clinical resource by line of business (ex. therapy type) as appropriate and conduct routine clinical/ compliance audits in assigned and adjacent areas as delegated.
  • Direct efficient caseload management and scheduling of patients within facility(ies) in geographic market assigned. Includes, but not limited to, resident screening, assignment of patients, review of treatment outcomes, assurance of efficiency requirements, and implementation of clinical programs.
  • Responsible for the review and analysis of facility case mix and contribution margin.
  • Communicate with facility staff and referral sources to obtain clinical information on new or potential admissions to facility.
  • Direct development of plans of action and ensure good outcomes of deficiencies noted in routine clinical audits and/or compliance investigations.
  • Manage new facility start-ups and labor costs within geographic area.
  • Manage practice to meet or exceed financial objectives; participate in the development of financial goals.

  • Develop corrective plans of action of risks or concerns identified and ensure good outcomes of deficiencies noted.
  • Implement ongoing documentation peer review system within assigned facilities.

  • May require travel time up to 75%. Must be able to travel between facilities during scheduled hours. Must be able to work varying hours and shifts, including weekends and holidays.
  • Must comply with the position description for the discipline of current license.

Qualifications

Education/Experience:

  • Associates degree, or higher, in Occupational Therapy (OT), Physical Therapy (PT), or Speech-Language Pathology (SLP) required.
  • Minimum of five years clinical experience required, including at least three years in patient care and one to two years of successful clinical management.

Computer Skills:

  • Proficient knowledge of Microsoft Office (Outlook, Word, Excel, Power Point, etc.)
  • Basic Internet navigation skills

Certificates and Licenses:

  • Valid credentials that indicate meeting state regulatory board requirements to practice in state assigned required. Must meet other required regulatory standards to practice.

Supervisory Responsibilities:

  • Supervises the work of others in multiple facilities within the geographical area to include, but not limited to: training, scheduling, coaching, resolving issues, maintaining personnel records, and assisting with discipline and terminations.

title: Product Manager, Direct to Consumer
description:
Job Title:

Product Manager, Direct to Consumer

Requisition ID:

R028088

Job Description:

Job Title: Product Manager

Reporting To: Associate Director of Product

Department: Call of Duty: Mobile Product Team

Location: Santa Monica, California

Your Mission

As a Product Manager, you will help drive growth of direct to consumer revenues for Call of Duty: Mobile, including our own web store and third party stores. You will help design the strategy and roadmap, ideate improvements, and generate insights from looking at performance, to drive revenue growth.

You will lead and partner closely with various stakeholder groups, including our external web store payment partners, product team, marketing team, and CODM development team at Tencent in China, to gain alignment and execute on your plans. You will also generate robust analysis and actionable insights into the performance of the store, to inform our future direction. You’ll report to the Associate Director of Product, Direct to Consumer, who leads our direct to consumer efforts.

This role is based in our Santa Monica, CA office and follows an onsite work schedule of four days per week. Work arrangements may change at the company's discretion to meet business needs.

Main responsibilities

  • Drive direct to consumer revenue growth

  • Generate a deep understanding of our direct to consumer performance through analysis and player research

  • Generate ideas to improve our exclusive offers, seasonal promotions, loyalty/retention offers, checkout improvements, personalization features, and growth experiments, to improve our overall roadmap and strategy

  • Ideate, design, execute and analyze A/B tests, and apply learnings to improve our roadmap

  • Work closely with our internal teams and payment partners to improve our store design and value propositions, and our marketing team to drive more traffic to the store

  • Communicate performance, product plans, and improvement recommendations to stakeholders across the organization

Minimum Requirements

  • 5+ years of experience in product management or another relevant role

  • Able to clearly synthesize insights from analysis and research to diagnose root causes of problems and generate recommendations

  • Experience using SQL, Tableau, Excel, or other analytical tools to generate insights from data

  • Experience using AI tools to help improve the quality and efficiency of your work

  • Strong influence skills, able to work well with others across cross-functional teams

  • Strong execution skills with bias to action and track record in hitting business outcomes

  • Strong structured and critical thinking skills, able to define a strategy and build a plan to hit goals

  • Able to do meetings in the evening with colleagues in Asia (typically no more than once or twice a week)

Extra Points

  • Experience with similar mobile games or on similar direct-to-consumer initiatives is helpful but not required for this role

  • Basic understanding of statistics, including experience with A/B testing

Our World

At Activision, we strive to create the most iconic brands in gaming and entertainment. We’re driven by our mission to deliver unrivaled gaming experiences for the world to enjoy, together. We are home to some of the most beloved entertainment franchises including Call of Duty®, Crash Bandicoot™, Tony Hawk’s™ Pro Skater™, and Guitar Hero®. As a leading worldwide developer, publisher and distributor of interactive entertainment and products, our “press start” is simple: delight hundreds of millions of players around the world with innovative, fun, thrilling, and engaging entertainment experiences.

We’re not just looking back at our decades-long legacy; we’re forging ahead to keep advancing gameplay with some of the most popular titles and sophisticated technology in the world. We have bold ambitions to create the most inclusive company as we know our success comes from the passionate, creative, and diverse teams within our organization.

We’re in the business of delivering fun and unforgettable entertainment for our player community to enjoy. And our future opportunities have never been greater — this could be your opportunity to level up.

Ready to Activate Your Future?

We love hearing from anyone who is enthusiastic about changing the games industry. Not sure you meet all qualifications? Let us decide! Research shows that women and members of other under-represented groups tend to not apply to jobs when they think they may not meet every qualification, when, in fact, they often do! We are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive environment and strongly encourage you to apply.

We are committed to working with and providing reasonable assistance to individuals with physical and mental disabilities. If you are a disabled individual requiring an accommodation to apply for an open position, please email your request to accommodations@activisionblizzard.com. General employment questions cannot be accepted or processed here. Thank you for your interest.

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status, among other characteristics.

Rewards

We provide a suite of benefits that promote physical, emotional and financial well-being for ‘Every World’ - we’ve got our employees covered! Subject to eligibility requirements, the Company offers comprehensive benefits including:

  • Medical, dental, vision, health savings account or health reimbursement account, healthcare spending accounts, dependent care spending accounts, life and AD&D insurance, disability insurance;
  • 401(k) with Company match, tuition reimbursement, charitable donation matching;
  • Paid holidays and vacation, paid sick time, floating holidays, compassion and bereavement leaves, parental leave;
  • Mental health & wellbeing programs, fitness programs, free and discounted games, and a variety of other voluntary benefit programs like supplemental life & disability, legal service, ID protection, rental insurance, and others;

Eligibility to participate in these benefits may vary for part time and temporary full-time employees and interns with the Company. You can learn more by visiting .

description:
32 – 40 uur | Maandsalaris: €4.230 - €6.614 | Locatie: Tilburg/Hybride | Afdeling: ICT Beheer, team Data

Wat doe je als senior data engineer?

Als senior data engineer ontwerp, beheer en optimaliseer je data-architecturen en ETL-processen voor interne en externe klanten. Je speelt een sleutelrol in de regie en doorontwikkeling van het Microsoft Fabric-platform, inclusief AI-toepassingen en moderne data-oplossingen. In het kort:

  • Toepassen van AI-functionaliteiten binnen Fabric.
  • Ontwerpen en implementeren van securitymaatregelen.
  • Ontwikkelen van notebooks en geavanceerde analyses in Python/R.

Wat bieden wij?

  • Een goede werksfeer met leuke collega’s."We werken echt samen, resultaatgericht en de manier van werken is heel professioneel" - Marloes.
  • Een bruto maandsalaris tussen de € 4.230,59 en € 6.614,12 (voor 40 uur) afhankelijk van kennis en ervaring. Per jaar is dit maximaal € 92.330,44 inclusief vakantiegeld en een dertiende maand.
  • Drie keer per jaar een innovatieweek waar je jezelf mag verdiepen in ontwikkelingen en trends.
  • Opleidingen en trainingen die je helpen in je werk vergoeden we volledig.
  • Flexibele werktijden en de mogelijkheid om thuis werken en werken op kantoor te combineren. We zijn minimaal één keer per week op kantoor.
  • Een vaste internetvergoeding per maand.
  • Een jaarcontract, met het doel om dit om te zetten naar een contract voor onbepaalde tijd.
  • En misschien wel het belangrijkste: je betekent echt iets in de zorg.
    "Iedereen hier heeft het 'VECOZO-hart' en werkt aan hetzelfde doel: kostenbeheersing in de zorg. Het is echt een mooi bedrijf om voor te werken" - Wendy.

Dit breng jij mee:

  • Hbo/wo werk- en denkniveau.
  • Minimaal 5 jaar ervaring in data-architectuur en ETL-processen.
  • Kennis van Microsoft Fabric, AI-toepassingen, moderne data-architectuur en -modellering, securityconcepten Azure Data Factory, SQL Server, Python, R, KUSTO.
  • Je krijgt energie van het spreken voor een groep.

VECOZO staat voor veilige communicatie in de zorg. We zorgen voor veilige en efficiënte uitwisseling van administratieve gegevens in de zorg. Zo’n 45.000 zorgaanbieders en alle zorgverzekeraars, zorgkantoren en gemeenten zijn bij ons aangesloten. Met slimme IT-systemen maken we voor hen het uitwisselen van gegevens veilig en makkelijk mogelijk.

Over het team

Je komt te werken in een hecht team van negen data-professionals, waaronder data engineers, BI-specialisten en een ETL-specialist. Samen zorgen we voor betrouwbare data, slimme analyses en innovatieve oplossingen die de zorgsector vooruithelpen. Dinsdag is onze vaste kantoordag: we zoeken dan actief de verbinding, bijvoorbeeld door samen te lunchen of een wandeling te maken. We werken volgens scrum en hebben oog voor samenwerking, kennisdeling en persoonlijke ontwikkeling.

title: Engineering Director, Storage
description:
Every day, tens of millions of people come to Roblox to explore, create, play, learn, and connect with friends in 3D immersive digital experiences– all created by our global community of developers and creators.

At Roblox, we’re building the tools and platform that empower our community to bring any experience that they can imagine to life. Our vision is to reimagine the way people come together, from anywhere in the world, and on any device. We’re on a mission to connect a billion people with optimism and civility, and looking for amazing talent to help us get there.

A career at Roblox means you’ll be working to shape the future of human interaction, solving unique technical challenges at scale, and helping to create safer, more civil shared experiences for everyone.

Roblox's infrastructure supports over 100M DAUs and recently supported a world record 45M players at the same time. The scale is real.

As Director of Engineering, you will own the technical strategy, design, delivery, and operation of Roblox's storage systems. The challenge is scale, efficiency, reliability, and innovation all at once. We are mostly on-prem but also in the cloud — yes, we're actually building a lot of this ourselves, and yes, we know how hard that is. We've got the scale and the talent to do it.

You've spent your career deep in storage: databases, caches, queues, object storage. You understand that reliability is the most important feature of any system. You care deeply about the success of the internal and external customers who depend on these systems. You're excited to shepherd a fast-growing platform from the nearly 1 exabyte we have today to a multi-exabyte deployment that will power some of the most interesting AI workloads in the industry.

You will

  • Own the technical strategy, architecture, and roadmap for Roblox's storage systems, including distributed databases, caches, queues, object storage, and encryption infrastructure
  • Ensure our storage platform scales by orders of magnitude while remaining reliable and efficient
  • Partner closely with Data Platform, Infrastructure, and product engineering teams to align storage capabilities with Roblox's technical and business needs
  • Build, grow, and retain a world-class storage engineering team — and develop the next generation of technical leaders within it
  • Drive operational excellence: define and hold the bar on reliability, on-call practices, and incident response
  • Own your systems end-to-end, including participation in on-call rotation for critical incidents

You have

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field
  • 10+ years of experience in storage, infrastructure, or distributed systems roles, including hands-on experience building and operating custom database systems - not just deploying off-the-shelf solutions - plus depth in at least several of: caching systems, object storage, message queues, or data streaming
  • 5+ years in engineering leadership, managing teams through ambiguity to deliver critical, production-scale systems
  • A track record of building reliable, high-availability systems at significant scale (millions of users, petabyte-scale data, or equivalent)
  • Strong operational instincts — you raise the bar on reliability and execution, not just vision
  • Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional partners and earn trust across engineering, product, and leadership
  • Comfort with ambiguity and a bias toward learning: you go deep on tech stacks that are new to you and bring others along

title: Senior Radiation Therapist (44450)

location: 2800 E State HW114 Ste 100 Trophy Club TX 76262 - Trophy Club, TX 76262
description:
SENIOR RADIATION THERAPIST

Department: Radiation Oncology
Company: Urology Clinics of North Texas, PLLC / Cancer Centers of North Texas
Reports To: Chief Radiation Therapist and/or Radiation Oncology Leadership
FLSA Status: Non-Exempt
Employment Status: Full-Time
Schedule: Day Shift

JOB SUMMARY

The Senior Radiation Therapist is an experienced clinical professional responsible for the safe, accurate, and compassionate delivery of radiation therapy services to patients undergoing cancer treatment. In addition to performing the full scope of Radiation Therapist responsibilities, the Senior Radiation Therapist serves as a clinical resource to other Radiation Therapists and members of the Radiation Oncology team.

This position provides advanced clinical support for complex treatment setups, treatment delivery, imaging, CT simulation, workflow coordination, quality assurance, and troubleshooting. The Senior Radiation Therapist also assists with staff orientation and training, promotes consistency with established clinical protocols and departmental procedures, and supports continuous improvement initiatives within Radiation Oncology.

The Senior Radiation Therapist works collaboratively with Radiation Oncologists, Medical Physicists, Dosimetrists, Nursing, Radiation Therapists, and other members of the oncology care team to ensure safe, efficient, and high-quality patient care.

This position does not have primary responsibility for formal staff supervision or performance management unless specifically assigned.

ESSENTIAL JOB DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Patient Care and Radiation Treatment Delivery

  • Safely and accurately administer prescribed radiation therapy treatments in accordance with physician prescriptions, treatment plans, departmental procedures, and applicable regulatory requirements.

  • Review treatment prescriptions, treatment parameters, imaging, documentation, and required approvals prior to initiating treatment.

  • Accurately position patients and reproduce treatment setups utilizing appropriate immobilization and positioning devices.

  • Demonstrate advanced proficiency with complex treatment setups and treatment techniques.

  • Perform treatment imaging and image-guided radiation therapy (IGRT) procedures in accordance with established protocols.

  • Recognize treatment setup discrepancies and take appropriate action before proceeding with treatment.

  • Monitor patients during treatment and recognize changes in patient condition that require clinical evaluation or intervention.

  • Promptly communicate patient concerns, treatment-related issues, or changes in clinical condition to the Radiation Oncologist, nurse, or other appropriate member of the care team.

  • Maintain patient privacy, dignity, comfort, and safety throughout treatment.

  • Provide compassionate and professional care to patients and their families throughout the course of radiation therapy.

CT Simulation and Treatment Preparation

  • Perform CT simulation procedures in accordance with physician directives and established departmental protocols.

  • Prepare patients for simulation and treatment planning procedures.

  • Utilize appropriate patient positioning, immobilization, and reproducibility techniques.

  • Verify patient identification, treatment site, physician orders, and required documentation prior to simulation.

  • Assist with complex simulations and specialized patient setups.

  • Accurately document simulation procedures and communicate pertinent information to Dosimetry, Medical Physics, Radiation Oncology physicians, and other appropriate team members.

Senior Clinical Support

  • Serve as an experienced clinical resource for Radiation Therapists and other members of the Radiation Oncology team.

  • Provide guidance and assistance with complex treatment setups, treatment delivery, imaging, simulation, and workflow-related questions.

  • Assist Radiation Therapists in troubleshooting clinical and treatment-related issues and escalate concerns when appropriate.

  • Support consistent application of departmental policies, procedures, treatment protocols, and safety standards.

  • Assist with the orientation, training, and clinical development of newly hired Radiation Therapists and other appropriate team members.

  • Serve as a preceptor or clinical resource for Radiation Therapy students when assigned.

  • Provide constructive clinical guidance and support to team members while maintaining a collaborative and professional work environment.

  • Assist leadership in identifying training needs, workflow concerns, and opportunities to improve clinical operations.

  • Support the implementation of new treatment techniques, equipment, technology, and clinical processes.

  • Provide clinical coverage and assistance as necessary to support departmental and patient care needs.

Quality Assurance and Patient Safety

  • Perform assigned equipment checks and quality assurance activities in accordance with departmental procedures.

  • Follow established radiation safety requirements and ALARA principles.

  • Maintain knowledge of and compliance with applicable regulatory, accreditation, safety, and organizational requirements.

  • Identify potential treatment errors, safety concerns, process breakdowns, or deviations from established protocols and immediately escalate concerns through appropriate channels.

  • Participate in departmental quality assurance, patient safety, and process improvement activities.

  • Assist with reviewing and improving treatment workflows and clinical processes to promote accuracy, efficiency, and patient safety.

  • Participate in incident review, process evaluation, or corrective action activities as requested by Radiation Oncology leadership.

  • Maintain a strong culture of safety and encourage team members to appropriately identify and communicate potential safety concerns.

Documentation and Information Systems

  • Accurately and timely document treatment, simulation, imaging, and other required clinical information in ARIA or the designated Oncology Information System.

  • Review treatment records for accuracy and completeness.

  • Maintain appropriate documentation in accordance with organizational policies, regulatory requirements, and professional standards.

  • Demonstrate proficiency with applicable Radiation Oncology systems, including ARIA, Eclipse, and other clinical technology utilized by the department.

  • Maintain confidentiality of patient information in accordance with HIPAA and organizational requirements.

Patient Education and Communication

  • Explain treatment procedures and expectations to patients in a manner that is understandable, compassionate, and appropriate to the patient's needs.

  • Answer patient questions within the Radiation Therapist's scope of practice and refer clinical questions to the appropriate healthcare professional.

  • Recognize and respond appropriately to patient anxiety, discomfort, or concerns.

  • Maintain effective communication with patients, family members, physicians, and members of the multidisciplinary care team.

Teamwork and Department Operations

  • Collaborate effectively with Radiation Oncologists, Medical Physicists, Dosimetrists, Nursing, Radiation Therapists, and other clinical and administrative team members.

  • Assist with maintaining efficient patient flow and daily treatment operations.

  • Communicate treatment delays, equipment concerns, scheduling issues, or other operational challenges to appropriate leadership.

  • Assist with departmental coverage and workflow adjustments as necessary to meet patient care needs.

  • Participate in departmental meetings, training, continuing education, and other organizational activities as required.

  • Demonstrate professionalism, accountability, dependability, and effective communication in interactions with patients and team members.

  • Perform other duties and responsibilities as assigned within the scope of the position.

WORK ENVIRONMENT

The Senior Radiation Therapist works primarily in a Radiation Oncology clinical environment and may have occupational exposure to patients with infectious illnesses, bodily fluids, radiation-producing equipment, and other conditions typically associated with a healthcare setting.

title: Chief Engineer (Optical Comms)
description:
About Apolink

Apolink is building the first-ever backward-compatible data relay constellation in low Earth orbit. By enabling efficient data aggregation and relay through our hybrid RF-optical inter-satellite link (ISL) architecture, we support scalable and resilient space infrastructure across commercial, federal, and defense applications.

About The Role:

The Chief Engineer (Optical) is the company’s technical lead for optical communications across our LEO data relay constellation. They own the optical architecture, requirements, link design, and verification, and lead technical decisions with our optical terminal vendor. The vendor handles terminal manufacturing, while this role remains hands-on with analysis, integration, and testing. This is a sole-contributor leadership role.

Responsibilities:

  • Own optical ISL and feeder-link architecture: wavelength plan, modulation and coding, aperture and divergence sizing, data rate vs range tradespace.

  • Develop and maintain end-to-end optical link budgets, including coherent receiver sensitivity, PAT margin, platform jitter, point-ahead, Doppler, stray light, fade statistics, and BER against realistic FEC.

  • Author optical requirements and ICDs, and manage flowdown to the vendor and to internal bus, flight software, and ground teams.

  • Direct the vendor technically: down-select, diligence, SOW and NRE scoping, design review participation, and accountability for performance and schedule.

  • Adjudicate R&D direction with the vendor; what warrants NRE investment, what is technically unviable, what we buy versus co-develop.

  • May lead a ZR-800G-class coherent transceiver NRE with the optical terminal.

  • Maintain compliance with applicable standards, including CCSDS O3K and SDA OCT where relevant to federal programs.

Qualifications:

  • Direct, hands-on experience with LEO-LEO optical inter-satellite links: designing, building, or verifying crosslink terminals between spacecraft in low Earth orbit.

  • 6+ years in free-space optical communications, coherent optical transport, or spaceborne photonics.

  • MS or PhD in optics, EE, or physics, or equivalent demonstrated depth.

  • Demonstrated experience directing vendor technical performance and NRE programs.

  • Capacity to exercise independent technical judgment as the sole optical authority and be accountable for it.

Preferred:

  • Direct experience with 400ZR, 800ZR, OpenZR+, or OIF coherent pluggables.

  • Flight heritage on an optical comms payload.

Benefits:

  • Competitive salary and benefits package

  • Meaningful early-stage equity

  • Opportunity to own optical for a constellation end to end

  • Medical, dental, vision, 401(k), relocation assistance

    Salary:     $180,000-$220,000

To conform to the U.S. Government space technology export regulations, including the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) you must be a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident of the U.S., protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3), or eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State.

title: Astrodynamics Lead (Founding Role)
description:
About Apolink

Apolink is building the first-ever backward-compatible data relay constellation in low Earth orbit. By enabling efficient data aggregation and relay through our hybrid RF-optical inter-satellite link (ISL) architecture, we support scalable and resilient space infrastructure across commercial, federal, and defense applications.

About The Role

In this role, you'll design the constellation, verify RAAN and phasing, and run the coverage analysis that shows which architectures meet customer SLAs. You'll also build the propulsion and Δv budgets for deployment, station-keeping, collision avoidance, and de-orbit. This starts with our upcoming paired demonstration satellite mission and scales to the full LEO relay constellation. You'll work directly with the bus, propulsion, and optical/RF link teams and turn orbital analysis into hardware and mission requirements. The role is hands-on end to end: modeling, trade studies, maneuver planning, and on-orbit operations.

Responsibilities:

  • Design and own constellation architecture: plane count, altitude, inclination, LTAN, and intra- and inter-plane phasing, traded against coverage, launch cost, and ISL geometry

  • Run SLA-grade coverage analysis on link-closing access: handover continuity, window durations, gap statistics, and percent-time-covered for specific target orbits.

  • Work with the RF team to close coverage and access analysis against real RF link budgets rather than geometric visibility alone. This means computing access windows only where range, elevation, off-boresight angle, Doppler, and slant-path losses support the required data rate and margin.

  • Model ISL relative geometry between constellation members and customer spacecraft, including range, angular constraints, and handover timing. Iterate with the RF and optical teams so orbit design and link design converge.

  • Develop Δv and propellant budgets for drag makeup across the solar cycle, station-keeping, collision avoidance, and end-of-life disposal. Provide thruster and propellant sizing inputs to the bus team.

  • Build and maintain the orbit determination, ephemeris, and maneuver-planning pipeline. Own conjunction screening and CDM response through Space-Track and commercial SSA providers.

  • Provide orbital parameters and deorbit analysis for the commercial FCC and ITU filings.


Qualifications:

  • Direct, hands-on experience with LEO mission or constellation design: orbit selection, SSO design, and station-keeping for flown or flight-bound spacecraft.

  • 4+ years in applied astrodynamics, mission design, or flight dynamics.

  • BS/MS/PhD in aerospace engineering, astrodynamics, or physics, or equivalent demonstrated depth.

  • Proficiency with at least one of GMAT, STK/ODTK, FreeFlyer, Orekit, Tudat, or Basilisk, and strong Python.

  • Solid perturbation modeling: J2 and higher-order gravity, atmospheric drag (NRLMSISE-00, JB2008), and SRP.

  • Capacity to exercise independent technical judgment as the orbital authority and be accountable for it.

Preferred:

  • Constellation, formation-flying, or relative-motion experience.

  • Flight dynamics operations experience, including maneuver execution, OD, and conjunction response.
