title: Director, Actuary
description:
American Equity Investment Life Insurance Company is a leading provider of annuity solutions designed to help clients protect and grow retirement income. Part of Brookfield Wealth Solutions, we partner with more than 40,000 financial professionals and help fund over half a million retirements nationwide. Recognized by Newsweek as one of America’s Most Trustworthy Companies and named a Top Workplace in Iowa, American Equity fosters a collaborative and purpose-driven culture where employees are empowered to ignite their passion and help shape the future of financial services.

Headquartered in Des Moines, Iowa, with satellite offices in New York, NY, American Equity provides opportunities for employees to support work across the enterprise, including our sister company, American National, headquartered in Houston, Texas.

GENERAL PURPOSE OF THE JOB:
The Director, Actuary provides leadership for the Company’s VM-22 valuation function, ensuring that valuation models, processes, controls, and reporting capabilities support accurate, timely, and well-documented reserve calculations for applicable annuity products. The role oversees quarterly valuation production, reserve analytics, model implementation and validation, and operational execution. In partnership with the Qualified Actuary and cross-functional stakeholders, the Director translates valuation requirements into effective processes and scalable solutions that support evolving business, regulatory, and financial reporting needs. The Director leads and develops actuarial talent and drives continuous improvement in the Company’s VM-22 valuation capabilities and operating processes.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Monitor regulatory and industry developments related to VM-22 and assess potential implications for the Company’s valuation models, processes, and results in partnership with the Qualified Actuary.
• Lead the validation, testing, implementation, and change management of VM-22 valuation models, including coordination of model enhancements, user acceptance testing, and production readiness.
• Lead the quarterly VM-22 valuation process, including production, review, analysis, reconciliation, documentation, and communication of reserve results.
• Direct and perform complex actuarial analyses related to annuity reserving and modeling, including reserve movement analysis, sensitivity testing, and identification of key result drivers.
• Partner with the Qualified Actuary and stakeholders across Actuarial, Investments, Product, Pricing, Finance, Risk, and Technology to support VM-22 implementation and ongoing valuation processes.
• Develop and present actuarial exhibits, analyses, and summaries to senior leadership and other governance stakeholders, and support the Qualified Actuary in communications with auditors and regulators.
• Ensure actuarial analyses and supporting documentation are completed in accordance with applicable professional standards, Company policies, and internal control requirements.
• Provide technical direction, coaching, and development to actuarial staff and build sustainable VM-22 valuation capabilities within the team.
• Manage the employee life cycle and experience, including but not limited to, selection and retention of talent, continuous feedback and performance management, reward and recognition, corrective action and employee development.
• Performs other related work as assigned.

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES:

Direct Reports: Will manage a senior actuarial associate.

General Description of Indirect Reports (2 and 3-downs): 0

EDUCATION AND/OR EXPERIENCE:

• Bachelor’s degree in actuarial science, mathematics, statistics, economics, or a related field with a strong quantitative foundation.
• Fellowship designation (FSA or equivalent).
• Demonstrated experience leading complex actuarial valuation, modeling, or financial reporting initiatives.
• Experience with Aon PathWise or another actuarial projection and asset-liability modeling platform is preferred.
• Supervisory experience is preferred.
• Experience with retail annuity products in the US.
• Experience with principle-based reserving, stochastic valuation methodologies, or asset-liability modeling is preferred.

CERTIFICATES, LICENSES, PROFESSIONAL DESIGNATIONS:

• FSA, MAAA required

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES:

• Deep understanding of actuarial science and the ability to apply this knowledge is critical.
• Knowledge of rating agency capital requirements.
• Mastery of actuarial valuation best practices, procedures and processes.
• General knowledge of assets and economic scenarios.
• Ability to effectively present technical information to top management.
• Strong knowledge and systems aptitude with asset-liability models.
• Exceptional attention to numeric and other detail.
• Strong statistical and advanced math skills, including excellent Excel modeling skills.
• Ability to apply principles of logical thinking to a wide range of intellectual and practical problems.
• Ability to read, analyze, and interpret technical journals, financial reports, and legal documents from regulatory agencies, and other members of the business community.
• Strong project management skills, including planning and organization.
• Ability to successfully handle pressure and meet deadlines in a fast-paced work environment.


____

title: Assistant Controller
description:
About MGT Insurance

MGT is the first AI-driven, neo-insurer focused on evolving commercial P&C insurance for the brokers and small business owners. By combining the expertise of industry veterans with state-of-the-art technology, we are ushering in the next evolution of commercial insurance and working to move the industry forward through the use of modern technology, better processes, and a rock-star team. We seek visionary leaders who thrive in dynamic, entrepreneurial settings, and excel in autonomous roles.

About the Role

MGT Insurance is seeking an Assistant Controller to lead our accounting operations.

As MGT continues to scale we are hiring an Assistant Controller who will take ownership of the monthly close, accounting controls, financial controls and external audit.

In this role, you will oversee the close and reporting process across five consolidated entities under both GAAP and statutory accounting requirements. You will lead and develop the accounting team, strengthen our control environment, and serve as the primary relationship owner for our external auditors. You will do so on a modern technology platform built substantially in house.

MGT is an AI-first company, and that commitment extends to the accounting function as well as to the product. Automated pipelines and AI agents perform a growing share of reconciliation work. Professional judgment remains the control that gates the close.

Your First Twelve Months

Three initiatives will define the first stretch of this role:

  1. Implement close management software. Close-management software is on our technology roadmap, and you will lead the implementation on top of NetSuite — defining the close checklist, reconciliation templates, review hierarchy, and sign-off trail. The objective is to move the close from institutional knowledge into a documented, auditable system.

  2. Establish balance sheet integrity across all five entities. Define and enforce a company-wide account reconciliation standard covering ownership, frequency, supporting documentation, and review. You will own the subledger-to-general-ledger tie-outs for premium receivable, commissions payable, and cash, and drive aged reconciling items to resolution.

  3. Establish audit and examination readiness at scale. Documented accounting policy, evidence captured at the source, clear statutory-to-GAAP bridges, and a PBC process that scales with the business.

What You'll Do

Own the close. Lead the monthly, quarterly, and annual close across all five entities. Serve as the primary reviewer, approving journal entries, reconciliations, roll-forwards, and flux analyses prepared by the team. Set the close calendar and hold the organization to it.

Manage GAAP and statutory reporting. Deliver the consolidated GAAP financial statements and the statutory financial statements reviewed by regulators and rating agencies. Own the annual and quarterly NAIC statements, state insurance department filings, and premium tax filings across our licensed footprint. Maintain a clear, well-documented statutory-to-GAAP bridge.

Manage the audit. Serve as the primary liaison to financial auditor, our external auditors, coordinating the PBC list, managing timelines, and resolving technical matters directly. Support the preparation of responses to financial examinations and regulatory inquiries.

Author accounting policy. Prepare technical accounting memoranda for non-standard transactions, including new program structures, reinsurance arrangements, product launches, and entity changes. Establish and maintain the accounting policies, procedures, and internal controls required to support the company's growth.

Lead the team. Lead and develop the accounting team. Set priorities, review work product, invest in the professional growth of your staff, and foster a culture of accountability, accuracy, and continuous improvement.

Build and automate the systems. Own the accounting architecture in NetSuite and partner with Engineering, Data Science, and FP&A on the data pipelines that move policy, claims, and billing information into the general ledger. Our environment includes NetSuite, Ramp, Stripe, and Aleph, alongside proprietary policy administration, billing, and AI-enabled data services developed in house, as well as Claude, which our accounting team uses daily. Identify recurring manual work and treat automation as the default solution.

Partner beyond Finance. Work directly with Operations, Product, Engineering, Data, Actuarial, and FP&A. A meaningful portion of this role involves data and systems work in addition to traditional accounting responsibilities.

What You Bring

Required

  • 8+ years of accounting experience in insurance,financial services, or public accounting serving those clients.

  • 3+ years directly managing accounting professionals, with a demonstrated record of developing staff and elevating the quality of their work.

  • Demonstrated ownership of a multi-entity month-end close and consolidation, including review of work prepared by others.

  • Experience serving as a primary counterparty to external auditors.

  • Strong command of US GAAP and statutory accounting; working knowledge of P&C insurance accounting.

  • Hands-on experience with a modern ERP; NetSuite strongly preferred.

  • Demonstrated ability to apply AI tools and emerging technologies to automate workflows, improve productivity, and strengthen internal controls, with specific examples of recurring work you have eliminated.

  • Advanced Excel and strong analytical capability. Comfort with SQL, or the willingness to develop it.

  • Sound judgment and clear communication, with the ability to build process in a developing control environment and to escalate issues appropriately.

Preferred

  • CPA license, or active progress toward one.

  • P&C carrier, MGA/MGU, reinsurance, or program business experience, including statutory/NAIC reporting, premium taxes, bordereaux, ceding commissions, trust accounting, producer commissions, or TPA claims flows.

  • Experience implementing a close-management, reconciliation, or reporting platform such as FloQast, BlackLine, Numeric, or Workiva.

  • Experience at a venture-backed company scaling toward a Series C or beyond.

  • Big 4 or national firm foundation.

We recognize that no candidate will meet every qualification and encourage individuals with relevant experience and interest in the role to apply. Candidates with deep insurance accounting expertise and candidates with strong systems and process backgrounds are both encouraged to apply.

Location

This is a hybrid role requiring a minimum of three days per week in one of MGT Insurance's offices. San Francisco, CA is strongly preferred; however, qualified candidates based in Denver, CO or Madison, WI will also be considered.

Compensation

$150,000 – $190,000

Annual base salary, plus a target performance bonus and equity. Compensation will be determined based on experience, qualifications, geographic location, and scope of responsibilities.

We recognize that no candidate will meet every qualification and encourage individuals with relevant experience and interest in the role to apply.

Please do not forward resumes to our jobs alias, MGT employees, or any other company location. Any submittals without a prior signed agreement will become property of MGT.

Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity & Inclusion

At MGT, inclusion drives excellence and belonging sustains it. We believe diverse perspectives make us stronger, more innovative, and more connected to the people we serve. We value every voice, champion equity, and create space where all people can grow and succeed together.

Equal Employment Opportunity Statement

MGT is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We do not discriminate in employment opportunities or practices based on race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, military or veteran status, or any other status protected by applicable law.

All employment decisions are based on qualifications, merit, and business needs. If you need assistance or accommodations, please contact us at accommodations@mgtinsurance.com.

title: Participant Success Coach
location: Center for Sustainable Careers - Baltimore, MD
description:
Organization Summary:
Civic Works strengthens Baltimore’s communities for people of all ages through education, skills development, and community service. Our Center for Sustainable Careers (CSC) expands access to family-sustaining careers for Baltimore residents facing significant barriers to quality employment. CSC supports participants in developing both technical skills and soft skills, and earning marketable certifications, all while providing wraparound case management and job placement services.

Emergency Medical Systems (EMS) Corps is a cohort-based EMT training and career development program for young adults, designed to launch them into meaningful careers in emergency medical services, fire, and allied health. EMS Corps is a national model brought to life through local partnerships. Civic Works serves as the Lead Agency in Baltimore, partnering with local training institutions, employers, and community-based organizations to implement the program with fidelity and community rootedness.

Position Overview:

The Participant Success Coach fills a critical role within the program, responsible for helping participants successfully navigate training, overcome barriers, and transition into stable employment and long-term career growth. This position works closely with participants from enrollment through job placement and beyond, ensuring they have the individualized support, coaching, and resources needed to succeed. The Coach also serves as a central point of coordination across instructors, program staff, case management partners, and employers to support participant progress and alignment around participant needs and support strategies.

The Participant Success Coach will work closely with the Program Manager to launch the EMS Corps program in Baltimore. The Coach will help shape the participant experience from the ground up, drawing on CSC's established case management practices and adapting them to the EMS Corps model.

We are looking for someone who can build strong relationships, support participants with accountability and encouragement, and help create a positive, participant-centered program culture. Additional responsibilities include workshop facilitation, participant documentation and reporting, alumni engagement, and continuous program improvement efforts.

Primary Responsibilities:

  1. Case Management
  • Support participants in addressing barriers to success, including transportation, housing stability, financial challenges, legal concerns, healthcare access, while fostering resilience, positive social skills, and workplace readiness.
  • Conduct participant intake assessments and ongoing one-on-one meetings to identify barriers, establish goals, and develop individualized service and support plans.
  • Build and maintain partnerships with community organizations and service providers, while connecting participants to internal and external resources and coordinating referrals.
  • Drive the continuous improvement and development of the program through the development of our feedback loop with program participants.
  1. Job Readiness Coaching
  • Provide individualized coaching related to professionalism, workplace readiness, communication, accountability, and progress toward program completion and graduation standards.
  • Facilitate workshops focused on personal growth, life skills, workplace readiness, leadership, and career success.
  • Deliver ongoing feedback and support the development of systems and processes related to participant accountability, performance improvement, and progressive disciplinary practices, while ensuring participants receive appropriate guidance and support.
  1. Career Services & Job Placement
  • Provide individualized strengths based career coaching to participants and graduates including resume development, interview preparation, networking support, and job search strategies.
  • Support participants through all stages of the employment process including job applications, interview preparation, hiring, onboarding, and retention.
  • Connect participants with employment opportunities aligned with their skills, interests, and career goals.
  • Lead active job search sessions for current participants and alumni, providing hands-on support with applications, outreach, and follow-up.
  • Provide ongoing retention and career advancement support to graduates through continued coaching, career planning, and professional development resources.
  1. Documentation, Data Tracking & Reporting
  • Maintain accurate, timely, and compliant participant documentation including case notes, referrals, performance tracking, employment outcomes, and retention milestones in Salesforce and other required systems.
  • Track and analyze participant and graduate data - including progress toward graduation standards, wages, work hours, job placement, retention, and advancement outcomes - to support reporting, program evaluation, and continuous improvement efforts.

title: Senior Software Engineer - Java @ Vyntra Global
description:
Senior Software Engineer – Java

Financial Crime Product | Backend Engineering | Warsaw

Every day, banks process enormous volumes of transactions. Vyntra's Financial Crime platform analyses that data in real time to help financial institutions identify fraud and suspicious activity.

We're growing our engineering team in Warsaw and looking for a Software Engineer who enjoys understanding how systems work, solving difficult problems and improving the technology behind them.

The role

You'll join our Financial Crime Product Development team, working in a small, experienced engineering team on backend systems used by banks around the world.

The work is predominantly Java and Spring Boot within a larger distributed platform processing significant volumes of financial data.

We're looking for someone who wants to understand the problem rather than simply implement a ticket. You'll be involved in technical design, development and production, with opportunities to improve existing systems and influence how new solutions are built.

We work from our Warsaw WeWork office a minimum of 2 days per week.

Your work will include
  • Designing and developing backend services using Java and Spring Boot
  • Taking features from technical design through development and into production
  • Working with distributed systems, messaging and large volumes of data
  • Investigating production issues, finding root causes and implementing long-term solutions
  • Improving the performance, reliability and scalability of existing systems
  • Contributing to technical and architectural decisions
  • Collaborating with other engineers while taking ownership of your own solutions
What we're looking for

You have experience building and running production systems and are comfortable working independently on complex technical problems.

You have:

  • Good hands-on experience with Java and Spring/Spring Boot backend development
  • Experience with microservices and distributed or cloud-based systems
  • Experience investigating production issues and troubleshooting beyond your own code
  • Good understanding of databases and SQL
  • Good analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Experience contributing to technical design and making decisions about how things should be built
  • Experience working in agile development teams
  • Clear, practical communication skills

You don't need to know every technology we use. Our wider stack includes Kafka and other messaging systems, Docker, Kubernetes, SQL, Grafana, Python, Spark, Elasticsearch and StarRocks.

Experience with some of these is useful, but we're more interested in what you've built, improved or troubleshot than how many technologies you can list.

The team

Our Warsaw engineering team is small and close-knit, currently around 10 people and growing to around 15.

It's Vyntra's technical hub for our Financial Crime product, with developers and architects working closely together. It's an environment where engineers can work independently, contribute ideas and have a genuine influence on how things are built.

About Vyntra

Vyntra was created through the combination of Swiss fintech NetGuardians and Belgian fintech Intix.

title: Senior Systems Analyst, Digital Experience Platform & Author Enablement
description:
What You'll Do

Avalara's website platform is only as valuable as the authors who use it every day to publish content. Today, author success depends heavily on expertise with the CMS and web marketing practices, which slows content velocity and creates inconsistent, off-brand, or low-ROI use of the platform.

This role exists to change that: to own the template and component library as a product, define its scope and guardrails, and make the authoring experience simple enough that any content contributor can succeed without platform

The business outcome is faster, more consistent, and more measurable content production, with design and functionality decisions anchored to brand integrity and return on investment rather than ad hoc requests.


What Your Responsibilities Will Be

  • Own and govern the CMS template and component library, defining the scope, limits, and supported features of each component so authors have a clear, sustainable toolkit to work within.

  • Set the boundaries of design and feature influence on the platform, ensuring new functionality is added only where it reinforces brand consistency and demonstrates a clear return on investment.

  • Define what behavioral data must be captured across templates and components to drive understanding of common visitor behavior.

  • Act as the primary source of truth on platform capabilities and constraints for internal stakeholders, tailoring explanations for both content-management-fluent and non-technical audiences.

  • Support teams working on internationalization and localization projects. Guide teams through the workflows that enable content publishing across multiple geographies.

  • Continuously improve the usability of the template and component library, lowering the learning curve so authors can succeed with less reliance on specialized CMS or web marketing skills.

  • Demonstrate platform functionality and design potential to stakeholders exploring new ways to promote their products, translating technical capability into business opportunity.

  • Identify shortcomings in the platform and translate them into clear, prioritized requirements for the CMS development teams.

  • Identify gaps in content analysis and reporting tools and define requirements to close them so stakeholders can trust the data behind their content decisions.

  • Define the constraints and guardrails within the authoring environment needed to protect SEO, tagging, and asset management integrity, without unnecessarily limiting author flexibility.

  • Define the strategy for asset management and oversee the implementation of standards and practices for asset upload, metadata assignment, and retrieval.

  • Use AI to accelerate and improve this work end-to-end, with particular emphasis on helping authors and content creators succeed without needing deep CMS or web marketing expertise.


What You'll Need to be Successful

What You'll Need to be Successful 

  • Drive measurable improvements in content and campaign creation outcomes for engagement and conversion, increasing stakeholder confidence in the platform across both technical and non-technical teams.

  • A governed component library and change process is in place, with a measurable reduction in one-off, duplicate, or unsupported components.

  • Authors show a measurable improvement in time-to-publish and a measurable reduction in platform-related support requests, driven by usability improvements to templates and components.

  • Analytics and behavioral data capture is defined and implemented across most templates and components, enabling stakeholders to self-serve engagement reporting.

  • Asset management standards (upload, metadata, retrieval) are defined, adopted, and show measurable improvement in asset findability and metadata completeness.

AI Expectations

In this role you will

  • Use AI to accelerate the definition, documentation, and governance of the template and component library, including surfacing unused or redundant components.

  • Deploy at least one AI-enabled authoring aid live into production, with a quantifiable reduction in the AEM expertise required for authors to publish successfully.

  • Apply AI to analyze content and analytics data, identifying gaps in reporting and opportunities to improve measurement of user behavior.

  • Build or direct AI-enabled aids (for example, in-authoring guidance, automated metadata or tagging suggestions, or content quality checks) that let authors succeed without deep CMS or web marketing skills.

  • Quantify the impact of AI adoption in this role, such as reduced authoring errors, faster onboarding of new authors, or hours saved on manual review.

  • Apply AI responsibly and securely, with attention to data governance given the customer-facing nature of the content platform.

  • Share AI practices and tooling with peers to raise AI capability across the broader platform and content management function.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in an Information Technology field required, consistent with Avalara's degree requirement for technical program management roles.

  • 7+ years of experience in technical program or product management for a web content management or digital experience platform, including direct ownership of a template or component library at a senior level.

  • Direct experience with one more enterprise content management systems or digital experience platforms including author-facing template and component design.

  • Experience defining requirements and guardrails for SEO, tagging, and asset management (DAM) within a content authoring environment.

  • Demonstrated, quantifiable use of AI tools to improve platform governance, content operations, or author enablement, consistent with Avalara's AI Bar Raiser standard.

  • A track record of raising the performance of teams and processes around them, consistent with Avalara's Bar Raiser expectations for judgment, ownership, and accountability.

This role is a Bar Raiser hire. The successful candidate will:
  • Hold themselves and others to high standards of technical quality, data integrity, and operational accountability.
  • Demonstrate strong judgment when making platform and technical tradeoffs, especially those that affect campaign performance, lead data quality, or system reliability.
  • Raise the performance of those around them through mentorship, rigorous technical guidance, and clear documentation.
  • Simplify complexity, translating ambiguous marketing requirements into clean, maintainable technical solutions.
  • Challenge assumptions respectfully and bring data into technical decisions.
  • Leave every system, process, and team they touch stronger than they found it.

Avalara is an AI-first Company

AI is embedded in our workflows, decision-making, and products. Success here requires embracing AI as an essential capability.

  • You’ll bring experience using AI and AI-related technologies, ready to thrive here.

  • You’ll apply AI every day to business challenges - improving efficiency, contributing solutions, and driving results for your team, our company, and our customers.

  • You’ll grow with AI by staying curious about new trends and best practices, and by sharing what you learn so others can benefit too.


How We'll Take Care of You

Total Rewards

In addition to a great compensation package, paid time off, and paid parental leave, many Avalara employees are eligible for bonuses.

Health & Wellness
Benefits vary by location but generally include private medical, life, and disability insurance.

Inclusive culture and diversity
Avalara strongly supports diversity, equity, and inclusion, and is committed to integrating them into our business practices and our organizational culture. We also have a total of 8 employee-run resource groups, each with senior leadership and exec sponsorship.


What You Need To Know About Avalara

We’re defining the relationship between tax and tech.

We’ve already built an industry-leading cloud compliance platform, processing over 54 billion customer API calls and over 6.6 million tax returns a year. Our growth is real - we're a billion dollar business - and we’re not slowing down until we’ve achieved our mission - to be part of every transaction in the world.

We’re bright, innovative, and disruptive, like the orange we love to wear. It captures our quirky spirit and optimistic mindset. It shows off the culture we’ve designed, that empowers our people to win. We’ve been different from day one. Join us, and your career will be too.

We’re An Equal Opportunity Employer

Supporting diversity and inclusion is a cornerstone of our company — we don’t want people to fit into our culture, but to enrich it. All qualified candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, age, gender, national orientation, disability, sexual orientation, US Veteran status, or any other factor protected by law. If you require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, please let us know.

title: Data Engineer
description:
Ben jij de Data Engineer die we zoeken om binnen ons datawarehouse gegevens te modelleren? Bouw jij mee aan ons standaard dataplatform? Is het ontsluiten van nieuwe databronnen voor jou geen probleem?Bij Axelio in Bunnik krijg je de kans om je vaardigheden in te zetten voor het ontwikkelen en beheren van gestandaardiseerde data pipelines op het Microsoft SQL/Azure/Fabric platform.

Dit ga je doen als Data Engineer

Als Data Engineer bij Axelio in Bunnik ben je belangrijk voor het beheer en de optimalisatie van onze data-infrastructuren. Je werkt zelfstandig aan uitdagende projecten en speelt een sleutelrol in het realiseren van hoogwaardige data-oplossingen. Daarnaast werk je ook samen met collega’s om onze verschillende dataplatformen zo standaard als mogelijk bij klanten te realiseren.

Je hebt ervaring met het ontwikkelen van ETL-processen en versiebeheer in Azure DevOps. Je zorgt ervoor dat data pipelines soepel functioneren en dat de integriteit van de gegevens gewaarborgd blijft, terwijl je ook zorgt voor efficiënte versiebeheer en continue integratie van systemen.

Jouw werkzaamheden

  • Onderhouden van onze standaard BI Architecturen.
  • Ontwikkelen van technische koppelingen naar bronsystemen om data te importeren in de BI-omgeving in Azure en Fabric.
  • Het extracten van data uit een bronsysteem in een staging area.
  • Ontwerpen en bouwen van datawarehouses met Databricks of SQL, inclusief het creëren van mappings van brondata naar het datawarehouse.
  • Ontwerpen en bouwen van datamodellen voor datasets.
  • Het automatiseren van de datawarehouse laadprocessen in Azure Data Factory of Fabric.
  • Formuleren en presenteren van adviezen aan stakeholders, gebaseerd op data-analyse en bevindingen.

Dit mag je van ons verwachten

Je verdient tussen de €4.000 - €7.000. Ook kun je extra bonussen ontvangen, afhankelijk van jouw prestaties en die van de organisatie.

Wij bieden jou een mobiliteitsbudget dat je kunt inzetten voor een leaseauto, een leasefiets, het openbaar vervoer of kunt laten uitkeren als een bruto vergoeding.

Een goede balans tussen werk en privé is belangrijk en voor iedereen verschillend. Bij Axelio krijg je 28 vakantiedagen en heb je de mogelijkheid om 5 dagen bij te kopen of te verkopen.

Flexibel werken

Bij Axelio faciliteren we je in een werkplek waar je altijd en overal kunt werken: thuis, op kantoor of bij één van de andere vestigingen van Axelio.

Onze kracht zit in de energie die we samen brengen. We werken hard, maar vergeten niet om samen stil te staan bij succes. Soms met een teamdag vol inspiratie, regelmatig met een spontaan uitje of kennissessies.

We vinden het belangrijk dat je het maximale uit jezelf haalt. Daarom stimuleren we je om je te blijven ontwikkelen en initiëren wij opleidingen & trainingen. Per jaar investeren we 10 dagen die je kan inzetten voor studie & trainingen.

Welzijn

Jouw welzijn staat voorop. Met toegang tot coaches en zelfhulpmodules blijf je in balans, op het werk en daarbuiten.

Dit verwachten we van jou

  • Minimaal een hbo-opleiding in Informatica, (Technische) Bedrijfskunde of ICT.
  • Kennis van Microsoft Azure, Databricks, Python, SQL, Power BI.
  • Ervaring met het ontsluiten van data uit ERP-Systemen.
  • Je bent een teamspeler met sterke analytische vaardigheden en een resultaatgerichte instelling.
  • Certificaten in Microsoft BI stack.
  • Creativiteit in het vinden van de beste oplossing voor de klant.
  • Uitstekende beheersing van zowel de Nederlandse als Engelse taal, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk.

Axelio is de aanjager van digitale groei. We helpen organisaties vooruit door technologie, mensen en ambities met elkaar te verbinden. Met het volledige Microsoft-ecosysteem als basis ontwikkelen we slimme oplossingen die echt het verschil maken.

Onze teams combineren diepgaande branchekennis met innovatieve denkkracht. Met onze oplossingen voor CRM, ERP, Data & BI, Field Service en AI helpen we organisaties om slimmer te werken en hun digitale ambities waar te maken. Als Microsoft-partner lopen we voorop in de nieuwste ontwikkelingen en brengen we innovatie tot leven bij onze klanten.

Met vestigingen door heel Nederland vormen we een hecht collectief van specialisten. Dat betekent: korte lijnen, lokale betrokkenheid en een cultuur waarin kennisdeling vanzelfsprekend is. Jij krijgt bij ons de ruimte om te groeien, vernieuwen en initiatief te nemen. Wij zorgen voor de energie, begeleiding en verbinding om dat mogelijk te maken.

Zo werken we niet alleen met technologie, maar vooral voor mensen. En bouwen we samen aan vooruitgang die je elke dag merkt.

title: X Ray Technologist PRN
description:
Overview

Are you ready to take your career to new heights? At Concentra, you will be a vital member of our patient care team and play a crucial role in providing exceptional care to our patients. Our mission is to improve the health of America's workforce, one patient at a time. Join us at Concentra and see how your clinical competency and compassion can make a meaningful difference in the lives of the patients you serve.

The Radiologic Technologist & Medical Support Specialist performs routine will perform routine x-ray examinations in accordance with Concentra policies, practices, and procedures and applicable regulations under direct supervision of the treating clinician, as well as supports in other needed areas of the facility. This role requires efficient and accurate delivery of one-on-one patient care while thriving in a fast-paced environment. The RT MSS ensures that every patient is treated with quality clinical care and receives an excellent patient experience from welcoming, respectful, and skillful colleagues.

Responsibilities

Radiologic Technologist Duties

  • Prepare patients for radiologic procedures. Escort patients to dressing and x-ray rooms, provide verbal and/or written instructions and assist patients in positioning body parts to be radiographed. Explain procedures and observe patients to ensure patient care, safety and comfort during the x-ray exam.
  • Operate radiologic equipment to produce images of the body for diagnostic purposes. Position radiologic equipment and adjust controls to set exposure time and distance according to specification of examination. Take x-rays following established radiologic requirements and regulations to ensure patient care and safety.
  • Use radiation safety measures and protection devices to ensure safety of patients and team members
  • Ensure radiologic equipment remains in working order. Report equipment malfunctions to Center Operations Director
  • Ensure all Radiology workflows are followed and all Radiology reports cross correctly to EMR
  • Follows documentation procedures and completes required documentation related to patient x-ray visit.
  • Maintain all x-ray equipment, including calibration, QA/QC procedures, and record keeping in accordance with current policy and procedures

Medical Assistant Duties

  • Perform Department of Transportation (DOT) and Non-DOT drug and alcohol testing
  • Prepare patients for physical examinations, including taking vital signs and any required or requested ancillary testing including but not limited to vaccines and injections, phlebotomy, PFTs, audiogram testing and respirator fit testing (in accordance with state regulations)
  • Perform rapid screening tests (influenza, strep, mono, glucose, etc.)
  • Assist providers during examination and treatment
  • Responsible for performing routine medical procedures as ordered by treating clinician as well as triaging emergent patients as needed
  • Prepare and assist clinician with procedure set up and injury care
  • Apply bandages, dressings and splints as ordered by the treating clinician
  • Dispense medications and DME as ordered by the treating clinician in accordance with state regulations
  • Complete quality assurance activities on equipment and medical devices as well as testing processes used in the center
  • Maintain supplies, clean rooms and equipment, and stock exam rooms
  • Maintain and operate all medical devices and equipment, including calibration and record keeping in accordance with current policy and procedures
  • Notify supervisor immediately if equipment is not functioning properly, supplies are needed, or facility is not operating as expected
  • In partnership with center leadership, assist with patient flow and volume
  • Keep patients informed of expected wait times during all aspects of the center visit
  • Responsible for clerical tasks in both the front and back office associated with patient care and proper record keeping
  • Ensure accuracy in documentation
  • Perform front office duties: greet patients, obtain authorization, check in/out, communicate wait times, answer multi-line telephone system, and distribute employer results/paperwork as needed
  • Follow HIPAA guidelines and safety rules
  • Attend center staff meetings or huddles as required
  • Assist in maintaining a neat, clean, and orderly appearance throughout the facility
  • Complete any applicable training including but not limited to clinical competency training that occurs monthly.

This job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

Qualifications

  • Education Level: High School Diploma or GED
  • Graduate of an accredited school of radiologic technology and applicable certification by the state in which employed.
  • Registered with The American Registry of Radiologic Technologists (ARRT) and has active and valid certification.
  • CPR/First Aid Certification

Job-Related Experience

  • Customarily has at least six months or more of medical assistant experience with knowledge of medical procedures and medical terminology
  • Working knowledge of occupational medicine requirements (state specific) is preferred with prior medical office, healthcare and/or customer service-related experience.

Job-Related Skills/Competencies

  • Concentra Core Competencies of Service Mentality, Attention to Detail, Sense of Urgency, Initiative and Flexibility
  • Ability to make decisions or solve problems by using logic to identify key facts, explore alternatives, and propose quality solutions
  • Outstanding customer service skills as well as the ability to deal with people in a manner which shows tact and professionalism
  • The ability to properly handle sensitive and confidential information (including HIPAA and PHI) in accordance with federal and state laws and company policies
  • Able to communicate both verbally and in writing in a clear, and professional manner
  • Teamwork focus with peers and center leadership team; ability to maintain working relationship with all levels of colleagues
  • Must participate in initial and ongoing training as required
  • Obtain all certifications required of Medical Support Specialists including but not limited to Drug Screen Collection, Breath Alcohol Certification, Hair and Oral Fluids Collection
  • Intermediate knowledge of Microsoft Office such as Word, Excel, Outlook and entry of data into various systems/applications

Additional Data

title: AI Transformation Catalyst
description:
Who We Are

Bidgely is an AI-powered SaaS company accelerating a clean-energy future by enabling energy companies and consumers to make data-driven decisions about energy. At Bidgely, we are building the intelligence layer for the energy transition. Our UtilityAI™ Platform turns the data already flowing through smart meters into a rich, behind-the-meter view of how energy is being used—helping utilities understand customers at the appliance level, spot emerging loads like electric vehicles, and turn complex data into decisions that improve lives and strengthen the grid. This is AI with a real-world mission: helping people use energy more intelligently while giving energy providers the insight to build a cleaner, more resilient future.

Energy is entering one of the most consequential transformations in a generation. EVs, rooftop solar, batteries, flexible loads, extreme weather, and rising electricity demand are turning the grid into a dynamic, two-way system. Across the industry, AI is becoming a critical tool for forecasting demand, integrating renewables, optimizing distributed energy resources, improving reliability, and making the clean-energy transition more affordable and accessible. The U.S. Department of Energy describes AI as a force that can accelerate grid modernization and the broader clean-energy economy, while Bidgely is already applying it to real utility and customer challenges. (DOE: AI for Energy)

This is where you come in. You will work at the intersection of advanced AI, energy, and a market that is being reshaped in real time—helping turn breakthrough technology into products, growth, and outcomes that matter. At Bidgely, you will not be building demos disconnected from the world; you will help utilities and millions of energy users navigate the future as it happens. (Bidgely GenAI announcement)

How You Fit In

Bidgely is hiring analytical, curious, and action-oriented professionals who want to build practical AI solutions, solve meaningful business problems, and develop their expertise through hands-on work with experienced leaders.

You bring strong problem-solving skills, demonstrated AI capability, and the ability to learn quickly. We provide functional training, product and industry knowledge, practical coaching, and opportunities to apply what you learn.

As an AI Transformation Catalyst, you will work directly with functional teams and senior leaders to turn ideas into measurable results. You will take responsibility for defined projects and deliverables from the start, with your scope and independence growing as you build expertise and demonstrate readiness.

You will be aligned to one of three tracks:

  • Product Marketing: Develop positioning, messaging, sales enablement materials, and customer-facing content with guidance from Product and Marketing leaders. Build your understanding of what we create, why customers buy, and how to communicate value.

  • Sales & Growth Strategy: Help grow adoption and revenue for established products through customer research, commercial analysis, proposals, and improvements to sales workflows using AI.

  • New Products Market Introduction: Work with an executive sponsor to research market opportunities, develop business cases, test positioning, and support the introduction of new products.

We are hiring three people through one common application process. You can indicate your preferred track, and we will explore your strengths and interests across the opportunities. Your track, reporting relationship, and initial scope will be confirmed before an offer.

What You’ll Own and Drive

Across All Tracks

  • Take responsibility for a defined workstream or business problem, with hands-on coaching and regular review. Expand your ownership as you build expertise and demonstrate readiness.

  • Turn ambiguous questions into structured analyses, recommendations, plans, and deliverables, working with your manager to clarify assumptions and priorities.

  • Build and test AI tools, automations, and repeatable workflows that improve the speed, quality, and consistency of work.

  • Check the accuracy and usefulness of AI outputs, identify limitations, and apply appropriate human judgment and review.

  • Build strong working relationships across functions and help move shared projects forward.

  • Define success measures with your manager, communicate progress and risks, and follow through on commitments.

  • Present concise recommendations that explain your reasoning, evidence, and proposed next steps.

  • Learn Bidgely’s products, customers, market, and operating context through structured learning and practical assignments, applying that knowledge to increasingly independent decisions.

Product Marketing Track

  • Research customer needs and competitive alternatives, then develop and refine positioning and messaging with guidance from Product and Marketing leaders.

  • Create sales enablement materials, talk tracks, competitive narratives, customer-facing content, and landing-page copy, incorporating feedback from experienced colleagues.

  • Partner with Product, Sales, Sales Engineering, Customer Success, and Marketing to translate product capabilities into clear customer value.

  • Gather product and market insights from customers, company leadership, and customer-facing teams.

  • Build AI-enabled workflows for research, drafting, iteration, personalization, and content operations while maintaining accuracy and quality.

You will own defined deliverables while Marketing leadership retains responsibility for overall strategy and final messaging decisions.

Sales & Growth Strategy Track

  • Analyze customer, product, and market information to identify opportunities for adoption, expansion, and revenue growth, working with commercial leaders to prioritize and test recommendations.

  • Develop customer pitches, proposals, value narratives, business cases, and sales presentations that connect Bidgely’s products to measurable customer outcomes.

  • Coordinate defined components of RFP and RFI responses, including research, drafting, input collection, and submission tracking. Progress toward managing complete responses with experienced leaders reviewing strategy, technical accuracy, and commercial commitments.

  • Prepare and progressively lead portions of customer presentations alongside experienced colleagues, learning to tailor the story to executive, procurement, and technical audiences.

  • Contribute account research, analyses, and customer-facing materials to cross-functional pursuit teams, learning how complex enterprise opportunities are developed and won.

  • Build pricing models and recommendations with guidance from commercial and Finance leaders. Develop your understanding of packaging, usage models, implementation and services costs, multi-year agreements, discounting, and deal economics.

  • Partner with functional teams to improve workflows such as account research, RFP responses, deal reviews, and sales planning through AI and automation.

  • Create practical playbooks, analyses, and reusable tools that help customer-facing teams work more effectively.

  • Measure the results of new approaches and work with functional leaders to expand those that improve productivity, customer engagement, or commercial outcomes.

Commercial, technical, and Finance leaders will retain approval of pricing, solution commitments, and contractual terms as you develop your expertise.

New Products Market Introduction Track

  • Work with an executive sponsor to research, plan, and execute the introduction of new products, taking responsibility for defined deliverables and progressively broader scope.

  • Develop business cases using customer research, market analysis, competitive context, and financial assumptions, with coaching from Product and commercial leaders.

  • Help design and conduct research with analysts, customers, prospects, and internal stakeholders to test product and positioning assumptions.

  • Research and recommend target segments, buyer needs, initial use cases, and approaches to early adoption.

  • Coordinate assigned launch activities across Product, Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and other teams.

  • Track launch readiness, synthesize early customer feedback, and surface dependencies or roadblocks to your manager or executive sponsor.

Your sponsor and functional leaders will guide product strategy, investment decisions, and launch priorities while helping you build market and commercial judgment.

What Makes You Successful

Mindset and Working Style

  • You are intellectually curious, analytically rigorous, and motivated to learn unfamiliar domains.

  • You combine thoughtful analysis with action and tangible output.

  • You can move from a blank page to a useful first version, then improve it through feedback and evidence.

  • You communicate clearly and can explain complex technical, market, or business concepts in practical terms.

  • You are comfortable working through ambiguity, asking useful questions, and seeking guidance when needed.

  • You make thoughtful choices about priorities, trade-offs, and where to focus your effort.

  • You build trust across functions, welcome constructive disagreement, and follow through on shared decisions.

  • You apply feedback quickly and demonstrate increasing independence as your knowledge grows.

  • You build processes that improve outcomes and simplify those that do not.

  • You take responsibility for your work, communicate when you are blocked, and follow through until commitments are complete.

Experience and Capabilities

  • An MBA from a leading business school and some relevant work experience are preferred, but neither is required. We welcome candidates who demonstrate strong analytical thinking, hands-on AI capability, and the ability to learn quickly through academic, professional, entrepreneurial, or independent projects.

  • Evidence of turning analysis into decisions, useful deliverables, or results. Examples may come from internships, research, consulting projects, entrepreneurship, leadership, or other demanding work.

  • Demonstrated use of AI to build or materially improve a workflow, tool, or output. Be prepared to explain what you built, how you checked its quality, what changed as a result, and what you learned.

  • Strong written and verbal communication, including the ability to structure an argument and explain your reasoning.

  • The ability to manage multiple priorities, incorporate feedback, and deliver reliable work with appropriate support.

  • Willingness to engage with senior leaders and cross-functional teams and develop confidence in unfamiliar business settings.

  • Experience in SaaS, enterprise technology, AI, energy, utilities, or clean technology is helpful but not required.

Training, Mentorship, and Support Offered

You will report to a functional leader who will establish priorities, define your initial scope, and guide your day-to-day development. You will also receive dedicated coaching from Bidgely executives.

Your development will include product and industry learning, examples of effective work, feedback on deliverables, and opportunities to work alongside experienced colleagues. Your manager and executive mentor will help you understand the reasoning behind decisions and apply that judgment to your own work.

The three catalysts will meet regularly with executive mentors to share progress, work through challenges, and develop practical AI skills. Your functional manager will coordinate priorities with your executive mentor so expectations remain clear.

As you demonstrate readiness, you will take on more complex projects and greater decision-making responsibility. Your development discussions will include the skills, results, and next responsibilities that support your growth within your track.

How We’ll Assess Your Fit

Our shared assessment process will explore your problem-solving, communication, learning agility, and practical use of AI. You will also complete a work sample relevant to the track being considered.

You will have opportunities to explain your approach, evaluate the quality of your output, and adapt your work in response to feedback or new information. Examples from academic, personal, entrepreneurial, and professional projects are welcome.

Why Join Bidgely?

  • Shape the future of clean energy through AI, data, and customer-centered innovation.

  • Work directly with senior leaders on high-priority business and transformation opportunities.

  • Own meaningful outcomes in a fast-moving, low-bureaucracy environment.

  • Build practical expertise at the intersection of AI, SaaS, energy, strategy, and execution.

  • Join a passionate, global team working to help utilities and consumers make better energy decisions.

Location and Compensation

  • Location: Virtual/remote in U.S. time zones

  • Employment type: Full-time

  • Salary: $130,000–$160,000 base salary, plus bonus, stock options, and standard benefits.

The actual offer will reflect the candidate’s experience, knowledge, skills, abilities, and internal equity considerations.

Diversity, Equity, Inclusion and Equal Opportunity

At Bidgely, we’re on a mission to make a difference and build a workplace where every unique voice is heard and celebrated. We believe that diverse backgrounds, perspectives, and abilities make our company, our products, and our impact stronger.

Bidgely is an equal opportunity employer. Our hiring decisions are based on skills, talent, and passion—not on background, gender, race, age, or any other protected characteristic. Bidgely is an E-Verify employer.

title: Senior Data Engineer (Azure, Databricks & MLOps)
description:
Als Senior Data Engineer bij Axians werk je aan het ontwerpen, bouwen en optimaliseren van schaalbare data‑ en ML‑platformen voor klanten binnen onder andere de financiële sector én de publieke sector. Je werkt in multidisciplinaire teams samen met collega‑engineers, data scientists, analisten en stakeholders aan uitdagende datavraagstukken.

Je combineert diepgaande technische kennis met een leidende rol: je helpt klanten en collega’s vooruit door richting te geven, best practices te introduceren en inhoudelijk het voortouw te nemen in ontwerp- en implementatiekeuzes.

Je houdt je onder andere bezig met:

  • Het ontwerpen en ontwikkelen van schaalbare data pipelines en ML‑pijplijnen op productieniveau
  • Het modelleren en structureren van data voor analytics en reporting
  • Het bouwen, optimaliseren en doorontwikkelen van data‑platformen in de cloud
  • Het integreren van verschillende databronnen in robuuste architecturen
  • Het verbeteren van datakwaliteit, performance en betrouwbaarheid
  • Het adviseren van klanten over data‑architectuur, modellering en best practices
  • Het bouwen en onderhouden van ML‑workflows, inclusief training, validatie, deployment en monitoring
  • Het toepassen van CI/CD en automatisering voor data‑ en ML‑workflows
  • Het actief meenemen en coachen van collega’s en klantteams in technische keuzes en werkwijzen

Je maakt daarbij gebruik van moderne data‑engineering tooling en cloudomgevingen zoals Azure, Databricks en (waar relevant) Snowflake.

Technologie & stack

Je werkt onder andere met:

  • Databricks (PySpark en SQL), inclusief Databricks voor ML‑workloads
  • Python (gedegen programmeervaardigheden) en SQL (complexe queries en performance‑optimalisatie)
  • Spark of vergelijkbare grootschalige verwerkingsframeworks
  • ML‑experimenttracking en modelbeheer (bijv. MLflow of gelijkwaardig)
  • Azure Data Factory voor orkestratie en integratie
  • dbt voor transformeren en modelleren van data volgens software‑engineering best practices
  • CI/CD, Git en DevOps‑principes voor data‑ en ML‑workflows
  • Datamodellering en architectuurprincipes zoals Kimball en Data Vault
  • Cloudomgevingen zoals Azure (ervaring met AWS of GCP is ook waardevol)
  • Senior ervaring als Data Engineer
  • Sterke kennis van data‑ én ML‑pijplijnen in productie
  • Goede beheersing van AI/ML‑fundamenten
  • Ervaring met het implementeren van ML‑modellen in cloudomgevingen
  • Je kunt technische keuzes helder uitleggen aan zowel engineers als business stakeholders
  • Je neemt eigenaarschap en pakt een leidende rol in de verdere ontwikkeling van de onderwerpen in onze Business Unit en onze klant
  • Ervaring in de financiële sector is een pré
  • Ervaring in de publieke sector is eveneens zeer welkom
  • HBO of WO werk-‑ en denkniveau
  • Goede beheersing van de Nederlandse taal
  • Een senior rol met inhoudelijk invloed en verantwoordelijkheid:
  • Een salaris passend bij je ervaring en rol
  • Een werkweek van 32 tot 40 uur
  • 24 vakantiedagen op basis van een fulltime dienstverband met de mogelijkheid om 6 dagen (naar rato) bij te kopen;
  • Hybride werken met veel flexibiliteit in werkplek en -tijden
  • Uitgebreide opleidings- en ontwikkelmogelijkheden via o.a. de VINCI Energies Academy, het Axians Institute en online leerplatforms.
  • Doorgroeimogelijkheden richting bijvoorbeeld lead consultant, business consultant of strategisch adviseur
  • Leaseauto of mobiliteitsbudget, laptop en smartphone
  • Goede secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden, waaronder pensioenregeling en aandelenprogramma
  • Een open, inclusieve en collegiale werkomgeving

Axians is een internationale netwerkorganisatie bestaande uit gespecialiseerde en zelfsturende IT units. In deze rol ga je aan de slag voor het expertisegebied Data & AI. Binnen Data & AI zijn 5 Business Units actief die elk verschillende marktsegmenten bedienen en verschillende proposities hebben.

De engineers die binnen het expertisegebied Data & AI werken, hebben elk hun eigen specialisme en standplaats. Als engineer werk je nauw samen in een multidisciplinair team bestaande uit zowel klant als directe collega's. In deze rol is jouw standplaats de Business Unit in Laren (NH), maar uiteraard krijg jij alle ruimte om jouw werkweek en werklocatie zelf in te delen.

Over Business Data & AI in Laren

De Axians locatie in Laren (NH) is gespecialiseerd in Data & AI. Met zo’n 40 collega’s werken we samen om onze klanten te helpen en adviseren met hun datavraagstukken. Onze klanten zijn grote, innovatieve organisaties als ABN AMRO verzekeringen, Stichting Philadelphia zorg, Zeeman en PGGM. Onze werkwijze isgebaseerd op onze Axians kernwaarden: autonomie, verantwoordelijkheid, ondernemerschap, vertrouwen & transparantie en solidariteit.

Betrokkenheid en een goede werksfeer

De Business Unit bestaat uit betrokken collega's die ook een gezellige werksfeer belangrijk vinden. We vieren onze successen en helpen elkaar door mindere periodes heen. Regelmatig worden er borrels, uitjes met collega's en andere leuke activiteiten georganiseerd.

Leren en ontwikkelen

We kijken naar wat je al kan, maar ook wat je nog kan leren. We zijn er namelijk van overtuigd dat de juiste omgeving jou in staat stelt om alles uit jezelf te halen. En daar helpen we je bij. Want groeien doe je samen. Onze slogan is hier treffend; ICT with a Human Touch.

We nodigen je graag uit om te solliciteren via onderstaande sollicitatiebutton. Wil je eerst meer informatie? Neem dan contact op met Inez Schalks: HR Business Partner via inez.schalks@axians.comof telefonisch via +31 6 13708141

title: SVP of Development
description:
Reports To: President/CEO

Status: Full-time, Salaried (Exempt)

Rate of Pay: $190,000 - $200,000

Posting Timeline: This position will remain open until filled, and will have a priority deadline of October 11, 2026


About Hennepin Arts

Hennepin Arts powers a thriving arts community - rooted in Minneapolis, with impact across Minnesota - through unforgettable experiences, preserving history, expanding opportunity, and inspiring connection through the power of performance. We bring people together through powerful performances and educational programs. Our work preserving historic theatres and activating the District honors the past and shapes the future of Minnesota.


At Hennepin Arts, we believe identity should never be a barrier to belonging or success. Every person on our staff, on our stages, in our audiences, and in our communities deserves to feel seen, respected, and valued. Inclusion is core to who we are and how we lead. We affirm that diversity, equity, inclusion, accessibility, and belonging (DEIAB) are daily practices that shape how we work, who we serve, and what we stand for.


Position Summary

The Senior Vice President (SVP) of Development at Hennepin Arts is responsible for overseeing and enhancing all aspects of the organization’s fundraising from both individual and institutional sources. This senior role is designed to strategically increase the organization’s financial support through innovative fundraising initiatives, major donor cultivation, and securing substantial grants and sponsorships.


Key responsibilities include leading the design and execution of comprehensive giving strategies tailored to the evolving needs of our donor base, ensuring a robust foundation for the organization’s financial health. The SVP will craft and manage a high-level fundraising strategy that aligns intricately with the organization’s overarching financial objectives. This includes leading a dynamic team of fundraising professionals, collaborating closely with the CEO and the Board of Directors, and ensuring all fundraising activities are integrated with the organization’s strategic vision.


The role also demands mastery in orchestrating high-impact fundraising events and campaigns and working closely with the marketing and communications team to effectively promote the organization’s mission. Additionally, the SVP will manage the fundraising budget, monitor progress, and maintain compliance with all relevant laws and ethical standards, thereby upholding the integrity and reputation of Hennepin Arts.


Responsibilities

Individual Giving (25%)

  • Strategically cultivate and steward enduring relationships with major donors to secure and enhance their ongoing support, ensuring a robust foundation for the organization's financial health
  • Direct the comprehensive design and execution of diverse giving strategies, including annual campaigns, structured planned giving programs, and innovative donor recognition initiatives, all tailored to meet the evolving needs of our donor base
  • Proactively identify and engage prospective donors by leveraging expansive networks and community connections, effectively broadening the organization's financial support system and ensuring a continuous influx of new benefactors

Strategic Leadership (20%)

  • Craft and orchestrate a high-level fundraising strategy that intricately aligns with the organization’s overarching financial objectives, meticulously crafted to bolster long-term fiscal sustainability
  • Lead and galvanize a dynamic team of fundraising experts, setting rigorous performance standards and clear, ambitious targets that cultivate a culture of high achievement and strategic excellence
  • Collaborate proactively with the CEO and Board of Directors, ensuring that all fundraising initiatives are seamlessly integrated with the organization’s strategic vision, thereby maximizing impact and coherence across all operational levels

Institutional Fundraising (20%)

  • Proactively secure substantial grants and sponsorships from a broad spectrum of foundations and government entities, strategically enhancing the financial underpinnings of our organization
  • Establish and sustain robust partnerships with institutional funders, ensuring meticulous adherence to reporting requirements and fostering trust through transparency and reliability
  • Meticulously craft and manage a portfolio of proposals and grant applications, carefully aligning each submission with the specific priorities and guidelines of funders to maximize the likelihood of funding success

Events and Campaigns (15%)

  • Mastermind and orchestrate a series of high-impact fundraising events, such as galas, auctions, and donor cultivation gatherings, meticulously designed to maximize engagement and financial contributions
  • Command oversight of capital campaigns and special projects, ensuring their triumphant execution through strategic planning and diligent management
  • Mobilize and empower a network of volunteers and community partners, leveraging their enthusiasm and capabilities to enhance the reach and success of fundraising efforts

Communications and Outreach (10%)

  • Collaborate closely with the marketing and communications team to craft and deploy captivating fundraising materials and campaigns that resonate with diverse audiences
  • Act as a prominent ambassador for Hennepin Arts at public gatherings, meetings, and conferences, vigorously promoting the organization’s mission and fundraising objectives
  • Maintain rigorous and strategic communication with donors and stakeholders, ensuring a consistent and persuasive narrative that bolsters ongoing support and engagement

Financial Management (10%)

  • Devise and administer the fundraising budget with a sharp focus on optimizing resource allocation and achieving financial benchmarks
  • Systematically monitor and report on fundraising progress, providing comprehensive updates to the CEO and Board of Directors to inform strategic decisions
  • Rigorously ensure compliance with all pertinent laws, regulations, and ethical standards, upholding the integrity of fundraising activities and the organization’s reputation

Amsterdam, Netherlands

operates on the cutting-edge use of technology to create a competitive edge over the competition. We also grow quick and have plenty of complex technical challenges. title: Data Engineer
description:
Je ontwikkelt end-to-end data-oplossingen en creëert een solide data-infrastructuur in de cloud.

Data Engineering

Daarnaast kun je bij ons ervoor kiezen om bijv. dataprojecten voor het goede doel te doen. Wij hechten veel waarde aan gezelligheid en gezondheid, daarom hebben wij een sport- en feestcommissie, die o.a. de jaarlijkse wintersport en wekelijkse sportactiviteiten organiseren.

Daarnaast bieden wij ook:

  • een mooie uitdaging binnen een transparante organisatie met een passend salaris op basis van jouw ervaring;
  • volledige reiskostenvergoeding;
  • Macbook of Windows laptop naar keuze;
  • een flexibele pensioenregeling;
  • veel verantwoordelijkheid en flexibele werktijden/ werkplekken.

title: Data & AI Engineer bij Humention
description:
Medior Data & AI Engineer (2-4 jaar ervaring)

Heeft jouw code pas écht waarde als mensen er iets aan hebben?

Bij Humention geloven we dat technologie pas waardevol is als de mens ermee kan werken. We bouwen geen ingewikkelde blackboxes; we bouwen slimme, vloeiende AI-oplossingen die daadwerkelijk het verschil maken. Als Medior Data & AI Engineer bij Humention ben je de architect die data omzet in deze slimme oplossingen. Je zorgt dat de technische basis staat, je traint de modellen en je zorgt dat de AI ook echt gaat werken voor de eindgebruiker.

Ben jij die engineer met 2 tot 4 jaar ervaring die niet blind achter één tech-gigant aanloopt, maar altijd kiest voor de beste architectuur? Dan zoeken we jou.

Wat je bij ons gaat doen (en wat niet)

  • Je bouwt de fundering:Je ontwerpt en onderhoudt robuuste datapijplijnen en traint de AI-modellen die onze oplossingen intelligent maken.
  • Je kijkt met een cloud-agnostische blik:Of we nu met AWS, Google Cloud (BigQuery) of Azurewerken; jij snapt de onderliggende concepten en kiest de beste tool voor de klus. Je durft bestaande ideeën ter discussie te stellen.
  • Je bouwt mee aan de toekomst:Je vindt het vet om je tanden te zetten in de nieuwste ontwikkelingen, zoals het bouwen van eensoevereine data cloudwaarmee we de data-autonomie van onze klanten écht kunnen garanderen.
  • Wat je níet gaat doen:Je verstoppen achter een muur van code. Je schuift aan bij de klant om te begrijpen wat hun échte pijn is. En nee, je hoeft bij ons geen Excel-sheets te vullen; we werken met een moderne, innovatieve tech-stack.

Wie jij bent

  • Je hebt2 tot 4 jaar ervaringals Data- of AI Engineer.
  • Je bentcloud-agnostischóf wil dat zijn. Je hebt ervaring met de grote cloud-omgevingen, maar staart je niet blind op Microsoft; je snapt de kracht van een onafhankelijke, soevereine data-infrastructuur.
  • Je deelt onze passie voorMenselijkheid en Community. Je vindt het leuk om samen te lunchen, een potje padel te spelen of elkaar uit te dagen in Mario Kart.
  • Je bent nieuwsgierig en neemtinitiatief. Als je iets niet weet, ben je niet bang om te zeggen:“Ik weet dit nog niet, wie helpt me?”(Want bij ons is kwetsbaarheid een kracht).

Wat wij jou bieden

  • De ultieme balans tussenvrijheid en verantwoordelijkheid. Geen micromanagement, wel de ruimte om je werk op jouw manier te doen.
  • Een omgeving waar wesamen groeien. Je krijgt een serieus persoonlijk opleidingsbudget dat er is om écht op te maken.
  • Geen achterkamertjespolitiek: we zijn in alles gelijk. Geen individuele privileges (iedereen pakt die reis naar de Randstad als het nodig is), maar wel een glashelder en eerlijk fundament voor het hele team.
  • Een hechte community. Van vette teamuitjes en kookworkshops tot de wekelijkse ‘5minOfFame’ waarin we nieuwe ontdekkingen met elkaar vieren.

title: Lead Autonomy Engineer
description:
Mission

TAR’s mission is to power intelligence for the world. We are building the world’s first off-grid power plant for data centers powered by renewable technologies.

We firmly believe AI should be built in the US for the benefit of all people. For that, power must be fast, clean and scalable. We are singularly focused on delivering GW-scale power faster than anyone has ever done, by rethinking every layer of the stack.

We vertically integrate to solve every bottleneck, from racking systems to power electronics to dispatch algorithms to on-site construction.

Leave your mark on the future of civilization-scale energy infrastructure.

Company

TAR is both a hardware and software company, we are building out massive, critical, physical infrastructure. TAR is working directly with one of the largest compute providers to scale and deploy 5GWs by 2028.

We operate on…

  • High ownership. High Agency. Own project end-to-end. Great people don’t need to be managed.

  • Speed. We achieve great things on incredible timelines. We push ourselves to go faster.

  • First principles. No ego. No hierarchy. Challenge every assumption.

  • Passion. Solving the energy problem is one of the largest challenges that faces the world now and in the future.

About the role: TAR builds its own construction robots to install a proprietary solar racking system at the scale and pace gigawatt campuses demand. The autonomy software that drives them has to hold up in the dust, heat, and vibration of a live construction site in West Texas. As Lead Autonomy Engineer, you own a core piece of the autonomy stack: perception, planning, or controls; from early development through field deployment, and act as the technical lead for a small group of autonomy engineers. You report into the VP of Autonomy and split time between the San Francisco robotics facility and regular field trips to West Texas

Responsibilities:

  • Own the technical design and delivery plan for a defined area of the autonomy stack (e.g., perception, planning, or controls), turning org-level roadmap priorities into concrete engineering work.

  • Lead day-to-day technical direction for a small group of autonomy engineers, reviewing designs and code and mentoring less experienced engineers.

  • Drive your area of the stack from early development through field deployment, validating against real operating conditions.

  • Make architecture and design decisions within your area that hold up under field conditions, working closely with hardware engineers so autonomy is co-developed with the robots it runs on.

  • Own the development lifecycle for your area: roadmap input, prioritization, release, monitoring, and iteration.

  • Spend time at the West Texas site (1-3 weeks per year) closing the loop between field performance and software fixes.

  • Partner with the VP of Autonomy, contributing to hiring and roadmap decisions

Qualifications:

  • 5-7 years of software engineering experience, including some experience leading a small team or serving as a technical lead on a project.

  • Hands-on experience owning software or autonomy for a robotics system through to production or field deployment

  • Comfortable writing realtime, safety critical software with limited compute

  • Solid expertise in one or more of perception, navigation, planning, or controls for autonomous systems.

  • Comfortable reviewing others' technical work and communicating design trade-offs to a manager or cross-functional partners.

Nice to have:

  • Experience with autonomy for energy, industrial, or infrastructure robotics rather than consumer robotics.

  • Experience partnering closely with hardware teams on tightly coupled hardware/software/autonomy systems.

  • Background at a high-growth, venture-backed robotics or hardware startup.

Salary and Benefits

  • Up to $15K relocation bonus

  • Unlimited PTO

  • Health, Dental, Vision insurance

  • $1K monthly stipend for meals
