title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
Job Description

Rakuten Group, Inc. is a global leader in internet services and has a diverse ecosystem spanning across e-commerce, fintech, communications and more serving approximately 1.8 billion members worldwide. Founded in Tokyo in 1997, the Group operates in over 30 countries and regions with more than 30,000 employees.

Based in Singapore's Central Business District, Rakuten Asia Pte. Ltd. serves as the regional headquarters for Asia, driving value through areas such as advertising product development, product strategy, and data management to support Rakuten Group's global ecosystem.

Learn more at:

The Global Ad Technology Department (GATD) manages the whole of the advertising systems that power Rakuten. We are a cross-functional and data-driven organization working together in a diverse team spread across five countries: Japan, Singapore, India, China.

GATD Website:

The APS Team boasts a highly motivated, skilled, talented, and friendly team spread across Tokyo, Singapore, India, and China. We are looking for someone who can quickly integrate and collaborate effectively with our team.

We are seeking a Staff Engineer to join our team and help us define the next generation of our advertising platform. This is not just a coding role it is a position of architectural and technical cultural leadership.

You will own the end-to-end product development lifecycle, leveraging a modern tech stack and AI-augmented workflows to deliver high-impact solutions. We are looking for a technologist who doesn't just keep up with the industry, but shapes it-someone who thrives on building scalable systems, mentoring the next generation of engineers, and integrating AI to push the boundaries of productivity and software quality.

If you are a builder who values technical rigor, thrives in cross-functional environments, and is eager to contribute to Rakuten's expansive global ecosystem, we want to talk to you.

Responsibilities:

Project Execution & Engineering Excellence

  • Technical Leadership: Translate complex business requirements into robust, scalable, and maintainable technical specifications and architectural designs.

  • Lifecycle Ownership: Own the full SDLC-from initial design and implementation to deployment, monitoring, and proactive maintenance across all environments.

  • Quality Assurance: Conduct rigorous code reviews, ensuring adherence to design patterns, security best practices, and long-term maintainability.

    • AI-Augmented Development: Drive engineering velocity by integrating AI-powered coding assistants (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Cursor) into the team's workflow. Establish standards for AI-assisted code generation, ensuring that AI-written code is rigorously vetted for security, accuracy, and alignment with system architecture.

    Strategic Innovation & Productivity

  • System Stewardship: Maintain a deep understanding of the product ecosystem to identify technical debt and architectural bottlenecks. Proactively propose and lead initiatives to refactor or enhance systems for better performance and scalability.

  • AI-Driven Productivity: Leverage advanced prompt engineering to automate repetitive tasks-such as documentation generation, legacy code refactoring, and test suite creation-to maximize team bandwidth.

    • Tech Radar: Stay ahead of the curve by evaluating emerging technologies and AI tools, creating strategic roadmaps to integrate innovations that provide a competitive advantage.

    Collaboration & Cross-Functional Impact

  • Partnership: Act as the primary technical bridge between Product, Design, and Engineering. Translate high-level business objectives into clear, actionable technical plans.

    • Technical Advocacy: Influence product roadmaps by anticipating future technical constraints and opportunities, ensuring the platform remains resilient as business needs evolve.

    Mentorship & Technical Culture

  • Team Growth: Actively mentor junior engineers and interns. Foster a culture of technical excellence by providing constructive feedback, guiding career progression, and promoting best practices in software design.

    • Knowledge Sharing: Champion a culture of continuous learning, ensuring the team stays informed on modern development paradigms and AI-assisted workflows.

Requirements:

  • Experience & Impact: 8+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a proven track record of leading complex, large-scale web application projects from inception to production.

  • Architectural Mastery: Deep hands-on expertise in Java (Spring Boot/Batch) and Cloud-native architectures (GCP ecosystem: BigQuery, DataProc, Composer). Ability to design for scale, performance, and high availability.

  • Data Strategy: Strong proficiency in both relational ( MariaDB/MySQL ) and NoSQL ( MongoDB ) databases, with the ability to choose the right data storage strategy for specific architectural needs.

    AI-Augmented Engineering:

  • Agentic AI: Demonstrated experience in designing or implementing Agentic AI workflows (e.g., using frameworks like LangChain, n8n, dify, or custom agent orchestration) to solve complex business problems.

    • Developer Productivity: Expert-level fluency in AI-assisted coding tools (Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Claude Code) to drive high-velocity development while maintaining rigorous security and quality gates.

    System Design:

  • Analyzing complex business systems, industry requirements and governance, and creating solution designs from them

    • Proven architecture and design experience for cloud-based platforms and enterprise applications including defining microservices boundaries, API design, and asynchronous communication patterns.

  • Soft Skills & Ownership: A 'get-things-done' mindset with demonstrated accountability for system health and team output. Excellent communication skills, with the ability to distill complex technical constraints into business-friendly insights.

Technical Proficiencies

  • Languages & Frameworks: Java (Spring Boot/Batch), JavaScript/TypeScript (HTML5/CSS3).

  • Data & Infrastructure: MariaDB/MySQL, MongoDB, GCP (BigQuery, DataProc, Composer).

  • Tools & Process: Version Control (Git), Agile/Scrum, Task Management (Jira).

title: Medior Data Engineer Capaciteitsmanagement
description:
Medior Data Engineer Capaciteitsmanagement

De wereld verandert snel en onze rol verandert mee. Vanuit onze purpose ‘Banking for better, for generations to come’ zetten we ons in voor een duurzaam, stabiel en veilig financieel systeem. Het opsporen van financiële criminaliteit staat bij ons hoog op de agenda. Maar daarmee vertellen we jou niets nieuws, want je leest de krant. Je bent maatschappelijk betrokken, integer en nieuwsgierig. Je wilt het juiste voor klanten, de maatschappij en de bank. Daar ga je voor. Binnen Detecting Financial Crime (DFC) hebben we alle activiteiten rond het tegengaan van witwassen, terrorisme financiering en corruptie samengebracht.

Door kennis, expertise en krachten te bundelen, zijn we beter in staat financiële criminaliteit te weren en nieuwe ontwikkelingen het hoofd te bieden. Voortschrijdende technologie is zowel een kans als een bedreiging. Niet alleen kunnen wij hierdoor ons opsporingswerk verbeteren, ook maakt het de georganiseerde misdaad steeds geavanceerder. Detecting financial crime is dan ook een ongoing process dat dag in dag uit het uiterste vraagt van onze expertise en alertheid.

  • Analyseren van complexe databestanden, combineren van gegevens uit verschillende bronnen en vertalen naar waardevolle inzichten voor de business.
  • Werken volgens het Agile framework in sprints van 2 weken onder leiding van een Product Owner.
  • Samenwerken met de product owner en interne stakeholders om wensen en functionaliteiten te realiseren.
  • Bouwen van een product dat voldoet aan de wensen van de klant.
  • Zorgen dat tickets refined en dus helder zijn.
  • Opleveren van het werk dat in de sprint backlog opgenomen wordt.
  • Transparant communiceren over (mogelijke) impediments, zowel technisch, functioneel als in de relationele sfeer.
  • Opleiden nieuwe developers.
  • Coachen en begeleiden collega developers.
  • Beheer en inrichting architectuur.
  • Meedraaien in projecten.
  • Deskundige op specifieke technische onderwerpen & adviserende rol voor de Product Owner.

Werkomgeving

De afdeling Capaciteitsmanagement is een afdeling binnen Execution Enablement. Jij gaat in de rol als medior data engineer actief bijdragen bij om het KYC Center zo optimaal mogelijk te laten presteren. Het team staat opgesteld om workforce management (WFM) te ontwikkelen en uit te rollen over heel DFC. We werken lokaal in VSCode en maken geen gebruik van cloud-applicaties zoals Azure cloud of Databricks.

Je zult werken in het scrumteam Data & Dashboarding (D&D) met 6 collega developers onder leiding van een Product Owner. We gebruiken de data van onze WFM collega’s en zetten deze om in bruikbare PowerBI dashboards voor zowel onze WFM als DFC collega’s. De uitdaging zit in het schaalbaar en duurzaam ontwikkelen van de back-end infrastructuur waarop de capaciteitsplanning en de PowerBI dashboards gebouwd worden.

  • Minimaal WO werk- en denkniveau.
  • Je hebt 3+ jaar relevante werkervaring als data engineer of (back-end) developer.
  • Je hebt gevorderde kennis van en ervaring met Python en SQL.
  • Je bent een team player, communicatief sterk en pro-actief ingesteld.
  • Pré: kennis en ervaring met PowerBI.
  • Pré: kennis en ervaring met Agile/Scrum.
  • Pré: kennis en ervaring met SAFe principes.
  • Pré: kennis en ervaring met KYC.
  • Analytisch denken: Logisch redeneren, herkennen van gegevens die van belang zijn; verbanden leggen tussen verschillende vormen van informatie, oorzaak en gevolg en afwegen van alternatieven.
  • Nieuwsgierig: Is geïnteresseerd naar en ontvankelijk voor nieuwe ideeën en benaderingen. Verdiept zich in de beweegredenen en standpunten van anderen. Leert van nieuwe ervaringen.
  • Oordeelsvorming: Beschikbare informatie verzamelen en gebruiken om juiste en realistische conclusies te trekken.
  • Autonomie: De eigen overtuigingen als leidraad hanteren voor besluiten en acties; zelfstandig handelen en een eigen standpunt innemen.

Wij bieden

Bij Detecting Financial Crime kom je terecht in een gedreven en dynamische werkomgeving, waarin hard gewerkt wordt vanuit een gezamenlijke visie en doelstelling. Een platte structuur, korte communicatielijnen, resultaatgerichtheid en een intensieve samenwerking met andere afdelingen kenmerken onze nieuwe unit. We stellen hoge eisen aan ons werk en verliezen hierbij nooit de menselijke touch uit het oog omdat we ervan overtuigd zijn dat juist dat essentieel is voor het slagen van onze missie. Daarnaast bieden wij je:

  • Het bovenaan de pagina weergegeven bruto maandsalaris is op basis van een 36-urige werkweek, inclusief vakantiegeld en benefit budget. Het gaat hier om een functie in Schaal 9.
  • Een hybride werkplek (2 dagen in de week op kantoor en de rest vanuit huis).
  • Het benefit budget bedraagt 11% van je salaris. Als je in een maand geen aankopen of reserveringen doet in de Benefit Shop, krijg je over die maand een twaalfde deel van je benefit budget uitbetaald.
  • Vijf weken vakantie per jaar. Je hebt de mogelijkheid om vier weken per jaar bij te kopen.
  • Persoonlijk Ontwikkelbudget van € 1.000,- per jaar. Dit bedrag kun je opsparen tot € 3.000,-.
  • Een ov-jaarabonnement met gratis openbaar vervoer in heel Nederland.
  • Een uitstekende pensioenregeling.

Jouw Toekomst: Inclusief, Innovatief en Duurzaam

Bij ABN AMRO geloven we in “Banking for better, for generations to come.” Gelijke kansen voor iedereen vormen een belangrijk fundament, waarbij we streven naar een inclusieve cultuur waarin alle medewerkers zich gezien, gehoord en gewaardeerd voelen. Onze visie alspersoonlijke bank in de digitale tijdsluit naadloos aan bij de behoefte aan verrassende inzichten en innovatieve oplossingen, voortkomend uit een divers samenspel van culturen en ervaringen. We richten ons op klantbeleving, duurzaamheid en bouwen aan een toekomstbestendige bank, waarbij we gelijke beloning voor gelijk werk jaarlijks onderzoeken om eerlijke kansen te waarborgen. Sluit je aan bij een bank die vindingrijkheid en ambitie omarmt, en maak samen met ons impact voor een betere toekomst.

Als je wilt solliciteren voor het B-Able of Reboot programma, zorg er dan voor dat je dit vermeldt zowel in de titel als in de inhoud van je cv.

Externe recruitmentbureaus dienen een overeenkomst met ABN AMRO BANK N.V. te hebben getekend, uitgegeven door een Talent Acquisition Specialist, om cv’s te mogen indienen. Acquisitie wordt daarom niet op prijs gesteld.

3 We nodigen je uit voor een of meerdere interview(s)

description:
AOCUSA|AMALIE OIL COMPANY IS HIRING IN TAMPA

Competitive pay and great benefits!

AOCUSA pays the full cost of our Employee’s Health Insurance


We are looking for a Creative Department Administrative Assistant for the following shift:

First Shift: 9:00 AM EST – 5:00 PM EST

Full-Time: Monday – Friday

OnSite: Tampa, Florida


Amalie Oil Company is North America's largest privately held independent blender of motor oils and industrial lubricants. With production facilities in Tampa, Florida; Charleston, South Carolina; and the Los Angeles area, Amalie manufactures over 3,000 products and distributes to all 50 states and over 100 countries around the world.

Better than it has to be... Since 1903.

Are you looking for the right opportunity to establish your career?

We are growing and need talented team players to join us!


JOB SUMMARY

We are hiring a friendly Creative Department Assistant to join AOCUSA full-time on-site in Tampa, serving as the first point of contact for visitors. This role is ideal for an outgoing, people-oriented professional who enjoys engaging with visitors while also supporting administrative and marketing functions. The position combines traditional reception duties with hands-on involvement in promotional fulfillment, artwork proofing, and trade show preparation, making it a dynamic opportunity for someone who thrives in a customer-focused environment.


Essential Duties

Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

· Proofreading to ensure accuracy of labels and marketing materials

· Check artwork – detail oriented

· Fulfilling wearable orders, filing, creating P.O’s/S.O.’s

· Lead handler of promotional inventory and ordering

· Fulfill promotional orders and maintain inventory of marketing collateral.

· Operate printer/cutter equipment to produce brochures, sell sheets, and other materials (training provided).

· Prepare and organize items for trade shows and company event

· Greet and assist visitors, clients, employees, candidates, and vendors in a professional and friendly manner.

· Support administrative tasks, including filing, document organization, and general office duties.

· Manage incoming calls and direct inquiries appropriately.

· Collaborate with internal teams to ensure smooth office and event operations.


Required Qualifications

  • Excellent interpersonal and customer service skills.
  • High school diploma or equivalent required.
  • May require occasional overtime or flexibility in working hours to meet department needs.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint)
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Ability to multitask and manage time effectively in an office environment.
  • Comfort with light production tasks: printing, cutting, assembling, packaging, etc.

Work Environment + Physical Requirements

This job operates in a professional office environment. This position routinely uses standard office equipment such as computers, phones, photocopiers, filing cabinets, and fax machines. Moderate noise can be expected from the office equipment as well as trains and trucks from the plant. This job may occasionally require walks through the industrial plant with exposure to non-controlled temperatures and moderate noises. Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer. Must be able to lift up to 50 pounds at times

description:

title: Project Manager, Facilities & Capital Projects
description:
Overview

Marin Community Clinics, founded in 1972, is today, a multi-clinic network with a wide array of integrated primary care, dental, behavioral, specialty and referral services. As a Federally Qualified Health Center (FQHC), we provide vital health services to almost 40,000 individuals annually in Marin County. The Clinics regularly receive national awards from the Health Resources and Services Administrations (HRSA). Our Mission is to promote health and wellness through excellent, compassionate care for all.

The Project Manager, Facilities & Capital Projects will lead the planning, design, permitting, construction, relocation, activation, and occupancy of major administrative and clinical facility projects. Serving as MCC's primary project lead and owner's representative, the Project Manager coordinates architects, engineers, contractors, landlords, consultants, regulatory agencies, vendors, and MCC leadership to ensure projects are completed within approved scope, budget, schedule, quality, operational, and regulatory requirements.The initial focus of this role will be leading MCC’s 47,000-square-foot facility project, including the relocation and buildout of administrative offices, as well as the planning, permitting, construction, and operational activation of new clinical space.

Responsibilities

Project Leadership and Coordination:

  • Manage projects from planning and design through permitting, construction, activation, occupancy, and closeout.
  • Develop and maintain project plans, schedules, budgets, milestones, risk registers, decision logs, and action-item trackers.
  • Serve as MCC's primary point of coordination for landlords, architects, engineers, contractors, consultants, vendors, regulatory agencies, and internal stakeholders.
  • Facilitate project meetings and document decisions, approvals, risks, and action items.
  • Identify project risks, schedule delays, budget concerns, and operational challenges and implement mitigation strategies.
  • Prepare and present project status reports to executive leadership, Board committees, and the Board of Directors as requested.

Planning, Design, and Regulatory Coordination:

  • Collaborate with clinical, operational, facilities, information technology, compliance, finance, and administrative teams to determine project requirements.
  • Translate organizational and clinical workflow into functional space and design requirements.
  • Review plans and specifications for compliance with approved scope, budget, accessibility, patient safety, privacy, and operational requirements.
  • Coordinate space planning, furniture, equipment, signage, telecommunications, security systems, and technology infrastructure.
  • Manage permitting, inspections, licensing, fire clearances, accessibility compliance, and occupancy approvals.
  • Coordinate compliance with California Building Standards Code, Title 24, HCAI/OSHPD 3 requirements, and healthcare licensing standards.

Budget, Contracts, and Procurement:

  • Develop, monitor, and manage project budgets, including construction, design, equipment, furniture, permitting, technology, contingencies, relocation, and activation expenses.
  • Track landlord-funded tenant improvement allowances and MCC-funded expenditures.
  • Review contracts, invoices, payment applications, change orders, commitments, and cost forecasts.
  • Coordinate expense review, approvals, reimbursements, and documentation with Finance and other departments.
  • Support procurement and selection of architects, contractors, consultants, and vendors.
  • Monitor vendor and contractor performance and address schedule, budget, contractual, and performance issues.

Construction Management:

  • Monitor construction progress, quality, safety, compliance, schedules, and budgets.
  • Conduct site visits and participate in owner-architect-contractor meetings.
  • Review contractor schedules, progress reports, invoices, change orders, submittals, and project documentation.
  • Coordinate testing and transition of HVAC, electrical, plumbing, elevators, fire and life safety systems, security systems, telecommunications, and other critical building systems.
  • Ensure construction deficiencies are documented and corrected.
  • Coordinate infection prevention and safety measures during construction activities adjacent to active healthcare operations.

Relocation and Facility Activation:

  • Develop and execute relocation and activation plans that minimize disruption to patient care and business operations.
  • Coordinate furniture installation, equipment setup, technology testing, security implementation, signage, supplies, staff training, and operational readiness activities.
  • Establish and monitor department-specific readiness checklists.
  • Coordinate inspections, occupancy approvals, licenses, and regulatory clearances.
  • Ensure all operational, safety, training, equipment, and regulatory requirements are met prior to occupancy and service activation.

Project Closeout:

  • Manage commissioning activities, punch lists, final inspections, warranties, training, and project closeout documentation.
  • Obtain as-built drawings, operations and maintenance manuals, permits, warranties, certifications, and inspection records.
  • Coordinate turnover of facilities documentation and systems to Facilities, Information Technology, and operational departments.
  • Reconcile project financials, including final invoices, reimbursements, and lien releases.
  • Monitor warranty issues and facilitate timely resolution.

Other Duties:

  • Perform other related duties as assigned to support departmental and organizational objectives.

Qualifications

Qualifications:

  • Excellent organizational and time-management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
  • Strong budgeting, financial management, and contract administration skills.
  • Ability to identify project risks, analyze issues, and implement effective solutions.
  • Exceptional verbal and written communication skills.
  • Strong stakeholder management and relationship-building abilities.
  • Ability to lead cross-functional teams and influence decision-making without direct authority.
  • Strong negotiation and conflict-resolution skills.
  • Proficiency in project management software and Microsoft Office applications.
  • Ability to maintain confidentiality and exercise sound judgment.
  • Commitment to patient safety, accessibility, health equity, and high-quality healthcare environments.

Required Skills and Abilities:

  • Commitment to patient safety, accessibility, health equity, and high-quality healthcare environments.

Education and Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree in construction management, Architecture, Engineering, Facilities Management, Business Administration, Healthcare Administration, or a related field required.
  • Five (5) or more years of progressively responsible project management experience involving healthcare facilities, commercial construction, capital improvement projects, tenant improvements, medical office developments, or complex facility relocations. Equivalent combination of education and related experience may be considered.

title: Senior Software Development Engineer In Test
description:
We anticipate the application window for this opening will close on - 21 Sep 2026 At MiniMed, you can begin a lifelong career of exploration and innovation, while helping make a difference in the lives of people living with diabetes around the globe. You'll lead with purpose, breaking down barriers to innovation for a more connected, compassionate world.

About the Role

The Senior Software Development Engineer in Test is a coding-focused individual contributor responsible for verification and validation (V&V) of embedded software used in insulin-pump systems. This role develops and maintains automated test software, reusable libraries, frameworks, and CI/CD integrations while executing risk-based testing across firmware, embedded applications, device interfaces, hardware/software integration, and supporting test infrastructure. The engineer partners closely with software, systems, hardware, quality, and regulatory teams to build high-confidence evidence that product requirements are met and patient safety is protected.

Responsibilities

  • Test Automation & Engineering Tools
    • Design, develop, version, and maintain production-quality automated test scripts, test library functions, framework APIs, utilities, and test data using Python and JavaScript.
    • Write clean, maintainable, and well-structured test software for embedded-device workflows including device configuration, communication interfaces, logging, data capture, and result analysis.
    • Integrate, troubleshoot, and maintain automated tests in source control and CI/CD pipelines, including test execution, quality gates, reporting, and failure diagnostics.
    • Debug test scripts, framework libraries, CI/CD failures, and test-environment issues; identify root causes and implement durable corrective fixes.
  • AI-Enabled Quality Engineering
    • Apply AI-assisted tools responsibly to improve requirements analysis, test design, test-data generation, log analysis, defect triage, and test documentation.
    • Evaluate AI-enabled testing capabilities for accuracy, traceability, security, intended use, and fit within a regulated medical-device development environment.
    • Use engineering judgment to review AI-generated outputs and ensure that test evidence remains accurate, reproducible, and compliant with established quality processes.
  • Embedded Pump Software Verification & Validation
    • Develop and execute test strategies, test plans, protocols, test cases, and reports for embedded pump firmware.
    • Analyze software and system requirements, architecture, interfaces, and risk controls to identify test conditions, gaps, and traceable verification evidence.
    • Perform functional, integration, regression, reliability, fault-injection, and recovery testing of embedded device behavior.
    • Validate hardware/software interactions using hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) and software-in-the-loop (SIL) benches, simulators, test fixtures, and laboratory equipment.
    • Investigate defects, isolate root causes, document reproducible evidence, and partner with development teams through resolution and verification.
  • Quality, Risk & Regulatory Compliance
    • Create and maintain objective V&V evidence, including traceability between requirements, risks, tests, results, deviations, and defects.
    • Execute risk-based testing in accordance with design controls, applicable procedures, and relevant medical-device standards, including IEC 62304, ISO 13485, and risk-management processes.
    • Support design reviews, risk analyses, audits, investigations, CAPAs, and release-readiness activities as needed.
    • Identify quality risks and opportunities to improve test coverage, product reliability, and engineering processes.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration & Technical Leadership
    • Collaborate with Systems Engineering, Embedded Software, Hardware, Quality, Regulatory, Cybersecurity, and Manufacturing teams throughout the product lifecycle.
    • Communicate test status, quality risks, defects, and recommendations clearly to technical and cross-functional stakeholders.
    • Provide technical guidance and mentorship to test engineers, share automation and embedded-test practices, and contribute as a senior member of the team.

Required Qualifications

  • Requires a bachelor's degree and minimum of 4 years of relevant experience, or an advanced degree with a minimum of 2 years of relevant experience.
  • Experience testing embedded software, firmware, real-time systems, or hardware/software integrated products; medical-device experience is strongly preferred.
  • Strong hands‑on programming proficiency in Python and JavaScript, including code design, debugging, refactoring, use of version control, and development of reusable functions and libraries.
  • Hands‑on experience with embedded debugging and test tools such as HIL systems, simulators, test fixtures, serial interfaces, protocol analyzers, device logs, or laboratory instruments.
  • Demonstrated hands‑on software development experience building and maintaining automated test frameworks, reusable libraries, and utilities; ability to debug and resolve issues in test code independently.
  • Experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD workflows, including pipeline configuration, test execution, quality gates, reporting, and diagnosis of pipeline failures.
  • Experience with AI‑enabled testing or AI‑assisted engineering workflows, including the ability to evaluate output quality, maintain appropriate traceability and human review, and apply generated code responsibly.

title: Executive Functioning Coach - Contract/1099
description:
About Blackbird Health

Blackbird Health is clinician-founded, owned, and operated by dedicated professionals. We believe that providing the best care for children starts with building the best possible team. We deliver virtual and in-person mental health services across Pennsylvania, Virginia, New Jersey & Maryland—and we’re growing into new markets in 2027.

At Blackbird, we take a whole-child approach, looking at how the brain, body, and behavior interact to address the root causes of challenges, not just the symptoms. Every role matters here, and you’ll join a collaborative, supportive, and innovative team that’s shaping the future of pediatric mental health care. If you’re passionate about helping children and families while growing your career, Blackbird is the place to make an impact.

Join us and help change mental health care for children for the better!

Position Summary

As an Executive Functioning Coach, you will provide evidence-based coaching to children, adolescents, and young adults facing daily challenges with executive functioning and task management. You will help clients build practical strategies to improve organization, planning, time management, task initiation, and independence across home, school, and community settings. Partnering closely with our interdisciplinary care team, you will implement individualized, skills-based plans that drive lasting functional outcomes.

We welcome candidates from backgrounds in Special Education, Reading/Learning Support, School Psychology, Counseling, Occupational Therapy, or Speech-Language Pathology to help clients build practical strategies for home, school, and community settings. This is a fully remote opportunity.

How You’ll Make an Impact

  • Deliver Virtual Coaching: Conduct 6–10 weekly virtual coaching sessions (45-minute sessions + 15-minute documentation).
  • Build Real-World Tools: Create practical family resources, handouts, and actionable strategies to reinforce skill-building between sessions.
  • Collaborate Interdisciplinarily: Partner with the Specialty Services Team and participate in weekly team consultations.
  • Support Peak Hours: Maintain client availability during high-demand family times (weekday evenings between 3:00 PM – 7:00 PM or weekends).

What Makes You, You

  • Subject Matter Depth: Strong understanding of executive dysfunction (ADHD, autism, learning differences, anxiety) and how it affects daily routines.
  • Practical Strategist: Proven ability to translate complex cognitive concepts into simple, real-world tools tailored to a child's age and learning style.
  • Collaborative Communicator: Excellent rapport-building skills with children, parents, and interdisciplinary care teams.
  • Tech & Compliance Savvy: Comfortable navigating EMR platforms and managing patient records in compliance with HIPAA guidelines.

The Basics You’ll Need

  • Education: Associate’s degree or higher in Special Education, Education, OT/COTA, SLP/SLPA, Counseling, Psychology, or a related human services field (equivalent practical experience considered).
  • Experience: Direct experience supporting executive functioning, learning differences, or skill-building in educational, therapeutic, or pediatric settings.
  • Licensure: No formal clinical license required; relevant professional certifications or credentials are welcomed.
Salary Range
$30—$35 USD

Join us!

To raise the standard of pediatric mental health care through accurate understanding and precise treatment that reflect how each child’s brain, body, and behavior work together.

“It's so rare to find comprehensive care like this---from testing to therapy to med management (and more)--all in one place. In addition, the school advocacy support we receive is unprecedented. We no longer feel like we are managing things alone.”

Fostering an inclusive environment:

Blackbird is committed to cultivating and preserving a culture of inclusion and belonging. We are able to grow and learn better together with a diverse team of employees. In recruiting for our team, we welcome the unique contributions that you can bring in terms of your education, opinions, culture, ethnicity, race, sex, gender identity and expression, nation of origin, age, languages spoken, veteran status, color, religion, disability, sexual orientation and beliefs. Blackbird provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type. If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or interview process, please contact us at recruiting@blackbirdhealth.com so we can support you.

Our patient support team is busy helping children and families, please do not call or email them about your application — this helps us process your application more efficiently.

description:
Job Title: Helpdesk Specialist Senior (807334)
Location: Washington, DC
Employment Type: Contract
Engagement Type: W2 or 1099 (No C2C)

Position Summary

Dhaka Technologies Limited Company (DTLC) is hiring a Helpdesk Specialist Senior on behalf of the District of Columbia Department of Energy and Environment (DOEE), the leading authority on energy and environmental issues affecting the District. The Helpdesk Specialist Senior responds to and diagnoses problems through discussion with users and provides technical assistance to computer system users in a Windows-based environment. The role covers desktop and laptop deployment, mobile device support, Microsoft 365 and collaboration tool troubleshooting, printer and conference room technology support, and inventory and asset management.

Key Responsibilities

Deployment and Configuration

  • Configure, prepare, and deploy new desktop and laptop computers for staff, including installation of required software and security tools.
  • Deploy and configure mobile devices, including iPads and iPhones, ensuring proper enrollment, security compliance, and application setup.
  • Implement and support shared software, including operating systems, configuration management tools, and standard enterprise software applications.
  • Assist with the coordination and implementation of system upgrades, patches, and new hardware and software deployments.

Technical Support and Troubleshooting

  • Provide technical assistance to computer system users in a Windows-based environment.
  • Identify, research, and resolve software issues involving Microsoft 365 applications, Adobe products, email, Microsoft Teams, and OneDrive.
  • Respond to telephone calls, emails, and personnel requests for desktop and mobile device support, and resolve computer problems in person, by telephone, or through remote support tools.
  • Provide support for printing devices and office copiers, including installation, print queue and printing troubleshooting, and replacement of consumables.
  • Assist users with Cisco conference room technology and with Webex and Microsoft Teams meeting setup and connectivity troubleshooting.
  • Provide support for computer peripherals including wireless keyboards, mice, scanners, local printers, and wireless headsets.
  • Use diagnostic tools and reference materials, and read and interpret technical manuals and documentation, to resolve hardware and software issues.

Documentation and Asset Management

  • Document, track, and monitor reported issues to ensure timely and complete resolution.
  • Follow procedures and maintain inventory and asset management for computers, mobile devices, printers, and related equipment, including tracking assignments, returns, and lifecycle status.
  • Maintain knowledge of commonly used concepts, practices, and procedures within desktop support and enterprise IT environments.

Communication

  • Communicate clearly and effectively with end users and IT team members, and provide accurate and complete answers to general computing and administrative questions in a timely manner.
  • Communicate status updates and provide timely reporting on work activities, task progress, and issue resolution.

Required Skills and Experience

  • 11+ years diagnosing and resolving end user computer and computer peripheral problems
  • 11+ years providing second-tier support to end users for server or mainframe applications and hardware
  • 11+ years documenting, tracking, and monitoring end user, server, or mainframe application and hardware problems

Education

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Technology or a related field, or equivalent experience (15+ years)

Work Requirements

  • This contract is open to W2 or 1099 candidates only. Corp-to-Corp (C2C) candidates will not be considered.
  • The final interview will be conducted in person.

How to Apply

Qualified candidates should email their resume to talent@dhakatech.us with "Helpdesk Specialist Senior (807334)" in the subject line.

title: Fusion Configuration Specialist – Oracle Cloud Financials
description:
The Opportunity:

Mattel is seeking a Fusion Configuration Specialist – Oracle Cloud Financials to play a critical role in the configuration, optimization, and ongoing management of our Oracle Cloud Fusion Financials environment. This role will join the Global Technology Organization (GTO), Corporate Systems Applications team, which supports Finance, Legal, and Human Resources across Mattel’s global enterprise.

As Mattel continues its transformation to Oracle Cloud Fusion, this role will serve as a senior individual contributor and subject matter expert focused on Oracle Fusion Financials configuration, leveraging configuration workbooks and configuration snapshot tools to manage, migrate, and govern system setups across environments. The ideal candidate brings deep hands-on experience configuring Fusion Financials modules in complex, global organizations and understands how configuration decisions directly impact business processes, controls, and scalability.

This role is based on site in El Segundo, CA (Mattel Headquarters), and partners closely with Finance stakeholders, IT application leads, integration teams, and external consulting partners.

What Your Impact Will Be:

  • Own and manage Oracle Cloud Fusion Financials configuration across environments (Dev, Test, Stage, Prod) using configuration workbooks and the configuration snapshot tool
  • Serve as the primary configuration expert for Oracle Fusion Financials modules, ensuring accuracy, consistency, and alignment with business and control requirements
  • Support and maintain configuration across core Financials process areas, including:
    • Record to Report
    • Order to Cash
    • Requisition to Pay
    • Acquire to Retire
    • Plan to Perform
    • Projects to Result
  • Manage configuration migration activities, including snapshot creation, comparison, validation, and deployment between environments
  • Partner with Finance and IT teams to translate business requirements into scalable, supportable Oracle Fusion configurations
  • Ensure configurations comply with SOX controls, audit requirements, and internal governance standards
  • Support the Oracle Cloud Fusion architecture post-migration from Oracle E-Business Suite
  • Identify opportunities to simplify configurations, reduce customization, and align with Oracle best practices
  • Collaborate with integration and technical teams to understand configuration dependencies and downstream impacts
  • Participate in design and configuration review sessions with business users, IT leadership, and implementation partners
  • Troubleshoot and resolve configuration-related issues across environments, including during testing cycles and production support
  • Support go-live readiness, cutover activities, and post-production stabilization
  • Stay current on Oracle Cloud Fusion Financials quarterly updates and recommend configuration changes or feature adoption when beneficial

Documentation & Governance

  • Create and maintain detailed configuration documentation, including:
    • Configuration Workbooks
    • Configuration Snapshot inventories and deployment records
    • Current-state and future-state setup documentation
    • Process and configuration impact assessments
  • Clearly communicate configuration changes, dependencies, and impacts to business and IT stakeholders
  • Support knowledge transfer from implementation partners and help transition Mattel to long-term self-sufficiency

What We’re Looking For:

  • Bachelors degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Finance Systems, or a related field
  • 10+ years of hands-on Oracle Fusion Cloud Financials experience, with deep focus on system configuration
  • Proven expertise configuring Oracle Fusion Financials modules in a global, multi-ledger, multi-OU environment
  • Extensive experience using:
    • Oracle Fusion Configuration Workbooks
    • Configuration Snapshot creation, comparison, and migration
  • Strong functional understanding of Oracle Financials business processes from a global enterprise perspective
  • Experience supporting or participating in Oracle EBS to Oracle Fusion migrations
  • Familiarity with Oracle Financials setup components such as ledgers, COA structures, calendars, currencies, tax, intercompany, approvals, and security
  • Experience working in SOX-controlled environments and partnering with internal audit teams
  • Ability to work independently as a senior individual contributor while collaborating across IT and business teams
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain configuration concepts and impacts to non-technical stakeholders
  • Experience working with external implementation partners and consulting firms
  • Oracle Cloud Financials certifications strongly preferred

Don’t meet every single requirement? At Mattel, we are dedicated to an inclusive workplace and a culture of belonging. If you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we still encourage you to apply. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles. Join Mattel's Talent Community and start receiving exciting updates about our company, our employees, and our culture. title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Blis Digital is één van de eerste échte AI-first bedrijven van Nederland. Niet omdat het goed klinkt, maar omdat we al 20 jaar vooroplopen; van de eerste webplatformen tot de nieuwste AI-gedreven oplossingen.

Bij ons sta je midden in de frontlinie van digitale innovatie. We werken met organisaties die vooruit willen, lef hebben en samen met ons oplossingen bouwen die écht impact maken. Ook jouw collega’s behoren tot de top van de markt: (ex-)CTO-profielen, ervaren consultants, engineers en designers die allemaal een stap verder denken.

En misschien wel het mooiste: zowel klanten als collega’s blijven hier lang. Omdat we bouwen aan duurzame relaties, slimme oplossingen en een cultuur waarin leren, eigenaarschap en plezier vanzelfsprekend zijn.

Als Senior Data Engineer bij Blis Digital...

We zoeken een Senior Data Engineer die weet hoe een dataplatform er van binnen uitziet. Iemand die de architectuur bedenkt, het fundament neerzet en andere developers aanstuurt om het samen neer te zetten.

Je werkt niet vanachter een ticket-systeem, maar zit bij klanten aan tafel. In gesprek met stakeholders, zodat je snapt wat je bouwt én waarom. Dat doe je in een klein en slagvaardig team, direct samen met de klant. Van de eerste vraag tot werkbare inzichten waar beslissingen op worden genomen.

Hoe wij werken: AI-Native Engineering

Bij Blis bouwen we niet meer op de oude manier. Wij werken volgens onze AI-Native Engineering aanpak: kleine, senior teams die AI inzetten als kern van het ontwikkelproces. Niet als gadget ernaast. Dat betekent dat jij niet acht uur per dag code tikt, maar architectuur ontwerpt, AI-agents aanstuurt en resultaten valideert. Dat vraagt om mensen die eigenaarschap nemen over het resultaat en scherp genoeg zijn om te definiëren wat er gebouwd moet worden vóórdat er één regel code staat.

Wat ga je doen?

  • Data-architecturen ontwerpen en opzetten volgens de medallion-architectuur (Bronze / Silver / Gold)
  • ETL/ELT-pipelines bouwen in Azure Data Factory en Microsoft Fabric
  • Zorgen dat data die in Power BI landt correct, schoon en schaalbaar is
  • End-to-end verantwoordelijkheid nemen: van intake en ontwerp tot deployment
  • Andere developers aansturen en begeleiden op technische keuzes en kwaliteit
  • Technische keuzes onderbouwen richting zowel developers als business stakeholders

Musthaves

  • Minimaal 8 jaar ervaring in data engineering of een vergelijkbare rol
  • Diepgaande kennis van data warehousing: dimensionaal modelleren, medallion-architectuur, best practices
  • Sterke SQL-skills en ervaring met Microsoft-dataplatformen en relationele databases
  • Hands‑on ervaring met Microsoft Azure: Fabric, Azure SQL, Azure Data Factory
  • Ervaring met Python voor dataverwerking, automatisering en pipeline development
  • Basiskennis van Power BI: je bouwt geen dashboards, maar begrijpt wat de BI‑laag nodig heeft
  • Een bewezen track record in het end-to-end opleveren van dataprojecten
  • Ervaring met projectmatig werken: je weet wat het betekent om binnen scope, budget en planning te leveren
  • Het vermogen om te schakelen tussen een technisch gesprek met developers en een functioneel gesprek met product owners of managers

Wie ben jij?

Je bent iemand die snapt hoe een dataplatform werkt. Niet op theorie‑niveau, maar omdat je er zelf meerdere hebt gebouwd. Je denkt in architectuur, zet het fundament neer en zorgt dat andere developers effectief mee kunnen bouwen.

Je wacht niet af. Je fixt het. Je durft dingen uit te proberen, accepteert dat niet alles in één keer lukt en leert snel van wat misgaat. Je hebt een gezonde allergie voor “dat doen we altijd zo” en een natuurlijke neiging om dingen slimmer en beter te maken.

Je hebt te veel projecten zien ontsporen om er nog diplomatiek omheen te draaien. Als de architectuur niet klopt, zeg je het. Als de planning onrealistisch is, zeg je het. Maar je laat het niet bij constateren — je komt met een richting.

Kort gezegd: fail fast, learn quick, build cool stuff.

Wat bieden wij jou

  • Brutosalaris van €4.500 – €6.900 op basis van 40 uur
  • Jaarlijkse winstdeling (wij geloven niet in individuele bonussen; succes behalen we samen)
  • 25 vakantiedagen
  • Pensioenregeling
  • Contract voor 1 jaar met uitzicht op een vast contract
  • Leaseauto of mobiliteitsvergoeding
  • Thuiswerkplek ter waarde van €250
  • Laptop en telefoon van de zaak
  • Hybride werken: 2-3 dagen op kantoor in Barendrecht of bij de klant

title: Research Engineer - Environments, Data and Post-Training
description:
About Mercor

Mercor's mission is to organize human intelligence to power the AI economy. We're a leading AI data company, building the layer between human expertise and frontier models. Millions of domain experts on the platform are paid over $4 million per day to train frontier AI models. Mercor's APEX benchmark family measures AI's real-world impact on professional work. Mercor Enterprise brings this same infrastructure to Fortune 500 companies: helping companies capture how their best people actually work, translating that expertise directly back into agents.

Mercor is creating a new category of work where expertise powers AI advancement. Achieving this requires an ambitious, fast-paced and deeply committed team. You’ll work alongside researchers, operators, and AI companies at the forefront of shaping the systems that are redefining society. Mercor is a profitable Series C company valued at $10 billion. We work in-person five days a week in our San Francisco, NYC, or London offices.

About the Role

As a Research Scientist at Mercor, you will work at the intersection of research and engineering on frontier post-training. You will develop new training and evaluation methods, test them through rigorous experiments, and implement successful approaches at scale.

Working with researchers, engineers, domain experts, and customers, you will investigate how data, rewards, environments, and optimization methods shape model behavior. Your work will influence frontier models, Mercor’s products, and the broader research community through releasing blogposts, technical reports, and papers.

What You’ll Do

  • Implement novel post-training methods that improve model reasoning, tool use, and agentic behavior.

  • Develop new training recipes for frontier open models.

  • Design and run experiments across datasets, reward functions, environments, and optimization strategies, including methods such as GRPO and DAPO.

  • Build reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) and other post-training pipelines at scale.

  • Investigate model capabilities and failure modes, then develop targeted training interventions.

  • Create methods for measuring data quality, usability, and causal impact on model performance.

  • Build scalable pipelines for data generation, filtering, augmentation, and selection.

  • Develop rubrics, evaluators, benchmarks, and scoring systems that inform training decisions.

  • Translate open-ended research questions into rigorous experiments and production systems.

  • Collaborate with researchers, applied AI teams, engineers, and domain experts producing training data.

  • Contribute to open-source post-training tools and research.

What We’re Looking For

  • Demonstrated experience training and evaluating machine learning models.

  • A strong research record in post-training, reinforcement learning, language-model evaluation, data-centric ML, or a closely related field.

  • Ability to reason rigorously about model behavior, experimental results, and data quality.

  • Strong programming skills and experience implementing machine learning systems.

  • Knowledge of the current AI research landscape and important open problems.

  • Excitement to work in person in San Francisco, five days a week (with optional remote Saturdays), and thrive in a high-intensity, high-ownership environment.

Nice To Have

  • Experience on an industry post-training or frontier-model team.

  • Main authorship of publications at top-tier conferences (NeurIPS, ICML, ACL).

  • Experience with synthetic-data generation

  • Experience building large-scale evaluation or data-generation infrastructure.

  • Solid foundations in distributed or backend systems, and experimental design.

  • Familiarity with APIs, databases, and cloud infrastructure.

Benefits

  • Bi-annual performance bonus structure

  • Generous equity grant vested over 4 years

  • Up to $15k Relocation bonus

  • $10K housing bonus (if you live within 0.5 miles of our office)

  • $1.5K monthly stipend for meals

  • Free Equinox membership

  • $200 monthly laundry reimbursement

  • $200 monthly personal wellness reimbursement

  • Health, Dental, Vision insurance

title: Director of Culture and Language
description:
The Tla’amin Nation is a modern, forward-thinking, self-governing nation located on the beautiful upper Sunshine Coast (qathet Region).


Position Summary

Job Type: Full-time, permanent

Hours of Work: 8:30AM – 4:30PM, Monday to Friday

Reports to: Chief Administrative Officer (CAO)

Department: Culture and Language


The Director of Culture and Language provides strategic leadership for the Tla’amin Nation’s culture, language, heritage, and protocol priorities. Working closely with Elders, cultural leaders, the Culture Committee, Executive Council, staff, and the Tla’amin administration, the Director provides trusted guidance on cultural practices, language use, protocol, and heritage.


The position brings together culture and protocol, ʔəms ʔayɛ, and language revitalization into a cohesive vision. The Director of Culture and Language provides leadership for departmental staff, budgets, strategic planning, programs, partnerships, and funding, ensuring Tla’amin teachings, practices, and language are upheld with integrity and actively carried forward across government, community life, and public-facing work.


Key Responsibilities

Performs all duties and responsibilities in accordance with Tla’amin policies, standards, practices and procedures as directed by the CAO. Maintains confidentiality as required pertaining to members, clients, employees and general matters of the Nation.


Leadership & Strategic Direction

  • Provides overall leadership for the Culture and Language Department, including staff, budgets, work plans, and priorities.
  • Develops and implements multi-year strategies and annual plans for culture, language, heritage, protocol, and ʔəms ʔayɛ.
  • Ensures alignment between cultural programming, language revitalization, museum development, and Tla’amin Nation priorities.
  • Provides supervision, direction, and support to department staff and oversees departmental resources.


Cultural Governance & Advisory

  • Supports the Tla’amin Culture Committee and provides senior advice to leadership on culture, protocol, heritage, and language.
  • Supports Executive Council, departments, and staff in applying Tla’amin teachings, practices, and protocols.
  • Ensures cultural integrity and appropriate protocols are maintained in major initiatives, projects, partnerships, and public-facing work.


Language Revitalization

  • Leads implementation of the five-year Tla’amin language strategy and annual work plans.
  • Provides oversight of language programs, resources, documentation, archiving, and learning opportunities.
  • Supports ʔayʔajuθəm programming in schools and the qaymɩxʷqɛnəmšt immersion program.
  • Develops adult language learning opportunities and partnerships, including with the University of Victoria.
  • Oversees the online Tla’amin dictionary and builds relationships with sister Nations and language organizations.


Living Museum – ʔəms ʔayɛ

  • Leads implementation of the five-year museum plan for ɬawšəs.
  • Provides strategic oversight of the Tla’amin Living Museum, including policies, programming, collections, exhibitions, and visitor experience.
  • Ensures museum activities reflect Tla’amin teachings, histories, perspectives, and lived practices and align with broader cultural and language priorities.


Community, Partnerships & Funding

  • Builds strong relationships with Elders, cultural leaders, knowledge holders, artists, Citizens, sister Nations, and community partners.
  • Represents Tla’amin Nation at cultural gatherings, forums, meetings, and Nation-to-Nation engagements.
  • Develops partnerships with educational institutions, government agencies, museums, language organizations, and other external partners.
  • Identifies and secures funding opportunities and oversees grants, budgets, reporting, and deliverables.
  • Supports evaluation, continuous improvement, and growth of culture, language, heritage, and community initiatives.
  • Performs other duties as assigned by the CAO.


Qualifications
Training, Education, Experience
• Post-secondary education in Indigenous studies, language revitalization, cultural resource management, museum studies, education, public administration, or a related field is preferred.
• Strong knowledge and demonstrated experience with Tla’amin culture, language, teachings, history, protocols, and governance.
• Demonstrated leadership experience, including strategic planning, program development, staff supervision, and budget management.
• Experience working with Elders, cultural leaders, knowledge holders, and community-led initiatives.
• Experience developing and managing cultural, language, heritage, education, museum, or community programs.
• Experience working in a First Nation government or Indigenous organization is preferred.
• Experience with language revitalization, cultural programming, museum or heritage development is an asset.
• Experience with grants, funding applications, partnerships, and reporting is an asset.
• Proficiency in ʔayʔajuθəm, spoken and/or written, is an asset.
• Ability to read and write International Phonetic Alphabet (IPA) is an asset.
• An equivalent combination of education, training, and experience will be considered.
• Acceptable Police Information Check with Vulnerable Sector Check prior to employment.

Knowledge, Skills, Abilities
• Strong knowledge and understanding of Tla’amin culture, language, teachings, values, history, governance, and protocols.
• Strong leadership, communication, relationship-building, and people-management skills.
• Ability to provide strategic direction while supporting effective day-to-day operations.
• Excellent organizational, project management, financial management, and problem-solving skills.
• Ability to manage multiple priorities, budgets, projects, deadlines, and partnerships.
• Strong written, verbal, facilitation, presentation, and public-speaking skills.
• Understanding of language revitalization, cultural programming, and/or museum and heritage practices.
• Ability to provide sound, culturally informed advice to leadership, departments, staff, and external partners.
• Ability to exercise sound judgment, discretion, diplomacy, and cultural sensitivity when working with cultural knowledge and community matters.
• Ability to work independently, take initiative, and recognize when consultation with Elders, cultural leaders, leadership, or community is required.
• Strong computer skills, including Microsoft Office 365 and relevant project management and database systems.
• Commitment to Tla’amin Nation self-determination, cultural continuity, language revitalization, intergenerational learning, and Nation-building.
• Strong cultural sensitivity and demonstrated respect for Tla’amin culture, traditions, values, teachings, and protocols.


Working Conditions
Work is performed primarily in an office environment. Occasional travel to attend meetings, cultural gatherings, training, conferences, or community events is required. Occasional flexibility outside regular working hours may be required to support approved cultural activities, meetings, or events.


How to Apply
Please apply online by sending your resume and cover letter to:


OR drop-off/mail to Attention: Human Resources Department, Tla’amin Nation, 4779 Klahanie Rd, qathet, BC, V8A 0C4


This posting will be open until filled.

Preference may be given to qualified Tla’amin citizens, qualified Indigenous applicants, and applicants with experience working in First Nations, modern treaty, or self-governing Indigenous government environments.


*We thank all applicants for their interest, however only those shortlisted will be contacted.

title: Mechanical Technician - Junior Level (NASA Ballon Program)
description:
Responsibilities

Peraton provides management and technical support for NASA’s scientific balloon program which supports enabling science missions for NASA and universities across the United States and foreign scientific communities. Scientific balloon missions provide researchers inexpensive, relatively quick, long duration access to near space altitudes and environments. Balloon missions cost orders of magnitude less than satellite missions and provide platforms for heavy experiments (some greater than 5000-lbs) to operate for weeks and even months. Balloon missions have provided significant science theories and discoveries about cosmic rays, gamma ray and x-ray astronomy, optical and UV astronomy, atmospheric sciences, and cosmic microwave background studies.

Our staff are located at the Columbia Scientific Balloon Facility (CSBF) in Palestine, TX where we design, analyze, build and assembly the support hardware and balloon gondola payloads for the missions. We launch the balloons from locations within the United States (Texas, New Mexico, and Hawaii) and around the world including Antarctica, Sweden, New Zealand, and Australia. Our engineers and technician staff support the launches and balloon and payload recoveries in the US and many worldwide locations. Peraton’s NASA Balloon Operations Contract (NBOC) program is seeking an Engineering Technician to join our team in Palestine, Texas.

Our rural campus offers the ability to work in a low-cost of living area, but within an easy drive of Tyler, Dallas and Houston.

Responsibilities of the position:

  • Assists in fabrication, installation and testing of mechanical units, systems, sub-systems or models from specific drawings and schematic diagrams.
  • Operates standard test equipment and instruments and records data.
  • Performs preventative maintenance of light vehicles and equipment, documents and files records for same.
  • Operates applicable equipment and performs functions to assist with the launch and recovery of scientific payloads and balloons.

Supports field operations which could require travel for periods up to eight weeks or more several times a year both in the United States and overseas.

Specific Requirements / Licensing Special Requirements:

  • Must be able to travel to support campaigns in various locations around the world
  • Up to 60% travel per year
  • Must have or be able to obtain a passport
  • Ability to pass the National Science Foundation physical (Medical) requirement to work in Antarctica including latest FLU vaccinations required to qualify.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications:

  • High School diploma or GED certificate.
  • Two years of related experience mechanical experience
  • Equivalency – Completion of post-secondary degree or certificate may substitute for years of experience.
  • Certifications/License – Must possess or have the ability to obtain a Commercial Driver’s License (CDL) within 3 years of employment.
  • Must be a US Citizen
  • Must be able to pass a background check to obtain a NASA Personal Identity Verification card (PIV) background check and drug screen required.

Desired Qualifications:

  • Knowledge/experience with stick and heli-arc welding desired.
  • Knowledge with machine shop tools and machines desired.
  • Knowledge/experience with forklift and heavy equipment operation desired.
  • Knowledge of methods and techniques involved with assembly and testing of mechanical hardware.
  • Knowledge of basic mechanical theory and application.

Peraton Overview

Peraton is a next-generation national security company that drives missions of consequence spanning the globe and extending to the farthest reaches of the galaxy. As the world’s leading mission capability integrator and transformative enterprise IT provider, we deliver trusted, highly differentiated solutions and technologies to protect our nation and allies. Peraton operates at the critical nexus between traditional and nontraditional threats across all domains: land, sea, space, air, and cyberspace. The company serves as a valued partner to essential government agencies and supports every branch of the U.S. armed forces. Each day, our employees do the can’t be done by solving the most daunting challenges facing our customers. Visit peraton.com to learn how we’re keeping people around the world safe and secure.

title: Sr Total Rewards Analyst
description:
Overview

Position Summary:

The Sr. Total Rewards Analyst supports the design, analysis, governance, and communication of Mercury’s compensation and benefits programs. This role is primarily focused on compensation, representing approximately 60% of the position, with approximately 40% focused on benefits strategy, program evaluation, governance, and communications. The analyst uses data, sound judgment, and business partnership to help ensure programs are equitable, competitive, compliant, and aligned with Mercury’s business and talent priorities.

A significant portion of the role will support Mercury’s current career architecture project underway. The Sr. Total Rewards Analyst will analyze job and compensation data, assess implications for pay structures and processes, weigh in on design decisions, and provide informed recommendations to support alignment between career architecture and compensation.The role partners with HR Business Partners, Talent Acquisition, Finance, Payroll, HRIS, benefits consultants, vendors, and business leaders. Success requires strong analytical skills, attention to detail, effective communication, discretion with confidential information, and the ability to translate complex Total Rewards topics into practical recommendations.

$83,670 to $161,815 (NJ, NY, WA, HI, AK, MD, CT, RI, MA)

$76,064 to $147,104 (NV, OR, AZ, CO, WY, TX, ND, MN, MO, IL, WI, FL, GA, MI, OH, VA, PA, DE, VT, NH, ME)

$68,457 to $132,394 (UT, ID, MT, NM, SD, NE, KS, OK, IA, AR, LA, MS, AL, TN, KY, IN, SC, NC, WV)

Compensation Strategy & Analytics

  • Support annual compensation planning, incentive processes, offer reviews, promotions, transfers, and other pay decisions.
  • Maintain compensation structures, job data, range information, and related documentation in partnership with Total Rewards and HRIS teams.

Career Architecture Project

  • Play a significant role in Mercury’s current career architecture project underway.
  • Analyze job and compensation data and assess how proposed job families, sub-families, levels, and role placement may affect pay structures, internal equity, and compensation processes.
  • Weigh in on design decisions, identify compensation-related risks and opportunities, and provide data-driven recommendations.
  • Support job data alignment, documentation, stakeholder coordination, communications, and integration with compensation processes.

Benefits Strategy & Governance

  • Support the strategy, governance, and ongoing evaluation of health and welfare, 401k/retirement, time-off, and other employee benefit programs.
  • Analyze participation, utilization, cost, vendor performance, and employee experience data to inform recommendations.
  • Partner with benefits consultants, carriers, vendors, HRIS, Payroll, and internal stakeholders to evaluate program performance, resolve issues, and support effective delivery.
  • Support annual enrollment strategy and other benefits communications by developing and reviewing content for accuracy, clarity, and compliance.
  • Analyze audit results, issue patterns, and plan information to identify risks and opportunities for improvement; direct administrative matters to the appropriate operational owner.

Business Partnership & Advisory

  • Provide clear, practical guidance to HR Business Partners, Talent Acquisition, managers, employees, and business leaders on compensation and benefits topics.

  • Protect confidential employee and company information and exercise sound judgment when handling sensitive data.

  • Document processes, identify control points, and recommend improvements that strengthen accuracy and scalability.
  • Manage multiple priorities, deadlines, and projects with limited supervision.

AI, Automation & Responsible Innovation

  • Identify and responsibly use AI-enabled tools to improve Total Rewards analysis, reporting, documentation, and decision support while protecting confidential information and validating results.

Minimum:

Preferred:

Experience:

  • Minimum of 5 years of progressive experience in compensation, benefits, HR analytics, or Total Rewards, with compensation as the primary area of expertise and meaningful experience supporting benefits programs.
  • Experience with market pricing, compensation structures, annual compensation planning, pay equity, job data, and compensation analysis.
  • Experience evaluating benefits programs, analyzing plan or vendor data, and supporting benefits strategy or communications without direct responsibility for benefits administration.
  • Experience supporting enterprise HR initiatives, job architecture, HR technology, or other cross-functional projects is preferred.

Knowledge and Skills:

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to interpret data and translate findings into practical recommendations.

title: Senior Systems Engineer – GNC & Flight Controls
description:
Pivotal is the leader in the emerging market of electric Vertical Takeoff and Landing (eVTOL) aircraft. We design, develop, and manufacture light eVTOL aircraft and are renowned for the BlackFly aircraft the world's first light eVTOL to fly manned missions and enter the consumer market.
Efficient, compact, and simple, Pivotal aircraft are designed for a wide range of consumer, public service, and defense applications. Our distinctive tilt-aircraft architecture and scalable platform have been flying for over 10 years. Last year we announced our next-generation aircraft, the Helix, which is rapidly progressing toward general release and scalable production in 2026.
Mobility is one of the most highly-valued areas of modern technology investments. This is the right company, in the right space, the right strategy, at the right time. If you are ready for adventure, we invite you to join our amazing team and grow with us.

About the Job

Pivotal is the leader in the emerging market of electric Vertical Takeoff and Landing (eVTOL) aircraft. We design, develop, and manufacture light eVTOL aircraft for personal, public service, and defense applications.

Pivotal is seeking a Systems Engineer – GNC & Flight Controls to support requirements development, system integration, and Verification & Validation (V&V) of our aircraft guidance, navigation, control, and flight-control systems.

This is a Systems Engineering role focused on translating aircraft-level needs into clear, testable system and subsystem requirements and ensuring those requirements are verified through analysis, simulation, bench testing, SIL/HIL, ground test, and flight test.
The successful candidate will have strong Systems Engineering fundamentals along with enough technical depth in GNC, controls, embedded software, or autonomous vehicles to work directly with the engineers designing and implementing these systems. This is not primarily a modeling or simulation-development position; the focus is requirements quality, interfaces, traceability, verification, and system-level technical closure.

Responsibilities

  • Develop, decompose, allocate, and maintain aircraft and subsystem requirements for Guidance, Navigation & Control (GNC), flight controls, estimation, sensing, and related embedded software functions.
  • Own requirements and verification artifacts in Jama, including traceability, relationships, baselines, change management, verification methods, and objective evidence.
  • Translate aircraft-level behavior and safety needs into clear, measurable, testable requirements for GNC, embedded software, sensors, actuators, and supporting hardware.
  • Work directly with GNC and software engineers to ensure requirements accurately capture intended control-law behavior, operating envelopes, modes, transitions, fault responses, degraded operation, and system interfaces.
  • Develop and maintain Verification & Validation plans, verification matrices, test requirements, procedures, and reports.
  • Define appropriate verification methods including analysis, inspection, simulation, Software-in-the-Loop (SIL), Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL), bench testing, ground testing, UAV flight testing, and crewed flight testing.
  • Review verification results and objective evidence and drive requirements to formal verification closure.
  • Maintain bidirectional traceability from stakeholder and aircraft-level requirements through subsystem/software requirements, implementation, verification activities, and test evidence.
  • Support definition and management of interfaces between GNC, flight-control software, sensors, actuators, flight computers, electrical systems, aircraft dynamics, and other subsystems.
  • Partner with GNC engineers to review MATLAB/Simulink models, control architectures, state machines, mode logic, and simulation results from a Systems Engineering and requirements perspective.
  • Review software implementation and development artifacts sufficiently to confirm requirements intent and traceability, including working with Git-based repositories and C/C++ and Python code.
  • Participate in requirements and design reviews including SRR, CoDR, PDR, CDR, TRR, and aircraft or flight-readiness reviews.
  • Support system-level integration, aircraft bring-up, anomaly investigation, requirements clarification, and root-cause activities.
  • Identify gaps, inconsistencies, unverified assumptions, and ambiguous requirements before they become integration or flight-test issues.
  • Work cross-functionally with GNC, embedded software, electrical, aeromechanical, autonomy, flight test, safety, and program teams to resolve multidisciplinary technical issues.
  • Contribute to practical Systems Engineering processes that provide appropriate rigor and traceability without creating unnecessary development overhead.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in Aerospace Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Systems Engineering, Robotics, or a related technical discipline.
  • 5+ years of experience developing complex aerospace, automotive, robotics, autonomous, or other safety-critical electromechanical systems.
  • Strong experience with requirements engineering, including requirements definition, decomposition, allocation, traceability, interface definition, change management, and verification closure.
  • Demonstrated experience developing and executing Verification & Validation activities for complex hardware/software systems.
  • Experience using Jama or a comparable requirements-management environment such as DOORS, Polarion, or Codebeamer; Jama experience strongly preferred.
  • Technical experience with Guidance, Navigation & Control, flight controls, controls engineering, vehicle dynamics, state estimation, autonomous systems, or closely related systems.
  • Working knowledge of MATLAB and Simulink, including the ability to understand control models, signal flows, state machines, simulation results, and model-to-requirement relationships.
  • Ability to read and understand embedded software sufficiently to work effectively with implementation teams, including familiarity with C/C++, Python, Git, and software development workflows.
  • Experience defining verification methods and evaluating objective evidence from SIL, HIL, simulation, bench, vehicle, or flight testing.
  • Strong analytical skills and the ability to translate complex system behavior into clear, testable engineering requirements.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with demonstrated ability to work across hardware, software, controls, and test organizations.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Aerospace experience involving flight-control systems, GNC, avionics, autonomous aircraft, UAVs, spacecraft, or other flight-critical systems.
  • Experience with DO-178C software development and verification processes.
  • Familiarity with DO-331 model-based development and verification using MATLAB/Simulink.
  • Familiarity with ARP4754A/ARP4754B, ARP4761, system safety assessments, functional hazard analysis, or other structured aerospace development processes.
  • Experience with ISO 26262 functional safety for automotive systems.
  • Familiarity with ISO 21448 / SOTIF, Automotive SPICE, UL 4600, or other autonomous-vehicle and safety-critical development frameworks.
  • Experience defining and verifying failure behavior, degraded modes, redundancy, monitoring, fault detection, and fault response.
  • Experience with requirements-based testing of control laws, estimators, navigation systems, sensors, actuator-control systems, or autonomous vehicle functions.
  • Experience with SIL/HIL environments, automated regression testing, test scripting, data analysis, and requirements-driven test coverage.
  • Familiarity with configuration management, software baselines, release processes, CI/CD, Jira, and GitLab.
  • Experience supporting ground or flight-test programs and investigating discrepancies between predicted and actual vehicle behavior.

Attributes aligned with Core Values

  • Safety Above All: Demonstrates a proactive safety mindset by embedding safety into daily work, identifying and mitigating risks, encouraging open dialogue about safety concerns, and continuously improving practices and protocols.
  • Customer Focus: Puts customers at the center of every action by understanding their challenges, delivering meaningful value, and supporting their success.
  • Work Better Together: Seeks and values diverse perspectives, builds cross-functional relationships, and fosters trust through empathetic, fact-based communication and commitment to shared decisions.
  • Be the Pilot: Drives results with clarity and purpose by focusing on what matters most, adapting to change, taking initiative, and owning outcomes.
  • Embrace the Unknown: Navigates ambiguity with resilience and bold thinking, challenges the status quo, and combines innovative ideas with practical approaches to overcome obstacles and drive progress.
  • Respect for People: Fosters a high-performance culture grounded in respect, professionalism, and support by balancing high expectations with a healthy, collaborative environment and being a trusted, dependable teammate.
